text_en: In the beginning was the Word : and the Word was with God : and the Word was God .
text_la: In principio erat Verbum, et Verbum erat apud Deum, et Deus erat Verbum.
text_pt: No princípio era o Verbo, e o Verbo estava com Deus, e o Verbo era Deus.
text_el: Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἦν ὁ λόγος, καὶ ὁ λόγος ἦν πρὸς τὸν θεόν, καὶ θεὸς ἦν ὁ λόγος.

text_en: The same was in the beginning with God .
text_la: Hoc erat in principio apud Deum.
text_pt: Ele estava no princípio com Deus.
text_el: οὗτος ἦν ἐν ἀρχῇ πρὸς τὸν θεόν.

text_en: All things were made by him: and without him was made nothing that was made.
text_la: Omnia per ipsum facta sunt : et sine ipso factum est nihil, quod factum est.
text_pt: Todas as coisas foram feitas por ele, e sem ele nada do que foi feito se fez.
text_el: πάντα δι' αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο, καὶ χωρὶς αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο οὐδὲ ἕν ὃ γέγονεν

text_en: In him was life: and the life was the light of men .
text_la: In ipso vita erat, et vita erat lux hominum :
text_pt: Nele estava a vida, e a vida era a luz dos homens.
text_el: ἐν αὐτῷ ζωὴ ἦν, καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ἦν τὸ φῶς τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: And the light shines in darkness: and the darkness did not comprehend it.
text_la: et lux in tenebris lucet, et tenebræ eam non comprehenderunt.
text_pt: E a luz resplandece nas trevas, e as trevas não a compreenderam.
text_el: καὶ τὸ φῶς ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ φαίνει, καὶ ἡ σκοτία αὐτὸ οὐ κατέλαβεν.

text_en: There was a man sent from God , whose name was John .
text_la: Fuit homo missus a Deo, cui nomen erat Joannes.
text_pt: Houve um homem enviado de Deus, cujo nome era João.
text_el: Ἐγένετο ἄνθρωπος, ἀπεσταλμένος παρὰ θεοῦ, ὄνομα αὐτῷ Ἰωάννης:

text_en: This man came for a witness , to give testimony of the light, that all men might believe through him.
text_la: Hic venit in testimonium ut testimonium perhiberet de lumine, ut omnes crederent per illum.
text_pt: Este veio para testemunho, para que testificasse da luz, para que todos cressem por ele.
text_el: οὗτος ἦλθεν εἰς μαρτυρίαν, ἵνα μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ φωτός, ἵνα πάντες πιστεύσωσιν δι' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: He was not the light, but was to give testimony of the light.
text_la: Non erat ille lux, sed ut testimonium perhiberet de lumine.
text_pt: Não era ele a luz, mas para que testificasse da luz.
text_el: οὐκ ἦν ἐκεῖνος τὸ φῶς, ἀλλ' ἵνα μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ φωτός.

text_en: That was the true light, which enlightens every man that comes into this world.
text_la: Erat lux vera, quæ illuminat omnem hominem venientem in hunc mundum.
text_pt: Ali estava a luz verdadeira, que ilumina a todo o homem que vem ao mundo.
text_el: Ἦν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν, ὃ φωτίζει πάντα ἄνθρωπον, ἐρχόμενον εἰς τὸν κόσμον.

text_en: He was in the world: and the world was made by him: and the world knew him not.
text_la: In mundo erat, et mundus per ipsum factus est, et mundus eum non cognovit.
text_pt: Estava no mundo, e o mundo foi feito por ele, e o mundo não o conheceu.
text_el: ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἦν, καὶ ὁ κόσμος δι' αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο, καὶ ὁ κόσμος αὐτὸν οὐκ ἔγνω.

text_en: He came unto his own: and his own received him not.
text_la: In propria venit, et sui eum non receperunt.
text_pt: Veio para o que era seu, e os seus não o receberam.
text_el: εἰς τὰ ἴδια ἦλθεν, καὶ οἱ ἴδιοι αὐτὸν οὐ παρέλαβον.

text_en: But as many as received him, he gave them power to be made the sons of God , to them that believe in his name .
text_la: Quotquot autem receperunt eum, dedit eis potestatem filios Dei fieri, his qui credunt in nomine ejus :
text_pt: Mas, a todos quantos o receberam, deu-lhes o poder de serem feitos filhos de Deus, aos que crêem no seu nome;
text_el: ὅσοι δὲ ἔλαβον αὐτόν, ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν τέκνα θεοῦ γενέσθαι, τοῖς πιστεύουσιν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ,

text_en: Who are born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man , but of God .
text_la: qui non ex sanguinibus, neque ex voluntate carnis, neque ex voluntate viri, sed ex Deo nati sunt.
text_pt: Os quais não nasceram do sangue, nem da vontade da carne, nem da vontade do homem, mas de Deus.
text_el: οἳ οὐκ ἐξ αἱμάτων οὐδὲ ἐκ θελήματος σαρκὸς οὐδὲ ἐκ θελήματος ἀνδρὸς ἀλλ' ἐκ θεοῦ ἐγεννήθησαν.

text_en: And the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us (and we saw his glory , the glory as it were of the only begotten of the Father ), full of grace and truth .
text_la: Et Verbum caro factum est, et habitavit in nobis : et vidimus gloriam ejus, gloriam quasi unigeniti a Patre plenum gratiæ et veritatis.
text_pt: E o Verbo se fez carne, e habitou entre nós, e vimos a sua glória, como a glória do unigênito do Pai, cheio de graça e de verdade.
text_el: καὶ ὁ λόγος σὰρξ ἐγένετο καὶ ἐσκήνωσεν ἐν ἡμῖν, καὶ ἐθεασάμεθα τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ, δόξαν ὡς μονογενοῦς παρὰ πατρός, πλήρης χάριτος καὶ ἀληθείας.

text_en: John bears witness of him and cries out, saying: This was he of whom I spoke: He that shall come after me is preferred before me: because he was before me.
text_la: Joannes testimonium perhibet de ipso, et clamat dicens : Hic erat quem dixi : Qui post me venturus est, ante me factus est : quia prior me erat.
text_pt: João testificou dele, e clamou, dizendo: Este era aquele de quem eu dizia: O que vem após mim é antes de mim, porque foi primeiro do que eu.
text_el: Ἰωάννης μαρτυρεῖ περὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ κέκραγεν λέγων: οὗτος ἦν ὁ εἰπών: ὁ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος ἔμπροσθέν μου γέγονεν, ὅτι πρῶτός μου ἦν.

text_en: And of his fullness we all have received: and grace for grace .
text_la: Et de plenitudine ejus nos omnes accepimus, et gratiam pro gratia :
text_pt: E todos nós recebemos também da sua plenitude, e graça por graça.
text_el: ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ πληρώματος αὐτοῦ ἡμεῖς πάντες ἐλάβομεν, καὶ χάριν ἀντὶ χάριτος:

text_en: For the law was given by Moses : grace and truth came by Jesus Christ .
text_la: quia lex per Moysen data est, gratia et veritas per Jesum Christum facta est.
text_pt: Porque a lei foi dada por Moisés; a graça e a verdade vieram por Jesus Cristo.
text_el: ὅτι ὁ νόμος διὰ Μωϋσέως ἐδόθη, ἡ χάρις καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐγένετο.

text_en: No man has seen God at any time: the only begotten Son who is in the Bosom of the Father , he has declared him.
text_la: Deum nemo vidit umquam : unigenitus Filius, qui est in sinu Patris, ipse enarravit.
text_pt: Deus nunca foi visto por alguém. O Filho unigênito, que está no seio do Pai, esse o revelou.
text_el: θεὸν οὐδεὶς ἑώρακεν πώποτε: μονογενὴς θεὸς ὁ ὢν εἰς τὸν κόλπον τοῦ πατρὸς, ἐκεῖνος ἐξηγήσατο.

text_en: And this is the testimony of John , when the Jews sent from Jerusalem priests and Levites to him, to ask him: Who are you?
text_la: Et hoc est testimonium Joannis, quando miserunt Judæi ab Jerosolymis sacerdotes et Levitas ad eum ut interrogarent eum : Tu quis es?
text_pt: E este é o testemunho de João, quando os judeus mandaram de Jerusalém sacerdotes e levitas para que lhe perguntassem: Quem és tu?
text_el: Καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ Ἰωάννου, ὅτε ἀπέστειλαν πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐξ Ἱεροσολύμων ἱερεῖς καὶ Λευίτας ἵνα ἐρωτήσωσιν αὐτόν: σὺ τίς εἶ;

text_en: And he confessed and did not deny: and he confessed: I am not the Christ .
text_la: Et confessus est, et non negavit, et confessus est : Quia non sum ego Christus.
text_pt: E confessou, e não negou; confessou: Eu não sou o Cristo.
text_el: καὶ ὡμολόγησεν καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσατο, καὶ ὡμολόγησεν ὅτι ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ὁ Χριστός.

text_en: And they asked him: What then? Are you Elias ? And he said: I am not. Are you the prophet ? And he answered: No.
text_la: Et interrogaverunt eum : Quid ergo? Elias es tu? Et dixit : Non sum. Propheta es tu? Et respondit : Non.
text_pt: E perguntaram-lhe: Então quê? És tu Elias? E disse: Não sou. És tu profeta? E respondeu: Não.
text_el: καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτόν: Τί οὖν; [σύ] Ἠλίας εἶ; καὶ λέγει: οὐκ εἰμί. ὁ προφήτης εἶ σύ; καὶ ἀπεκρίθη: οὔ.

text_en: They said therefore unto him: Who are you, that we may give an answer to them that sent us? What do you say of yourself?
text_la: Dixerunt ergo ei : Quis es ut responsum demus his qui miserunt nos? quid dicis de teipso?
text_pt: Disseram-lhe pois: Quem és? para que demos resposta àqueles que nos enviaram; que dizes de ti mesmo?
text_el: εἶπαν οὖν αὐτῷ: τίς εἶ; ἵνα ἀπόκρισιν δῶμεν τοῖς πέμψασιν ἡμᾶς: τί λέγεις περὶ σεαυτοῦ;

text_en: He said: I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness , make straight the way of the Lord , as said the prophet Isaias .
text_la: Ait : Ego vox clamantis in deserto : Dirigite viam Domini, sicut dixit Isaias propheta.
text_pt: Disse: Eu sou a voz do que clama no deserto: Endireitai o caminho do Senhor, como disse o profeta Isaías.
text_el: ἔφη: ἐγὼ φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ: εὐθύνατε τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου, καθὼς εἶπεν Ἠσαΐας ὁ προφήτης.

text_en: And they that were sent were of the Pharisees .
text_la: Et qui missi fuerant, erant ex pharisæis.
text_pt: E os que tinham sido enviados eram dos fariseus.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεσταλμένοι ἦσαν ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων.

text_en: And they asked him and said to him: Why then do you baptize , if you be not Christ , nor Elias , nor the prophet ?
text_la: Et interrogaverunt eum, et dixerunt ei : Quid ergo baptizas, si tu non es Christus, neque Elias, neque propheta?
text_pt: E perguntaram-lhe, e disseram-lhe: Por que batizas, pois, se tu não és o Cristo, nem Elias, nem o profeta?
text_el: καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: τί οὖν βαπτίζεις, εἰ σὺ οὐκ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐδὲ Ἠλίας οὐδὲ ὁ προφήτης;

text_en: John answered them, saying: I baptize with water: but there has stood one in the midst of you, whom you know not.
text_la: Respondit eis Joannes, dicens : Ego baptizo in aqua : medius autem vestrum stetit, quem vos nescitis.
text_pt: João respondeu-lhes, dizendo: Eu batizo com água; mas no meio devós está um a quem vós não conheceis.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰωάννης λέγων: ἐγὼ βαπτίζω ἐν ὕδατι: μέσος ὑμῶν στήκει, ὃν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε,

text_en: The same is he that shall come after me, who is preferred before me: the latchet of whose shoe I am not worthy to loose.
text_la: Ipse est qui post me venturus est, qui ante me factus est : cujus ego non sum dignus ut solvam ejus corrigiam calceamenti.
text_pt: Este é aquele que vem após mim, que é antes de mim, do qual eu não sou digno de desatar a correia da alparca.
text_el: ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ [ἐγὼ] ἄξιος ἵνα λύσω αὐτοῦ τὸν ἱμάντα τοῦ ὑποδήματος.

text_en: These things were done in Bethania, beyond the Jordan , where John was baptizing .
text_la: Hæc in Bethania facta sunt trans Jordanem, ubi erat Joannes baptizans.
text_pt: Estas coisas aconteceram em Betabara, do outro lado do Jordão, onde João estava batizando.
text_el: Ταῦτα ἐν Βηθανίᾳ ἐγένετο πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, ὅπου ἦν ὁ Ἰωάννης βαπτίζων.

text_en: The next day, John saw Jesus coming to him; and he says: Behold the Lamb of God . Behold him who takes away the sin of the world.
text_la: Altera die vidit Joannes Jesum venientem ad se, et ait : Ecce agnus Dei, ecce qui tollit peccatum mundi.
text_pt: No dia seguinte João viu a Jesus, que vinha para ele, e disse: Eis o Cordeiro de Deus, que tira o pecado do mundo.
text_el: Τῇ ἐπαύριον βλέπει τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐρχόμενον πρὸς αὐτόν, καὶ λέγει: ἴδε ὁ ἀμνὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ὁ αἴρων τὴν ἁμαρτίαν τοῦ κόσμου.

text_en: This is he of whom I said: After me there comes a man , who is preferred before me: because he was before me.
text_la: Hic est de quo dixi : Post me venit vir qui ante me factus est : quia prior me erat:
text_pt: Este é aquele do qual eu disse: Após mim vem um homem que é antes de mim, porque foi primeiro do que eu.
text_el: οὗτός ἐστιν ὑπὲρ οὗ ἐγὼ εἶπον: ὀπίσω μου ἔρχεται ἀνὴρ ὃς ἔμπροσθέν μου γέγονεν, ὅτι πρῶτός μου ἦν.

text_en: And I knew him not: but that he may be made manifest in Israel , therefore am I come baptizing with water.
text_la: et ego nesciebam eum, sed ut manifestetur in Israël, propterea veni ego in aqua baptizans.
text_pt: E eu não o conhecia; mas, para que ele fosse manifestado a Israel, vim eu, por isso, batizando com água.
text_el: κἀγὼ οὐκ ᾔδειν αὐτόν, ἀλλ' ἵνα φανερωθῇ τῷ Ἰσραὴλ, διὰ τοῦτο ἦλθον ἐγὼ ἐν ὕδατι βαπτίζων.

text_en: And John gave testimony, saying: I saw the Spirit coming down, as a dove from heaven ; and he remained upon him.
text_la: Et testimonium perhibuit Joannes, dicens : Quia vidi Spiritum descendentem quasi columbam de cælo, et mansit super eum.
text_pt: E João testificou, dizendo: Eu vi o Espírito descer do céu como pomba, e repousar sobre ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐμαρτύρησεν Ἰωάννης λέγων ὅτι τεθέαμαι τὸ πνεῦμα καταβαῖνον ὡς περιστερὰν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐπ' αὐτόν.

text_en: And I knew him not: but he who sent me to baptize with water said to me: He upon whom you shall see the Spirit descending and remaining upon him, he it is that baptizes with the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Et ego nesciebam eum : sed qui misit me baptizare in aqua, ille mihi dixit : Super quem videris Spiritum descendentem, et manentem super eum, hic est qui baptizat in Spiritu Sancto.
text_pt: E eu não o conhecia, mas o que me mandou a batizar com água, esse me disse: Sobre aquele que vires descer o Espírito, e sobre ele repousar, esse é o que batiza com o Espírito Santo.
text_el: κἀγὼ οὐκ ᾔδειν αὐτόν, ἀλλ' ὁ πέμψας με βαπτίζειν ἐν ὕδατι, ἐκεῖνός μοι εἶπεν: ἐφ' ὃν ἂν ἴδῃς τὸ πνεῦμα καταβαῖνον καὶ μένον ἐπ' αὐτόν, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ βαπτίζων ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ.

text_en: And I saw: and I gave testimony that this is the Son of God .
text_la: Et ego vidi : et testimonium perhibui quia hic est Filius Dei.
text_pt: E eu vi, e tenho testificado que este é o Filho de Deus.
text_el: κἀγὼ ἑώρακα, καὶ μεμαρτύρηκα ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: The next day again John stood and two of his disciples .
text_la: Altera die iterum stabat Joannes, et ex discipulis ejus duo.
text_pt: No dia seguinte João estava outra vez ali, e dois dos seus discípulos;
text_el: Τῇ ἐπαύριον πάλιν εἱστήκει Ἰωάννης καὶ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ δύο,

text_en: And beholding Jesus walking, he says: Behold the Lamb of God .
text_la: Et respiciens Jesum ambulantem, dicit : Ecce agnus Dei.
text_pt: E, vendo passar a Jesus, disse: Eis aqui o Cordeiro de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐμβλέψας τῷ Ἰησοῦ περιπατοῦντι λέγει: ἴδε ὁ ἀμνὸς τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And the two disciples heard him speak: and they followed Jesus .
text_la: Et audierunt eum duo discipuli loquentem, et secuti sunt Jesum.
text_pt: E os dois discípulos ouviram-no dizer isto, e seguiram a Jesus.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν. οἱ δύο μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος καὶ ἠκολούθησαν τῷ Ἰησοῦ:

text_en: And Jesus turning and seeing them following him, says to them: What seek you? Who said to him: Rabbi (which is to say, being interpreted, Master), where are you dwelling?
text_la: Conversus autem Jesus, et videns eos sequentes se, dicit eis : Quid quæritis? Qui dixerunt ei : Rabbi (quod dicitur interpretatum Magister), ubi habitas?
text_pt: E Jesus, voltando-se e vendo que eles o seguiam, disse-lhes: Que buscais? E eles disseram: Rabi (que, traduzido, quer dizer Mestre), onde moras?
text_el: στραφεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ θεασάμενος αὐτοὺς ἀκολουθοῦντας λέγει αὐτοῖς τί ζητεῖτε; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: ῥαββί, ὃ λέγεται μεθερμηνευόμενον διδάσκαλε, ποῦ μένεις;

text_en: He says to them: Come and see. They came and saw where he abode: and they stayed with him that day. Now it was about the tenth hour.
text_la: Dicit eis : Venite et videte. Venerunt, et viderunt ubi maneret, et apud eum manserunt die illo : hora autem erat quasi decima.
text_pt: Ele lhes disse: Vinde, e vede. Foram, e viram onde morava, e ficaram com ele aquele dia; e era já quase a hora décima.
text_el: λέγει αὐτοῖς: ἔρχεσθε καὶ ὄψεσθε. ἦλθαν οὖν καὶ εἶδαν ποῦ μένει, καὶ παρ' αὐτῷ ἔμειναν τὴν ἡμέραν ἐκείνην: ὥρα ἦν ὡς δεκάτη.

text_en: And Andrew , the brother of Simon Peter , was one of the two who had heard of John and followed him.
text_la: Erat autem Andreas, frater Simonis Petri, unus ex duobus qui audierant a Joanne, et secuti fuerant eum.
text_pt: Era André, irmão de Simão Pedro, um dos dois que ouviram aquilo de João, e o haviam seguido.
text_el: ἦν Ἀνδρέας ὁ ἀδελφὸς Σίμωνος Πέτρου εἷς ἐκ τῶν δύο τῶν ἀκουσάντων παρὰ Ἰωάννου καὶ ἀκολουθησάντων αὐτῷ:

text_en: He finds first his brother Simon and said to him: We have found the Messias , which is, being interpreted, the Christ .
text_la: Invenit hic primum fratrem suum Simonem, et dicit ei : Invenimus Messiam (quod est interpretatum Christus).
text_pt: Este achou primeiro a seu irmão Simão, e disse-lhe: Achamos o Messias (que, traduzido, é o Cristo).
text_el: εὑρίσκει οὗτος πρῶτον τὸν ἀδελφὸν τὸν ἴδιον Σίμωνα καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ: εὑρήκαμεν τὸν Μεσσίαν, ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Χριστός.

text_en: And he brought him to Jesus . And Jesus looking upon him, said: You are Simon the son of Jona. You shall be called Cephas, which is interpreted Peter .
text_la: Et adduxit eum ad Jesum. Intuitus autem eum Jesus, dixit : Tu es Simon, filius Jona; tu vocaberis Cephas, quod interpretatur Petrus.
text_pt: E levou-o a Jesus. E, olhando Jesus para ele, disse: Tu és Simão, filho de Jonas; tu serás chamado Cefas (que quer dizer Pedro).
text_el: ἤγαγεν αὐτὸν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν. ἐμβλέψας αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: σὺ εἶ Σίμων ὁ υἱὸς Ἰωάννου, σὺ κληθήσῃ Κηφᾶς, ὃ ἑρμηνεύεται Πέτρος.

text_en: On the following day, he would go forth into Galilee : and he finds Philip , And Jesus said to him: follow me.
text_la: In crastinum voluit exire in Galilæam, et invenit Philippum. Et dicit ei Jesus : Sequere me.
text_pt: No dia seguinte quis Jesus ir à Galiléia, e achou a Filipe, e disse-lhe: Segue-me.
text_el: Τῇ ἐπαύριον ἠθέλησεν ἐξελθεῖν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, καὶ εὑρίσκει Φίλιππον. καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, ἀκολούθει μοι.

text_en: Now Philip was of Bethsaida , the city of Andrew and Peter .
text_la: Erat autem Philippus a Bethsaida, civitate Andreæ et Petri.
text_pt: E Filipe era de Betsaida, cidade de André e de Pedro.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ὁ Φίλιππος ἀπὸ Βηθσαϊδά, ἐκ τῆς πόλεως Ἀνδρέου καὶ Πέτρου.

text_en: Philip finds Nathanael and said to him: We have found him of whom Moses , in the law and the prophets did write, Jesus the son of Joseph of Nazareth .
text_la: Invenit Philippus Nathanaël, et dicit ei : Quem scripsit Moyses in lege, et prophetæ, invenimus Jesum filium Joseph a Nazareth.
text_pt: Filipe achou Natanael, e disse-lhe: Havemos achado aquele de quem Moisés escreveu na lei, e os profetas: Jesus de Nazaré, filho de José.
text_el: εὑρίσκει Φίλιππος τὸν Ναθαναὴλ καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ: ὃν ἔγραψεν Μωϋσῆς ἐν τῷ νόμῳ καὶ οἱ προφῆται, εὑρήκαμεν, Ἰησοῦν υἱὸν τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ τὸν ἀπὸ Ναζαρέτ.

text_en: And Nathanael said to him: Can anything of good come from Nazareth ? Philip said to him: Come and see.
text_la: Et dixit ei Nathanaël : A Nazareth potest aliquid boni esse? Dicit ei Philippus : Veni et vide.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Natanael: Pode vir alguma coisa boa de Nazaré? Disse-lhe Filipe: Vem, e vê.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ναθαναήλ: ἐκ Ναζαρὲτ δύναταί τι ἀγαθὸν εἶναι; λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Φίλιππος: ἔρχου καὶ ἴδε.

text_en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him and he says of him: Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom there is no guile.
text_la: Vidit Jesus Nathanaël venientem ad se, et dicit de eo : Ecce vere Israëlita, in quo dolus non est.
text_pt: Jesus viu Natanael vir ter com ele, e disse dele: Eis aqui um verdadeiro israelita, em quem não há dolo.
text_el: εἶδεν Ἰησοῦς τὸν Ναθαναὴλ ἐρχόμενον πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ λέγει περὶ αὐτοῦ: ἴδε ἀληθῶς Ἰσραηλίτης, ἐν ᾧ δόλος οὐκ ἔστιν.

text_en: Nathanael said to him: Whence do you know me? Jesus answered and said to him: Before that Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.
text_la: Dicit ei Nathanaël : Unde me nosti? Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei : Priusquam te Philippus vocavit, cum esses sub ficu, vidi te.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Natanael: De onde me conheces tu? Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Antes que Filipe te chamasse, te vi eu, estando tu debaixo da figueira.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ Ναθαναήλ: πόθεν με γινώσκεις; ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: πρὸ τοῦ σε Φίλιππον φωνῆσαι ὄντα ὑπὸ τὴν συκῆν εἶδόν σε.

text_en: Nathanael answered him and said: Rabbi : You are the Son of God . You are the King of Israel .
text_la: Respondit ei Nathanaël, et ait : Rabbi, tu es Filius Dei, tu es rex Israël.
text_pt: Natanael respondeu, e disse-lhe: Rabi, tu és o Filho de Deus; tu és o Rei de Israel.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ναθαναήλ: ῥαββί, σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ, σὺ βασιλεὺς εἶ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: Jesus answered and said to him: Because I said unto you, I saw you under the fig tree, you believe : greater things than these shall you see.
text_la: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei : Quia dixi tibi : Vidi te sub ficu, credis; majus his videbis.
text_pt: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Porque te disse: Vi-te debaixo da figueira, crês? Coisas maiores do que estas verás.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ὅτι εἶπόν σοι ὅτι εἶδόν σε ὑποκάτω τῆς συκῆς, πιστεύεις; μείζω τούτων ὄψῃ.

text_en: And he said to him: Amen , amen , I say to you, you shall see the heaven opened and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man .
text_la: Et dicit ei : Amen, amen dico vobis, videbitis cælum apertum, et angelos Dei ascendentes, et descendentes supra Filium hominis.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que daqui em diante vereis o céu aberto, e os anjos de Deus subindo e descendo sobre o Filho do homem.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὄψεσθε τὸν οὐρανὸν ἀνεῳγότα καὶ τοὺς ἀγγέλους τοῦ θεοῦ ἀναβαίνοντας καὶ καταβαίνοντας ἐπὶ τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

text_en: And the third day, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee : and the mother of Jesus was there.
text_la: Et die tertia nuptiæ factæ sunt in Cana Galilææ, et erat mater Jesu ibi.
text_pt: E, ao terceiro dia, fizeram-se umas bodas em Caná da Galiléia; e estava ali a mãe de Jesus.
text_el: Καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ γάμος ἐγένετο ἐν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, καὶ ἦν ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐκεῖ:

text_en: And Jesus also was invited, and his disciples , to the marriage .
text_la: Vocatus est autem et Jesus, et discipuli ejus, ad nuptias.
text_pt: E foi também convidado Jesus e os seus discípulos para as bodas.
text_el: ἐκλήθη δὲ καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν γάμον.

text_en: And the wine failing, the mother of Jesus said to him: They have no wine.
text_la: Et deficiente vino, dicit mater Jesu ad eum : Vinum non habent.
text_pt: E, faltando vinho, a mãe de Jesus lhe disse: Não têm vinho.
text_el: καὶ ὑστερήσαντος οἴνου λέγει ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ πρὸς αὐτόν: οἶνον οὐκ ἔχουσιν.

text_en: And Jesus says to her: Woman , what is that to me and to you? My hour is not yet come.
text_la: Et dicit ei Jesus : Quid mihi et tibi est, mulier? nondum venit hora mea.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Mulher, que tenho eu contigo? Ainda não é chegada a minha hora.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί, γύναι; οὔπω ἥκει ἡ ὥρα μου.

text_en: His mother says to the waiters: Whatsoever he shall say to you, do.
text_la: Dicit mater ejus ministris : Quodcumque dixerit vobis, facite.
text_pt: Sua mãe disse aos serventes: Fazei tudo quanto ele vos disser.
text_el: λέγει ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ τοῖς διακόνοις: ὅ τι ἂν λέγῃ ὑμῖν, ποιήσατε.

text_en: Now there were set there six waterpots of stone, according to the manner of the purifying of the Jews , containing two or three measures apiece.
text_la: Erant autem ibi lapideæ hydriæ sex positæ secundum purificationem Judæorum, capientes singulæ metretas binas vel ternas.
text_pt: E estavam ali postas seis talhas de pedra, para as purificações dos judeus, e em cada uma cabiam dois ou três almudes.
text_el: ἦσαν δὲ ἐκεῖ λίθιναι ὑδρίαι ἓξ κατὰ τὸν καθαρισμὸν τῶν Ἰουδαίων κείμεναι, χωροῦσαι ἀνὰ μετρητὰς δύο ἢ τρεῖς.

text_en: Jesus says to them: Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
text_la: Dicit eis Jesus : Implete hydrias aqua. Et impleverunt eas usque ad summum.
text_pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Enchei de água essas talhas. E encheram-nas até em cima.
text_el: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: γεμίσατε τὰς ὑδρίας ὕδατος. καὶ ἐγέμισαν αὐτὰς ἕως ἄνω.

text_en: And Jesus says to them: Draw out now and carry to the chief steward of the feast. And they carried it.
text_la: Et dicit eis Jesus : Haurite nunc, et ferte architriclino. Et tulerunt.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Tirai agora, e levai ao mestre-sala. E levaram.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: ἀντλήσατε νῦν καὶ φέρετε τῷ ἀρχιτρικλίνῳ. οἱ δὲ ἤνεγκαν.

text_en: And when the chief steward had tasted the water made wine and knew not whence it was, but the waiters knew who had drawn the water: the chief steward calls the bridegroom,
text_la: Ut autem gustavit architriclinus aquam vinum factam, et non sciebat unde esset, ministri autem sciebant, qui hauserant aquam : vocat sponsum architriclinus,
text_pt: E, logo que o mestre-sala provou a água feita vinho (não sabendo de onde viera, se bem que o sabiam os serventes que tinham tirado a água), chamou o mestre-sala ao esposo,
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐγεύσατο ὁ ἀρχιτρίκλινος τὸ ὕδωρ οἶνον γεγενημένον, καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει πόθεν ἐστίν, οἱ δὲ διάκονοι ᾔδεισαν οἱ ἠντληκότες τὸ ὕδωρ, φωνεῖ τὸν νυμφίον ὁ ἀρχιτρίκλινος

text_en: and said to him: Every man at first sets forth good wine, and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse. But you have kept the good wine until now.
text_la: et dicit ei : Omnis homo primum bonum vinum ponit et cum inebriati fuerint, tunc id, quod deterius est. Tu autem servasti bonum vinum usque adhuc.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Todo o homem põe primeiro o vinho bom e, quando já têm bebido bem, então o inferior; mas tu guardaste até agora o bom vinho.
text_el: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ: πᾶς ἄνθρωπος πρῶτον τὸν καλὸν οἶνον τίθησιν, καὶ ὅταν μεθυσθῶσιν τὸν ἐλάσσω: σὺ τετήρηκας τὸν καλὸν οἶνον ἕως ἄρτι.

text_en: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee and manifested his glory . And his disciples believed in him.
text_la: Hoc fecit initium signorum Jesus in Cana Galilææ; et manifestavit gloriam suam, et crediderunt in eum discipuli ejus.
text_pt: Jesus principiou assim os seus sinais em Caná da Galiléia, e manifestou a sua glória; e os seus discípulos creram nele.
text_el: ταύτην ἐποίησεν ἀρχὴν τῶν σημείων ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐφανέρωσεν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: After this, he went down to Capharnaum , he and his mother and his brethren and his disciples : and they remained there not many days.
text_la: Post hoc descendit Capharnaum ipse, et mater ejus, et fratres ejus, et discipuli ejus : et ibi manserunt non multis diebus.
text_pt: Depois disto desceu a Cafarnaum, ele, e sua mãe, e seus irmãos, e seus discípulos; e ficaram ali não muitos dias.
text_el: Μετὰ τοῦτο κατέβη εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐκεῖ ἔμειναν οὐ πολλὰς ἡμέρας.

text_en: And the pasch of the Jews was at hand: and Jesus went up to Jerusalem .
text_la: Et prope erat Pascha Judæorum, et ascendit Jesus Jerosolymam:
text_pt: E estava próxima a páscoa dos judeus, e Jesus subiu a Jerusalém.
text_el: Καὶ ἐγγὺς ἦν τὸ πάσχα τῶν Ἰουδαίων, καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ὁ Ἰησοῦς.

text_en: And he found in the temple them that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
text_la: et invenit in templo vendentes boves, et oves, et columbas, et numularios sedentes.
text_pt: E achou no templo os que vendiam bois, e ovelhas, e pombos, e os cambiadores assentados.
text_el: καὶ εὗρεν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ τοὺς πωλοῦντας βόας καὶ πρόβατα καὶ περιστερὰς καὶ τοὺς κερματιστὰς καθημένους,

text_en: And when he had made, as it were, a scourge of little cords, he drove them all out of the temple , the sheep also and the oxen: and the money of the changers he poured out, and the tables he overthrew.
text_la: Et cum fecisset quasi flagellum de funiculis, omnes ejecit de templo, oves quoque, et boves, et numulariorum effudit æs, et mensas subvertit.
text_pt: E tendo feito um azorrague de cordéis, lançou todos fora do templo, também os bois e ovelhas; e espalhou o dinheiro dos cambiadores, e derribou as mesas;
text_el: καὶ ποιήσας φραγέλλιον ἐκ σχοινίων πάντας ἐξέβαλεν ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ, τά τε πρόβατα καὶ τοὺς βόας, καὶ τῶν κολλυβιστῶν ἐξέχεεν τὰ κέρματα καὶ τὰς τραπέζας ἀνέτρεψεν,

text_en: And to them that sold doves he said: Take these things hence, and make not the house of my Father a house of traffic.
text_la: Et his qui columbas vendebant, dixit : Auferte ista hinc, et nolite facere domum patris mei, domum negotiationis.
text_pt: E disse aos que vendiam pombos: Tirai daqui estes, e não façais da casa de meu Pai casa de venda.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς τὰς περιστερὰς πωλοῦσιν εἶπεν: ἄρατε ταῦτα ἐντεῦθεν, μὴ ποιεῖτε τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός μου οἶκον ἐμπορίου.

text_en: And his disciples remembered, that it was written: The zeal of your house has eaten me up.
text_la: Recordati sunt vero discipuli ejus quia scriptum est: Zelus domus tuæ comedit me.
text_pt: E os seus discípulos lembraram-se do que está escrito: O zelo da tua casa me devorou.
text_el: ἐμνήσθησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι γεγραμμένον ἐστίν: ὁ ζῆλος τοῦ οἴκου σου καταφάγεταί με.

text_en: The Jews , therefore, answered, and said to him: What sign do you show unto us, seeing you do these things?
text_la: Responderunt ergo Judæi, et dixerunt ei : Quod signum ostendis nobis, quia hæc facis?
text_pt: Responderam, pois, os judeus, e disseram-lhe: Que sinal nos mostras para fazeres isto?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: τί σημεῖον δεικνύεις ἡμῖν, ὅτι ταῦτα ποιεῖς;

text_en: Jesus answered and said to them: Destroy this temple ; and in three days I will raise it up.
text_la: Respondit Jesus, et dixit eis : Solvite templum hoc, et in tribus diebus excitabo illud.
text_pt: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhes: Derribai este templo, e em três dias o levantarei.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: λύσατε τὸν ναὸν τοῦτον, καὶ [ἐν] τρισὶν ἡμέραις ἐγερῶ αὐτόν.

text_en: The Jews then said: Six and forty years was this temple in building; and will you raise it up in three days?
text_la: Dixerunt ergo Judæi : Quadraginta et sex annis ædificatum est templum hoc, et tu in tribus diebus excitabis illud?
text_pt: Disseram, pois, os judeus: Em quarenta e seis anos foi edificado este templo, e tu o levantarás em três dias?
text_el: εἶπαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι: τεσσεράκοντα καὶ ἓξ ἔτεσιν οἰκοδομήθη ὁ ναὸς οὗτος, καὶ σὺ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις ἐγερεῖς αὐτόν;

text_en: But he spoke of the temple of his body.
text_la: Ille autem dicebat de templo corporis sui.
text_pt: Mas ele falava do templo do seu corpo.
text_el: ἐκεῖνος δὲ ἔλεγεν περὶ τοῦ ναοῦ τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ.

text_en: When therefore he was risen again from the dead , his disciples remembered that he had said this: and they believed the scripture and the word that Jesus had said.
text_la: Cum ergo resurrexisset a mortuis, recordati sunt discipuli ejus, quia hoc dicebat, et crediderunt scripturæ et sermoni quem dixit Jesus.
text_pt: Quando, pois, ressuscitou dentre os mortos, os seus discípulos lembraram-se de que lhes dissera isto; e creram na Escritura, e na palavra que Jesus tinha dito.
text_el: ὅτε οὖν ἠγέρθη ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐμνήσθησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι τοῦτο ἔλεγεν, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν τῇ γραφῇ καὶ τῷ λόγῳ ὃν εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς.

text_en: Now when he was at Jerusalem , at the pasch , upon the festival day, many believed in his name , seeing his signs which he did.
text_la: Cum autem esset Jerosolymis in Pascha in die festo, multi crediderunt in nomine ejus, videntes signa ejus, quæ faciebat.
text_pt: E, estando ele em Jerusalém pela páscoa, durante a festa, muitos, vendo os sinais que fazia, creram no seu nome.
text_el: Ὡς δὲ ἦν ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν τῷ πάσχα ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ, πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, θεωροῦντες αὐτοῦ τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίει:

text_en: But Jesus did not trust himself unto them: for that he knew all men ,
text_la: Ipse autem Jesus non credebat semetipsum eis, eo quod ipse nosset omnes,
text_pt: Mas o mesmo Jesus não confiava neles, porque a todos conhecia;
text_el: αὐτὸς δὲ Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἐπίστευεν αὐτὸν αὐτοῖς διὰ τὸ αὐτὸν γινώσκειν πάντας,

text_en: and because he needed not that any should give testimony of man : for he knew what was in man .
text_la: et quia opus ei non erat ut quis testimonium perhiberet de homine : ipse enim sciebat quid esset in homine.
text_pt: E não necessitava de que alguém testificasse do homem, porque ele bem sabia o que havia no homem.
text_el: καὶ ὅτι οὐ χρείαν εἶχεν ἵνα τις μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου: αὐτὸς γὰρ ἐγίνωσκεν τί ἦν ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ.

text_en: And there was a man of the Pharisees , named Nicodemus , a ruler of the Jews .
text_la: Erat autem homo ex pharisæis, Nicodemus nomine, princeps Judæorum.
text_pt: E havia entre os fariseus um homem, chamado Nicodemos, príncipe dos judeus.
text_el: Ἦν δὲ ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων, Νικόδημος ὄνομα αὐτῷ, ἄρχων τῶν Ἰουδαίων:

text_en: This man came to Jesus by night and said to him: Rabbi , we know that you have come a teacher from God ; for no man can do these signs which you do, unless God be with him.
text_la: Hic venit ad Jesum nocte, et dixit ei : Rabbi, scimus quia a Deo venisti magister, nemo enim potest hæc signa facere, quæ tu facis, nisi fuerit Deus cum eo.
text_pt: Este foi ter de noite com Jesus, e disse-lhe: Rabi, bem sabemos que és Mestre, vindo de Deus; porque ninguém pode fazer estes sinais que tu fazes, se Deus não for com ele.
text_el: οὗτος ἦλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν νυκτὸς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ῥαββί, οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἐλήλυθας διδάσκαλος: οὐδεὶς γὰρ δύναται ταῦτα τὰ σημεῖα ποιεῖν ἃ σὺ ποιεῖς, ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ ὁ θεὸς μετ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Jesus answered and said to him: Amen , amen , I say to you, unless a man be born again , he cannot see the kingdom of God .
text_la: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei : Amen, amen dico tibi, nisi quis renatus fuerit denuo, non potest videre regnum Dei.
text_pt: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Na verdade, na verdade te digo que aquele que não nascer de novo, não pode ver o reino de Deus.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, ἐὰν μή τις γεννηθῇ ἄνωθεν, οὐ δύναται ἰδεῖν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: Nicodemus said to him: How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother's womb and be born again?
text_la: Dicit ad eum Nicodemus : Quomodo potest homo nasci, cum sit senex? numquid potest in ventrem matris suæ iterato introire et renasci?
text_pt: Disse-lhe Nicodemos: Como pode um homem nascer, sendo velho? Pode, porventura, tornar a entrar no ventre de sua mãe, e nascer?
text_el: λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Νικόδημος: πῶς δύναται ἄνθρωπος γεννηθῆναι γέρων ὤν; μὴ δύναται εἰς τὴν κοιλίαν τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ δεύτερον εἰσελθεῖν καὶ γεννηθῆναι;

text_en: Jesus answered: Amen , amen , I say to you, unless a man be born again of water and the Holy Ghost , he cannot enter into the kingdom of God .
text_la: Respondit Jesus : Amen, amen dico tibi, nisi quis renatus fuerit ex aqua, et Spiritu Sancto, non potest introire in regnum Dei.
text_pt: Jesus respondeu: Na verdade, na verdade te digo que aquele que não nascer da água e do Espírito, não pode entrar no reino de Deus.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, ἐὰν μή τις γεννηθῇ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ πνεύματος, οὐ δύναται εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: That which is born of the flesh is flesh: and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit .
text_la: Quod natum est ex carne, caro est : et quod natum est ex spiritu, spiritus est.
text_pt: O que é nascido da carne é carne, e o que é nascido do Espírito é espírito.
text_el: τὸ γεγεννημένον ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς σάρξ ἐστιν, καὶ τὸ γεγεννημένον ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος πνεῦμά ἐστιν.

text_en: Wonder not that I said to you: You must be born again.
text_la: Non mireris quia dixi tibi : oportet vos nasci denuo.
text_pt: Não te maravilhes de te ter dito: Necessário vos é nascer de novo.
text_el: μὴ θαυμάσῃς ὅτι εἶπόν σοι: δεῖ ὑμᾶς γεννηθῆναι ἄνωθεν.

text_en: The Spirit breathes where he will and you hear his voice: but you know not whence he comes and whither he goes. So is every one that is born of the Spirit .
text_la: Spiritus ubi vult spirat, et vocem ejus audis, sed nescis unde veniat, aut quo vadat : sic est omnis qui natus est ex spiritu.
text_pt: O vento assopra onde quer, e ouves a sua voz, mas não sabes de onde vem, nem para onde vai; assim étodo aquele que é nascido do Espírito.
text_el: τὸ πνεῦμα ὅπου θέλει πνεῖ, καὶ τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ ἀκούεις, ἀλλ' οὐκ οἶδας πόθεν ἔρχεται καὶ ποῦ ὑπάγει: οὕτως ἐστὶν πᾶς ὁ γεγεννημένος ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος.

text_en: Nicodemus answered and said to him: How can these things be done?
text_la: Respondit Nicodemus, et dixit ei : Quomodo possunt hæc fieri?
text_pt: Nicodemos respondeu, e disse-lhe: Como pode ser isso?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Νικόδημος καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: πῶς δύναται ταῦτα γενέσθαι;

text_en: Jesus answered and said to him: Are you a master in Israel , and know not these things?
text_la: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei : Tu es magister in Israël, et hæc ignoras?
text_pt: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Tu és mestre de Israel, e não sabes isto?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: σὺ εἶ ὁ διδάσκαλος τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ταῦτα οὐ γινώσκεις;

text_en: Amen , amen , I say to you that we speak what we know and we testify what we have seen: and you receive not our testimony.
text_la: amen, amen dico tibi, quia quod scimus loquimur, et quod vidimus testamur, et testimonium nostrum non accipitis.
text_pt: Na verdade, na verdade te digo que nós dizemos o que sabemos, e testificamos o que vimos; e não aceitais o nosso testemunho.
text_el: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτι ὃ οἴδαμεν λαλοῦμεν καὶ ὃ ἑωράκαμεν μαρτυροῦμεν, καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἡμῶν οὐ λαμβάνετε.

text_en: If I have spoken to you earthly things, and you believe not: how will you believe , if I shall speak to you heavenly things?
text_la: Si terrena dixi vobis, et non creditis : quomodo, si dixero vobis cælestia, credetis?
text_pt: Se vos falei de coisas terrestres, e não crestes, como crereis, se vos falar das celestiais?
text_el: εἰ τὰ ἐπίγεια εἶπον ὑμῖν καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε, πῶς ἐὰν εἴπω ὑμῖν τὰ ἐπουράνια πιστεύσετε;

text_en: And no man has ascended into heaven , but he that descended from heaven , the Son of man who is in heaven .
text_la: Et nemo ascendit in cælum, nisi qui descendit de cælo, Filius hominis, qui est in cælo.
text_pt: Ora, ninguém subiu ao céu, senão o que desceu do céu, o Filho do homem, que está no céu.
text_el: καὶ οὐδεὶς ἀναβέβηκεν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἰ μὴ ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς, ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

text_en: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the desert , so must the Son of man be lifted up:
text_la: Et sicut Moyses exaltavit serpentem in deserto, ita exaltari oportet Filium hominis:
text_pt: E, como Moisés levantou a serpente no deserto, assim importa que o Filho do homem seja levantado;
text_el: καὶ καθὼς Μωϋσῆς ὕψωσεν τὸν ὄφιν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, οὕτως ὑψωθῆναι δεῖ τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου,

text_en: That whosoever believes in him may not perish, but may have life everlasting .
text_la: ut omnis qui credit in ipsum, non pereat, sed habeat vitam æternam.
text_pt: Para que todo aquele que nele crê não pereça, mas tenha a vida eterna.
text_el: ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ἐν αὐτῷ ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

text_en: For God so loved the world, as to give his only begotten Son : that whosoever believes in him may not perish, but may have life everlasting .
text_la: Sic enim Deus dilexit mundum, ut Filium suum unigenitum daret : ut omnis qui credit in eum, non pereat, sed habeat vitam æternam.
text_pt: Porque Deus amou o mundo de tal maneira que deu o seu Filho unigênito, para que todo aquele que nele crê não pereça, mas tenha a vida eterna.
text_el: οὕτως γὰρ ἠγάπησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν κόσμον, ὥστε τὸν υἱὸν τὸν μονογενῆ ἔδωκεν, ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν μὴ ἀπόληται ἀλλ' ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

text_en: For God sent not his Son into the world, to judge the world: but that the world may be saved by him.
text_la: Non enim misit Deus Filium suum in mundum, ut judicet mundum, sed ut salvetur mundus per ipsum.
text_pt: Porque Deus enviou o seu Filho ao mundo, não para que condenasse o mundo, mas para que o mundo fosse salvo por ele.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν υἱὸν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα κρίνῃ τὸν κόσμον, ἀλλ' ἵνα σωθῇ ὁ κόσμος δι' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: He that believes in him is not judged . But he that does not believe is already judged : because he believes not in the name of the only begotten Son of God .
text_la: Qui credit in eum, non judicatur; qui autem non credit, jam judicatus est : quia non credit in nomine unigeniti Filii Dei.
text_pt: Quem crê nele não é condenado; mas quem não crê já está condenado, porquanto não crê no nome do unigênito Filho de Deus.
text_el: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν οὐ κρίνεται: ὁ μὴ πιστεύων ἤδη κέκριται, ὅτι μὴ πεπίστευκεν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ μονογενοῦς υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And this is the judgment: Because the light has come into the world and men loved darkness rather than the light: for their works were evil .
text_la: Hoc est autem judicium : quia lux venit in mundum, et dilexerunt homines magis tenebras quam lucem : erant enim eorum mala opera.
text_pt: E a condenação é esta: Que a luz veio ao mundo, e os homens amaram mais as trevas do que a luz, porque as suas obras eram más.
text_el: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ κρίσις, ὅτι τὸ φῶς ἐλήλυθεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον καὶ ἠγάπησαν οἱ ἄνθρωποι μᾶλλον τὸ σκότος ἢ τὸ φῶς: ἦν γὰρ αὐτῶν πονηρὰ τὰ ἔργα.

text_en: For every one that does evil hates the light and comes not to the light, that his works may not be reproved.
text_la: Omnis enim qui male agit, odit lucem, et non venit ad lucem, ut non arguantur opera ejus:
text_pt: Porque todo aquele que faz o mal odeia a luz, e não vem para a luz, para que as suas obras não sejam reprovadas.
text_el: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ φαῦλα πράσσων μισεῖ τὸ φῶς καὶ οὐκ ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸ φῶς, ἵνα μὴ ἐλεγχθῇ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ:

text_en: But he that does truth comes to the light, that his works may be made manifest: because they are done in God .
text_la: qui autem facit veritatem, venit ad lucem, ut manifestentur opera ejus, quia in Deo sunt facta.
text_pt: Mas quem pratica a verdade vem para a luz, a fim de que as suas obras sejam manifestas, porque são feitas em Deus.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ποιῶν τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸ φῶς, ἵνα φανερωθῇ αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα, ὅτι ἐν θεῷ ἐστιν εἰργασμένα.

text_en: After these things, Jesus and his disciples came into the land of Judea : and there he abode with them and baptized .
text_la: Post hæc venit Jesus et discipuli ejus in terram Judæam : et illic demorabatur cum eis, et baptizabat.
text_pt: Depois disto foi Jesus com os seus discípulos para a terra da Judéia; e estava ali com eles, e batizava.
text_el: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν γῆν, καὶ ἐκεῖ διέτριβεν μετ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἐβάπτιζεν.

text_en: And John also was baptizing in Ennon near Salim: because there was much water there. And they came and were baptized .
text_la: Erat autem et Joannes baptizans, in Ænnon, juxta Salim : quia aquæ multæ erant illic, et veniebant et baptizabantur.
text_pt: Ora, João batizava também em Enom, junto a Salim, porque havia ali muitas águas; e vinham ali, e eram batizados.
text_el: ἦν δὲ καὶ [ὁ] Ἰωάννης βαπτίζων ἐν Αἰνὼν ἐγγὺς τοῦ Σαλείμ, ὅτι ὕδατα πολλὰ ἦν ἐκεῖ, καὶ παρεγίνοντο καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο:

text_en: For John was not yet cast into prison .
text_la: Nondum enim missus fuerat Joannes in carcerem.
text_pt: Porque ainda João não tinha sido lançado na prisão.
text_el: οὔπω γὰρ ἦν βεβλημένος εἰς τὴν φυλακὴν Ἰωάννης.

text_en: And there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews , concerning purification.
text_la: Facta est autem quæstio ex discipulis Joannis cum Judæis de purificatione.
text_pt: Houve então uma questão entre os discípulos de João e os judeus acerca da purificação.
text_el: ἐγένετο οὖν ζήτησις ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν Ἰωάννου μετὰ Ἰουδαίου περὶ καθαρισμοῦ.

text_en: And they came to John and said to him: Rabbi, he that was with you beyond the Jordan , to whom you gave testimony: behold, he baptizes and all men come to him.
text_la: Et venerunt ad Joannem, et dixerunt ei : Rabbi, qui erat tecum trans Jordanem, cui tu testimonium perhibuisti, ecce hic baptizat, et omnes veniunt ad eum.
text_pt: E foram ter com João, e disseram-lhe: Rabi, aquele que estava contigo além do Jordão, do qual tu deste testemunho, ei-lo batizando, e todos vão ter com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάννην καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: ῥαββί, ὃς ἦν μετὰ σοῦ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, ᾧ σὺ μεμαρτύρηκας, ἴδε οὗτος βαπτίζει καὶ πάντες ἔρχονται πρὸς αὐτόν.

text_en: John answered and said: A man cannot receive anything, unless it be given him from heaven .
text_la: Respondit Joannes, et dixit : Non potest homo accipere quidquam, nisi fuerit ei datum de cælo.
text_pt: João respondeu, e disse: O homem não pode receber coisa alguma, se não lhe for dada do céu.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰωάννης καὶ εἶπεν: οὐ δύναται ἄνθρωπος λαμβάνειν οὐδὲν ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ δεδομένον αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.

text_en: You yourselves do bear me witness that I said that I am not Christ , but that I am sent before him.
text_la: Ipsi vos mihi testimonium perhibetis, quod dixerim : Non sum ego Christus : sed quia missus sum ante illum.
text_pt: Vós mesmos me sois testemunhas de que disse: Eu não sou o Cristo, mas sou enviado adiante dele.
text_el: αὐτοὶ ὑμεῖς μοι μαρτυρεῖτε ὅτι εἶπον: [ἐγώ] οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὁ Χριστός, ἀλλ' ὅτι ἀπεσταλμένος εἰμὶ ἔμπροσθεν ἐκείνου.

text_en: He that has the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears Him, rejoices with joy because of the bridegroom's voice. This my joy therefore is fulfilled.
text_la: Qui habet sponsam, sponsus est : amicus autem sponsi, qui stat, et audit eum, gaudio gaudet propter vocem sponsi. Hoc ergo gaudium meum impletum est.
text_pt: Aquele que tem a esposa é o esposo; mas o amigo do esposo, que lhe assiste e o ouve, alegra-se muito com a voz do esposo. Assim, pois, já este meu gozo está cumprido.
text_el: ὁ ἔχων τὴν νύμφην νυμφίος ἐστίν: ὁ δὲ φίλος τοῦ νυμφίου, ὁ ἑστηκὼς καὶ ἀκούων αὐτοῦ, χαρᾷ χαίρει διὰ τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ νυμφίου. αὕτη οὖν ἡ χαρὰ ἡ ἐμὴ πεπλήρωται.

text_en: He must increase: but I must decrease.
text_la: Illum oportet crescere, me autem minui.
text_pt: É necessário que ele cresça e que eu diminua.
text_el: ἐκεῖνον δεῖ αὐξάνειν, ἐμὲ δὲ ἐλαττοῦσθαι.

text_en: He that comes from above is above all. He that is of the earth, of the earth he is, and of the earth he speaks. He that comes from heaven is above all.
text_la: Qui desursum venit, super omnes est. Qui est de terra, de terra est, et de terra loquitur. Qui de cælo venit, super omnes est.
text_pt: Aquele que vem de cima é sobre todos; aquele que vem da terra é da terra e fala da terra. Aquele que vem do céu é sobre todos.
text_el: ὁ ἄνωθεν ἐρχόμενος ἐπάνω πάντων ἐστίν: ὁ ὢν ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐστιν καὶ ἐκ τῆς γῆς λαλεῖ. ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐρχόμενος ἐπάνω πάντων ἐστίν

text_en: And what he has seen and heard, that he testifies: and no man receives his testimony.
text_la: Et quod vidit, et audivit, hoc testatur : et testimonium ejus nemo accipit.
text_pt: E aquilo que ele viu e ouviu isso testifica; e ninguém aceita o seu testemunho.
text_el: ὃ ἑώρακεν καὶ ἤκουσεν τοῦτο μαρτυρεῖ, καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν αὐτοῦ οὐδεὶς λαμβάνει.

text_en: He that has received his testimony has set to his seal that God is true .
text_la: Qui accepit ejus testimonium signavit, quia Deus verax est.
text_pt: Aquele que aceitou o seu testemunho, esse confirmou que Deus é verdadeiro.
text_el: ὁ λαβὼν αὐτοῦ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἐσφράγισεν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἀληθής ἐστιν.

text_en: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God : for God does not give the Spirit by measure.
text_la: Quem enim misit Deus, verba Dei loquitur : non enim ad mensuram dat Deus spiritum.
text_pt: Porque aquele que Deus enviou fala as palavras de Deus; pois não lhe dá Deus o Espírito por medida.
text_el: ὃν γὰρ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς, τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ θεοῦ λαλεῖ: οὐ γὰρ ἐκ μέτρου δίδωσιν τὸ πνεῦμα.

text_en: The Father loves the Son: and he has given all things into his hand.
text_la: Pater diligit Filium et omnia dedit in manu ejus.
text_pt: O Pai ama o Filho, e todas as coisas entregou nas suas mãos.
text_el: ὁ πατὴρ ἀγαπᾷ τὸν υἱόν, καὶ πάντα δέδωκεν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: He that believes in the Son has life everlasting: but he that believes not the Son shall not see life: but the wrath of God abides on him.
text_la: Qui credit in Filium, habet vitam æternam; qui autem incredulus est Filio, non videbit vitam, sed ira Dei manet super eum.
text_pt: Aquele que crê no Filho tem a vida eterna; mas aquele que não crê no Filho não verá a vida, mas a ira de Deus sobre ele permanece.
text_el: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς τὸν υἱὸν ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον: ὁ δὲ ἀπειθῶν τῷ υἱῷ οὐκ ὄψεται ζωήν, ἀλλ' ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ θεοῦ μένει ἐπ' αὐτόν,

text_en: When Jesus therefore understood the Pharisees had heard that Jesus makes more disciples and baptizes more than John ,
text_la: Ut ergo cognovit Jesus quia audierunt pharisæi quod Jesus plures discipulos facit, et baptizat, quam Joannes
text_pt: E quando o Senhor entendeu que os fariseus tinham ouvido que Jesus fazia e batizava mais discípulos do que João
text_el: Ὡς οὖν ἔγνω ὁ κύριοσ ὅτι ἤκουσαν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ὅτι Ἰησοῦς πλείονας μαθητὰς ποιεῖ καὶ βαπτίζει [ἢ] Ἰωάννης,

text_en: (though Jesus himself did not baptize , but his disciples ),
text_la: (quamquam Jesus non baptizaret, sed discipuli ejus),
text_pt: (Ainda que Jesus mesmo não batizava, mas os seus discípulos),
text_el: καίτοιγε Ἰησοῦς αὐτὸς οὐκ ἐβάπτιζεν ἀλλ' οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ,

text_en: he left Judea and went again into Galilee .
text_la: reliquit Judæam, et abiit iterum in Galilæam.
text_pt: Deixou a Judéia, e foi outra vez para a Galiléia.
text_el: ἀφῆκεν τὴν Ἰουδαίαν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πάλιν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.

text_en: And he was of necessity to pass through Samaria .
text_la: Oportebat autem eum transire per Samariam.
text_pt: E era-lhe necessário passar por Samaria.
text_el: ἔδει δὲ αὐτὸν διέρχεσθαι διὰ τῆς Σαμαρείας.

text_en: He comes therefore to a city of Samaria , which is called Sichar, near the land which Jacob gave to his son Joseph .
text_la: Venit ergo in civitatem Samariæ, quæ dicitur Sichar, juxta prædium quod dedit Jacob Joseph filio suo.
text_pt: Foi, pois, a uma cidade de Samaria, chamada Sicar, junto da herdade que Jacó tinha dado a seu filho José.
text_el: ἔρχεται οὖν εἰς πόλιν τῆς Σαμαρείας λεγομένην Συχὰρ, πλησίον τοῦ χωρίου ὃ ἔδωκεν Ἰακὼβ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well . It was about the sixth hour .
text_la: Erat autem ibi fons Jacob. Jesus ergo fatigatus ex itinere, sedebat sic supra fontem. Hora erat quasi sexta.
text_pt: E estava ali a fonte de Jacó. Jesus, pois, cansado do caminho, assentou-se assim junto da fonte. Era isto quase à hora sexta.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ πηγὴ τοῦ Ἰακώβ. ὁ οὖν Ἰησοῦς κεκοπιακὼς ἐκ τῆς ὁδοιπορίας ἐκαθέζετο οὕτως ἐπὶ τῇ πηγῇ: ὥρα ἦν ὡς ἕκτη.

text_en: There comes a woman of Samaria , to draw water. Jesus says to her: Give me to drink.
text_la: Venit mulier de Samaria haurire aquam. Dicit ei Jesus : Da mihi bibere.
text_pt: Veio uma mulher de Samaria tirar água. Disse-lhe Jesus: Dá-me de beber.
text_el: ἔρχεται γυνὴ ἐκ τῆς Σαμαρείας ἀντλῆσαι ὕδωρ. λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, δός μοι πεῖν:

text_en: For his disciples had gone into the city to buy meats.
text_la: (Discipuli enim ejus abierant in civitatem ut cibos emerent.)
text_pt: Porque os seus discípulos tinham ido à cidade comprar comida.
text_el: οἱ γὰρ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπεληλύθεισαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν, ἵνα τροφὰς ἀγοράσωσιν.

text_en: Then that Samaritan woman said to him: How do you, being a Jew ; ask of me to drink, who am a Samaritan woman ? For the Jews do not communicate with the Samaritans .
text_la: Dicit ergo ei mulier illa Samaritana : Quomodo tu, Judæus cum sis, bibere a me poscis, quæ sum mulier Samaritana? non enim coutuntur Judæi Samaritanis.
text_pt: Disse-lhe, pois, a mulher samaritana: Como, sendo tu judeu, me pedes de beber a mim, que sou mulher samaritana? (porque os judeus não se comunicam com os samaritanos).
text_el: λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ἡ γυνὴ ἡ Σαμαρῖτις: πῶς σὺ Ἰουδαῖος ὢν παρ' ἐμοῦ πεῖν αἰτεῖς γυναικὸς Σαμαρίτιδος οὔσης; [οὐ γὰρ συγχρῶνται Ἰουδαῖοι Σαμαρίταις]

text_en: Jesus answered and said to her: If you knew the gift of God and who he is that says to you: Give me to drink; you perhaps would have asked of him, and he would have given you living water.
text_la: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei : Si scires donum Dei, et quis est qui dicit tibi : Da mihi bibere, tu forsitan petisses ab eo, et dedisset tibi aquam vivam.
text_pt: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Se tu conheceras o dom de Deus, e quem é o que te diz: Dá-me de beber, tu lhe pedirias, e ele te daria água viva.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ: εἰ ᾔδεις τὴν δωρεὰν τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ λέγων σοι: δός μοι πεῖν, σὺ ἂν ᾔτησας αὐτὸν καὶ ἔδωκεν ἄν σοι ὕδωρ ζῶν.

text_en: The woman said to him: Sir, you have nothing wherein to draw, and the well is deep. From whence then have you living water?
text_la: Dicit ei mulier : Domine, neque in quo haurias habes, et puteus altus est : unde ergo habes aquam vivam?
text_pt: Disse-lhe a mulher: Senhor, tu não tens com que a tirar, e o poço é fundo; onde, pois, tens a água viva?
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ κύριε, οὔτε ἄντλημα ἔχεις καὶ τὸ φρέαρ ἐστὶν βαθύ: πόθεν οὖν ἔχεις τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ζῶν;

text_en: Are you greater than our father Jacob , who gave us the well and drank thereof, himself and his children and his cattle?
text_la: Numquid tu major es patre nostro Jacob, qui dedit nobis puteum, et ipse ex eo bibit, et filii ejus, et pecora ejus?
text_pt: És tu maior do que o nosso pai Jacó, que nos deu o poço, bebendo ele próprio dele, e os seus filhos, e o seu gado?
text_el: μὴ σὺ μείζων εἶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἰακώβ, ὃς ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν τὸ φρέαρ, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἔπιεν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ θρέμματα αὐτοῦ;

text_en: Jesus answered and said to her: Whosoever drinks of this water shall thirst again: but he that shall drink of the water that I will give him shall not thirst for ever.
text_la: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei : Omnis qui bibit ex aqua hac, sitiet iterum; qui autem biberit ex aqua quam ego dabo ei, non sitiet in æternum:
text_pt: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Qualquer que beber desta água tornará a ter sede;
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ: πᾶς ὁ πίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος τούτου διψήσει πάλιν:

text_en: But the water that I will give him shall become in him a fountain of water, springing up into life everlasting.
text_la: sed aqua quam ego dabo ei, fiet in eo fons aquæ salientis in vitam æternam.
text_pt: Mas aquele que beber da água que eu lhe der nunca terá sede, porque a água que eu lhe der se fará nele uma fonte de água que salte para a vida eterna.
text_el: ὃς δ' ἂν πίῃ ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος οὗ ἐγὼ δώσω αὐτῷ, οὐ μὴ διψήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, ἀλλὰ τὸ ὕδωρ ὃ δώσω αὐτῷ γενήσεται ἐν αὐτῷ πηγὴ ὕδατος ἁλλομένου εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

text_en: The woman said to him: Sir, give me this water, that I may not thirst, nor come hither to draw.
text_la: Dicit ad eum mulier : Domine, da mihi hanc aquam, ut non sitiam, neque veniam huc haurire.
text_pt: Disse-lhe a mulher: Senhor, dá-me dessa água, para que não mais tenha sede, e não venha aqui tirá-la.
text_el: λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ γυνή: κύριε, δός μοι τοῦτο τὸ ὕδωρ, ἵνα μὴ διψῶ μηδὲ διέρχωμαι ἐνθάδε ἀντλεῖν.

text_en: Jesus says to her: Go, call your husband, and come hither.
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Vade, voca virum tuum, et veni huc.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Vai, chama o teu marido, e vem cá.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῇ: ὕπαγε φώνησον σου τὸν ἄνδρα καὶ ἐλθὲ ἐνθάδε.

text_en: The woman answered and said: I have no husband. Jesus said to her: You have said well: I have no husband.
text_la: Respondit mulier, et dixit : Non habeo virum. Dicit ei Jesus : Bene dixisti, quia non habeo virum;
text_pt: A mulher respondeu, e disse: Não tenho marido. Disse-lhe Jesus: Disseste bem: Não tenho marido;
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη ἡ γυνὴ καὶ εἶπεν: [αὐτῷ] οὐκ ἔχω. ἄνδρα λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: καλῶς εἶπας ὅτι ἄνδρα οὐκ ἔχω:

text_en: For you have had five husbands: and he whom you now have is not your husband. This, you have said truly .
text_la: quinque enim viros habuisti, et nunc, quem habes, non est tuus vir : hoc vere dixisti.
text_pt: Porque tiveste cinco maridos, e o que agora tens não é teu marido; isto disseste com verdade.
text_el: πέντε γὰρ ἄνδρας ἔσχες, καὶ νῦν ὃν ἔχεις οὐκ ἔστιν σου ἀνήρ: τοῦτο ἀληθὲς εἴρηκας.

text_en: The woman said to him: Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet .
text_la: Dicit ei mulier : Domine, video quia propheta es tu.
text_pt: Disse-lhe a mulher: Senhor, vejo que és profeta.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή: κύριε, θεωρῶ ὅτι προφήτης εἶ σύ.

text_en: Our fathers adored on this mountain: and you say that at Jerusalem is the place where men must adore .
text_la: Patres nostri in monte hoc adoraverunt, et vos dicitis, quia Jerosolymis est locus ubi adorare oportet.
text_pt: Nossos pais adoraram neste monte, e vós dizeis que é em Jerusalém o lugar onde se deve adorar.
text_el: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ προσεκύνησαν: καὶ ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐστὶν ὁ τόπος ὅπου προσκυνεῖν δεῖ.

text_en: Jesus says to her: Woman , believe me that the hour comes, when you shall neither on this mountain, nor in Jerusalem , adore the Father .
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Mulier, crede mihi, quia venit hora, quando neque in monte hoc, neque in Jerosolymis adorabitis Patrem.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Mulher, crê-me que a hora vem, em que nem neste monte nem em Jerusalém adorareis o Pai.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: πίστευέ μοι, γύναι, ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα ὅτε οὔτε ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ οὔτε ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις προσκυνήσετε τῷ πατρί.

text_en: You adore that which you know not : we adore that which we know . For salvation is of the Jews .
text_la: Vos adoratis quod nescitis : nos adoramus quod scimus, quia salus ex Judæis est.
text_pt: Vós adorais o que não sabeis; nós adoramos o que sabemos porque a salvação vem dos judeus.
text_el: ὑμεῖς προσκυνεῖτε ὃ οὐκ οἴδατε, ἡμεῖς προσκυνοῦμεν ὃ οἴδαμεν, ὅτι ἡ σωτηρία ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἐστίν:

text_en: But the hour comes and now is, when the true adorers shall adore the Father in spirit and in truth . For the Father also seeks such to adore him.
text_la: Sed venit hora, et nunc est, quando veri adoratores adorabunt Patrem in spiritu et veritate. Nam et Pater tales quærit, qui adorent eum.
text_pt: Mas a hora vem, e agora é, em que os verdadeiros adoradores adorarão o Pai em espírito e em verdade; porque o Pai procura a tais que assim o adorem.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ νῦν ἐστιν, ὅτε οἱ ἀληθινοὶ προσκυνηταὶ προσκυνήσουσιν τῷ πατρὶ ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ: καὶ γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ τοιούτους ζητεῖ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας αὐτόν.

text_en: God is a spirit: and they that adore him must adore him in spirit and in truth .
text_la: Spiritus est Deus : et eos qui adorant eum, in spiritu et veritate oportet adorare.
text_pt: Deus é Espírito, e importa que os que o adoram o adorem em espírito e em verdade.
text_el: πνεῦμα ὁ θεός, καὶ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας αὐτὸν ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ δεῖ προσκυνεῖν.

text_en: The woman said to him: I know that the Messias comes (who is called Christ ): therefore, when he has come, he will tell us all things.
text_la: Dicit ei mulier : Scio quia Messias venit (qui dicitur Christus) : cum ergo venerit ille, nobis annuntiabit omnia.
text_pt: A mulher disse-lhe: Eu sei que o Messias (que se chama o Cristo) vem; quando ele vier, nos anunciará tudo.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή: οἶδα ὅτι Μεσσίας ἔρχεται, ὁ λεγόμενος Χριστός: ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖνος, ἀναγγελεῖ ἡμῖν ἅπαντα.

text_en: Jesus says to her: I am he, who am speaking with you.
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Ego sum, qui loquor tecum.
text_pt: Jesus disse-lhe: Eu o sou, eu que falo contigo.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἐγώ εἰμι, ὁ λαλῶν σοι.

text_en: And immediately his disciples came. And they wondered that he talked with the woman . Yet no man said: What do you seek? Or: Why are you talking with her?
text_la: Et continuo venerunt discipuli ejus, et mirabantur quia cum muliere loquebatur. Nemo tamen dixit : Quid quæris? aut, Quid loqueris cum ea?
text_pt: E nisto vieram os seus discípulos, e maravilharam-se de que estivesse falando com uma mulher; todavia nenhum lhe disse: Que perguntas? ou: Por que falas com ela?
text_el: Καὶ ἐπὶ τούτῳ ἦλθαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ὅτι μετὰ γυναικὸς ἐλάλει: οὐδεὶς μέντοι εἶπεν: τί ζητεῖς ἤ τί λαλεῖς μετ' αὐτῆς;

text_en: The woman therefore left her waterpot and went her way into the city and says to the men there:
text_la: Reliquit ergo hydriam suam mulier, et abiit in civitatem, et dicit illis hominibus:
text_pt: Deixou, pois, a mulher o seu cântaro, e foi à cidade, e disse àqueles homens:
text_el: ἀφῆκεν οὖν τὴν ὑδρίαν αὐτῆς ἡ γυνὴ καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὴν πόλιν, καὶ λέγει τοῖς ἀνθρώποις:

text_en: Come, and see a man who has told me all things whatsoever I have done. Is not he the Christ ?
text_la: Venite, et videte hominem qui dixit mihi omnia quæcumque feci : numquid ipse est Christus?
text_pt: Vinde, vede um homem que me disse tudo quanto tenho feito. Porventura não é este o Cristo?
text_el: δεῦτε ἴδετε ἄνθρωπον ὃς εἶπέν μοι πάντα ἃ ἐποίησα: μήτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός;

text_en: They went therefore out of the city and came unto him.
text_la: Exierunt ergo de civitate et veniebant ad eum.
text_pt: Saíram, pois, da cidade, e foram ter com ele.
text_el: ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τῆς πόλεως, καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτόν.

text_en: In the mean time, the disciples prayed him, saying: Rabbi, eat.
text_la: Interea rogabant eum discipuli, dicentes : Rabbi, manduca.
text_pt: E entretanto os seus discípulos lhe rogaram, dizendo: Rabi, come.
text_el: Ἐν τῷ μεταξὺ ἠρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ λέγοντες: ῥαββί, φάγε.

text_en: But he said to them: I have meat to eat which you know not.
text_la: Ille autem dicit eis : Ego cibum habeo manducare, quem vos nescitis.
text_pt: Ele, porém, lhes disse: Uma comida tenho para comer, que vós não conheceis.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἐγὼ βρῶσιν ἔχω φαγεῖν ἣν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε.

text_en: The disciples therefore said one to another: Hath any man brought him to eat?
text_la: Dicebant ergo discipuli ad invicem : Numquid aliquis attulit ei manducare?
text_pt: Então os discípulos diziam uns aos outros: Trouxe-lhe, porventura, alguém algo de comer?
text_el: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ μαθηταὶ πρὸς ἀλλήλους, μή τις ἤνεγκεν αὐτῷ φαγεῖν;

text_en: Jesus says to them: My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, that I may perfect his work.
text_la: Dicit eis Jesus : Meus cibus est ut faciam voluntatem ejus qui misit me, ut perficiam opus ejus.
text_pt: Jesus disse-lhes: A minha comida é fazer a vontade daquele que me enviou, e realizar a sua obra.
text_el: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἐμὸν βρῶμά ἐστιν ἵνα ποιήσω τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με καὶ τελειώσω αὐτοῦ τὸ ἔργον.

text_en: Do not you say: There are yet four months, and then the harvest comes? Behold, I say to you, lift up your eyes, and see the countries. For they are white already to harvest.
text_la: Nonne vos dicitis quod adhuc quatuor menses sunt, et messis venit? Ecce dico vobis : levate oculos vestros, et videte regiones, quia albæ sunt jam ad messem.
text_pt: Não dizeis vós que ainda há quatro meses até que venha a ceifa? Eis que eu vos digo: Levantai os vossos olhos, e vede as terras, que já estão brancas para a ceifa.
text_el: οὐχ ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι ἔτι τετράμηνός ἐστιν καὶ ὁ θερισμὸς ἔρχεται; ἰδοὺ λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐπάρατε τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ θεάσασθε τὰς χώρας, ὅτι λευκαί εἰσιν πρὸς θερισμόν. ἤδη

text_en: And he that reaps receives wages and gathers fruit unto life everlasting: that both he that sows and he that reaps may rejoice together.
text_la: Et qui metit, mercedem accipit, et congregat fructum in vitam æternam : ut et qui seminat, simul gaudeat, et qui metit.
text_pt: E o que ceifa recebe galardão, e ajunta fruto para a vida eterna; para que, assim o que semeia como o que ceifa, ambos se regozijem.
text_el: ὁ θερίζων μισθὸν λαμβάνει καὶ συνάγει καρπὸν εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, ἵνα ὁ σπείρων ὁμοῦ χαίρῃ καὶ ὁ θερίζων.

text_en: For in this is the saying true : That it is one man that sows, and it is another that reaps.
text_la: In hoc enim est verbum verum : quia alius est qui seminat, et alius est qui metit.
text_pt: Porque nisto é verdadeiro o ditado, que um é o que semeia, e outro o que ceifa.
text_el: ἐν γὰρ τούτῳ ὁ λόγος ἐστὶν ἀληθινὸς, ὅτι ἄλλος ἐστὶν ὁ σπείρων καὶ ἄλλος ὁ θερίζων.

text_en: I have sent you to reap that in which you did not labour. Others have laboured: and you have entered into their labours.
text_la: Ego misi vos metere quod vos non laborastis : alii laboraverunt, et vos in labores eorum introistis.
text_pt: Eu vos enviei a ceifar onde vós não trabalhastes; outros trabalharam, e vós entrastes no seu trabalho.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἀπέστειλα ὑμᾶς θερίζειν ὃ οὐχ ὑμεῖς κεκοπιάκατε: ἄλλοι κεκοπιάκασιν, καὶ ὑμεῖς εἰς τὸν κόπον αὐτῶν εἰσεληλύθατε.

text_en: Now of that city many of the Samaritans believed in him, for the word of the woman giving testimony: He told me all things whatsoever I have done.
text_la: Ex civitate autem illa multi crediderunt in eum Samaritanorum, propter verbum mulieris testimonium perhibentis : Quia dixit mihi omnia quæcumque feci.
text_pt: E muitos dos samaritanos daquela cidade creram nele, pela palavra da mulher, que testificou: Disse-me tudo quanto tenho feito.
text_el: Ἐκ δὲ τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν τῶν Σαμαριτῶν διὰ τὸν λόγον τῆς γυναικὸς μαρτυρούσης ὅτι εἶπέν μοι πάντα ἃ ἐποίησα.

text_en: So when the Samaritans had come to him, they desired that he would tarry there. And he abode there two days.
text_la: Cum venissent ergo ad illum Samaritani, rogaverunt eum ut ibi maneret. Et mansit ibi duos dies.
text_pt: Indo, pois, ter com ele os samaritanos, rogaram-lhe que ficasse com eles; e ficou ali dois dias.
text_el: ὡς οὖν ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ Σαμαρῖται, ἠρώτων αὐτὸν μεῖναι παρ' αὐτοῖς: καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐκεῖ δύο ἡμέρας.

text_en: And many more believed in him, because of his own word.
text_la: Et multo plures crediderunt in eum propter sermonem ejus.
text_pt: E muitos mais creram nele, por causa da sua palavra.
text_el: καὶ πολλῷ πλείους ἐπίστευσαν διὰ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And they said to the woman : We now believe , not for your saying: for we ourselves have heard him and know that this is indeed the Saviour of the world.
text_la: Et mulieri dicebant : Quia jam non propter tuam loquelam credimus : ipsi enim audivimus, et scimus quia hic est vere Salvator mundi.
text_pt: E diziam à mulher: Já não é pelo teu dito que nós cremos; porque nós mesmos o temos ouvido, e sabemos que este é verdadeiramente o Cristo, o Salvador do mundo.
text_el: τῇ τε γυναικὶ ἔλεγον [ὅτι] οὐκέτι διὰ τὴν σὴν λαλιὰν πιστεύομεν: αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀκηκόαμεν, καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ σωτὴρ τοῦ κόσμου.

text_en: Now after two days, he departed thence and went into Galilee .
text_la: Post duos autem dies exiit inde, et abiit in Galilæam.
text_pt: E dois dias depois partiu dali, e foi para a Galiléia.
text_el: Μετὰ δὲ τὰς δύο ἡμέρας ἐξῆλθεν ἐκεῖθεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν:

text_en: For Jesus himself gave testimony that a prophet has no honour in his own country.
text_la: Ipse enim Jesus testimonium perhibuit, quia propheta in sua patria honorem non habet.
text_pt: Porque Jesus mesmo testificou que um profeta não tem honra na sua própria pátria.
text_el: αὐτὸς γὰρ Ἰησοῦς ἐμαρτύρησεν ὅτι προφήτης ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ πατρίδι τιμὴν οὐκ ἔχει.

text_en: And when he had come into Galilee , the Galileans received him, having seen all the things he had done at Jerusalem on the festival day: for they also went to the festival day.
text_la: Cum ergo venisset in Galilæam, exceperunt eum Galilæi, cum omnia vidissent quæ fecerat Jerosolymis in die festo : et ipsi enim venerant ad diem festum.
text_pt: Chegando, pois, à Galiléia, os galileus o receberam, vistas todas as coisas que fizera em Jerusalém, no dia da festa; porque também eles tinham ido à festa.
text_el: ὅτε οὖν ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, ἐδέξαντο αὐτὸν οἱ Γαλιλαῖοι, πάντα ἑωρακότες ὅσα ἐποίησεν ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ: καὶ αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν.

text_en: He came again therefore into Cana of Galilee , where he made the water wine. And there was a certain ruler, whose son was sick at Capharnaum .
text_la: Venit ergo iterum in Cana Galilææ, ubi fecit aquam vinum. Et erat quidam regulus, cujus filius infirmabatur Capharnaum.
text_pt: Segunda vez foi Jesus a Caná da Galiléia, onde da água fizera vinho. E havia ali um nobre, cujo filho estava enfermo em Cafarnaum.
text_el: ἦλθεν οὖν πάλιν εἰς τὴν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, ὅπου ἐποίησεν τὸ ὕδωρ οἶνον. καὶ Ἦν τις βασιλικὸς, οὗ ὁ υἱὸς ἠσθένει, ἐν Καφαρναούμ:

text_en: He having heard that Jesus had come from Judea into Galilee , sent to him and prayed him to come down and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
text_la: Hic cum audisset quia Jesus adveniret a Judæa in Galilæam, abiit ad eum, et rogabat eum ut descenderet, et sanaret filium ejus : incipiebat enim mori.
text_pt: Ouvindo este que Jesus vinha da Judéia para a Galiléia, foi ter com ele, e rogou-lhe que descesse, e curasse o seu filho, porque já estava à morte.
text_el: οὗτος ἀκούσας ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἥκει ἐκ τῆς Ἰουδαίας εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν, καὶ ἠρώτα ἵνα καταβῇ καὶ ἰάσηται αὐτοῦ τὸν υἱόν: ἤμελλεν γὰρ ἀποθνῄσκειν.

text_en: Jesus therefore said to him: Unless you see signs and wonders , you believe not.
text_la: Dixit ergo Jesus ad eum : Nisi signa et prodigia videritis, non creditis.
text_pt: Então Jesus lhe disse: Se não virdes sinais e milagres, não crereis.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς αὐτόν: ἐὰν μὴ σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ἴδητε, οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε.

text_en: The ruler said to him: Lord, come down before that my son die.
text_la: Dicit ad eum regulus : Domine, descende priusquam moriatur filius meus.
text_pt: Disse-lhe o nobre: Senhor, desce, antes que meu filho morra.
text_el: λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ βασιλικός: κύριε, κατάβηθι πρὶν ἀποθανεῖν τὸ παιδίον μου.

text_en: Jesus said to him: Go your way. Your son lives. The man believed the word which Jesus said to him and went his way.
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Vade, filius tuus vivit. Credidit homo sermoni quem dixit ei Jesus, et ibat.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Vai, o teu filho vive. E o homem creu na palavra que Jesus lhe disse, e partiu.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: πορεύου: ὁ υἱός σου ζῇ. ἐπίστευσεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῷ λόγῳ ὃν εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἐπορεύετο.

text_en: And as he was going down, his servants met him: and they brought word, saying, that his son lived.
text_la: Jam autem eo descendente, servi occurrerunt ei, et nuntiaverunt dicentes, quia filius ejus viveret.
text_pt: E descendo ele logo, saíram-lhe ao encontro os seus servos, e lhe anunciaram, dizendo: O teu filho vive.
text_el: ἤδη δὲ αὐτοῦ καταβαίνοντος οἱ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ ὑπήντησαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες ὅτι ὁ παῖς αὐτοῦ ζῇ.

text_en: He asked therefore of them the hour wherein he grew better. And they said to him: Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.
text_la: Interrogabat ergo horam ab eis in qua melius habuerit. Et dixerunt ei : Quia heri hora septima reliquit eum febris.
text_pt: Perguntou-lhes, pois, a que hora se achara melhor. E disseram-lhe: Ontem às sete horas a febre o deixou.
text_el: ἐπύθετο οὖν τὴν ὥραν παρ' αὐτῶν ἐν ᾗ κομψότερον ἔσχεν: εἶπαν οὖν αὐτῷ ὅτι ἐχθὲς ὥραν ἑβδόμην ἀφῆκεν αὐτὸν ὁ πυρετός.

text_en: The father therefore knew that it was at the same hour that Jesus said to him: Your son lives. And himself believed , and his whole house.
text_la: Cognovit ergo pater, quia illa hora erat in qua dixit ei Jesus : Filius tuus vivit; et credidit ipse et domus ejus tota.
text_pt: Entendeu, pois, o pai que era aquela hora a mesma em que Jesus lhe disse: O teu filho vive; e creu ele, e toda a sua casa.
text_el: ἔγνω οὖν ὁ πατὴρ ὅτι ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐν ᾗ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ὁ υἱός σου ζῇ: καὶ ἐπίστευσεν αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ οἰκία αὐτοῦ ὅλη.

text_en: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he had come out of Judea into Galilee .
text_la: Hoc iterum secundum signum fecit Jesus, cum venisset a Judæa in Galilæam.
text_pt: Jesus fez este segundo milagre, quando ia da Judéia para a Galiléia.
text_el: Τοῦτο δὲ πάλιν δεύτερον σημεῖον ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐλθὼν ἐκ τῆς Ἰουδαίας εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.

text_en: After these things was a festival day of the Jews : and Jesus went up to Jerusalem .
text_la: Post hæc erat dies festus Judæorum, et ascendit Jesus Jerosolymam.
text_pt: Depois disto havia uma festa entre os judeus, e Jesus subiu a Jerusalém.
text_el: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἦν ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων, καὶ ἀνέβη Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

text_en: Now there is at Jerusalem a pond, called Probatica, which in Hebrew is named Bethsaida , having five porches.
text_la: Est autem Jerosolymis probatica piscina, quæ cognominatur hebraice Bethsaida, quinque porticus habens.
text_pt: Ora, em Jerusalém há, próximo à porta das ovelhas, um tanque, chamado em hebreu Betesda, o qual tem cinco alpendres.
text_el: ἔστιν δὲ ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐπὶ τῇ προβατικῇ κολυμβήθρα, ἡ ἐπιλεγομένη Ἑβραϊστὶ Βηθζαθά, πέντε στοὰς ἔχουσα.

text_en: In these lay a great multitude of sick, of blind, of lame, of withered: waiting for the moving of the water.
text_la: In his jacebat multitudo magna languentium, cæcorum, claudorum, aridorum, exspectantium aquæ motum.
text_pt: Nestes jazia grande multidão de enfermos, cegos, mancos e ressicados, esperando o movimento da água.
text_el: ἐν ταύταις κατέκειτο πλῆθος τῶν ἀσθενούντων, τυφλῶν, χωλῶν, ξηρῶν.

text_en: And an angel of the Lord descended at certain times into the pond and the water was moved. And he that went down first into the pond after the motion of the water was made whole of whatsoever infirmity he lay under.
text_la: Angelus autem Domini descendebat secundum tempus in piscinam, et movebatur aqua. Et qui prior descendisset in piscinam post motionem aquæ, sanus fiebat a quacumque detinebatur infirmitate.
text_pt: Porquanto um anjo descia em certo tempo ao tanque, e agitava a água; e o primeiro que ali descia, depois do movimento da água, sarava de qualquer enfermidade que tivesse.

text_en: And there was a certain man there that had been eight and thirty years under his infirmity.
text_la: Erat autem quidam homo ibi triginta et octo annos habens in infirmitate sua.
text_pt: E estava ali um homem que, havia trinta e oito anos, se achava enfermo.
text_el: ἦν δέ τις ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖ τριάκοντα καὶ ὀκτὼ ἔτη ἔχων ἐν τῇ ἀσθενείᾳ αὐτοῦ:

text_en: Him when Jesus had seen lying, and knew that he had been now a long time, he said to him: Will you be made whole?
text_la: Hunc autem cum vidisset Jesus jacentem, et cognovisset quia jam multum tempus haberet, dicit ei : Vis sanus fieri?
text_pt: E Jesus, vendo este deitado, e sabendo que estava neste estado havia muito tempo, disse-lhe: Queres ficar são?
text_el: τοῦτον ἰδὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς κατακείμενον, καὶ γνοὺς ὅτι πολὺν ἤδη χρόνον ἔχει, λέγει αὐτῷ: θέλεις ὑγιὴς γενέσθαι;

text_en: The infirm man answered him: Sir, I have no man , when the water is troubled, to put me into the pond. For whilst I am coming, another goes down before me.
text_la: Respondit ei languidus : Domine, hominem non habeo, ut, cum turbata fuerit aqua, mittat me in piscinam : dum venio enim ego, alius ante me descendit.
text_pt: O enfermo respondeu-lhe: Senhor, não tenho homem algum que, quando a água é agitada, me ponha no tanque; mas, enquanto eu vou, desce outro antes de mim.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ ὁ ἀσθενῶν: κύριε, ἄνθρωπον οὐκ ἔχω, ἵνα ὅταν ταραχθῇ τὸ ὕδωρ βάλῃ με εἰς τὴν κολυμβήθραν: ἐν ᾧ δὲ ἔρχομαι ἐγὼ ἄλλος πρὸ ἐμοῦ καταβαίνει.

text_en: Jesus said to him: Arise, take up your bed and walk.
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Surge, tolle grabatum tuum et ambula.
text_pt: Jesus disse-lhe: Levanta-te, toma o teu leito, e anda.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἔγειρε ἆρον τὸν κράβαττόν σου καὶ περιπάτει.

text_en: And immediately the man was made whole: and he took up his bed and walked. And it was the sabbath that day.
text_la: Et statim sanus factus est homo ille : et sustulit grabatum suum, et ambulabat. Erat autem sabbatum in die illo.
text_pt: Logo aquele homem ficou são; e tomou o seu leito, e andava. E aquele dia era sábado.
text_el: καὶ εὐθέως ἐγένετο ὑγιὴς ὁ ἄνθρωπος, καὶ ἦρεν τὸν κράβαττον αὐτοῦ καὶ περιεπάτει: ἦν δὲ σάββατον ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ.

text_en: The Jews therefore said to him that was healed: It is the sabbath . It is not lawful for you to take up your bed.
text_la: Dicebant ergo Judæi illi qui sanatus fuerat : Sabbatum est, non licet tibi tollere grabatum tuum.
text_pt: Então os judeus disseram àquele que tinha sido curado: É sábado, não te é lícito levar o leito.
text_el: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τῷ τεθεραπευμένῳ: σάββατόν ἐστιν, καὶ οὐκ ἔξεστίν σοι ἆραι τὸν κράβαττόν.

text_en: He answered them: He that made me whole, he said to me: Take up your bed and walk.
text_la: Respondit eis : Qui me sanum fecit, ille mihi dixit : Tolle grabatum tuum et ambula.
text_pt: Ele respondeu-lhes: Aquele que me curou, ele próprio disse: Toma o teu leito, e anda.
text_el: ὃς δὲ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς: ὁ ποιήσας με ὑγιῆ, ἐκεῖνός μοι εἶπεν: ἆρον τὸν κράβαττόν σου καὶ περιπάτει.

text_en: They asked him therefore: Who is that man who said to you: Take up your bed and walk?
text_la: Interrogaverunt ergo eum : Quis est ille homo qui dixit tibi : Tolle grabatum tuum et ambula?
text_pt: Perguntaram-lhe, pois: Quem é o homem que te disse: Toma o teu leito, e anda?
text_el: ἠρώτησαν αὐτόν: τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ εἰπών σοι: ἆρον καὶ περιπάτει;

text_en: But he who was healed knew not who it was: for Jesus went aside from the multitude standing in the place.
text_la: Is autem qui sanus fuerat effectus, nesciebat quis esset. Jesus enim declinavit a turba constituta in loco.
text_pt: E o que fora curado não sabia quem era; porque Jesus se havia retirado, em razão de naquele lugar haver grande multidão.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἰαθεὶς οὐκ ᾔδει τίς ἐστιν: ὁ γὰρ Ἰησοῦς ἐξένευσεν ὄχλου ὄντος ἐν τῷ τόπῳ.

text_en: Afterwards, Jesus finds him in the temple and said to him: Behold you are made whole: sin no more, lest some worse thing happen to you.
text_la: Postea invenit eum Jesus in templo, et dixit illi : Ecce sanus factus es; jam noli peccare, ne deterius tibi aliquid contingat.
text_pt: Depois Jesus encontrou-o no templo, e disse-lhe: Eis que já estás são; não peques mais, para que não te suceda alguma coisa pior.
text_el: μετὰ ταῦτα εὑρίσκει αὐτὸν [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἴδε ὑγιὴς γέγονας: μηκέτι ἁμάρτανε, ἵνα μὴ χεῖρόν σοί τι γένηται.

text_en: The man went his way and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him whole.
text_la: Abiit ille homo, et nuntiavit Judæis quia Jesus esset, qui fecit eum sanum.
text_pt: E aquele homem foi, e anunciou aos judeus que Jesus era o que o curara.
text_el: ἀπῆλθεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ ποιήσας αὐτὸν ὑγιῆ.

text_en: Therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus , because he did these things on the sabbath .
text_la: Propterea persequebantur Judæi Jesum, quia hæc faciebat in sabbato.
text_pt: E por esta causa os judeus perseguiram a Jesus, e procuravam matá-lo, porque fazia estas coisas no sábado.
text_el: καὶ διὰ τοῦτο ἐδίωκον οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι τὸν Ἰησοῦν, ὅτι ταῦτα ἐποίει ἐν σαββάτῳ.

text_en: But Jesus answered them: My Father works until now; and I work.
text_la: Jesus autem respondit eis : Pater meus usque modo operatur, et ego operor.
text_pt: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Meu Pai trabalha até agora, e eu trabalho também.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἀπεκρίνατο αὐτοῖς: ὁ πατήρ μου ἕως ἄρτι ἐργάζεται, κἀγὼ ἐργάζομαι.

text_en: Hereupon therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he did not only break the sabbath but also said God was his Father , making himself equal to God .
text_la: Propterea ergo magis quærebant eum Judæi interficere : quia non solum solvebat sabbatum, sed et patrem suum dicebat Deum, æqualem se faciens Deo. Respondit itaque Jesus, et dixit eis:
text_pt: Por isso, pois, os judeus ainda mais procuravam matá-lo, porque não só quebrantava o sábado, mas também dizia que Deus era seu próprio Pai, fazendo-se igual a Deus.
