text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὖν μᾶλλον ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀποκτεῖναι, ὅτι οὐ μόνον ἔλυεν τὸ σάββατον, ἀλλὰ καὶ πατέρα ἴδιον ἔλεγεν τὸν θεόν, ἴσον ἑαυτὸν ποιῶν τῷ θεῷ.

text_en: Then Jesus answered and said to them: Amen , amen , I say unto you, the Son cannot do anything of himself, but what he sees the Father doing: for what things soever he does, these the Son also does in like manner.
text_la: Amen, amen dico vobis : non potest Filius a se facere quidquam, nisi quod viderit Patrem facientem : quæcumque enim ille fecerit, hæc et Filius similiter facit.
text_pt: Mas Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhes: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que o Filho por si mesmo não pode fazer coisa alguma, se o não vir fazer o Pai; porque tudo quanto ele faz, o Filho o faz igualmente.
text_el: Ἀπεκρίνατο οὖν [ὁ Ἰησοῦς] καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐ δύναται ὁ υἱὸς ποιεῖν ἀφ' ἑαυτοῦ οὐδὲν, ἐὰν μή τι βλέπῃ τὸν πατέρα ποιοῦντα: ἃ γὰρ ἂν ἐκεῖνος ποιῇ, ταῦτα καὶ ὁ υἱὸς ὁμοίως ποιεῖ.

text_en: For the Father loves the Son and shows him all things which himself does: and greater works than these will he show him, that you may wonder.
text_la: Pater enim diligit Filium, et omnia demonstrat ei quæ ipse facit : et majora his demonstrabit ei opera, ut vos miremini.
text_pt: Porque o Pai ama o Filho, e mostra-lhe tudo o que faz; e ele lhe mostrará maiores obras do que estas, para que vos maravilheis.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ πατὴρ φιλεῖ τὸν υἱὸν καὶ πάντα δείκνυσιν αὐτῷ ἃ αὐτὸς ποιεῖ, καὶ μείζονα τούτων δείξει αὐτῷ ἔργα, ἵνα ὑμεῖς θαυμάζητε.

text_en: For as the Father raises up the dead and gives life: so the Son also gives life to whom he will.
text_la: Sicut enim Pater suscitat mortuos, et vivificat, sic et Filius, quos vult, vivificat.
text_pt: Pois, assim como o Pai ressuscita os mortos, e os vivifica, assim também o Filho vivifica aqueles que quer.
text_el: ὥσπερ γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ ἐγείρει τοὺς νεκροὺς καὶ ζῳοποιεῖ, οὕτως καὶ ὁ υἱὸς οὓς θέλει ζῳοποιεῖ.

text_en: For neither does the Father judge any man : but has given all judgment to the Son.
text_la: Neque enim Pater judicat quemquam : sed omne judicium dedit Filio,
text_pt: E também o Pai a ninguém julga, mas deu ao Filho todo o juízo;
text_el: οὐδὲ γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ κρίνει οὐδένα, ἀλλὰ τὴν κρίσιν πᾶσαν δέδωκεν τῷ υἱῷ,

text_en: That all men may honour the Son, as they honour the Father . He who honours not the Son honours not the Father who has sent him.
text_la: ut omnes honorificent Filium, sicut honorificant Patrem; qui non honorificat Filium, non honorificat Patrem, qui misit illum.
text_pt: Para que todos honrem o Filho, como honram o Pai. Quem não honra o Filho, não honra o Pai que o enviou.
text_el: ἵνα πάντες τιμῶσι τὸν υἱὸν καθὼς τιμῶσι τὸν πατέρα. ὁ μὴ τιμῶν τὸν υἱὸν οὐ τιμᾷ τὸν πατέρα τὸν πέμψαντα αὐτόν.

text_en: Amen , amen , I say unto you that he who hears my word and believes him that sent me has life everlasting: and comes not into judgment, but is passed from death to life.
text_la: Amen, amen dico vobis, quia qui verbum meum audit, et credit ei qui misit me, habet vitam æternam, et in judicium non venit, sed transiit a morte in vitam.
text_pt: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que quem ouve a minha palavra, e crê naquele que me enviou, tem a vida eterna, e não entrará em condenação, mas passou da morte para a vida.
text_el: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὁ τὸν λόγον μου ἀκούων καὶ πιστεύων τῷ πέμψαντί με ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον, καὶ εἰς κρίσιν οὐκ ἔρχεται ἀλλὰ μεταβέβηκεν ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου εἰς τὴν ζωήν.

text_en: Amen , amen , I say unto you, that the hour comes, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God : and they that hear shall live.
text_la: Amen, amen dico vobis, quia venit hora, et nunc est, quando mortui audient vocem Filii Dei : et qui audierint, vivent.
text_pt: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que vem a hora, e agora é, em que os mortos ouvirão a voz do Filho de Deus, e os que a ouvirem viverão.
text_el: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ νῦν ἐστιν, ὅτε οἱ νεκροὶ ἀκούσουσιν τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀκούσαντες ζήσουσιν.

text_en: For as the Father has life in himself, so he has given to the Son also to have life in himself.
text_la: Sicut enim Pater habet vitam in semetipso, sic dedit et Filio habere vitam in semetipso:
text_pt: Porque, como o Pai tem a vida em si mesmo, assim deu também ao Filho ter a vida em si mesmo;
text_el: ὥσπερ γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ ἔχει ζωὴν ἐν ἑαυτῷ, οὕτως καὶ τῷ υἱῷ ἔδωκεν ζωὴν ἔχειν ἐν ἑαυτῷ:

text_en: And he has given him power to do judgment, because he is the Son of man .
text_la: et potestatem dedit ei judicium facere, quia Filius hominis est.
text_pt: E deu-lhe o poder de exercer o juízo, porque é o Filho do homem.
text_el: καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ κρίσιν ποιεῖν, ὅτι υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ἐστίν.

text_en: Wonder not at this: for the hour comes wherein all that are in the graves shall hear the voice of the Son of God .
text_la: Nolite mirari hoc, quia venit hora in qua omnes qui in monumentis sunt audient vocem Filii Dei:
text_pt: Não vos maravilheis disto; porque vem a hora em que todos os que estão nos sepulcros ouvirão a sua voz.
text_el: μὴ θαυμάζετε τοῦτο, ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα ἐν ᾗ πάντες οἱ ἐν τοῖς μνημείοις ἀκούσουσιν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And they that have done good things shall come forth unto the resurrection of life: but they that have done evil , unto the resurrection of judgment.
text_la: et procedent qui bona fecerunt, in resurrectionem vitæ; qui vero mala egerunt, in resurrectionem judicii.
text_pt: E os que fizeram o bem sairão para a ressurreição da vida; e os que fizeram o mal para a ressurreição da condenação.
text_el: καὶ ἐκπορεύσονται οἱ τὰ ἀγαθὰ ποιήσαντες εἰς ἀνάστασιν ζωῆς, οἱ τὰ φαῦλα πράξαντες εἰς ἀνάστασιν κρίσεως.

text_en: I cannot of myself do anything. As I hear, so I judge. And my judgment is just : because I seek not my own will but the will of him that sent me.
text_la: Non possum ego a meipso facere quidquam. Sicut audio, judico : et judicium meum justum est, quia non quæro voluntatem meam, sed voluntatem ejus qui misit me.
text_pt: Eu não posso de mim mesmo fazer coisa alguma. Como ouço, assim julgo; e o meu juízo é justo, porque não busco a minha vontade, mas a vontade do Pai que me enviou.
text_el: οὐ δύναμαι ἐγὼ ποιεῖν ἀπ' ἐμαυτοῦ οὐδέν: καθὼς ἀκούω κρίνω, καὶ ἡ κρίσις ἡ ἐμὴ δικαία ἐστίν, ὅτι οὐ ζητῶ τὸ θέλημα τὸ ἐμὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με

text_en: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true .
text_la: Si ego testimonium perhibeo de meipso, testimonium meum non est verum.
text_pt: Se eu testifico de mim mesmo, o meu testemunho não é verdadeiro.
text_el: ἐὰν ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ, ἡ μαρτυρία μου οὐκ ἔστιν ἀληθής:

text_en: There is another that bears witness of me: and I know that the witness which he witnesses of me is true .
text_la: Alius est qui testimonium perhibet de me : et scio quia verum est testimonium, quod perhibet de me.
text_pt: Há outro que testifica de mim, e sei que o testemunho que ele dá de mim é verdadeiro.
text_el: ἄλλος ἐστὶν ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ ἐμοῦ, καὶ οἶδα ὅτι ἀληθής ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία ἣν μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ.

text_en: You sent to John : and he gave testimony to the truth .
text_la: Vos misistis ad Joannem, et testimonium perhibuit veritati.
text_pt: Vós mandastes mensageiros a João, e ele deu testemunho da verdade.
text_el: ὑμεῖς ἀπεστάλκατε πρὸς Ἰωάννην, καὶ μεμαρτύρηκεν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ:

text_en: But I receive not testimony from man : but I say these things, that you may be saved.
text_la: Ego autem non ab homine testimonium accipio: sed hæc dico ut vos salvi sitis.
text_pt: Eu, porém, não recebo testemunho de homem; mas digo isto, para que vos salveis.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ παρὰ ἀνθρώπου τὴν μαρτυρίαν λαμβάνω, ἀλλὰ ταῦτα λέγω ἵνα ὑμεῖς σωθῆτε.

text_en: He was a burning and a shining light: and you were willing for a time to rejoice in his light.
text_la: Ille erat lucerna ardens et lucens : vos autem voluistis ad horam exsultare in luce ejus.
text_pt: Ele era a candeia que ardia e alumiava, e vós quisestes alegrar-vos por um pouco de tempo com a sua luz.
text_el: ἐκεῖνος ἦν ὁ λύχνος ὁ καιόμενος καὶ φαίνων, ὑμεῖς δὲ ἠθελήσατε ἀγαλλιαθῆναι πρὸς ὥραν ἐν τῷ φωτὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: But I have a greater testimony than that of John : for the works which the Father has given me to perfect, the works themselves which I do, give testimony of me, that the Father has sent me.
text_la: Ego autem habeo testimonium majus Joanne. Opera enim quæ dedit mihi Pater ut perficiam ea : ipsa opera, quæ ego facio, testimonium perhibent de me, quia Pater misit me:
text_pt: Mas eu tenho maior testemunho do que o de João; porque as obras que o Pai me deu para realizar, as mesmas obras que eu faço, testificam de mim, que o Pai me enviou.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἔχω τὴν μαρτυρίαν μείζω τοῦ Ἰωάννου: τὰ γὰρ ἔργα ἃ δέδωκέν μοι ὁ πατὴρ ἵνα τελειώσω αὐτά, αὐτὰ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιῶ μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὅτι ὁ πατήρ με ἀπέσταλκεν.

text_en: And the Father himself who has sent me has given testimony of me: neither have you heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
text_la: et qui misit me Pater, ipse testimonium perhibuit de me : neque vocem ejus umquam audistis, neque speciem ejus vidistis:
text_pt: E o Pai, que me enviou, ele mesmo testificou de mim. Vós nunca ouvistes a sua voz, nem vistes o seu parecer.
text_el: καὶ ὁ πέμψας με πατὴρ, ἐκεῖνος μεμαρτύρηκεν περὶ ἐμοῦ. οὔτε φωνὴν αὐτοῦ πώποτε ἀκηκόατε, οὔτε εἶδος αὐτοῦ ἑωράκατε,

text_en: And you have not his word abiding in you: for whom he has sent, him you believe not.
text_la: et verbum ejus non habetis in vobis manens : quia quem misit ille, huic vos non creditis.
text_pt: E a sua palavra não permanece em vós, porque naquele que ele enviou não credes vós.
text_el: καὶ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔχετε ἐν ὑμῖν μένοντα, ὅτι ὃν ἀπέστειλεν ἐκεῖνος, τούτῳ ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετε.

text_en: Search the scriptures : for you think in them to have life everlasting. And the same are they that give testimony of me.
text_la: Scrutamini Scripturas, quia vos putatis in ipsis vitam æternam habere : et illæ sunt quæ testimonium perhibent de me:
text_pt: Examinais as Escrituras, porque vós cuidais ter nelas a vida eterna, e são elas que de mim testificam;
text_el: ἐραυνᾶτε τὰς γραφάς, ὅτι ὑμεῖς δοκεῖτε ἐν αὐταῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἔχειν: καὶ ἐκεῖναί εἰσιν αἱ μαρτυροῦσαι περὶ ἐμοῦ:

text_en: And you will not come to me that you may have life.
text_la: et non vultis venire ad me ut vitam habeatis.
text_pt: E não quereis vir a mim para terdes vida.
text_el: καὶ οὐ θέλετε ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἵνα ζωὴν ἔχητε.

text_en: I receive not glory from men .
text_la: Claritatem ab hominibus non accipio.
text_pt: Eu não recebo glória dos homens;
text_el: δόξαν παρὰ ἀνθρώπων οὐ λαμβάνω,

text_en: But I know you, that you have not the love of God in you.
text_la: Sed cognovi vos, quia dilectionem Dei non habetis in vobis.
text_pt: Mas bem vos conheço, que não tendes em vós o amor de Deus.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἔγνωκα ὑμᾶς ὅτι τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἔχετε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.

text_en: I have come in the name of my Father , and you receive me not: if another shall come in his own name , him you will receive.
text_la: Ego veni in nomine Patris mei, et non accipitis me; si alius venerit in nomine suo, illum accipietis.
text_pt: Eu vim em nome de meu Pai, e não me aceitais; se outro vier em seu próprio nome, a esse aceitareis.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἐλήλυθα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρός μου, καὶ οὐ λαμβάνετέ με: ἐὰν ἄλλος ἔλθῃ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τῷ ἰδίῳ, ἐκεῖνον λήμψεσθε.

text_en: How can you believe , who receive glory one from another: and the glory which is from God alone, you do not seek?
text_la: Quomodo vos potestis credere, qui gloriam ab invicem accipitis, et gloriam quæ a solo Deo est, non quæritis?
text_pt: Como podeis vós crer, recebendo honra uns dos outros, e não buscando a honra que vem só de Deus?
text_el: πῶς δύνασθε ὑμεῖς πιστεῦσαι, δόξαν παρὰ ἀλλήλων λαμβάνοντες, καὶ τὴν δόξαν τὴν παρὰ τοῦ μόνου [θεοῦ] οὐ ζητεῖτε;

text_en: Think not that I will accuse you to the Father . There is one that accuses you, Moses , in whom you trust.
text_la: Nolite putare quia ego accusaturus sim vos apud Patrem : est qui accusat vos Moyses, in quo vos speratis.
text_pt: Não cuideis que eu vos hei de acusar para com o Pai. Há um que vos acusa, Moisés, em quem vós esperais.
text_el: μὴ δοκεῖτε ὅτι ἐγὼ κατηγορήσω ὑμῶν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα: ἔστιν ὁ κατηγορῶν ὑμῶν Μωϋσῆς, εἰς ὃν ὑμεῖς ἠλπίκατε.

text_en: For if you did believe Moses , you would perhaps believe me also: for he wrote of me.
text_la: Si enim crederetis Moysi, crederetis forsitan et mihi : de me enim ille scripsit.
text_pt: Porque, se vós crêsseis em Moisés, creríeis em mim; porque de mim escreveu ele.
text_el: εἰ γὰρ ἐπιστεύετε Μωϋσεῖ, ἐπιστεύετε ἂν ἐμοί: περὶ γὰρ ἐμοῦ ἐκεῖνος ἔγραψεν.

text_en: But if you do not believe his writings, how will you believe my words?
text_la: Si autem illius litteris non creditis, quomodo verbis meis credetis?
text_pt: Mas, se não credes nos seus escritos, como crereis nas minhas palavras?
text_el: εἰ δὲ τοῖς ἐκείνου γράμμασιν οὐ πιστεύετε, πῶς τοῖς ἐμοῖς ῥήμασιν πιστεύσετε;

text_en: M any therefore of his disciples , hearing it, said: "This saying is hard; and who can hear it?"
text_la: Post hæc abiit Jesus trans mare Galilææ, quod est Tiberiadis:
text_pt: Depois disto partiu Jesus para o outro lado do mar da Galiléia, que é o de Tiberíades.
text_el: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἀπῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς Γαλιλαίας τῆς Τιβεριάδος:

text_en: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw the miracles which he did on those who were diseased.
text_la: et sequebatur eum multitudo magna, quia videbant signa quæ faciebat super his qui infirmabantur.
text_pt: E grande multidão o seguia, porque via os sinais que operava sobre os enfermos.
text_el: ἠκολούθει δὲ αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς, ὅτι ἐθεώρουν τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίει ἐπὶ τῶν ἀσθενούντων.

text_en: Jesus therefore went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples .
text_la: Subiit ergo in montem Jesus et ibi sedebat cum discipulis suis.
text_pt: E Jesus subiu ao monte, e assentou-se ali com os seus discípulos.
text_el: ἀνῆλθεν δὲ εἰς τὸ ὄρος Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐκεῖ ἐκάθητο μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Now the pasch , the festival day of the Jews , was near at hand.
text_la: Erat autem proximum Pascha dies festus Judæorum.
text_pt: E a páscoa, a festa dos judeus, estava próxima.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ἐγγὺς τὸ πάσχα, ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων.

text_en: When Jesus therefore had lifted up his eyes and seen that a very great multitude was coming to him, he said to Philip : "Where shall we buy bread, that these may eat?"
text_la: Cum sublevasset ergo oculos Jesus, et vidisset quia multitudo maxima venit ad eum, dixit ad Philippum : Unde ememus panes, ut manducent hi?
text_pt: Então Jesus, levantando os olhos, e vendo que uma grande multidão vinha ter com ele, disse a Filipe: Onde compraremos pão, para estes comerem?
text_el: ἐπάρας οὖν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ θεασάμενος ὅτι πολὺς ὄχλος ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγει πρὸς Φίλιππον: πόθεν ἀγοράσωμεν ἄρτους ἵνα φάγωσιν οὗτοι;

text_en: And this he said to try him, for he himself knew what he would do.
text_la: Hoc autem dicebat tentans eum : ipse enim sciebat quid esset facturus.
text_pt: Mas dizia isto para o experimentar; porque ele bem sabia o que havia de fazer.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγεν πειράζων αὐτόν: αὐτὸς γὰρ ᾔδει τί ἔμελλεν ποιεῖν.

text_en: Philip answered him: "Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them that every one may take a little."
text_la: Respondit ei Philippus : Ducentorum denariorum panes non sufficiunt eis, ut unusquisque modicum quid accipiat.
text_pt: Filipe respondeu-lhe: Duzentos dinheiros de pão não lhes bastarão, para que cada um deles tome um pouco.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Φίλιππος, διακοσίων δηναρίων ἄρτοι οὐκ ἀρκοῦσιν αὐτοῖς, ἵνα ἕκαστος βραχύ λάβῃ.

text_en: One of his disciples , Andrew , the brother of Simon Peter , said to him:
text_la: Dicit ei unus ex discipulis ejus, Andreas, frater Simonis Petri:
text_pt: E um dos seus discípulos, André, irmão de Simão Pedro, disse-lhe:
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ εἷς ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ, Ἀνδρέας ὁ ἀδελφὸς Σίμωνος Πέτρου:

text_en: "There is a boy here that has five barley loaves and two fishes. But what are these among so many?"
text_la: Est puer unus hic qui habet quinque panes hordeaceos et duos pisces : sed hæc quid sunt inter tantos?
text_pt: Está aqui um rapaz que tem cinco pães de cevada e dois peixinhos; mas que é isto para tantos?
text_el: ἔστιν παιδάριον ὧδε ὃς ἔχει πέντε ἄρτους κριθίνους καὶ δύο ὀψάρια: ἀλλὰ ταῦτα τί ἐστιν εἰς τοσούτους;

text_en: Then Jesus said: "Make the men sit down." Now, there was much grass in the place. The men therefore sat down, in number about five thousand.
text_la: Dixit ergo Jesus : Facite homines discumbere. Erat autem fœnum multum in loco. Discumberunt ergo viri, numero quasi quinque millia.
text_pt: E disse Jesus: Mandai assentar os homens. E havia muita relva naquele lugar. Assentaram-se, pois, os homens em número de quase cinco mil.
text_el: εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ποιήσατε τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἀναπεσεῖν. ἦν δὲ χόρτος πολὺς ἐν τῷ τόπῳ. ἀνέπεσαν οὖν οἱ ἄνδρες τὸν ἀριθμὸν ὡς πεντακισχίλιοι.

text_en: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to them that were set down. In like manner also of the fishes, as much as they would.
text_la: Accepit ergo Jesus panes : et cum gratias egisset, distribuit discumbentibus : similiter et ex piscibus quantum volebant.
text_pt: E Jesus tomou os pães e, havendo dado graças, repartiu-os pelos discípulos, e os discípulos pelos que estavam assentados; e igualmente também dos peixes, quanto eles queriam.
text_el: ἔλαβεν οὖν τοὺς ἄρτους ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εὐχαριστήσας διέδωκεν τοῖς ἀνακειμένοις, ὁμοίως καὶ ἐκ τῶν ὀψαρίων ὅσον ἤθελον.

text_en: And when they were filled, he said to his disciples : "Gather up the fragments that remain, lest they be lost."
text_la: Ut autem impleti sunt, dixit discipulis suis : Colligite quæ superaverunt fragmenta, ne pereant.
text_pt: E, quando estavam saciados, disse aos seus discípulos: Recolhei os pedaços que sobejaram, para que nada se perca.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐνεπλήσθησαν, λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ: συναγάγετε τὰ περισσεύσαντα κλάσματα, ἵνα μή τι ἀπόληται.

text_en: They gathered up therefore and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves which remained over and above to them that had eaten.
text_la: Collegerunt ergo, et impleverunt duodecim cophinos fragmentorum ex quinque panibus hordeaceis, quæ superfuerunt his qui manducaverant.
text_pt: Recolheram-nos, pois, e encheram doze alcofas de pedaços dos cinco pães de cevada, que sobejaram aos que haviam comido.
text_el: συνήγαγον οὖν, καὶ ἐγέμισαν δώδεκα κοφίνους κλασμάτων ἐκ τῶν πέντε ἄρτων τῶν κριθίνων, ἃ ἐπερίσσευσαν τοῖς βεβρωκόσιν.

text_en: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
text_la: Illi ergo homines cum vidissent quod Jesus fecerat signum, dicebant : Quia hic est vere propheta, qui venturus est in mundum.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, aqueles homens o milagre que Jesus tinha feito, diziam: Este é verdadeiramente o profeta que devia vir ao mundo.
text_el: Οἱ οὖν ἄνθρωποι ἰδόντες ἃ ἐποίησεν σημεῖα ἔλεγον ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ προφήτης ὁ ἐρχόμενος εἰς τὸν κόσμον.

text_en: Jesus therefore, when he knew that they would come to take him by force and make him king, fled again into the mountains, himself alone.
text_la: Jesus ergo cum cognovisset quia venturi essent ut raperent eum, et facerent eum regem, fugit iterum in montem ipse solus.
text_pt: Sabendo, pois, Jesus que haviam de vir arrebatá-lo, para o fazerem rei, tornou a retirar-se, ele só, para o monte.
text_el: Ἰησοῦς οὖν γνοὺς ὅτι μέλλουσιν ἔρχεσθαι καὶ ἁρπάζειν αὐτὸν ἵνα ποιήσωσιν βασιλέα, ἀνεχώρησεν πάλιν εἰς τὸ ὄρος αὐτὸς μόνος.

text_en: And when evening had come, his disciples went down to the sea.
text_la: Ut autem sero factum est, descenderunt discipuli ejus ad mare.
text_pt: E, quando veio a tarde, os seus discípulos desceram para o mar.
text_el: Ὡς δὲ ὀψία ἐγένετο, κατέβησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν,

text_en: And when they had gone up into a ship, they went over the sea to Capharnaum . And it was now dark, and Jesus had not come unto them.
text_la: Et cum ascendissent navim, venerunt trans mare in Capharnaum : et tenebræ jam factæ erant et non venerat ad eos Jesus.
text_pt: E, entrando no barco, atravessaram o mar em direção a Cafarnaum; e era já escuro, e ainda Jesus não tinha chegado ao pé deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐμβάντες εἰς πλοῖον ἤρχοντο πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἰς Καφαρναούμ. καὶ σκοτία ἤδη ἐγεγόνει καὶ οὔπω ἐληλύθει πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς,

text_en: And the sea arose, by reason of a great wind that blew.
text_la: Mare autem, vento magno flante, exsurgebat.
text_pt: E o mar se levantou, porque um grande vento assoprava.
text_el: ἥ τε θάλασσα ἀνέμου μεγάλου πνέοντος διεγείρετο.

text_en: When they had rowed therefore about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they saw Jesus walking upon the sea and drawing near to the ship. And they were afraid.
text_la: Cum remigassent ergo quasi stadia viginti quinque aut triginta, vident Jesum ambulantem supra mare, et proximum navi fieri, et timuerunt.
text_pt: E, tendo navegado uns vinte e cinco ou trinta estádios, viram a Jesus, andando sobre o mar e aproximando-se do barco; e temeram.
text_el: ἐληλακότες οὖν ὡς σταδίους εἴκοσι πέντε ἢ τριάκοντα θεωροῦσιν τὸν Ἰησοῦν περιπατοῦντα ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἐγγὺς τοῦ πλοίου γινόμενον, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν.

text_en: But he said to them: "It is I. Be not afraid."
text_la: Ille autem dicit eis : Ego sum, nolite timere.
text_pt: Mas ele lhes disse: Sou eu, não temais.
text_el: ὁ δὲ λέγει αὐτοῖς: ἐγώ εἰμι, μὴ φοβεῖσθε.

text_en: They were willing therefore to take him into the ship. And presently the ship was at the land to which they were going.
text_la: Voluerunt ergo accipere eum in navim et statim navis fuit ad terram, in quam ibant.
text_pt: Então eles de boa mente o receberam no barco; e logo o barco chegou à terra para onde iam.
text_el: ἤθελον οὖν λαβεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, καὶ εὐθέως ἐγένετο τὸ πλοῖον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἰς ἣν ὑπῆγον.

text_en: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but {that} his disciples were gone away alone;
text_la: Altera die, turba, quæ stabat trans mare, vidit quia navicula alia non erat ibi nisi una, et quia non introisset cum discipulis suis Jesus in navim, sed soli discipuli ejus abiissent:
text_pt: No dia seguinte, a multidão que estava do outro lado do mar, vendo que não havia ali mais do que um barquinho, a não ser aquele no qual os discípulos haviam entrado, e que Jesus não entrara com os seus discípulos naquele barquinho, mas que os seus discípulos tinham ido sozinhos
text_el: Τῇ ἐπαύριον ὁ ὄχλος ὁ ἑστηκὼς πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἶδον ὅτι πλοιάριον ἄλλο οὐκ ἦν ἐκεῖ εἰ μὴ ἕν, καὶ ὅτι οὐ συνεισῆλθεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ πλοῖον ἀλλὰ μόνοι οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθον:

text_en: But other ships came in from Tiberias, near unto the place where they had eaten the bread, the Lord giving thanks.
text_la: aliæ vero supervenerunt naves a Tiberiade juxta locum ubi manducaverunt panem, gratias agente Domino.
text_pt: (Contudo, outros barquinhos tinham chegado de Tiberíades, perto do lugar onde comeram o pão, havendo o Senhor dado graças).
text_el: ἄλλα ἦλθεν πλοῖα ἐκ Τιβεριάδος ἐγγὺς τοῦ τόπου ὅπου ἔφαγον τὸν ἄρτον εὐχαριστήσαντος τοῦ κυρίου.

text_en: When therefore the multitude saw that Jesus was not there, nor his disciples , they took shipping and came to Capharnaum , seeking for Jesus .
text_la: Cum ergo vidisset turba quia Jesus non esset ibi, neque discipuli ejus, ascenderunt in naviculas, et venerunt Capharnaum quærentes Jesum.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, a multidão que Jesus não estava ali nem os seus discípulos, entraram eles também nos barcos, e foram a Cafarnaum, em busca de Jesus.
text_el: ὅτε οὖν εἶδεν ὁ ὄχλος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκεῖ οὐδὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, ἐνέβησαν αὐτοὶ εἰς τὰ πλοιάρια καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ ζητοῦντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: And when they had found him on that other side of the sea, they said to him: "Rabbi, when did you come here?"
text_la: Et cum invenissent eum trans mare, dixerunt ei : Rabbi, quando huc venisti?
text_pt: E, achando-o no outro lado do mar, disseram-lhe: Rabi, quando chegaste aqui?
text_el: καὶ εὑρόντες αὐτὸν πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἶπον αὐτῷ: ῥαββί, πότε ὧδε γέγονας;

text_en: Jesus answered them and said: " Amen , amen , I say to you, you seek me, not because you have seen miracles , but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
text_la: Respondit eis Jesus, et dixit : Amen, amen dico vobis : quæritis me non quia vidistis signa, sed quia manducastis ex panibus et saturati estis.
text_pt: Jesus respondeu-lhes e disse: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que me buscais, não pelos sinais que vistes, mas porque comestes do pão e vos saciastes.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ζητεῖτέ με οὐχ ὅτι εἴδετε σημεῖα, ἀλλ' ὅτι ἐφάγετε ἐκ τῶν ἄρτων καὶ ἐχορτάσθητε.

text_en: Labour not for the meat which perishes, but for that which endures unto life everlasting, which the Son of man will give you. For him has God, the Father , sealed."
text_la: Operamini non cibum, qui perit, sed qui permanet in vitam æternam, quem Filius hominis dabit vobis. Hunc enim Pater signavit Deus.
text_pt: Trabalhai, não pela comida que perece, mas pela comida que permanece para a vida eterna, a qual o Filho do homem vos dará; porque a este o Pai, Deus, o selou.
text_el: ἐργάζεσθε μὴ τὴν βρῶσιν τὴν ἀπολλυμένην, ἀλλὰ τὴν βρῶσιν τὴν μένουσαν εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, ἣν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑμῖν δώσει: τοῦτον γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ ἐσφράγισεν, ὁ θεός.

text_en: They said therefore unto him: "What shall we do, that we may work the works of God ?"
text_la: Dixerunt ergo ad eum: Quid faciemus ut operemur opera Dei?
text_pt: Disseram-lhe, pois: Que faremos para executarmos as obras de Deus?
text_el: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτόν: τί ποιῶμεν ἵνα ἐργαζώμεθα τὰ ἔργα τοῦ θεοῦ;

text_en: Jesus answered and said to them: "This is the work of God , that you believe in him whom he has sent."
text_la: Respondit Jesus, et dixit eis : Hoc est opus Dei, ut credatis in eum quem misit ille.
text_pt: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhes: A obra de Deus é esta: Que creiais naquele que ele enviou.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ ἔργον τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα πιστεύητε εἰς ὃν ἀπέστειλεν ἐκεῖνος.

text_en: They said therefore to him: "What sign therefore do you show that we may see and may believe you? What do you work?
text_la: Dixerunt ergo ei : Quod ergo tu facis signum ut videamus et credamus tibi? quid operaris?
text_pt: Disseram-lhe, pois: Que sinal, pois, fazes tu, para que o vejamos, e creiamos em ti? Que operas tu?
text_el: εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ: τί οὖν ποιεῖς σὺ σημεῖον, ἵνα ἴδωμεν καὶ πιστεύσωμέν σοι; τί ἐργάζῃ;

text_en: Our fathers ate manna in the desert , as it is written: 'He gave them bread from heaven to eat.'"
text_la: Patres nostri manducaverunt manna in deserto, sicut scriptum est : Panem de cælo dedit eis manducare.
text_pt: Nossos pais comeram o maná no deserto, como está escrito: Deu-lhes a comer o pão do céu.
text_el: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν τὸ μάννα ἔφαγον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καθώς ἐστιν γεγραμμένον: ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν.

text_en: Then Jesus said to them: " Amen , amen , I say to you; Moses gave you not bread from heaven , but my Father gives you the true bread from heaven .
text_la: Dixit ergo eis Jesus : Amen, amen dico vobis : non Moyses dedit vobis panem de cælo, sed Pater meus dat vobis panem de cælo verum.
text_pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo: Moisés não vos deu o pão do céu; mas meu Pai vos dá o verdadeiro pão do céu.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐ Μωϋσῆς ἔδωκεν ὑμῖν τὸν ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, ἀλλ' ὁ πατήρ μου δίδωσιν ὑμῖν τὸν ἄρτον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τὸν ἀληθινόν.

text_en: For the bread of God is that which comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."
text_la: Panis enim Dei est, qui de cælo descendit, et dat vitam mundo.
text_pt: Porque o pão de Deus é aquele que desce do céu e dá vida ao mundo.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ ἄρτος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν ὁ καταβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ζωὴν διδοὺς τῷ κόσμῳ.

text_en: They said therefore unto him: "Lord, give us always this bread."
text_la: Dixerunt ergo ad eum : Domine, semper da nobis panem hunc.
text_pt: Disseram-lhe, pois: Senhor, dá-nos sempre desse pão.
text_el: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτόν: κύριε, πάντοτε δὸς ἡμῖν τὸν ἄρτον τοῦτον.

text_en: And Jesus said to them: "I am the bread of life. He that comes to me shall not hunger, and he that believes in me shall never thirst.
text_la: Dixit autem eis Jesus : Ego sum panis vitæ : qui venit ad me, non esuriet, et qui credit in me, non sitiet umquam.
text_pt: E Jesus lhes disse: Eu sou o pão da vida; aquele que vem a mim não terá fome, e quem crê em mim nunca terá sede.
text_el: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς: ὁ ἐρχόμενος πρός ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ πεινάσῃ, καὶ ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ διψήσει πώποτε.

text_en: But I said unto you that you also have seen me, and you believe not.
text_la: Sed dixi vobis quia et vidistis me, et non creditis.
text_pt: Mas já vos disse que também vós me vistes, e contudo não credes.
text_el: ἀλλ' εἶπον ὑμῖν ὅτι καὶ ἑωράκατέ [με] καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε.

text_en: All that the Father gives to me shall come to me — and him that comes to me, I will not cast out.
text_la: Omne quod dat mihi Pater, ad me veniet : et eum qui venit ad me, non ejiciam foras:
text_pt: Todo o que o Pai me dá virá a mim; e o que vem a mim de maneira nenhuma o lançarei fora.
text_el: πᾶν ὃ δίδωσίν μοι ὁ πατὴρ πρὸς ἐμὲ ἥξει, καὶ τὸν ἐρχόμενον πρὸς με οὐ μὴ ἐκβάλω ἔξω,

text_en: Because I came down from heaven , not to do my own will but the will of him that sent me.
text_la: quia descendi de cælo, non ut faciam voluntatem meam, sed voluntatem ejus qui misit me.
text_pt: Porque eu desci do céu, não para fazer a minha vontade, mas a vontade daquele que me enviou.
text_el: ὅτι καταβέβηκα ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ οὐχ ἵνα ποιῶ τὸ θέλημα τὸ ἐμὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με:

text_en: Now this is the will of the Father who sent me: that of all that he has given me, I should lose nothing; but should raise it up again in the last day.
text_la: Hæc est autem voluntas ejus qui misit me, Patris : ut omne quod dedit mihi, non perdam ex eo, sed resuscitem illud in novissimo die.
text_pt: E a vontade do Pai que me enviou é esta: Que nenhum de todos aqueles que me deu se perca, mas que o ressuscite no último dia.
text_el: τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με, ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκέν μοι μὴ ἀπολέσω ἐξ αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸ τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.

text_en: And this is the will of my Father that sent me: that every one who sees the Son and believes in him may have life everlasting. And I will raise him up in the last day."
text_la: Hæc est autem voluntas Patris mei, qui misit me : ut omnis qui videt Filium et credit in eum, habeat vitam æternam, et ego resuscitabo eum in novissimo die.
text_pt: Porquanto a vontade daquele que me enviou é esta: Que todo aquele que vê o Filho, e crê nele, tenha a vida eterna; e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.
text_el: τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πατρός μου, ἵνα πᾶς ὁ θεωρῶν τὸν υἱὸν καὶ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον καὶ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν ἐγὼ τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.

text_en: The Jews therefore murmured at him, because he had said: "I am the living bread which came down from heaven ."
text_la: Murmurabant ergo Judæi de illo, quia dixisset : Ego sum panis vivus, qui de cælo descendi,
text_pt: Murmuravam, pois, dele os judeus, porque dissera: Eu sou o pão que desceu do céu.
text_el: Ἐγόγγυζον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι περὶ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι εἶπεν: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος ὁ καταβὰς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ,

text_en: And they said: "Is not this Jesus , the son of Joseph , whose father and mother we know ? How then says he: 'I came down from heaven ?'"
text_la: et dicebant : Nonne hic est Jesus filius Joseph, cujus nos novimus patrem et matrem? quomodo ergo dicit hic : Quia de cælo descendi?
text_pt: E diziam: Não é este Jesus, o filho de José, cujo pai e mãe nós conhecemos? Como, pois, diz ele: Desci do céu?
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγον: οὐχὶ οὗτός ἐστιν Ἰησοῦς ὁ υἱὸς Ἰωσήφ, οὗ ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα; πῶς νῦν λέγει ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβέβηκα;

text_en: Jesus therefore answered and said to them: "Murmur not among yourselves.
text_la: Respondit ergo Jesus, et dixit eis : Nolite murmurare in invicem:
text_pt: Respondeu, pois, Jesus, e disse-lhes: Não murmureis entre vós.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: μὴ γογγύζετε μετ' ἀλλήλων.

text_en: No man can come to me, unless the Father , who has sent me, draws him. And I will raise him up in the last day.
text_la: nemo potest venire ad me, nisi Pater, qui misit me, traxerit eum; et ego resuscitabo eum in novissimo die.
text_pt: Ninguém pode vir a mim, se o Pai que me enviou o não trouxer; e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.
text_el: οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἐὰν μὴ ὁ πατὴρ ὁ πέμψας με ἑλκύσῃ αὐτόν, κἀγὼ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.

text_en: It is written in the prophets : 'And they shall all be taught of God .' Every one that has heard of the Father and has learned comes forth me.
text_la: Est scriptum in prophetis : Et erunt omnes docibiles Dei. Omnis qui audivit a Patre, et didicit, venit ad me.
text_pt: Está escrito nos profetas: E serão todos ensinados por Deus. Portanto, todo aquele que do Pai ouviu e aprendeu vem a mim.
text_el: ἔστιν γεγραμμένον ἐν τοῖς προφήταις: καὶ ἔσονται πάντες διδακτοὶ θεοῦ: πᾶς ὁ ἀκούσας παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ μαθὼν ἔρχεται πρὸς ἐμέ.

text_en: Not that any man has seen the Father ; but he who is of God , he has seen the Father .
text_la: Non quia Patrem vidit quisquam, nisi is, qui est a Deo, hic vidit Patrem.
text_pt: Não que alguém visse ao Pai, a não ser aquele que é de Deus; este tem visto ao Pai.
text_el: οὐχ ὅτι τὸν πατέρα ἑώρακέν τις, εἰ μὴ ὁ ὢν παρὰ [τοῦ] θεοῦ, οὗτος ἑώρακεν τὸν πατέρα.

text_en: Amen , amen , I say unto you: He that believes in me has everlasting life.
text_la: Amen, amen dico vobis : qui credit in me, habet vitam æternam.
text_pt: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que aquele que crê em mim tem a vida eterna.
text_el: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ πιστεύων ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

text_en: I am the bread of life.
text_la: Ego sum panis vitæ.
text_pt: Eu sou o pão da vida.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος τῆς ζωῆς.

text_en: Your fathers ate manna in the desert , and are dead.
text_la: Patres vestri manducaverunt manna in deserto, et mortui sunt.
text_pt: Vossos pais comeram o maná no deserto, e morreram.
text_el: οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἔφαγον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τὸ μάννα καὶ ἀπέθανον:

text_en: This is the bread which comes down from heaven : that if any man eat of it, he may not die.
text_la: Hic est panis de cælo descendens : ut si quis ex ipso manducaverit, non moriatur.
text_pt: Este é o pão que desce do céu, para que o que dele comer não morra.
text_el: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβαίνων, ἵνα τις ἐξ αὐτοῦ φάγῃ καὶ μὴ ἀποθάνῃ.

text_en: I am the living bread which came down from heaven . If any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever; and the bread that I will give is my flesh, for the life of the world."
text_la: Ego sum panis vivus, qui de cælo descendi. Si quis manducaverit ex hoc pane, vivet in æternum : et panis quem ego dabo, caro mea est pro mundi vita.
text_pt: Eu sou o pão vivo que desceu do céu; se alguém comer deste pão, viverá para sempre; e o pão que eu der é a minha carne, que eu darei pela vida do mundo.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ζῶν ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς: ἐάν τις φάγῃ ἐκ τούτου τοῦ ἄρτου, ζήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα: καὶ ὁ ἄρτος δὲ ὃν ἐγὼ δώσω ἡ σάρξ μού ἐστιν ὑπὲρ, τῆς τοῦ κόσμου ζωῆς.

text_en: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying: "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?"
text_la: Litigabant ergo Judæi ad invicem, dicentes : Quomodo potest hic nobis carnem suam dare ad manducandum?
text_pt: Disputavam, pois, os judeus entre si, dizendo: Como nos pode dar este a sua carne a comer?
text_el: Ἐμάχοντο οὖν πρὸς ἀλλήλους οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι λέγοντες: πῶς δύναται οὗτος ἡμῖν δοῦναι τὴν σάρκα [αὐτοῦ] φαγεῖν;

text_en: Then Jesus said to them: " Amen , amen , I say unto you: unless you eat the flesh of the Son of man and drink his blood, you shall not have life in you.
text_la: Dixit ergo eis Jesus : Amen, amen dico vobis : nisi manducaveritis carnem Filii hominis, et biberitis ejus sanguinem, non habebitis vitam in vobis.
text_pt: Jesus, pois, lhes disse: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que, se não comerdes a carne do Filho do homem, e não beberdes o seu sangue, não tereis vida em vós mesmos.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν μὴ φάγητε τὴν σάρκα τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ πίητε αὐτοῦ τὸ αἷμα, οὐκ ἔχετε ζωὴν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.

text_en: He that eats my flesh and drinks my blood has everlasting life, and I will raise him up in the last day.
text_la: Qui manducat meam carnem, et bibit meum sanguinem, habet vitam æternam : et ego resuscitabo eum in novissimo die.
text_pt: Quem come a minha carne e bebe o meu sangue tem a vida eterna, e eu o ressuscitarei no último dia.
text_el: ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ πίνων μου τὸ αἷμα ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον, κἀγὼ ἀναστήσω αὐτὸν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.

text_en: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
text_la: Caro enim mea vere est cibus : et sanguis meus, vere est potus;
text_pt: Porque a minha carne verdadeiramente é comida, e o meu sangue verdadeiramente é bebida.
text_el: ἡ γὰρ σάρξ μου ἀληθής ἐστιν βρῶσις, καὶ τὸ αἷμά μου ἀληθής ἐστιν πόσις.

text_en: He that eats my flesh and drinks my blood abides in me, and I in him.
text_la: qui manducat meam carnem et bibit meum sanguinem, in me manet, et ego in illo.
text_pt: Quem come a minha carne e bebe o meu sangue permanece em mim e eu nele.
text_el: ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ πίνων μου τὸ αἷμα ἐν ἐμοὶ μένει κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ.

text_en: As the living Father has sent me and I live by the Father : so he that eats me, the same also shall live by me.
text_la: Sicut misit me vivens Pater, et ego vivo propter Patrem : et qui manducat me, et ipse vivet propter me.
text_pt: Assim como o Pai, que vive, me enviou, e eu vivo pelo Pai, assim, quem de mim se alimenta, também viverá por mim.
text_el: καθὼς ἀπέστειλέν με ὁ ζῶν πατὴρ κἀγὼ ζῶ διὰ τὸν πατέρα, καὶ ὁ τρώγων με κἀκεῖνος ζήσει δι' ἐμέ.

text_en: This is the bread that came down from heaven . Not as your fathers ate manna and are dead. He that eats this bread shall live for ever."
text_la: Hic est panis qui de cælo descendit. Non sicut manducaverunt patres vestri manna, et mortui sunt. Qui manducat hunc panem, vivet in æternum.
text_pt: Este é o pão que desceu do céu; não é o caso de vossos pais, que comeram o maná e morreram; quem comer este pão viverá para sempre.
text_el: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἄρτος ὁ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς, οὐ καθὼς ἔφαγον οἱ πατέρες καὶ ἀπέθανον: ὁ τρώγων τοῦτον τὸν ἄρτον ζήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

text_en: These things he said, teaching in the synagogue , in Capharnaum .
text_la: Hæc dixit in synagoga docens, in Capharnaum.
text_pt: Ele disse estas coisas na sinagoga, ensinando em Cafarnaum.
text_el: ταῦτα εἶπεν ἐν συναγωγῇ διδάσκων ἐν Καφαρναούμ.

text_en: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard {this}, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
text_la: Multi ergo audientes ex discipulis ejus, dixerunt : Durus est hic sermo, et quis potest eum audire?
text_pt: Muitos, pois, dos seus discípulos, ouvindo isto, disseram: Duro é este discurso; quem o pode ouvir?
text_el: Πολλοὶ οὖν ἀκούσαντες ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ εἶπαν: σκληρός ἐστιν ὁ λόγος οὗτος: τίς δύναται αὐτοῦ ἀκούειν;

text_en: But Jesus , knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them: "Does this scandalize you?
text_la: Sciens autem Jesus apud semetipsum quia murmurarent de hoc discipuli ejus, dixit eis : Hoc vos scandalizat?
text_pt: Sabendo, pois, Jesus em si mesmo que os seus discípulos murmuravam disto, disse-lhes: Isto escandaliza-vos?
text_el: εἰδὼς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν ἑαυτῷ ὅτι γογγύζουσιν περὶ τούτου οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: τοῦτο ὑμᾶς σκανδαλίζει;

text_en: If then you shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
text_la: si ergo videritis Filium hominis ascendentem ubi erat prius?
text_pt: Que seria, pois, se vísseis subir o Filho do homem para onde primeiro estava?
text_el: ἐὰν οὖν θεωρῆτε τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἀναβαίνοντα ὅπου ἦν τὸ πρότερον;

text_en: It is the spirit that quickens; the flesh profits nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are spirit and life.
text_la: Spiritus est qui vivificat : caro non prodest quidquam : verba quæ ego locutus sum vobis, spiritus et vita sunt.
text_pt: O espírito é o que vivifica, a carne para nada aproveita; as palavras que eu vos digo são espírito e vida.
text_el: τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν τὸ ζῳοποιοῦν, ἡ σὰρξ οὐκ ὠφελεῖ οὐδέν: τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ λελάληκα ὑμῖν πνεῦμά ἐστιν καὶ ζωή ἐστιν.

text_en: But there are some of you that believe not." For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that did not believe and who he was that would betray him.
text_la: Sed sunt quidam ex vobis qui non credunt. Sciebat enim ab initio Jesus qui essent non credentes, et quis traditurus esset eum.
text_pt: Mas há alguns de vós que não crêem. Porque bem sabia Jesus, desde o princípio, quem eram os que não criam, e quem era o que o havia de entregar.
text_el: ἀλλ' εἰσὶν ἐξ ὑμῶν τινες οἳ οὐ πιστεύουσιν. ᾔδει γὰρ ἐξ ἀρχῆς ὁ Ἰησοῦς τίνες εἰσὶν οἱ μὴ πιστεύοντες καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ παραδώσων αὐτόν.

text_en: And he said: "Therefore did I say to you that no man can come to me, unless it be given him by my Father ."
text_la: Et dicebat : Propterea dixi vobis, quia nemo potest venire ad me, nisi fuerit ei datum a Patre meo.
text_pt: E dizia: Por isso eu vos disse que ninguém pode vir a mim, se por meu Pai não lhe for concedido.
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγεν: διὰ τοῦτο εἴρηκα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐλθεῖν πρός με ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ δεδομένον αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ πατρός.

text_en: After this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.
text_la: Ex hoc multi discipulorum ejus abierunt retro : et jam non cum illo ambulabant.
text_pt: Desde então muitos dos seus discípulos tornaram para trás, e já não andavam com ele.
text_el: Ἐκ τούτου πολλοὶ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθον εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ οὐκέτι μετ' αὐτοῦ περιεπάτουν.

text_en: Then Jesus said to the twelve: "Will you also go away?"
text_la: Dixit ergo Jesus ad duodecim : Numquid et vos vultis abire?
text_pt: Então disse Jesus aos doze: Quereis vós também retirar-vos?
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς δώδεκα: μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς θέλετε ὑπάγειν;

text_en: And Simon Peter answered him: "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.
text_la: Respondit ergo ei Simon Petrus : Domine, ad quem ibimus? verba vitæ æternæ habes:
text_pt: Respondeu-lhe, pois, Simão Pedro: Senhor, para quem iremos nós? Tu tens as palavras da vida eterna.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος: κύριε, πρὸς τίνα ἀπελευσόμεθα; ῥήματα ζωῆς αἰωνίου ἔχεις:

text_en: And we have believed and have known that you are the Christ , the Son of God ."
text_la: et nos credidimus, et cognovimus quia tu es Christus Filius Dei.
text_pt: E nós temos crido e conhecido que tu és o Cristo, o Filho do Deus vivente.
text_el: καὶ ἡμεῖς πεπιστεύκαμεν καὶ ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ἅγιος τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: Jesus answered them: "Have not I chosen you twelve? And one of you is a devil ."
text_la: Respondit eis Jesus : Nonne ego vos duodecim elegi : et ex vobis unus diabolus est?
text_pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Não vos escolhi a vós os doze? e um de vós é um diabo.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς: ὁ Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἐγὼ ὑμᾶς τοὺς δώδεκα ἐξελεξάμην; καὶ ἐξ ὑμῶν εἷς διάβολός ἐστιν.

text_en: Now he meant Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon , for this same was about to betray him, whereas he was one of the twelve.
text_la: Dicebat autem Judam Simonis Iscariotem : hic enim erat traditurus eum, cum esset unus ex duodecim.
text_pt: E isto dizia ele de Judas Iscariotes, filho de Simão; porque este o havia de entregar, sendo um dos doze.
text_el: ἔλεγεν δὲ τὸν Ἰούδαν Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτου: οὗτος γὰρ ἔμελλεν παραδιδόναι, αὐτόν εἷς ἐκ τῶν δώδεκα.

text_en: After these things, Jesus walked in Galilee : for he would not walk in Judea , because the Jews sought to kill him.
text_la: Post hæc autem ambulabat Jesus in Galilæam : non enim volebat in Judæam ambulare, quia quærebant eum Judæi interficere.
text_pt: E depois disto Jesus andava pela Galiléia, e já não queria andar pela Judéia, pois os judeus procuravam matá-lo.
text_el: καὶ Μετὰ ταῦτα περιεπάτει [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ: οὐ γὰρ ἤθελεν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ περιπατεῖν, ὅτι ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀποκτεῖναι.

text_en: Now the Jews feast of tabernacles was at hand.
text_la: Erat autem in proximo dies festus Judæorum, Scenopegia.
text_pt: E estava próxima a festa dos judeus, a dos tabernáculos.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ἐγγὺς ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἡ σκηνοπηγία.

text_en: And his brethren said to, him: Pass from hence and go into Judea , that your disciples also may see your works which you do.
text_la: Dixerunt autem ad eum fratres ejus : Transi hinc, et vade in Judæam, ut et discipuli tui videant opera tua, quæ facis.
text_pt: Disseram-lhe, pois, seus irmãos: Sai daqui, e vai para a Judéia, para que também os teus discípulos vejam as obras que fazes.
text_el: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ: μετάβηθι ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ὕπαγε εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν, ἵνα καὶ οἱ μαθηταί σου θεωρήσουσιν [σοῦ] τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιεῖς:

text_en: For there is no man that does anything in secret, and he himself seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, manifest yourself to the world.
text_la: Nemo quippe in occulto quid facit, et quærit ipse in palam esse : si hæc facis, manifesta teipsum mundo.
text_pt: Porque não há ninguém que procure ser conhecido que faça coisa alguma em oculto. Se fazes estas coisas, manifesta-te ao mundo.
text_el: οὐδεὶς γάρ τι ἐν κρυπτῷ ποιεῖ καὶ ζητεῖ αὐτὸς ἐν παρρησίᾳ εἶναι. εἰ ταῦτα ποιεῖς, φανέρωσον σεαυτὸν τῷ κόσμῳ.

text_en: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
text_la: Neque enim fratres ejus credebant in eum.
text_pt: Porque nem mesmo seus irmãos criam nele.
text_el: οὐδὲ γὰρ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπίστευον εἰς αὐτόν.

text_en: Then Jesus said to them: My time is not yet come; but your time is always ready.
text_la: Dicit ergo eis Jesus : Tempus meum nondum advenit : tempus autem vestrum semper est paratum.
text_pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus: Ainda não é chegado o meu tempo, mas o vosso tempo sempre está pronto.
text_el: λέγει οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ὁ καιρὸς ὁ ἐμὸς οὔπω πάρεστιν, ὁ δὲ καιρὸς ὁ ὑμέτερος πάντοτέ ἐστιν ἕτοιμος.

text_en: The world cannot hate you: but me it hates , because I give testimony of it, that the works thereof are evil ,
text_la: Non potest mundus odisse vos : me autem odit, quia ego testimonium perhibeo de illo quod opera ejus mala sunt.
text_pt: O mundo não vos pode odiar, mas ele me odeia a mim, porquanto dele testifico que as suas obras são más.
text_el: οὐ δύναται ὁ κόσμος μισεῖν ὑμᾶς, ἐμὲ δὲ μισεῖ, ὅτι ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ πονηρά ἐστιν.

text_en: go you up to this festival day: but I go not up to this festival day, because my time is not accomplished.
text_la: Vos ascendite ad diem festum hunc, ego autem non ascendo ad diem festum istum : quia meum tempus nondum impletum est.
text_pt: Subi vós a esta festa; eu não subo ainda a esta festa, porque ainda o meu tempo não está cumprido.
text_el: ὑμεῖς ἀνάβητε εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν: ἐγὼ οὔπω ἀναβαίνω εἰς τὴν ἑορτὴν ταύτην, ὅτι ὁ ἐμὸς καιρὸς οὔπω πεπλήρωται.

text_en: When he had said these things, he himself stayed in Galilee .
text_la: Hæc cum dixisset, ipse mansit in Galilæa.
text_pt: E, havendo-lhes dito isto, ficou na Galiléia.
text_el: ταῦτα δὲ εἰπὼν αὐτοῖς ἔμεινεν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ.

text_en: But after his brethren had gone up, then he also went up to the feast, not openly, but, as it were, in secret.
text_la: Ut autem ascenderunt fratres ejus, tunc et ipse ascendit ad diem festum non manifeste, sed quasi in occulto.
text_pt: Mas, quando seus irmãos já tinham subido à festa, então subiu ele também, não manifestamente, mas como em oculto.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἀνέβησαν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν, τότε καὶ αὐτὸς ἀνέβη, οὐ φανερῶς ἀλλὰ' ὡς ἐν κρυπτῷ.

text_en: The Jews therefore sought him on the festival day and said: Where is he?
text_la: Judæi ergo quærebant eum in die festo, et dicebant : Ubi est ille?
text_pt: Ora, os judeus procuravam-no na festa, e diziam: Onde está ele?
text_el: οἱ οὖν Ἰουδαῖοι ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ καὶ ἔλεγον: ποῦ ἐστιν ἐκεῖνος;

text_en: And there was much murmuring among the multitude concerning him. For some said: He is a good man . And others said: No, but he seduces the people.
text_la: Et murmur multum erat in turba de eo. Quidam enim dicebant : Quia bonus est. Alii autem dicebant : Non, sed seducit turbas.
text_pt: E havia grande murmuração entre a multidão a respeito dele. Diziam alguns: Ele é bom. E outros diziam: Não, antes engana o povo.
text_el: καὶ γογγυσμὸς περὶ αὐτοῦ ἦν πολὺς ἐν τοῖς ὄχλοις: οἱ μὲν ἔλεγον ὅτι ἀγαθός ἐστιν: ἄλλοι δὲ ἔλεγον: οὔ, ἀλλὰ πλανᾷ τὸν ὄχλον.

text_en: Yet no man spoke openly of him, for fear of the Jews .
text_la: Nemo tamen palam loquebatur de illo propter metum Judæorum.
text_pt: Todavia ninguém falava dele abertamente, por medo dos judeus.
text_el: οὐδεὶς μέντοι παρρησίᾳ ἐλάλει περὶ αὐτοῦ διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων.

text_en: Now, about the midst of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
text_la: Jam autem die festo mediante, ascendit Jesus in templum, et docebat.
text_pt: Mas, no meio da festa subiu Jesus ao templo, e ensinava.
text_el: Ἤδη δὲ τῆς ἑορτῆς μεσούσης ἀνέβη Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἐδίδασκεν.

text_en: And the Jews wondered, saying: How does this man know letters, having never learned?
text_la: Et mirabantur Judæi, dicentes : Quomodo hic litteras scit, cum non didicerit?
text_pt: E os judeus maravilhavam-se, dizendo: Como sabe este letras, não as tendo aprendido?
text_el: ἐθαύμαζον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι λέγοντες: πῶς οὗτος γράμματα οἶδεν μὴ μεμαθηκώς;

text_en: Jesus answered them and said: My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
text_la: Respondit eis Jesus, et dixit : Mea doctrina non est mea, sed ejus qui misit me.
text_pt: Jesus lhes respondeu, e disse: A minha doutrina não é minha, mas daquele que me enviou.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη οὖν αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν: ἡ ἐμὴ διδαχὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὴ ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με:

text_en: If any man will do the will of him, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God , or whether I speak of myself.
text_la: Si quis voluerit voluntatem ejus facere, cognoscet de doctrina, utrum ex Deo sit, an ego a meipso loquar.
text_pt: Se alguém quiser fazer a vontade dele, pela mesma doutrina conhecerá se ela é de Deus, ou se eu falo de mim mesmo.
text_el: ἐάν τις θέλῃ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ποιεῖν, γνώσεται περὶ τῆς διδαχῆς πότερον ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν ἢ ἐγὼ ἀπ' ἐμαυτοῦ λαλῶ.

text_en: He that speaks of himself seeks his own glory : but he that seeks the glory of him that sent him, he is true and there is no injustice in him.
text_la: Qui a semetipso loquitur, gloriam propriam quærit; qui autem quærit gloriam ejus qui misit eum, hic verax est, et injustitia in illo non est.
text_pt: Quem fala de si mesmo busca a sua própria glória; mas o que busca a glória daquele que o enviou, esse é verdadeiro, e não há nele injustiça.
text_el: ὁ ἀφ' ἑαυτοῦ λαλῶν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἰδίαν ζητεῖ: ὁ δὲ ζητῶν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ πέμψαντος αὐτόν, οὗτος ἀληθής ἐστιν καὶ ἀδικία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν.

text_en: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law?
text_la: Nonne Moyses dedit vobis legem : et nemo ex vobis facit legem?
text_pt: Não vos deu Moisés a lei? e nenhum de vós observa a lei. Por que procurais matar-me?
text_el: οὐ Μωϋσῆς ἔδωκεν ὑμῖν τὸν νόμον; καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ποιεῖ τὸν νόμον. τί με ζητεῖτε ἀποκτεῖναι;

text_en: Why seek you to kill me? The multitude answered and said: You have a devil . Who seeks to kill you?
text_la: Quid me quæritis interficere? Respondit turba, et dixit : Dæmonium habes : quis te quæret interficere?
text_pt: A multidão respondeu, e disse: Tens demônio; quem procura matar-te?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ ὄχλος: δαιμόνιον ἔχεις: τίς σε ζητεῖ ἀποκτεῖναι;

text_en: Jesus answered and said to them: One work I have done: and you all wonder.
text_la: Respondit Jesus et dixit eis : Unum opus feci, et omnes miramini:
text_pt: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhes: Fiz uma só obra, e todos vos maravilhais.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἓν ἔργον ἐποίησα καὶ πάντες θαυμάζετε.

text_en: Therefore, Moses gave you circumcision (not because it is of Moses , but of the fathers): and on the sabbath day you circumcise a man .
text_la: propterea Moyses dedit vobis circumcisionem (non quia ex Moyse est, sed ex patribus), et in sabbato circumciditis hominem.
text_pt: Pelo motivo de que Moisés vos deu a circuncisão (não que fosse de Moisés, mas dos pais), no sábado circuncidais um homem.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν. ὑμῖν τὴν περιτομήν, οὐχ ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ Μωϋσέως ἐστὶν, ἀλλ' ἐκ τῶν πατέρων, καὶ [ἐν] σαββάτῳ περιτέμνετε ἄνθρωπον.

text_en: If a man receive circumcision on the sabbath day , that the law of Moses may not be broken: are you angry at me, because I have healed the whole man on the sabbath day ?
text_la: Si circumcisionem accipit homo in sabbato, ut non solvatur lex Moysi : mihi indignamini quia totum hominem sanum feci in sabbato?
text_pt: Se o homem recebe a circuncisão no sábado, para que a lei de Moisés não seja quebrantada, indignais-vos contra mim, porque no sábado curei de todo um homem?
text_el: εἰ περιτομὴν λαμβάνει [ὁ] ἄνθρωπος ἐν σαββάτῳ ἵνα μὴ λυθῇ ὁ νόμος Μωϋσέως, ἐμοὶ χολᾶτε ὅτι ὅλον ἄνθρωπον ὑγιῆ ἐποίησα ἐν σαββάτῳ;

text_en: Judge not according to the appearance: but judge just judgment.
text_la: Nolite judicare secundum faciem, sed justum judicium judicate.
text_pt: Não julgueis segundo a aparência, mas julgai segundo a reta justiça.
text_el: μὴ κρίνετε κατ' ὄψιν, ἀλλὰ τὴν δικαίαν κρίσιν κρίνετε.

text_en: Some therefore of Jerusalem said: Is not this he whom they seek to kill?
text_la: Dicebant ergo quidam ex Jerosolymis : Nonne hic est, quem quærunt interficere?
text_pt: Então alguns dos de Jerusalém diziam: Não é este o que procuram matar?
text_el: Ἔλεγον οὖν τινες ἐκ τῶν Ἱεροσολυμιτῶν: οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὃν ζητοῦσιν ἀποκτεῖναι;

text_en: And behold, he speaks openly: and they say nothing to him. Have the rulers known for a truth that this is the Christ ?
text_la: et ecce palam loquitur, et nihil ei dicunt. Numquid vere cognoverunt principes quia hic est Christus?
text_pt: E ei-lo aí está falando abertamente, e nada lhe dizem. Porventura sabem verdadeiramente os príncipes que de fato este é o Cristo?
text_el: καὶ ἴδε παρρησίᾳ λαλεῖ, καὶ οὐδὲν αὐτῷ λέγουσιν. μήποτε ἀληθῶς ἔγνωσαν οἱ ἄρχοντες ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός;

text_en: But we know this man , whence he is: but when the Christ comes, no man knows , whence he is.
text_la: Sed hunc scimus unde sit : Christus autem cum venerit, nemo scit unde sit.
text_pt: Todavia bem sabemos de onde este é; mas, quando vier o Cristo, ninguém saberá de onde ele é.
text_el: ἀλλὰ τοῦτον οἴδαμεν πόθεν ἐστίν: ὁ δὲ Χριστὸς ὅταν ἔρχηται, οὐδεὶς γινώσκει πόθεν ἐστίν.

text_en: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple , teaching and saying: You both know me, and you know whence I am. And I am not come of myself: but he that sent me is true , whom you know not.
text_la: Clamabat ergo Jesus in templo docens, et dicens : Et me scitis, et unde sim scitis : et a meipso non veni, sed est verus qui misit me, quem vos nescitis.
text_pt: Clamava, pois, Jesus no templo, ensinando, e dizendo: Vós conheceis-me, e sabeis de onde sou; e eu não vim de mim mesmo, mas aquele que me enviou é verdadeiro, o qual vós não conheceis.
text_el: ἔκραξεν οὖν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς καὶ λέγων: κἀμὲ οἴδατε καὶ οἴδατε πόθεν εἰμί: καὶ ἀπ' ἐμαυτοῦ οὐκ ἐλήλυθα, ἀλλ' ἔστιν ἀληθινὸς ὁ πέμψας με, ὃν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε:

text_en: I know him, because I am from him: and he has sent me.
text_la: Ego scio eum : quia ab ipso sum, et ipse me misit.
text_pt: Mas eu conheço-o, porque dele sou e ele me enviou.
text_el: ἐγὼ οἶδα αὐτόν, ὅτι παρ' αὐτοῦ εἰμι κἀκεῖνός με ἀπέστειλεν.

text_en: They sought therefore to apprehend him: and no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
text_la: Quærebant ergo eum apprehendere : et nemo misit in illum manus, quia nondum venerat hora ejus.
text_pt: Procuravam, pois, prendê-lo, mas ninguém lançou mão dele, porque ainda não era chegada a sua hora.
text_el: ἐζήτουν οὖν αὐτὸν πιάσαι, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπέβαλεν ἐπ' αὐτὸν τὴν χεῖρα, ὅτι οὔπω ἐληλύθει ἡ ὥρα αὐτοῦ.

text_en: But of the people many believed in him and said: When the Christ comes, shall he do more miracles than this man does?
text_la: De turba autem multi crediderunt in eum, et dicebant : Christus cum venerit, numquid plura signa faciet quam quæ hic facit?
text_pt: E muitos da multidão creram nele, e diziam: Quando o Cristo vier, fará ainda mais sinais do que os que este tem feito?
text_el: Ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου δὲ πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν, καὶ ἔλεγον: ὁ Χριστὸς ὅταν ἔλθῃ μὴ πλείονα σημεῖα ποιήσει ὧν οὗτος ἐποίησεν;

text_en: The Pharisees heard the people murmuring these things concerning him: and the rulers and Pharisees sent ministers to apprehend him.
text_la: Audierunt pharisæi turbam murmurantem de illo hæc : et miserunt principes et pharisæi ministros ut apprehenderent eum.
text_pt: Os fariseus ouviram que a multidão murmurava dele estas coisas; e os fariseus e os principais dos sacerdotes mandaram servidores para o prenderem.
text_el: ἤκουσαν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι τοῦ ὄχλου γογγύζοντος περὶ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα, καὶ ἀπέστειλαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ὑπηρέτας ἵνα πιάσωσιν αὐτόν.

text_en: Jesus therefore said to them: Yet a little while I am with you: and then I go to him that sent me.
text_la: Dixit ergo eis Jesus : Adhuc modicum tempus vobiscum sum : et vado ad eum qui me misit.
text_pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus: Ainda um pouco de tempo estou convosco, e depois vou para aquele que me enviou.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἔτι χρόνον μικρὸν μεθ' ὑμῶν εἰμι καὶ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με.

text_en: You shall seek me and shall not find me: and where I am, thither you cannot come.
text_la: Quæretis me, et non invenietis : et ubi ego sum, vos non potestis venire.
text_pt: Vós me buscareis, e não me achareis; e onde eu estou, vós não podeis vir.
text_el: ζητήσετέ με καὶ οὐχ εὑρήσετέ, με καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν.

text_en: The Jews therefore said among themselves: Where will he go, that we shall not find him? Will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles and teach the Gentiles ?
text_la: Dixerunt ergo Judæi ad semetipsos : Quo hic iturus est, quia non inveniemus eum? numquid in dispersionem gentium iturus est, et docturus gentes?
text_pt: Disseram, pois, os judeus uns para os outros: Para onde irá este, que o não acharemos? Irá porventura para os dispersos entre os gregos, e ensinará os gregos?
text_el: εἶπον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι πρὸς ἑαυτούς: ποῦ οὗτος μέλλει πορεύεσθαι, ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὐχ εὑρήσομεν αὐτόν; μὴ εἰς τὴν διασπορὰν τῶν Ἑλλήνων μέλλει πορεύεσθαι καὶ διδάσκειν τοὺς Ἕλληνας;

text_en: What is this saying that he has said: You shall seek me and shall not find me? And: Where I am, you cannot come?
text_la: quis est hic sermo, quem dixit : Quæretis me, et non invenietis : et ubi sum ego, vos non potestis venire?
text_pt: Que palavra é esta que disse: Buscar-me-eis, e não me achareis; e: Aonde eu estou vós não podeis ir?
text_el: τίς ἐστιν ὁ λόγος οὗτος ὃν εἶπεν: ζητήσετέ με καὶ οὐχ εὑρήσετέ, με καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν;

text_en: And on the last, and great day of the festivity, Jesus stood and cried, saying: If any man thirst, let him come to me and drink.
text_la: In novissimo autem die magno festivitatis stabat Jesus, et clamabat dicens : Si quis sitit, veniat ad me et bibat.
text_pt: E no último dia, o grande dia da festa, Jesus pôs-se em pé, e clamou, dizendo: Se alguém tem sede, venha a mim, e beba.
text_el: Ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ μεγάλῃ τῆς ἑορτῆς εἱστήκει ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἔκραξεν λέγων: ἐάν τις διψᾷ, ἐρχέσθω πρός με καὶ πινέτω.

text_en: He that believes in me, as the scripture says: Out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
text_la: Qui credit in me, sicut dicit Scriptura, flumina de ventre ejus fluent aquæ vivæ.
text_pt: Quem crê em mim, como diz a Escritura, rios de água viva correrão do seu ventre.
text_el: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμέ, καθὼς εἶπεν ἡ γραφή, ποταμοὶ ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας αὐτοῦ ῥεύσουσιν ὕδατος ζῶντος.

text_en: Now this he said of the Spirit which they should receive who believed in him: for as yet the Spirit was not given, because Jesus was not yet glorified .
text_la: Hoc autem dixit de Spiritu, quem accepturi erant credentes in eum : nondum enim erat Spiritus datus, quia Jesus nondum erat glorificatus.
text_pt: E isto disse ele do Espírito que haviam de receber os que nele cressem; porque o Espírito Santo ainda não fora dado, por ainda Jesus não ter sido glorificado.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ εἶπεν περὶ τοῦ πνεύματος {O(=}υ ἔμελλον λαμβάνειν οἱ πιστεύσαντες εἰς αὐτόν: οὔπω γὰρ ἦν πνεῦμα, ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὖπω ἐδοξάσθη.

text_en: Of that multitude therefore, when they had heard these words of his, some said: This is the prophet indeed.
text_la: Ex illa ergo turba cum audissent hos sermones ejus, dicebant : Hic est vere propheta.
text_pt: Então muitos da multidão, ouvindo esta palavra, diziam: Verdadeiramente este é o Profeta.
text_el: Ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου οὖν ἀκούσαντες τῶν λόγων τούτων ἔλεγον: [ὅτι] οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ προφήτης:

text_en: Others said: This is the Christ . But some said: Does the Christ come out of Galilee ?
text_la: Alii dicebant : Hic est Christus. Quidam autem dicebant : Numquid a Galilæa venit Christus?
text_pt: Outros diziam: Este é o Cristo; mas diziam outros: Vem, pois, o Cristo da Galiléia?
text_el: ἄλλοι ἔλεγον: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός: οἱ δὲ ἔλεγον: μὴ γὰρ ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ὁ Χριστὸς ἔρχεται;

text_en: Does not the scripture say: That Christ comes of the seed of David and from Bethlehem the town where David was?
text_la: nonne Scriptura dicit : Quia ex semine David, et de Bethlehem castello, ubi erat David, venit Christus?
text_pt: Não diz a Escritura que o Cristo vem da descendência de Davi, e de Belém, da aldeia de onde era Davi?
text_el: οὐχ ἡ γραφὴ εἶπεν ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος Δαυίδ καὶ ἀπὸ Βηθλέεμ τῆς κώμης ὅπου ἦν Δαυίδ, ἔρχεται ὁ Χριστὸς;

text_en: So there arose a dissension among the people because of him.
text_la: Dissensio itaque facta est in turba propter eum.
text_pt: Assim entre o povo havia dissensão por causa dele.
text_el: σχίσμα οὖν ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ δι' αὐτόν:

text_en: And some of them would have apprehended him: but no man laid hands upon him.
text_la: Quidam autem ex ipsis volebant apprehendere eum : sed nemo misit super eum manus.
text_pt: E alguns deles queriam prendê-lo, mas ninguém lançou mão dele.
text_el: τινὲς δὲ ἤθελον ἐξ αὐτῶν πιάσαι αὐτόν, ἀλλ' οὐδεὶς ἔβαλεν ἐπ' αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας.

text_en: The ministers therefore came to the chief priests and the Pharisees . And they said to them: Why have you not brought him?
text_la: Venerunt ergo ministri ad pontifices et pharisæos. Et dixerunt eis illi : Quare non adduxistis illum?
text_pt: E os servidores foram ter com os principais dos sacerdotes e fariseus; e eles lhes perguntaram: Por que não o trouxestes?
text_el: Ἦλθον οὖν οἱ ὑπηρέται πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ Φαρισαίους, καὶ εἶπον αὐτοῖς ἐκεῖνοι, διὰ τί οὐκ ἠγάγετε αὐτόν;

text_en: The ministers answered: Never did man speak like this man .
text_la: Responderunt ministri : Numquam sic locutus est homo, sicut hic homo.
text_pt: Responderam os servidores: Nunca homem algum falou assim como este homem.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ ὑπηρέται: οὐδέποτε ἐλάλησεν οὕτως ἄνθρωπος.

text_en: The Pharisees therefore answered them: Are you also seduced?
text_la: Responderunt ergo eis pharisæi : Numquid et vos seducti estis?
text_pt: Responderam-lhes, pois, os fariseus: Também vós fostes enganados?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν οὖν [αὐτοῖς] οἱ Φαρισαῖοι: μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς πεπλάνησθε;

text_en: Has any one of the rulers believed in him, or of the Pharisees ?
text_la: numquid ex principibus aliquis credidit in eum, aut ex pharisæis?
text_pt: Creu nele porventura algum dos principais ou dos fariseus?
text_el: μή τις ἐκ τῶν ἀρχόντων ἐπίστευσεν εἰς αὐτὸν ἢ ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων;

text_en: But this multitude, that knows not the law, are accursed .
text_la: sed turba hæc, quæ non novit legem, maledicti sunt.
text_pt: Mas esta multidão, que não sabe a lei, é maldita.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ὁ ὄχλος οὗτος ὁ μὴ γινώσκων τὸν νόμον ἐπάρατοί εἰσιν.

text_en: Nicodemus said to them (he that came to him by night, who was one of them):
text_la: Dixit Nicodemus ad eos, ille qui venit ad eum nocte, qui unus erat ex ipsis:
text_pt: Nicodemos, que era um deles (o que de noite fora ter com Jesus), disse-lhes:
text_el: λέγει Νικόδημος πρὸς αὐτούς, ὁ ἐλθὼν πρὸς αὐτὸν πρότερον εἷς ὢν ἐξ αὐτῶν:

text_en: Does our law judge any man , unless it first hears him and knows what he does?
text_la: Numquid lex nostra judicat hominem, nisi prius audierit ab ipso, et cognoverit quid faciat?
text_pt: Porventura condena a nossa lei um homem sem primeiro o ouvir e ter conhecimento do que faz?
text_el: μὴ ὁ νόμος ἡμῶν κρίνει τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσῃ πρῶτον παρ' αὐτοῦ καὶ γνῷ τί ποιεῖ;

text_en: They answered and said to him: Are you also a Galilean ? Search the scriptures , and see that out of Galilee a prophet rises not.
text_la: Responderunt, et dixerunt ei : Numquid et tu Galilæus es? scrutare Scripturas, et vide quia a Galilæa propheta non surgit.
text_pt: Responderam eles, e disseram-lhe: És tu também da Galiléia? Examina, e verás que da Galiléia nenhum profeta surgiu.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶ; ἐραύνησον καὶ ἴδε ὅτι ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας προφήτης οὐκ ἐγείρεται.

text_en: And every man returned to his own house.
text_la: Et reversi sunt unusquisque in domum suam.
text_pt: E cada um foi para sua casa.
text_el: [Καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ,]

text_en: And Jesus went unto mount Olivet .
text_la: Jesus autem perrexit in montem Oliveti:
text_pt: Jesus, porém, foi para o Monte das Oliveiras.
text_el: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὸ Ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν.

text_en: And early in the morning he came again into the temple : and all the people came to him. And sitting down he taught them.
text_la: et diluculo iterum venit in templum, et omnis populus venit ad eum, et sedens docebat eos.
text_pt: E pela manhã cedo tornou para o templo, e todo o povo vinha ter com ele, e, assentando-se, os ensinava.
text_el: Ὄρθρου δὲ πάλιν παρεγένετο εἰς τὸ ἱερόν [, καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἤρχετο πρὸς αὐτόν, καὶ καθίσας ἐδίδασκεν αὐτούς].

text_en: And the scribes and Pharisees bring unto him a woman taken in adultery : and they set her in the midst,
text_la: Adducunt autem scribæ et pharisæi mulierem in adulterio deprehensam : et statuerunt eam in medio,
text_pt: E os escribas e fariseus trouxeram-lhe uma mulher apanhada em adultério;
text_el: ἄγουσιν δὲ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι γυναῖκα ἐπὶ μοιχείᾳ κατειλημμένην καὶ στήσαντες αὐτὴν ἐν μέσῳ

text_en: and said to him: Master, this woman was even now taken in adultery .
text_la: et dixerunt ei : Magister, hæc mulier modo deprehensa est in adulterio.
text_pt: E, pondo-a no meio, disseram-lhe: Mestre, esta mulher foi apanhada, no próprio ato, adulterando.
text_el: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ, Διδάσκαλε, αὕτη ἡ γυνὴ κατείληπται ἐπ' αὐτοφώρῳ μοιχευομένη:

text_en: Now Moses in the law commanded us to stone such a one. But what do you say?
text_la: In lege autem Moyses mandavit nobis hujusmodi lapidare. Tu ergo quid dicis?
text_pt: E na lei nos mandou Moisés que as tais sejam apedrejadas. Tu, pois, que dizes?
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῷ νόμῳ [ἡμῖν] Μωϋσῆς ἐνετείλατο τὰς τοιαύτας λιθάζειν. σὺ οὖν τί λέγεις;

text_en: And this they said tempting him, that they might accuse him. But Jesus bowing himself down, wrote with his finger on the ground.
text_la: Hoc autem dicebant tentantes eum, ut possent accusare eum. Jesus autem inclinans se deorsum, digito scribebat in terra.
text_pt: Isto diziam eles, tentando-o, para que tivessem de que o acusar. Mas Jesus, inclinando-se, escrevia com o dedo na terra.
text_el: [τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγον πειράζοντες αὐτόν, ἵνα ἔχωσιν κατηγορεῖν αὐτοῦ.] ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς κάτω κύψας τῷ δακτύλῳ κατέγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν.

text_en: When therefore they continued asking him, he lifted up himself and said to them: He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
text_la: Cum ergo perseverarent interrogantes eum, erexit se, et dixit eis : Qui sine peccato est vestrum, primus in illam lapidem mittat.
text_pt: E, como insistissem, perguntando-lhe, endireitou-se, e disse-lhes: Aquele que de entre vós está sem pecado seja o primeiro que atire pedra contra ela.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐπέμενον ἐρωτῶντες [αὐτόν], ἀνέκυψεν καὶ εἶπεν [αὐτοῖς], Ὁ ἀναμάρτητος ὑμῶν πρῶτος ἐπ' αὐτὴν βαλέτω λίθον.

text_en: And again stooping down, he wrote on the ground.
text_la: Et iterum se inclinans, scribebat in terra.
text_pt: E, tornando a inclinar-se, escrevia na terra.
text_el: καὶ πάλιν κατακύψας ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν.

text_en: But they hearing this, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest. And Jesus alone remained, and the woman standing in the midst.
text_la: Audientes autem unus post unum exibant, incipientes a senioribus : et remansit solus Jesus, et mulier in medio stans.
text_pt: Quando ouviram isto, redargüidos da consciência, saíram um a um, a começar pelos mais velhos até aos últimos; ficou só Jesus e a mulher que estava no meio.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες ἐξήρχοντο εἷς καθ' εἷς ἀρξάμενοι ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ κατελείφθη μόνος καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἐν μέσῳ οὖσα.

text_en: Then Jesus lifting up himself, said to her: Woman , where are they that accused you? Has no man condemned you?
text_la: Erigens autem se Jesus, dixit ei : Mulier, ubi sunt qui te accusabant? nemo te condemnavit?
text_pt: E, endireitando-se Jesus, e não vendo ninguém mais do que a mulher, disse-lhe: Mulher, onde estão aqueles teus acusadores? Ninguém te condenou?
text_el: ἀνακύψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῇ, Γύναι, ποῦ εἰσιν; οὐδείς σε κατέκρινεν;

text_en: Who said: No man , Lord. And Jesus said: Neither will I condemn you. Go, and now sin no more.
text_la: Quæ dixit : Nemo, Domine. Dixit autem Jesus : Nec ego te condemnabo : vade, et jam amplius noli peccare.
text_pt: E ela disse: Ninguém, Senhor. E disse-lhe Jesus: Nem eu também te condeno; vai-te, e não peques mais.
text_el: ἡ δὲ εἶπεν, Οὐδείς, κύριε. εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, Οὐδὲ ἐγώ σε κατακρίνω: πορεύου, ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν μηκέτι ἁμάρτανε.]]

text_en: Again therefore, Jesus spoke to: them, saying: I am the light of the world. He that follows me walks not in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
text_la: Iterum ergo locutus est eis Jesus, dicens : Ego sum lux mundi : qui sequitur me, non ambulat in tenebris, sed habebit lumen vitæ.
text_pt: Falou-lhes, pois, Jesus outra vez, dizendo: Eu sou a luz do mundo; quem me segue não andará em trevas, mas terá a luz da vida.
text_el: Πάλιν οὖν αὐτοῖς ἐλάλησεν [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς λέγων: ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου: ὁ ἀκολουθῶν μοι οὐ μὴ περιπατήσῃ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ, ἀλλ' ἕξει τὸ φῶς τῆς ζωῆς.

text_en: The Pharisees therefore said to him: You give testimony of yourself. Your testimony is not true .
text_la: Dixerunt ergo ei pharisæi : Tu de teipso testimonium perhibes; testimonium tuum non est verum.
text_pt: Disseram-lhe, pois, os fariseus: Tu testificas de ti mesmo; o teu testemunho não é verdadeiro.
text_el: εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι: σὺ περὶ σεαυτοῦ μαρτυρεῖς: ἡ μαρτυρία σου οὐκ ἔστιν ἀληθής.

text_en: Jesus answered and said to them: Although I give testimony of myself, my testimony is true : for I know whence I came and whither I go.
text_la: Respondit Jesus, et dixit eis : Et si ego testimonium perhibeo de meipso, verum est testimonium meum : quia scio unde veni et quo vado; vos autem nescitis unde venio aut quo vado.
text_pt: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhes: Ainda que eu testifico de mim mesmo, o meu testemunho é verdadeiro, porque sei de onde vim, e para onde vou; mas vós não sabeis de onde venho, nem para onde vou.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, κἂν ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ, ἀληθής ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία μου, ὅτι οἶδα πόθεν ἦλθον καὶ ποῦ ὑπάγω: ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐκ οἴδατε πόθεν ἔρχομαι ἢ ποῦ ὑπάγω.

text_en: You judge according to the flesh: I judge not any man .
text_la: Vos secundum carnem judicatis : ego non judico quemquam;
text_pt: Vós julgais segundo a carne; eu a ninguém julgo.
text_el: ὑμεῖς κατὰ τὴν σάρκα κρίνετε, ἐγὼ οὐ κρίνω οὐδένα.

text_en: And if I do judge, my judgment is true : because I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
text_la: et si judico ego, judicium meum verum est, quia solus non sum : sed ego et qui misit me, Pater.
text_pt: E, se na verdade julgo, o meu juízo é verdadeiro, porque não sou eu só, mas eu e o Pai que me enviou.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν κρίνω δὲ ἐγώ, ἡ κρίσις ἡ ἐμὴ ἀληθινή ἐστιν, ὅτι μόνος οὐκ εἰμί, ἀλλ' ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ πέμψας με. [πατήρ]

text_en: And in your law it is written that the testimony of two men is true .
text_la: Et in lege vestra scriptum est, quia duorum hominum testimonium verum est.
text_pt: E na vossa lei está também escrito que o testemunho de dois homens é verdadeiro.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ δὲ τῷ ὑμετέρῳ γέγραπται ὅτι δύο ἀνθρώπων ἡ μαρτυρία ἀληθής ἐστιν.

text_en: I am one that give testimony of myself: and the Father that sent me gives testimony of me.
text_la: Ego sum qui testimonium perhibeo de meipso, et testimonium perhibet de me qui misit me, Pater.
text_pt: Eu sou o que testifico de mim mesmo, e de mim testifica também o Pai que me enviou.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ, καὶ μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὁ πέμψας με πατήρ.

text_en: They said therefore to him: Where is your Father ? Jesus answered: Neither me do you know , nor my Father . If you did know me, perhaps you would know my Father also.
text_la: Dicebant ergo ei : Ubi est Pater tuus? Respondit Jesus : Neque me scitis, neque Patrem meum : si me sciretis, forsitan et Patrem meum sciretis.
text_pt: Disseram-lhe, pois: Onde está teu Pai? Jesus respondeu: Não me conheceis a mim, nem a meu Pai; se vós me conhecêsseis a mim, também conheceríeis a meu Pai.
text_el: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ: ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ πατήρ σου; ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς: οὔτε ἐμὲ οἴδατε οὔτε τὸν πατέρα μου: εἰ ἐμὲ ᾔδειτε, καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου ἂν ᾔδειτε.

text_en: These words Jesus spoke in the treasury, teaching in the temple : and no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
text_la: Hæc verba locutus est Jesus in gazophylacio, docens in templo : et nemo apprehendit eum, quia necdum venerat hora ejus.
text_pt: Estas palavras disse Jesus no lugar do tesouro, ensinando no templo, e ninguém o prendeu, porque ainda não era chegada a sua hora.
text_el: ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα ἐλάλησεν ἐν τῷ γαζοφυλακίῳ διδάσκων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ: καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπίασεν αὐτόν, ὅτι οὔπω ἐληλύθει ἡ ὥρα αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Again therefore Jesus said to them: I go: and you shall seek me. And you shall die in your sin . Where I go, you cannot come.
text_la: Dixit ergo iterum eis Jesus : Ego vado, et quæretis me, et in peccato vestro moriemini. Quo ego vado, vos non potestis venire.
text_pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus outra vez: Eu retiro-me, e buscar-me-eis, e morrereis no vosso pecado. Para onde eu vou, não podeis vós vir.
text_el: Εἶπεν οὖν πάλιν αὐτοῖς: ἐγὼ ὑπάγω καὶ ζητήσετέ με, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ὑμῶν ἀποθανεῖσθε: ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν.

text_en: The Jews therefore said: Will he kill himself, because he said: Where I go you cannot come?
text_la: Dicebant ergo Judæi : Numquid interficiet semetipsum, quia dixit : Quo ego vado, vos non potestis venire?
text_pt: Diziam, pois, os judeus: Porventura quererá matar-se a si mesmo, pois diz: Para onde eu vou não podeis vir?
text_el: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι: μήτι ἀποκτενεῖ ἑαυτόν, ὅτι λέγει: ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν;

text_en: And he said to them: You are from beneath: I am from above. You are of this world: I am not of this world.
text_la: Et dicebat eis : Vos de deorsum estis, ego de supernis sum. Vos de mundo hoc estis, ego non sum de hoc mundo.
text_pt: E dizia-lhes: Vós sois de baixo, eu sou de cima; vós sois deste mundo, eu não sou deste mundo.
text_el: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τῶν κάτω ἐστέ, ἐγὼ ἐκ τῶν ἄνω εἰμί: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τούτου τοῦ κόσμου ἐστέ, ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου.

text_en: Therefore I said to you that you shall die in your sins . For if you believe not that I am he, you shall die in your sin .
text_la: Dixi ergo vobis quia moriemini in peccatis vestris : si enim non credideritis quia ego sum, moriemini in peccato vestro.
text_pt: Por isso vos disse que morrereis em vossos pecados, porque se não crerdes que eu sou, morrereis em vossos pecados.
text_el: εἶπον οὖν ὑμῖν ὅτι ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν: ἐὰν γὰρ μὴ πιστεύσητε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι, ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν.

text_en: They said therefore to him: Who are you? Jesus said to them: The beginning, who also speak unto you.
text_la: Dicebant ergo ei : Tu quis es? Dixit eis Jesus : Principium, qui et loquor vobis.
text_pt: Disseram-lhe, pois: Quem és tu? Jesus lhes disse: Isso mesmo que já desde o princípio vos disse.
text_el: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ: σὺ τίς εἶ; εἶπεν αὐτοῖς [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: τὴν ἀρχὴν ὅ τι καὶ λαλῶ ὑμῖν.

text_en: Many things I have to speak and to judge of you. But he that sent me, is true : and the things I have heard of him, these same I speak in the world.
text_la: Multa habeo de vobis loqui, et judicare; sed qui me misit, verax est; et ego quæ audivi ab eo, hæc loquor in mundo.
text_pt: Muito tenho que dizer e julgar de vós, mas aquele que me enviou é verdadeiro; e o que dele tenho ouvido, isso falo ao mundo.
text_el: πολλὰ ἔχω περὶ ὑμῶν λαλεῖν καὶ κρίνειν: ἀλλ' ὁ πέμψας με ἀληθής ἐστιν, κἀγὼ ἃ ἤκουσα παρ' αὐτοῦ, ταῦτα λαλῶ εἰς τὸν κόσμον.

text_en: And they understood not that he called God his Father.
text_la: Et non cognoverunt quia Patrem ejus dicebat Deum.
text_pt: Mas não entenderam que ele lhes falava do Pai.
text_el: οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῖς ἔλεγεν.

text_en: Jesus therefore said to them: When you shall have lifted up, the Son of man , then shall you know that I am he and that I do nothing of myself. But as the Father has taught me, these things I speak.
text_la: Dixit ergo eis Jesus : Cum exaltaveritis Filium hominis, tunc cognoscetis quia ego sum, et a meipso facio nihil, sed sicut docuit me Pater, hæc loquor:
text_pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus: Quando levantardes o Filho do homem, então conhecereis que EU SOU, e que nada faço por mim mesmo; mas isto falo como meu Pai me ensinou.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ὅταν ὑψώσητε τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, τότε γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι, καὶ ἀπ' ἐμαυτοῦ ποιῶ οὐδέν, ἀλλὰ καθὼς ἐδίδαξέν με ὁ πατὴρ ταῦτα λαλῶ.

text_en: And he that sent me is with me: and he has not left me alone. For I do always the things that please him.
text_la: et qui me misit, mecum est, et non reliquit me solum : quia ego quæ placita sunt ei, facio semper.
text_pt: E aquele que me enviou está comigo. O Pai não me tem deixado só, porque eu faço sempre o que lhe agrada.
text_el: καὶ ὁ πέμψας με μετ' ἐμοῦ ἐστιν: οὐκ ἀφῆκέν με μόνον, ὅτι ἐγὼ τὰ ἀρεστὰ αὐτῷ ποιῶ πάντοτε.

text_en: When he spoke these things, many believed in him.
text_la: Hæc illo loquente, multi crediderunt in eum.
text_pt: Dizendo ele estas coisas, muitos creram nele.
text_el: Ταῦτα αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν.

text_en: Then Jesus said to those Jews who believed him: If you continue in my word, you shall be my disciples indeed.
