text_la: Dicebat ergo Jesus ad eos, qui crediderunt ei, Judæos : Si vos manseritis in sermone meo, vere discipuli mei eritis,
text_pt: Jesus dizia, pois, aos judeus que criam nele: Se vós permanecerdes na minha palavra, verdadeiramente sereis meus discípulos;
text_el: ἔλεγεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς τοὺς πεπιστευκότας αὐτῷ Ἰουδαίους: ἐὰν ὑμεῖς μείνητε ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τῷ ἐμῷ, ἀληθῶς μαθηταί μού ἐστε,

text_en: And you shall know the truth : and the truth shall make you free.
text_la: et cognoscetis veritatem, et veritas liberabit vos.
text_pt: E conhecereis a verdade, e a verdade vos libertará.
text_el: καὶ γνώσεσθε τὴν ἀλήθειαν, καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια ἐλευθερώσει ὑμᾶς.

text_en: They answered him: We are the seed of Abraham : and we have never been slaves to any man . How do you say: You shall be free?
text_la: Responderunt ei : Semen Abrahæ sumus, et nemini servivimus umquam : quomodo tu dicis : Liberi eritis?
text_pt: Responderam-lhe: Somos descendência de Abraão, e nunca servimos a ninguém; como dizes tu: Sereis livres?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν πρὸς αὐτόν: σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ ἐσμεν, καὶ οὐδενὶ δεδουλεύκαμεν πώποτε: πῶς σὺ λέγεις ὅτι ἐλεύθεροι γενήσεσθε;

text_en: Jesus answered them: Amen , amen , I say unto you that whosoever commits sin is the servant of sin .
text_la: Respondit eis Jesus : Amen, amen dico vobis : quia omnis qui facit peccatum, servus est peccati.
text_pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que todo aquele que comete pecado é servo do pecado.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν δοῦλός ἐστιν [τῆς ἁμαρτίας].

text_en: Now the servant abides not in the house for ever: but the son abides for ever.
text_la: Servus autem non manet in domo in æternum : filius autem manet in æternum.
text_pt: Ora o servo não fica para sempre em casa; o Filho fica para sempre.
text_el: ὁ δὲ δοῦλος οὐ μένει ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα: ὁ υἱὸς μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

text_en: If therefore the son shall make you free, you shall be free indeed.
text_la: Si ergo vos filius liberaverit, vere liberi eritis.
text_pt: Se, pois, o Filho vos libertar, verdadeiramente sereis livres.
text_el: ἐὰν οὖν ὁ υἱὸς ὑμᾶς ἐλευθερώσῃ, ὄντως ἐλεύθεροι ἔσεσθε.

text_en: I know that you are the children of Abraham : but you seek to kill me, because my word has no place in you.
text_la: Scio quia filii Abrahæ estis : sed quæritis me interficere, quia sermo meus non capit in vobis.
text_pt: Bem sei que sois descendência de Abraão; contudo, procurais matar-me, porque a minha palavra não entra em vós.
text_el: οἶδα ὅτι σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ ἐστε: ἀλλὰ ζητεῖτέ με ἀποκτεῖναι, ὅτι ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐμὸς οὐ χωρεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν.

text_en: I speak that which I have seen with my Father : and you do the things that you have seen with your father.
text_la: Ego quod vidi apud Patrem meum, loquor : et vos quæ vidistis apud patrem vestrum, facitis.
text_pt: Eu falo do que vi junto de meu Pai, e vós fazeis o que também vistes junto de vosso pai.
text_el: ἃ ἐγὼ ἑώρακα παρὰ τῷ πατρὶ λαλῶ: καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν ἃ ἠκούσατε παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ποιεῖτε.

text_en: They answered and said to him: Abraham is our father. Jesus says them: If you be the children of Abraham , do the works of Abraham .
text_la: Responderunt, et dixerunt ei : Pater noster Abraham est. Dicit eis Jesus : Si filii Abrahæ estis, opera Abrahæ facite.
text_pt: Responderam, e disseram-lhe: Nosso pai é Abraão. Jesus disse-lhes: Se fôsseis filhos de Abraão, faríeis as obras de Abraão.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ ἐστιν. λέγει αὐτοῖς [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: εἰ τέκνα τοῦ Ἀβραάμ ἐστε, τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ ποιεῖτε:

text_en: But now you seek to kill me, a man who have spoken the truth to you, which I have heard of God . This Abraham did not.
text_la: Nunc autem quæritis me interficere, hominem, qui veritatem vobis locutus sum, quam audivi a Deo : hoc Abraham non fecit.
text_pt: Mas agora procurais matar-me, a mim, homem que vos tem dito a verdade que de Deus tem ouvido; Abraão não fez isto.
text_el: νῦν δὲ ζητεῖτέ με ἀποκτεῖναι, ἄνθρωπον ὃς τὴν ἀλήθειαν ὑμῖν λελάληκα, ἣν ἤκουσα παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ: τοῦτο Ἀβραὰμ οὐκ ἐποίησεν.

text_en: You do the works of your father. They said therefore to him: We are not born of fornication: we have one Father, even God .
text_la: Vos facitis opera patris vestri. Dixerunt itaque ei : Nos ex fornicatione non sumus nati : unum patrem habemus Deum.
text_pt: Vós fazeis as obras de vosso pai. Disseram-lhe, pois: Nós não somos nascidos de fornicação; temos um Pai, que é Deus.
text_el: ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν. εἶπαν αὐτῷ: ἡμεῖς ἐκ πορνείας οὐκ ἐγεννήθημεν, ἕνα πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν θεόν.

text_en: Jesus therefore said to them: If God were your Father, you would indeed love me. For from God I proceeded and came. For I came not of myself: but he sent me.
text_la: Dixit ergo eis Jesus : Si Deus pater vester esset, diligeretis utique et me; ego enim ex Deo processi, et veni : neque enim a meipso veni, sed ille me misit.
text_pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus: Se Deus fosse o vosso Pai, certamente me amaríeis, pois que eu saí, e vim de Deus; não vim de mim mesmo, mas ele me enviou.
text_el: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: εἰ ὁ θεὸς πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἦν, ἠγαπᾶτε ἂν ἐμέ: ἐγὼ γὰρ ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἥκω: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἀπ' ἐμαυτοῦ ἐλήλυθα, ἀλλ' ἐκεῖνός με ἀπέστειλεν.

text_en: Why do you not know my speech? Because you cannot hear my word.
text_la: Quare loquelam meam non cognoscitis? Quia non potestis audire sermonem meum.
text_pt: Por que não entendeis a minha linguagem? Por não poderdes ouvir a minha palavra.
text_el: διὰ τί τὴν λαλιὰν τὴν ἐμὴν οὐ γινώσκετε; ὅτι οὐ δύνασθε ἀκούειν τὸν λόγον τὸν ἐμόν.

text_en: You are of your father the devil : and the desires of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning: and he stood not in the truth , because truth is not in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar , and the father thereof.
text_la: Vos ex patre diabolo estis : et desideria patris vestri vultis facere. Ille homicida erat ab initio, et in veritate non stetit : quia non est veritas in eo : cum loquitur mendacium, ex propriis loquitur, quia mendax est, et pater ejus.
text_pt: Vós tendes por pai ao diabo, e quereis satisfazer os desejos de vosso pai. Ele foi homicida desde o princípio, e não se firmou na verdade, porque não há verdade nele. Quando ele profere mentira, fala do que lhe é próprio, porque é mentiroso, e pai da mentira.
text_el: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς τοῦ διαβόλου ἐστὲ καὶ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν θέλετε ποιεῖν. ἐκεῖνος ἀνθρωποκτόνος ἦν ἀπ' ἀρχῆς, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ οὐκ ἔστηκεν, ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν αὐτῷ. ὅταν λαλῇ τὸ ψεῦδος, ἐκ τῶν ἰδίων λαλεῖ, ὅτι ψεύστης ἐστὶν καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: But if I say the truth , you believe me not.
text_la: Ego autem si veritatem dico, non creditis mihi.
text_pt: Mas, porque vos digo a verdade, não me credes.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ὅτι τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω, οὐ πιστεύετέ μοι.

text_en: Which of you shall convince me of sin ? If I say the truth to you, why do you not believe me:
text_la: Quis ex vobis arguet me de peccato? si veritatem dico vobis, quare non creditis mihi?
text_pt: Quem dentre vós me convence de pecado? E se vos digo a verdade, por que não credes?
text_el: τίς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐλέγχει με περὶ ἁμαρτίας; εἰ ἀλήθειαν λέγω, διὰ τί ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετέ μοι;

text_en: He that is of God hears the words of God . Therefore you hear them not, because you are not of God .
text_la: Qui ex Deo est, verba Dei audit. Propterea vos non auditis, quia ex Deo non estis.
text_pt: Quem é de Deus escuta as palavras de Deus; por isso vós não as escutais, porque não sois de Deus.
text_el: ὁ ὢν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ θεοῦ ἀκούει: διὰ τοῦτο ὑμεῖς οὐκ ἀκούετε, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἐστέ.

text_en: The Jews therefore answered and said to him: Do not we say well that you are a Samaritan and have a devil ?
text_la: Responderunt ergo Judæi, et dixerunt ei : Nonne bene dicimus nos quia Samaritanus es tu, et dæmonium habes?
text_pt: Responderam, pois, os judeus, e disseram-lhe: Não dizemos nós bem que és samaritano, e que tens demônio?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: οὐ καλῶς λέγομεν ἡμεῖς ὅτι Σαμαρίτης εἶ σὺ καὶ δαιμόνιον ἔχεις;

text_en: Jesus answered: I have not a devil : but I honour my Father . And you have dishonoured me.
text_la: Respondit Jesus : Ego dæmonium non habeo : sed honorifico Patrem meum, et vos inhonorastis me.
text_pt: Jesus respondeu: Eu não tenho demônio, antes honro a meu Pai, e vós me desonrais.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς: ἐγὼ δαιμόνιον οὐκ ἔχω, ἀλλὰ τιμῶ τὸν πατέρα μου, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀτιμάζετέ με.

text_en: But I seek not my own glory : there is one that seeks and judges.
text_la: Ego autem non quæro gloriam meam : est qui quærat, et judicet.
text_pt: Eu não busco a minha glória; há quem a busque, e julgue.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ ζητῶ τὴν δόξαν μου: ἔστιν ὁ ζητῶν καὶ κρίνων.

text_en: Amen , amen , I say to you: If any man keep my word, he shall not see death for ever.
text_la: Amen, amen dico vobis : si quis sermonem meum servaverit, mortem non videbit in æternum.
text_pt: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que, se alguém guardar a minha palavra, nunca verá a morte.
text_el: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐάν τις τὸν ἐμὸν λόγον τηρήσῃ, θάνατον οὐ μὴ θεωρήσῃ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

text_en: The Jews therefore said: Now we know that you have a devil . Abraham is dead, and the prophets : and you say: If any man keep my word, he shall not taste death for ever.
text_la: Dixerunt ergo Judæi : Nunc cognovimus quia dæmonium habes. Abraham mortuus est, et prophetæ; et tu dicis : Si quis sermonem meum servaverit, non gustabit mortem in æternum.
text_pt: Disseram-lhe, pois, os judeus: Agora conhecemos que tens demônio. Morreu Abraão e os profetas; e tu dizes: Se alguém guardar a minha palavra, nunca provará a morte.
text_el: εἶπον αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι: νῦν ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι δαιμόνιον ἔχεις. Ἀβραὰμ ἀπέθανεν καὶ οἱ προφῆται, καὶ σὺ λέγεις: ἐάν τις τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσῃ, οὐ μὴ γεύσηται θανάτου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα:

text_en: Are you greater than our father Abraham who is dead? And the prophets are dead. Whom do you make yourself?
text_la: Numquid tu major es patre nostro Abraham, qui mortuus est? et prophetæ mortui sunt. Quem teipsum facis?
text_pt: És tu maior do que o nosso pai Abraão, que morreu? E também os profetas morreram. Quem te fazes tu ser?
text_el: μὴ σὺ μείζων εἶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ, ὅστις ἀπέθανεν; καὶ οἱ προφῆται ἀπέθανον: τίνα σεαυτὸν ποιεῖς;

text_en: Jesus answered: If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father that glorifies me, of whom you say that he is your God .
text_la: Respondit Jesus : Si ego glorifico meipsum, gloria mea nihil est : est Pater meus, qui glorificat me, quem vos dicitis quia Deus vester est,
text_pt: Jesus respondeu: Se eu me glorifico a mim mesmo, a minha glória não é nada; quem me glorifica é meu Pai, o qual dizeis que é vosso Deus.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς: ἐὰν ἐγὼ δοξάσω ἐμαυτόν, ἡ δόξα μου οὐδέν ἐστιν: ἔστιν ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ δοξάζων με, ὃν ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι θεὸς ὑμῶν ἐστιν,

text_en: And you have not known him: but I know him. And if I shall say that I know him not, I shall be like to you, a liar . But I do know him and do keep his word.
text_la: et non cognovistis eum : ego autem novi eum. Et si dixero quia non scio eum, ero similis vobis, mendax. Sed scio eum, et sermonem ejus servo.
text_pt: E vós não o conheceis, mas eu conheço-o. E, se disser que o não conheço, serei mentiroso como vós; mas conheço-o e guardo a sua palavra.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐγνώκατε αὐτόν, ἐγὼ δὲ οἶδα αὐτόν. κἂν εἴπω ὅτι οὐκ οἶδα αὐτόν, ἔσομαι ὅμοιος ὑμῖν ψεύστης: ἀλλὰ οἶδα αὐτὸν καὶ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ τηρῶ.

text_en: Abraham your father rejoiced that he might see my day: he saw it and was glad.
text_la: Abraham pater vester exsultavit ut videret diem meum : vidit, et gavisus est.
text_pt: Abraão, vosso pai, exultou por ver o meu dia, e viu-o, e alegrou-se.
text_el: Ἀβραὰμ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἠγαλλιάσατο ἵνα ἴδῃ τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν ἐμήν, καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἐχάρη.

text_en: The Jews therefore said to him: You are not yet fifty years old. And you have seen Abraham ?
text_la: Dixerunt ergo Judæi ad eum : Quinquaginta annos nondum habes, et Abraham vidisti?
text_pt: Disseram-lhe, pois, os judeus: Ainda não tens cinqüenta anos, e viste Abraão?
text_el: εἶπον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι πρὸς αὐτόν: πεντήκοντα ἔτη οὔπω ἔχεις καὶ Ἀβραὰμ ἑώρακας;

text_en: Jesus said to them: Amen , amen , I say to you, before Abraham was made, I AM .
text_la: Dixit eis Jesus : Amen, amen dico vobis, antequam Abraham fieret, ego sum.
text_pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que antes que Abraão existisse, eu sou.
text_el: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, πρὶν Ἀβραὰμ γενέσθαι ἐγὼ εἰμί.

text_en: They took up stones therefore to cast at him. But Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple .
text_la: Tulerunt ergo lapides, ut jacerent in eum : Jesus autem abscondit se, et exivit de templo.
text_pt: Então pegaram em pedras para lhe atirarem; mas Jesus ocultou-se, e saiu do templo, passando pelo meio deles, e assim se retirou.
text_el: ἦραν οὖν λίθους ἵνα βάλωσιν ἐπ' αὐτόν: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἐκρύβη καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ.

text_en: And Jesus passing by, saw a man who was blind from his birth.
text_la: Et præteriens Jesus vidit hominem cæcum a nativitate:
text_pt: E, passando Jesus, viu um homem cego de nascença.
text_el: Καὶ παράγων εἶδεν ἄνθρωπον τυφλὸν ἐκ γενετῆς.

text_en: And his disciples asked him: "Rabbi, who has sinned , this man or his parents , that he should be born blind?"
text_la: et interrogaverunt eum discipuli ejus : Rabbi, quis peccavit, hic, aut parentes ejus, ut cæcus nasceretur?
text_pt: E os seus discípulos lhe perguntaram, dizendo: Rabi, quem pecou, este ou seus pais, para que nascesse cego?
text_el: καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ λέγοντες: ῥαββί, τίς ἥμαρτεν, οὗτος ἢ οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ, ἵνα τυφλὸς γεννηθῇ;

text_en: Jesus answered: "Neither has this man sinned , nor his parents ; but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
text_la: Respondit Jesus : Neque hic peccavit, neque parentes ejus : sed ut manifestentur opera Dei in illo.
text_pt: Jesus respondeu: Nem ele pecou nem seus pais; mas foi assim para que se manifestem nele as obras de Deus.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς: οὔτε οὗτος ἥμαρτεν οὔτε οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ, ἀλλ' ἵνα φανερωθῇ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ.

text_en: I must work the works of him that sent me, whilst it is day; the night comes, when no man can work.
text_la: Me oportet operari opera ejus qui misit me, donec dies est : venit nox, quando nemo potest operari:
text_pt: Convém que eu faça as obras daquele que me enviou, enquanto é dia; a noite vem, quando ninguém pode trabalhar.
text_el: ἡμᾶς δεῖ ἐργάζεσθαι τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πέμψαντός με ἕως ἡμέρα ἐστίν: ἔρχεται νὺξ ὅτε οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐργάζεσθαι.

text_en: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world."
text_la: quamdiu sum in mundo, lux sum mundi.
text_pt: Enquanto estou no mundo, sou a luz do mundo.
text_el: ὅταν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ὦ, φῶς εἰμι τοῦ κόσμου.

text_en: When he had said these things, he spat on the ground and made clay of the spittle and spread the clay upon his eyes,
text_la: Hæc cum dixisset, exspuit in terram, et fecit lutum ex sputo, et linivit lutum super oculos ejus,
text_pt: Tendo dito isto, cuspiu na terra, e com a saliva fez lodo, e untou com o lodo os olhos do cego.
text_el: ταῦτα εἰπὼν ἔπτυσεν χαμαὶ καὶ ἐποίησεν πηλὸν ἐκ τοῦ πτύσματος, καὶ ἐπέθηκεν αὐτοῦ τὸν πηλὸν ἐπὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς,

text_en: and said to him: "Go, wash in the pool of Siloe ," which is interpreted, Sent . He went therefore and washed, and he came seeing.
text_la: et dixit ei : Vade, lava in natatoria Siloë (quod interpretatur Missus). Abiit ergo, et lavit, et venit videns.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Vai, lava-te no tanque de Siloé (que significa o Enviado). Foi, pois, e lavou-se, e voltou vendo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ὕπαγε νίψαι εἰς τὴν κολυμβήθραν τοῦ Σιλωάμ, ὃ ἑρμηνεύεται ἀπεσταλμένος. ἀπῆλθεν οὖν καὶ ἐνίψατο, καὶ ἦλθεν βλέπων.

text_en: The neighbours, therefore, and they who had seen him before that he was a beggar, said: "Is not this he that sat and begged?" Some said: "This is he."
text_la: Itaque vicini, et qui viderant eum prius quia mendicus erat, dicebant : Nonne hic est qui sedebat, et mendicabat? Alii dicebant : Quia hic est.
text_pt: Então os vizinhos, e aqueles que dantes tinham visto que era cego, diziam: Não é este aquele que estava assentado e mendigava?
text_el: Οἱ οὖν γείτονες καὶ οἱ θεωροῦντες αὐτὸν τὸ πρότερον, ὅτι προσαίτης ἦν, ἔλεγον: οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ καθήμενος καὶ προσαιτῶν;

text_en: But others said: "No, but he is like him." But he said: "I am he."
text_la: Alii autem : Nequaquam, sed similis est ei. Ille vero dicebat : Quia ego sum.
text_pt: Uns diziam: É este. E outros: Parece-se com ele. Ele dizia: Sou eu.
text_el: ἄλλοι ἔλεγον ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν: ἄλλοι ἔλεγον: οὐχί, ἀλλὰ ὅμοιος αὐτῷ ἐστιν. ἐκεῖνος ἔλεγεν ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι.

text_en: They said therefore to him: "How were your eyes opened?"
text_la: Dicebant ergo ei : Quomodo aperti sunt tibi oculi?
text_pt: Diziam-lhe, pois: Como se te abriram os olhos?
text_el: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ: πῶς οὖν ἠνεῴχθησάν σου οἱ ὀφθαλμοί;

text_en: He answered: "That man that is called Jesus made clay and anointed my eyes and said to me: 'Go to the pool of Siloe and wash.' And I went, I washed, and I see."
text_la: Respondit : Ille homo qui dicitur Jesus, lutum fecit : et unxit oculos meos, et dixit mihi : Vade ad natatoria Siloë, et lava. Et abii, et lavi, et video.
text_pt: Ele respondeu, e disse: O homem, chamado Jesus, fez lodo, e untou-me os olhos, e disse-me: Vai ao tanque de Siloé, e lava-te. Então fui, e lavei-me, e vi.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη ἐκεῖνος: ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰησοῦς πηλὸν ἐποίησεν καὶ ἐπέχρισέν μου τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὅτι ὕπαγε εἰς τὸν Σιλωὰμ καὶ νίψαι: ἀπελθὼν οὖν καὶ νιψάμενος ἀνέβλεψα.

text_en: And they said to him: "Where is he?" He said: "I know not."
text_la: Et dixerunt ei : Ubi est ille? Ait : Nescio.
text_pt: Disseram-lhe, pois: Onde está ele? Respondeu: Não sei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: ποῦ ἐστιν ἐκεῖνος; λέγει: οὐκ οἶδα.

text_en: They brought him that had been blind to the Pharisees .
text_la: Adducunt eum ad pharisæos, qui cæcus fuerat.
text_pt: Levaram, pois, aos fariseus o que dantes era cego.
text_el: Ἄγουσιν αὐτὸν πρὸς τοὺς Φαρισαίους, τόν ποτε τυφλόν.

text_en: Now it was the sabbath , when Jesus made the clay and opened his eyes.
text_la: Erat autem sabbatum quando lutum fecit Jesus, et aperuit oculos ejus.
text_pt: E era sábado quando Jesus fez o lodo e lhe abriu os olhos.
text_el: ἦν δὲ σάββατον ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ τὸν πηλὸν ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἀνέῳξεν αὐτοῦ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς.

text_en: Again therefore the Pharisees asked him how he had received his sight. But he said to them: "He put clay upon my eyes, and I washed, and I see."
text_la: Iterum ergo interrogabant eum pharisæi quomodo vidisset. Ille autem dixit eis : Lutum mihi posuit super oculos, et lavi, et video.
text_pt: Tornaram, pois, também os fariseus a perguntar-lhe como vira, e ele lhes disse: Pôs-me lodo sobre os olhos, lavei-me, e vejo.
text_el: πάλιν οὖν ἠρώτων αὐτὸν καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πῶς ἀνέβλεψεν. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: πηλὸν ἐπέθηκέν μου ἐπὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς, καὶ ἐνιψάμην, καὶ βλέπω.

text_en: Some therefore of the Pharisees said: "This man is not of God , who keeps not the sabbath ." But others said: "How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles ?" And there was a division among them.
text_la: Dicebant ergo ex pharisæis quidam : Non est hic homo a Deo, qui sabbatum non custodit. Alii autem dicebant : Quomodo potest homo peccator hæc signa facere? Et schisma erat inter eos.
text_pt: Então alguns dos fariseus diziam: Este homem não é de Deus, pois não guarda o sábado. Diziam outros: Como pode um homem pecador fazer tais sinais? E havia dissensão entre eles.
text_el: ἔλεγον οὖν ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων τινές: οὐκ ἔστιν οὗτος παρὰ θεοῦ ὁ ἄνθρωπος, ὅτι τὸ σάββατον οὐ τηρεῖ. ἄλλοι δὲ ἔλεγον: πῶς δύναται ἄνθρωπος ἁμαρτωλὸς τοιαῦτα σημεῖα ποιεῖν; καὶ σχίσμα ἦν ἐν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: They said therefore to the blind man again: "What do you say of him that has opened your eyes?" And he said: "He is a prophet ."
text_la: Dicunt ergo cæco iterum : Tu quid dicis de illo qui aperuit oculos tuos? Ille autem dixit : Quia propheta est.
text_pt: Tornaram, pois, a dizer ao cego: Tu, que dizes daquele que te abriu os olhos? E ele respondeu: Que é profeta.
text_el: λέγουσιν οὖν τῷ τυφλῷ πάλιν: τί σὺ λέγεις περὶ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἠνέῳξέν σου τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ὅτι προφήτης ἐστίν.

text_en: The Jews then did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight,
text_la: Non crediderunt ergo Judæi de illo, quia cæcus fuisset et vidisset, donec vocaverunt parentes ejus, qui viderat:
text_pt: Os judeus, porém, não creram que ele tivesse sido cego, e que agora visse, enquanto não chamaram os pais do que agora via.
text_el: οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι περὶ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἦν τυφλὸς καὶ ἀνέβλεψεν, ἕως ὅτου ἐφώνησαν τοὺς γονεῖς αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἀναβλέψαντος,

text_en: and asked them, saying: "Is this your son, who you say was born blind? How then does he now see?"
text_la: et interrogaverunt eos, dicentes : Hic est filius vester, quem vos dicitis quia cæcus natus est? quomodo ergo nunc videt?
text_pt: E perguntaram-lhes, dizendo: É este o vosso filho, que vós dizeis ter nascido cego? Como, pois, vê agora?
text_el: καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτοὺς λέγοντες: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς ὑμῶν, ὃν ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι τυφλὸς ἐγεννήθη; πῶς οὖν βλέπει ἄρτι;

text_en: His parents answered them and said: "We know that this is our son and that he was born blind.
text_la: Responderunt eis parentes ejus, et dixerunt : Scimus quia hic est filius noster, et quia cæcus natus est:
text_pt: Seus pais lhes responderam, e disseram: Sabemos que este é o nosso filho, e que nasceu cego;
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν οὖν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπαν: οἴδαμεν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς ἡμῶν καὶ ὅτι τυφλὸς ἐγεννήθη:

text_en: But how he now sees, we know not; or who has opened his eyes, we know not. Ask him. He is of age. Let him speak for himself."
text_la: quomodo autem nunc videat, nescimus : aut quis ejus aperuit oculos, nos nescimus; ipsum interrogate : ætatem habet, ipse de se loquatur.
text_pt: Mas como agora vê, não sabemos; ou quem lhe tenha aberto os olhos, não sabemos. Tem idade, perguntai-lho a ele mesmo; e ele falará por si mesmo.
text_el: πῶς δὲ νῦν βλέπει οὐκ οἴδαμεν, ἢ τίς ἤνοιξεν αὐτοῦ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἡμεῖς οὐκ οἴδαμεν: αὐτὸν ἐρωτήσατε, ἡλικίαν ἔχει, αὐτὸς περὶ ἑαυτοῦ λαλήσει.

text_en: These things his parents said, because they feared the Jews ; for the Jews had already agreed among themselves that if any man should confess him to be Christ , he should be put out of the synagogue .
text_la: Hæc dixerunt parentes ejus, quoniam timebant Judæos : jam enim conspiraverunt Judæi, ut si quis eum confiteretur esse Christum, extra synagogam fieret.
text_pt: Seus pais disseram isto, porque temiam os judeus. Porquanto já os judeus tinham resolvido que, se alguém confessasse ser ele o Cristo, fosse expulso da sinagoga.
text_el: ταῦτα εἶπαν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐφοβοῦντο τοὺς Ἰουδαίους: ἤδη γὰρ συνετέθειντο οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἵνα ἐάν τις αὐτὸν ὁμολογήσῃ Χριστόν, ἀποσυνάγωγος γένηται.

text_en: Therefore did his parents say: "He is of age. Ask him."
text_la: Propterea parentes ejus dixerunt : Quia ætatem habet, ipsum interrogate.
text_pt: Por isso é que seus pais disseram: Tem idade, perguntai-lho a ele mesmo.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ εἶπαν ὅτι ἡλικίαν ἔχει, αὐτὸν ἐπερωτήσατε.

text_en: They therefore called the man again that had been blind and said to him: "Give glory to God . We know that this man is a sinner."
text_la: Vocaverunt ergo rursum hominem qui fuerat cæcus, et dixerunt ei : Da gloriam Deo : nos scimus quia hic homo peccator est.
text_pt: Chamaram, pois, pela segunda vez o homem que tinha sido cego, e disseram-lhe: Dá glória a Deus; nós sabemos que esse homem é pecador.
text_el: Ἐφώνησαν οὖν τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐκ δευτέρου, ὃς ἦν τυφλὸς, καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: δὸς δόξαν τῷ θεῷ: ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν ὅτι οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἁμαρτωλός ἐστιν.

text_en: He said therefore to them: "If he be a sinner, I know not. One thing I know , that whereas I was blind now I see."
text_la: Dixit ergo eis ille : Si peccator est, nescio; unum scio, quia cæcus cum essem, modo video.
text_pt: Respondeu ele pois, e disse: Se é pecador, não sei; uma coisa sei, é que, havendo eu sido cego, agora vejo.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη οὖν ἐκεῖνος: εἰ ἁμαρτωλός ἐστιν οὐκ οἶδα: ἓν οἶδα, ὅτι τυφλὸς ὢν ἄρτι βλέπω.

text_en: They said then to him: "What did he to you? How did he open your eyes?"
text_la: Dixerunt ergo illi : Quid fecit tibi? quomodo aperuit tibi oculos?
text_pt: E tornaram a dizer-lhe: Que te fez ele? Como te abriu os olhos?
text_el: εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ: τί ἐποίησέν σοι; πῶς ἤνοιξέν σου τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς;

text_en: He answered them: "I have told you already, and you have heard. Why would you hear it again? Will you also become his disciples ?"
text_la: Respondit eis : Dixi vobis jam, et audistis : quod iterum vultis audire? numquid et vos vultis discipuli ejus fieri?
text_pt: Respondeu-lhes: Já vo-lo disse, e não ouvistes; para que o quereis tornar a ouvir? Quereis vós porventura fazer-vos também seus discípulos?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς: εἶπον ὑμῖν ἤδη καὶ οὐκ ἠκούσατε: τί πάλιν θέλετε ἀκούειν; μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς θέλετε αὐτοῦ μαθηταὶ γενέσθαι;

text_en: They reviled him therefore and said: "You are his disciple , but we are the disciples of Moses .
text_la: Maledixerunt ergo ei, et dixerunt : Tu discipulus illius sis : nos autem Moysi discipuli sumus.
text_pt: Então o injuriaram, e disseram: Discípulo dele sejas tu; nós, porém, somos discípulos de Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἐλοιδόρησαν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπον: σὺ μαθητὴς εἶ ἐκείνου, ἡμεῖς δὲ τοῦ Μωϋσέως ἐσμὲν μαθηταί:

text_en: We know that God spoke to Moses : but as to this man , we know not from whence he is."
text_la: Nos scimus quia Moysi locutus est Deus; hunc autem nescimus unde sit.
text_pt: Nós bem sabemos que Deus falou a Moisés, mas este não sabemos de onde é.
text_el: ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν ὅτι Μωϋσεῖ λελάληκεν ὁ θεός, τοῦτον δὲ οὐκ οἴδαμεν πόθεν ἐστίν.

text_en: The man answered and said to them: "Why, herein is a wonderful thing, that you know not from whence he is, and he has opened my eyes.
text_la: Respondit ille homo, et dixit eis : In hoc enim mirabile est quia vos nescitis unde sit, et aperuit meos oculos:
text_pt: O homem respondeu, e disse-lhes: Nisto, pois, está a maravilha, que vós não saibais de onde ele é, e contudo me abrisse os olhos.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἐν τούτῳ γὰρ τὸ θαυμαστόν ἐστιν, ὅτι ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε πόθεν ἐστίν, καὶ ἤνοιξέν μου τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς.

text_en: Now we know that God does not hear sinners. But if a man is a server of God and does his will, him he hears.
text_la: scimus autem quia peccatores Deus non audit : sed si quis Dei cultor est, et voluntatem ejus facit, hunc exaudit.
text_pt: Ora, nós sabemos que Deus não ouve a pecadores; mas, se alguém é temente a Deus, e faz a sua vontade, a esse ouve.
text_el: οἴδαμεν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἁμαρτωλῶν οὐκ ἀκούει, ἀλλ' ἐάν τις θεοσεβὴς ᾖ καὶ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ποιῇ, τούτου ἀκούει.

text_en: From the beginning of the world it has not been heard, that any man has opened the eyes of one born blind.
text_la: A sæculo non est auditum quia quis aperuit oculos cæci nati.
text_pt: Desde o princípio do mundo nunca se ouviu que alguém abrisse os olhos a um cego de nascença.
text_el: ἐκ τοῦ αἰῶνος οὐκ ἠκούσθη ὅτι ἠνέῳξέν τις ὀφθαλμοὺς τυφλοῦ γεγεννημένου:

text_en: Unless this man were of God , he could not do anything."
text_la: Nisi esset hic a Deo, non poterat facere quidquam.
text_pt: Se este não fosse de Deus, nada poderia fazer.
text_el: εἰ μὴ ἦν οὗτος παρὰ θεοῦ, οὐκ ἠδύνατο ποιεῖν οὐδέν.

text_en: They answered and said to him: "You were wholly born in sins , and you teach us?" And they cast him out.
text_la: Responderunt, et dixerunt ei : In peccatis natus es totus, et tu doces nos? Et ejecerunt eum foras.
text_pt: Responderam eles, e disseram-lhe: Tu és nascido todo em pecados, e nos ensinas a nós? E expulsaram-no.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: ἐν ἁμαρτίαις σὺ ἐγεννήθης ὅλος, καὶ σὺ διδάσκεις ἡμᾶς; καὶ ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω.

text_en: Jesus heard that they had cast him out. And when he had found him, he said to him: "Do you believe in the Son of God ?"
text_la: Audivit Jesus quia ejecerunt eum foras : et cum invenisset eum, dixit ei : Tu credis in Filium Dei?
text_pt: Jesus ouviu que o tinham expulsado e, encontrando-o, disse-lhe: Crês tu no Filho de Deus?
text_el: Ἤκουσεν Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω, καὶ εὑρὼν αὐτὸν εἶπεν: σὺ πιστεύεις εἰς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου;

text_en: He answered, and said: "Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?"
text_la: Respondit ille, et dixit : Quis est, Domine, ut credam in eum?
text_pt: Ele respondeu, e disse: Quem é ele, Senhor, para que nele creia?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη ἐκεῖνος [καὶ εἶπεν]: καὶ τίς ἐστιν, κύριε, ἵνα πιστεύσω εἰς αὐτόν;

text_en: And Jesus said to him: "You have both seen him, and it is he that talks with you."
text_la: Et dixit ei Jesus : Et vidisti eum, et qui loquitur tecum, ipse est.
text_pt: E Jesus lhe disse: Tu já o tens visto, e é aquele que fala contigo.
text_el: εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: καὶ ἑώρακας αὐτὸν, καὶ ὁ λαλῶν μετὰ σοῦ ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν.

text_en: And he said: "I believe , Lord." And falling down, he adored him.
text_la: At ille ait : Credo, Domine. Et procidens adoravit eum.
text_pt: Ele disse: Creio, Senhor. E o adorou.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἔφη: πιστεύω, κύριε: καὶ προσεκύνησεν αὐτῷ.

text_en: And Jesus said: "For judgment I have come into this world: that they who see not may see, and they who see may become blind."
text_la: Et dixit Jesus : In judicium ego in hunc mundum veni : ut qui non vident videant, et qui vident cæci fiant.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Jesus: Eu vim a este mundo para juízo, a fim de que os que não vêem vejam, e os que vêem sejam cegos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς: εἰς κρίμα ἐγὼ εἰς τὸν κόσμον τοῦτον ἦλθον, ἵνα οἱ μὴ βλέποντες βλέπωσιν καὶ οἱ βλέποντες τυφλοὶ γένωνται.

text_en: And some of the Pharisees , who were with him, heard. And they said unto him: "Are we also blind?"
text_la: Et audierunt quidam ex pharisæis qui cum ipso erant, et dixerunt ei : Numquid et nos cæci sumus?
text_pt: E aqueles dos fariseus, que estavam com ele, ouvindo isto, disseram-lhe: Também nós somos cegos?
text_el: ἤκουσαν ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων ταῦτα οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ ὄντες, καὶ εἶπον αὐτῷ: μὴ καὶ ἡμεῖς τυφλοί ἐσμεν;

text_en: Jesus said to them: "If you were blind, you should not have sin . But now you say: 'We see.' Your sin remains."
text_la: Dixit eis Jesus : Si cæci essetis, non haberetis peccatum. Nunc vero dicitis, Quia videmus : peccatum vestrum manet.
text_pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Se fôsseis cegos, não teríeis pecado; mas como agora dizeis: Vemos; por isso o vosso pecado permanece.
text_el: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: εἰ τυφλοὶ ἦτε, οὐκ ἂν εἴχετε ἁμαρτίαν: νῦν δὲ λέγετε ὅτι βλέπομεν: ἡ ἁμαρτία ὑμῶν μένει.

text_en: Amen , amen , I say to you: He that enters not by the door into the sheepfold but climbs up another way, the same is a thief and a robber.
text_la: Amen, amen dico vobis : qui non intrat per ostium in ovile ovium, sed ascendit aliunde, ille fur est et latro.
text_pt: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que aquele que não entra pela porta no curral das ovelhas, mas sobe por outra parte, é ladrão e salteador.
text_el: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ μὴ εἰσερχόμενος διὰ τῆς θύρας εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τῶν προβάτων ἀλλὰ ἀναβαίνων ἀλλαχόθεν, ἐκεῖνος κλέπτης ἐστὶν καὶ λῃστής:

text_en: But he that enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
text_la: Qui autem intrat per ostium, pastor est ovium.
text_pt: Aquele, porém, que entra pela porta é o pastor das ovelhas.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἰσερχόμενος διὰ τῆς θύρας ποιμήν ἐστιν τῶν προβάτων.

text_en: To him the porter opens: and the sheep hear his voice. And he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
text_la: Huic ostiarius aperit, et oves vocem ejus audiunt, et proprias ovas vocat nominatim, et educit eas.
text_pt: A este o porteiro abre, e as ovelhas ouvem a sua voz, e chama pelo nome às suas ovelhas, e as traz para fora.
text_el: τούτῳ ὁ θυρωρὸς ἀνοίγει, καὶ τὰ πρόβατα τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούει, καὶ τὰ ἴδια πρόβατα φωνεῖ κατ' ὄνομα καὶ ἐξάγει αὐτά.

text_en: And when he has let out his own sheep, he goes before them: and the sheep follow him, because they know his voice.
text_la: Et cum proprias oves emiserit, ante eas vadit : et oves illum sequuntur, quia sciunt vocem ejus.
text_pt: E, quando tira para fora as suas ovelhas, vai adiante delas, e as ovelhas o seguem, porque conhecem a sua voz.
text_el: ὅταν τὰ ἴδια πάντα ἐκβάλῃ, ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν πορεύεται, καὶ τὰ πρόβατα αὐτῷ ἀκολουθεῖ, ὅτι οἴδασιν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ:

text_en: But a stranger they follow not, but fly from him, because they know not the voice of strangers.
text_la: Alienum autem non sequuntur, sed fugiunt ab eo : quia non noverunt vocem alienorum.
text_pt: Mas de modo nenhum seguirão o estranho, antes fugirão dele, porque não conhecem a voz dos estranhos.
text_el: ἀλλοτρίῳ δὲ οὐ μὴ ἀκολουθήσουσιν, ἀλλὰ φεύξονται ἀπ' αὐτοῦ, ὅτι οὐκ οἴδασιν τῶν ἀλλοτρίων τὴν φωνήν.

text_en: This proverb Jesus spoke to them. But they understood not what he spoke.
text_la: Hoc proverbium dixit eis Jesus : illi autem non cognoverunt quid loqueretur eis.
text_pt: Jesus disse-lhes esta parábola; mas eles não entenderam o que era que lhes dizia.
text_el: Ταύτην τὴν παροιμίαν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἐκεῖνοι δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τίνα ἦν ἃ ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς.

text_en: Jesus therefore said to them again: Amen , amen , I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.
text_la: Dixit ergo eis iterum Jesus : Amen, amen dico vobis, quia ego sum ostium ovium.
text_pt: Tornou, pois, Jesus a dizer-lhes: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que eu sou a porta das ovelhas.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν πάλιν [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ θύρα τῶν προβάτων.

text_en: All others, as many as have come, are thieves and robbers: and the sheep heard them not.
text_la: Omnes quotquot venerunt, fures sunt, et latrones, et non audierunt eos oves.
text_pt: Todos quantos vieram antes de mim são ladrões e salteadores; mas as ovelhas não os ouviram.
text_el: πάντες ὅσοι ἦλθον πρὸ ἐμοῦ κλέπται εἰσὶν καὶ λῃσταί, ἀλλ' οὐκ ἤκουσαν αὐτῶν τὰ πρόβατα.

text_en: I am the door. By me, if any man enter in, he shall be saved: and he shall go in and go out, and shall find pastures.
text_la: Ego sum ostium. Per me si quis introierit, salvabitur : et ingredietur, et egredietur, et pascua inveniet.
text_pt: Eu sou a porta; se alguém entrar por mim, salvar-se-á, e entrará, e sairá, e achará pastagens.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ θύρα: δι' ἐμοῦ ἐάν τις εἰσέλθῃ, σωθήσεται καὶ εἰσελεύσεται καὶ ἐξελεύσεται καὶ νομὴν εὑρήσει.

text_en: The thief comes not, but for to steal and to kill and to destroy. I have come that they may have life and may have it more abundantly.
text_la: Fur non venit nisi ut furetur, et mactet, et perdat. Ego veni ut vitam habeant, et abundantius habeant.
text_pt: O ladrão não vem senão a roubar, a matar, e a destruir; eu vim para que tenham vida, e a tenham com abundância.
text_el: ὁ κλέπτης οὐκ ἔρχεται εἰ μὴ ἵνα κλέψῃ καὶ θύσῃ καὶ ἀπολέσῃ: ἐγὼ ἦλθον ἵνα ζωὴν ἔχωσιν καὶ περισσὸν ἔχωσιν.

text_en: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd gives his life for his sheep.
text_la: Ego sum pastor bonus. Bonus pastor animam suam dat pro ovibus suis.
text_pt: Eu sou o bom Pastor; o bom Pastor dá a sua vida pelas ovelhas.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός. ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλὸς τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ τίθησιν ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων:

text_en: But the hireling and he that is not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and flies: and the wolf casts and scatters the sheep,
text_la: Mercenarius autem, et qui non est pastor, cujus non sunt oves propriæ, videt lupum venientem, et dimittit oves, et fugit : et lupus rapit, et dispergit oves;
text_pt: Mas o mercenário, e o que não é pastor, de quem não são as ovelhas, vê vir o lobo, e deixa as ovelhas, e foge; e o lobo as arrebata e dispersa as ovelhas.
text_el: ὁ μισθωτὸς καὶ οὐκ ὢν ποιμήν, οὗ οὐκ ἔστιν τὰ πρόβατα ἴδια, θεωρεῖ τὸν λύκον ἐρχόμενον καὶ ἀφίησιν τὰ πρόβατα καὶ φεύγει, καὶ ὁ λύκος ἁρπάζει αὐτὰ καὶ σκορπίζει:

text_en: and the hireling flies, because he is a hireling: and he has no care for the sheep.
text_la: mercenarius autem fugit, quia mercenarius est, et non pertinet ad eum de ovibus.
text_pt: Ora, o mercenário foge, porque é mercenário, e não tem cuidado das ovelhas.
text_el: ὅτι μισθωτός ἐστιν, καὶ οὐ μέλει αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν προβάτων.

text_en: I am the good shepherd: and I know mine, and mine know me.
text_la: Ego sum pastor bonus : et cognosco meas, et cognoscunt me meæ.
text_pt: Eu sou o bom Pastor, e conheço as minhas ovelhas, e das minhas sou conhecido.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός, καὶ γινώσκω τὰ ἐμὰ, καὶ γινώσκουσί με τὰ ἐμά,

text_en: As the Father knows me, and I know the Father : and I lay down my life for my sheep.
text_la: Sicut novit me Pater, et ego agnosco Patrem : et animam meam pono pro ovibus meis.
text_pt: Assim como o Pai me conhece a mim, também eu conheço o Pai, e dou a minha vida pelas ovelhas.
text_el: καθὼς γινώσκει με ὁ πατὴρ κἀγὼ γινώσκω τὸν πατέρα, καὶ τὴν ψυχήν μου τίθημι ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων.

text_en: And other sheep I have that are not of this fold: them also I must bring. And they shall hear my voice: And there shall be one fold and one shepherd.
text_la: Et alias oves habeo, quæ non sunt ex hoc ovili : et illas oportet me adducere, et vocem meam audient, et fiet unum ovile et unus pastor.
text_pt: Ainda tenho outras ovelhas que não são deste aprisco; também me convém agregar estas, e elas ouvirão a minha voz, e haverá um rebanho e um Pastor.
text_el: καὶ ἄλλα πρόβατα ἔχω, ἃ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τῆς αὐλῆς ταύτης: κἀκεῖνα δεῖ με ἀγαγεῖν, καὶ τῆς φωνῆς μου ἀκούσουσιν, καὶ γενήσονται μία ποίμνη, εἷς ποιμήν.

text_en: Therefore does the Father love me: because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
text_la: Propterea me diligit Pater : quia ego pono animam meam, ut iterum sumam eam.
text_pt: Por isto o Pai me ama, porque dou a minha vida para tornar a tomá-la.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτό με ὁ πατὴρ ἀγαπᾷ, ὅτι ἐγὼ τίθημι τὴν ψυχήν μου, ἵνα πάλιν λάβω αὐτήν.

text_en: No man takes it away from me: but I lay it down of myself. And I have power to lay it down: and I have power to take it up again. This commandment have I received of my Father .
text_la: Nemo tollit eam a me : sed ego pono eam a meipso, et potestatem habeo ponendi eam, et potestatem habeo iterum sumendi eam. Hoc mandatum accepi a Patre meo.
text_pt: Ninguém ma tira de mim, mas eu de mim mesmo a dou; tenho poder para a dar, e poder para tornar a tomá-la. Este mandamento recebi de meu Pai.
text_el: οὐδεὶς ἦρεν αὐτὴν ἀπ' ἐμοῦ, ἀλλ' ἐγὼ τίθημι αὐτὴν ἀπ' ἐμαυτοῦ. ἐξουσίαν ἔχω θεῖναι αὐτήν, καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔχω πάλιν λαβεῖν αὐτήν: ταύτην τὴν ἐντολὴν ἔλαβον παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου.

text_en: A dissension rose again among the Jews for these words.
text_la: Dissensio iterum facta est inter Judæos propter sermones hos.
text_pt: Tornou, pois, a haver divisão entre os judeus por causa destas palavras.
text_el: σχίσμα πάλιν ἐγένετο ἐν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις διὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους.

text_en: And many of them said: He has a devil and is mad. Why hear you him?
text_la: Dicebant autem multi ex ipsis : Dæmonium habet, et insanit : quid eum auditis?
text_pt: E muitos deles diziam: Tem demônio, e está fora de si; por que o ouvis?
text_el: ἔλεγον δὲ πολλοὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν: δαιμόνιον ἔχει καὶ μαίνεται: τί αὐτοῦ ἀκούετε;

text_en: Others said: These are not the words of one that has a devil . Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
text_la: Alii dicebant : Hæc verba non sunt dæmonium habentis : numquid dæmonium potest cæcorum oculos aperire?
text_pt: Diziam outros: Estas palavras não são de endemoninhado. Pode, porventura, um demônio abrir os olhos aos cegos?
text_el: ἄλλοι ἔλεγον: ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα οὐκ ἔστιν δαιμονιζομένου: μὴ δαιμόνιον δύναται τυφλῶν ὀφθαλμοὺς ἀνοῖξαι;

text_en: And it was the feast of the dedication at Jerusalem : and it was winter.
text_la: Facta sunt autem Encænia in Jerosolymis, et hiems erat.
text_pt: E em Jerusalém havia a festa da dedicação, e era inverno.
text_el: Ἐγένετο τότε τὰ ἐγκαίνια ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις: χειμὼν ἦν:

text_en: And Jesus walked in the temple , in Solomon's porch.
text_la: Et ambulabat Jesus in templo, in porticu Salomonis.
text_pt: E Jesus andava passeando no templo, no alpendre de Salomão.
text_el: καὶ περιεπάτει [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἐν τῇ στοᾷ τοῦ Σολομῶνος.

text_en: The Jews therefore came round about him and said to him: How long do you hold our souls in suspense? If you be the Christ , tell us plainly.
text_la: Circumdederunt ergo eum Judæi, et dicebant ei : Quousque animam nostram tollis? si tu es Christus, dic nobis palam.
text_pt: Rodearam-no, pois, os judeus, e disseram-lhe: Até quando terás a nossa alma suspensa? Se tu és o Cristo, dize-no-lo abertamente.
text_el: ἐκύκλωσαν οὖν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ: ἕως πότε τὴν ψυχὴν ἡμῶν αἴρεις; εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστός, εἰπὸν ἡμῖν παρρησίᾳ.

text_en: Jesus answered them: I speak to you, and you believe not: the works that I do in the name of my Father , they give testimony of me.
text_la: Respondit eis Jesus : Loquor vobis, et non creditis : opera quæ ego facio in nomine Patris mei, hæc testimonium perhibent de me:
text_pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Já vo-lo tenho dito, e não o credes. As obras que eu faço, em nome de meu Pai, essas testificam de mim.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: εἶπον ὑμῖν, καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε: τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρός μου, ταῦτα μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ:

text_en: But you do not believe , because you are not of my sheep.
text_la: sed vos non creditis, quia non estis ex ovibus meis.
text_pt: Mas vós não credes porque não sois das minhas ovelhas, como já vo-lo tenho dito.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετε, ὅτι οὐκ ἐστὲ ἐκ τῶν προβάτων τῶν ἐμῶν.

text_en: My sheep hear my voice. And I know them: and they follow me.
text_la: Oves meæ vocem meam audiunt, et ego cognosco eas, et sequuntur me:
text_pt: As minhas ovelhas ouvem a minha voz, e eu conheço-as, e elas me seguem;
text_el: τὰ πρόβατα τὰ ἐμὰ τῆς φωνῆς μου ἀκούουσιν, κἀγὼ γινώσκω αὐτά, καὶ ἀκολουθοῦσίν μοι,

text_en: And I give them life everlasting: and they shall not perish for ever. And no man shall pluck them out of my hand.
text_la: et ego vitam æternam do eis, et non peribunt in æternum, et non rapiet eas quisquam de manu mea.
text_pt: E dou-lhes a vida eterna, e nunca hão de perecer, e ninguém as arrebatará da minha mão.
text_el: κἀγὼ δίδωμι αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀπόλωνται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ οὐχ ἁρπάσει τις αὐτὰ ἐκ τῆς χειρός μου.

text_en: That which my Father has given me is greater than all: and no one can snatch them out of the hand of my Father .
text_la: Pater meus quod dedit mihi, majus omnibus est : et nemo potest rapere de manu Patris mei.
text_pt: Meu Pai, que mas deu, é maior do que todos; e ninguém pode arrebatá-las da mão de meu Pai.
text_el: ὁ πατήρ μου ὃ δέδωκέν μοι πάντων μεῖζόν ἐστιν, καὶ οὐδεὶς δύναται ἁρπάζειν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ πατρός.

text_en: I and the Father are one.
text_la: Ego et Pater unum sumus.
text_pt: Eu e o Pai somos um.
text_el: ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ἕν ἐσμεν.

text_en: The Jews then took up stones to stone him.
text_la: Sustulerunt ergo lapides Judæi, ut lapidarent eum.
text_pt: Os judeus pegaram então outra vez em pedras para o apedrejar.
text_el: Ἐβάστασαν πάλιν λίθους οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἵνα λιθάσωσιν αὐτόν.

text_en: Jesus answered them: Many good works I have showed you from my Father . For which of those works do you stone me?
text_la: Respondit eis Jesus : Multa bona opera ostendi vobis ex Patre meo : propter quod eorum opus me lapidatis?
text_pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Tenho-vos mostrado muitas obras boas procedentes de meu Pai; por qual destas obras me apedrejais?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, πολλὰ ἔργα ἔδειξα ὑμῖν καλὰ ἐκ τοῦ πατρός: διὰ ποῖον αὐτῶν ἔργον ἐμὲ λιθάζετε;

text_en: The Jews answered him: For a good work we stone you not, but for blasphemy : and because that you being a man , make yourself God .
text_la: Responderunt ei Judæi : De bono opere non lapidamus te, sed de blasphemia; et quia tu homo cum sis, facis teipsum Deum.
text_pt: Os judeus responderam, dizendo-lhe: Não te apedrejamos por alguma obra boa, mas pela blasfêmia; porque, sendo tu homem, te fazes Deus a ti mesmo.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι: περὶ καλοῦ ἔργου οὐ λιθάζομέν σε ἀλλὰ περὶ βλασφημίας, καὶ ὅτι σὺ ἄνθρωπος ὢν ποιεῖς σεαυτὸν θεόν.

text_en: Jesus answered them: Is it not written in your law: I said, you are gods?
text_la: Respondit eis Jesus : Nonne scriptum est in lege vestra, Quia ego dixi : Dii estis?
text_pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Não está escrito na vossa lei: Eu disse: Sois deuses?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: οὐκ ἔστιν γεγραμμένον ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ὑμῶν ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπα: θεοί ἐστε;

text_en: If he called them gods to whom the word of God was spoken; and the scripture cannot be broken:
text_la: Si illos dixit deos, ad quos sermo Dei factus est, et non potest solvi Scriptura:
text_pt: Pois, se a lei chamou deuses àqueles a quem a palavra de Deus foi dirigida, e a Escritura não pode ser anulada,
text_el: εἰ ἐκείνους εἶπεν θεοὺς, πρὸς οὓς ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐγένετο, καὶ οὐ δύναται λυθῆναι ἡ γραφή:

text_en: Do you say of him whom the Father has sanctified and sent into the world: You blaspheme ; because I said: I am the Son of God ?
text_la: quem Pater sanctificavit, et misit in mundum vos dicitis : Quia blasphemas, quia dixi : Filius Dei sum?
text_pt: «quele a quem o Pai santificou, e enviou ao mundo, vós dizeis: Blasfemas, porque disse: Sou Filho de Deus?
text_el: ὃν ὁ πατὴρ ἡγίασεν καὶ ἀπέστειλεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι βλασφημεῖς, ὅτι εἶπον: υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ εἰμι;

text_en: If I do not the works of my Father , believe me not.
text_la: Si non facio opera Patris mei, nolite credere mihi.
text_pt: Se não faço as obras de meu Pai, não me acrediteis.
text_el: εἰ οὐ ποιῶ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πατρός μου, μὴ πιστεύετέ μοι:

text_en: But if I do, though you will not believe me, believe the works: that you may know and believe that the Father is in me and I in the Father .
text_la: Si autem facio : etsi mihi non vultis credere, operibus credite, ut cognoscatis, et credatis quia Pater in me est, et ego in Patre.
text_pt: Mas, se as faço, e não credes em mim, crede nas obras; para que conheçais e acrediteis que o Pai está em mim e eu nele.
text_el: εἰ δὲ ποιῶ, κἂν ἐμοὶ μὴ πιστεύητε, τοῖς ἔργοις πιστεύετε, ἵνα γνῶτε καὶ γινώσκητε ὅτι ἐν ἐμοὶ ὁ πατὴρ κἀγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρί.

text_en: They sought therefore to take him: and he escaped out of their hands.
text_la: Quærebant ergo eum apprehendere : et exivit de manibus eorum.
text_pt: Procuravam, pois, prendê-lo outra vez, mas ele escapou-se de suas mãos,
text_el: Ἐζήτουν [οὖν] αὐτὸν πάλιν πιάσαι, καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν.

text_en: And he went again beyond the Jordan , into that place where John was baptizing first. And there he abode.
text_la: Et abiit iterum trans Jordanem, in eum locum ubi erat Joannes baptizans primum, et mansit illic;
text_pt: E retirou-se outra vez para além do Jordão, para o lugar onde João tinha primeiramente batizado; e ali ficou.
text_el: Καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πάλιν πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου εἰς τὸν τόπον ὅπου ἦν Ἰωάννης τὸ πρῶτον βαπτίζων, καὶ ἔμενεν ἐκεῖ.

text_en: And many resorted to him: and they said: John indeed did no sign.
text_la: et multi venerunt ad eum, et dicebant : Quia Joannes quidem signum fecit nullum.
text_pt: E muitos iam ter com ele, e diziam: Na verdade João não fez sinal algum, mas tudo quanto João disse deste era verdade.
text_el: καὶ πολλοὶ ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἰωάννης μὲν σημεῖον ἐποίησεν οὐδέν, πάντα δὲ ὅσα εἶπεν Ἰωάννης περὶ τούτου ἀληθῆ ἦν.

text_en: But all things whatsoever John said of this man were true . And many believed in him.
text_la: Omnia autem quæcumque dixit Joannes de hoc, vera erant. Et multi crediderunt in eum.
text_pt: E muitos ali creram nele.
text_el: καὶ πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ.

text_en: Now there was a certain man sick, named Lazarus , of Bethania , of the town of Mary and of Martha her sister.
text_la: Erat autem quidam languens Lazarus a Bethania, de castello Mariæ et Marthæ sororis ejus.
text_pt: Estava, porém, enfermo um certo Lázaro, de betânia, aldeia de Maria e de sua irmã Marta.
text_el: Ἦν δέ τις ἀσθενῶν, Λάζαρος ἀπὸ Βηθανίας, ἐκ τῆς κώμης Μαρίας καὶ Μάρθας τῆς ἀδελφῆς αὐτῆς.

text_en: (And Mary was she that anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair : whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
text_la: (Maria autem erat quæ unxit Dominum unguento, et extersit pedes ejus capillis suis : cujus frater Lazarus infirmabatur.)
text_pt: E Maria era aquela que tinha ungido o Senhor com ungüento, e lhe tinha enxugado os pés com os seus cabelos, cujo irmão Lázaro estava enfermo.
text_el: ἦν δὲ Μαριὰμ ἡ ἀλείψασα τὸν κύριον μύρῳ καὶ ἐκμάξασα τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ταῖς θριξὶν αὐτῆς, ἧς ὁ ἀδελφὸς Λάζαρος ἠσθένει.

text_en: His sisters therefore sent to him, saying: Lord, behold, he whom you love is sick.
text_la: Miserunt ergo sorores ejus ad eum dicentes : Domine, ecce quem amas infirmatur.
text_pt: Mandaram-lhe, pois, suas irmãs dizer: Senhor, eis que está enfermo aquele que tu amas.
text_el: ἀπέστειλαν οὖν αἱ ἀδελφαὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγουσαι: κύριε, ἴδε ὃν φιλεῖς ἀσθενεῖ.

text_en: And Jesus hearing it, said to them: This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God : that the Son of God may be glorified by it.
text_la: Audiens autem Jesus dixit eis : Infirmitas hæc non est ad mortem, sed pro gloria Dei, ut glorificetur Filius Dei per eam.
text_pt: E Jesus, ouvindo isto, disse: Esta enfermidade não é para morte, mas para glória de Deus, para que o Filho de Deus seja glorificado por ela.
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: αὕτη ἡ ἀσθένεια οὐκ ἔστιν πρὸς θάνατον ἀλλ' ὑπὲρ τῆς δόξης τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ δι' αὐτῆς.

text_en: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister Mary and Lazarus .
text_la: Diligebat autem Jesus Martham, et sororem ejus Mariam, et Lazarum.
text_pt: Ora, Jesus amava a Marta, e a sua irmã, e a Lázaro.
text_el: ἠγάπα δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὴν Μάρθαν καὶ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῆς καὶ τὸν Λάζαρον.

text_en: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he still remained in the same place two days.
text_la: Ut ergo audivit quia infirmabatur, tunc quidem mansit in eodem loco duobus diebus;
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, que estava enfermo, ficou ainda dois dias no lugar onde estava.
text_el: ὡς οὖν ἤκουσεν ὅτι ἀσθενεῖ, τότε μὲν ἔμεινεν ἐν ᾧ ἦν τόπῳ δύο ἡμέρας:

text_en: Then after that, he said to his disciples : Let us go into Judea again.
text_la: deinde post hæc dixit discipulis suis: Eamus in Judæam iterum.
text_pt: Depois disto, disse aos seus discípulos: Vamos outra vez para a Judéia.
text_el: ἔπειτα μετὰ τοῦτο λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς: ἄγωμεν εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν πάλιν.

text_en: The disciples say to him: Rabbi, the Jews but now sought to stone you. And you are going there again?
text_la: Dicunt ei discipuli : Rabbi, nunc quærebant te Judæi lapidare, et iterum vadis illuc?
text_pt: Disseram-lhe os discípulos: Rabi, ainda agora os judeus procuravam apedrejar-te, e tornas para lá?
text_el: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταί: ῥαββί, νῦν ἐζήτουν σε λιθάσαι οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι, καὶ πάλιν ὑπάγεις ἐκεῖ;

text_en: Jesus answered: Are there not twelve hours of the day? If a man walk in the day he stumbles not, because he sees the light of this world:
text_la: Respondit Jesus : Nonne duodecim sunt horæ diei? Si quis ambulaverit in die, non offendit, quia lucem hujus mundi videt:
text_pt: Jesus respondeu: Não há doze horas no dia? Se alguém andar de dia, não tropeça, porque vê a luz deste mundo;
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς: οὐχὶ δώδεκα ὧραί εἰσιν τῆς ἡμέρας; ἐάν τις περιπατῇ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ, οὐ προσκόπτει, ὅτι τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου τούτου βλέπει:

text_en: But if he walk in the night, he stumbles, because the light is not in him.
text_la: si autem ambulaverit in nocte, offendit, quia lux non est in eo.
text_pt: Mas, se andar de noite, tropeça, porque nele não há luz.
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις περιπατῇ ἐν τῇ νυκτί, προσκόπτει, ὅτι τὸ φῶς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτῷ.

text_en: These things he said; and after that he said to them: Lazarus our friend sleeps: but I go that I may awake him out of sleep.
text_la: Hæc ait, et post hæc dixit eis : Lazarus amicus noster dormit : sed vado ut a somno excitem eum.
text_pt: Assim falou; e depois disse-lhes: Lázaro, o nosso amigo, dorme, mas vou despertá-lo do sono.
text_el: ταῦτα εἶπεν, καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο λέγει αὐτοῖς: Λάζαρος ὁ φίλος ἡμῶν κεκοίμηται: ἀλλὰ πορεύομαι ἵνα ἐξυπνίσω αὐτόν.

text_en: His disciples therefore said: Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
text_la: Dixerunt ergo discipuli ejus : Domine, si dormit, salvus erit.
text_pt: Disseram, pois, os seus discípulos: Senhor, se dorme, estará salvo.
text_el: εἶπαν οὖν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτῷ κύριε, εἰ κεκοίμηται σωθήσεται.

text_en: But Jesus spoke of his death: and they thought that he spoke of the repose of sleep.
text_la: Dixerat autem Jesus de morte ejus : illi autem putaverunt quia de dormitione somni diceret.
text_pt: Mas Jesus dizia isto da sua morte; eles, porém, cuidavam que falava do repouso do sono.
text_el: εἰρήκει δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς περὶ τοῦ θανάτου αὐτοῦ. ἐκεῖνοι δὲ ἔδοξαν ὅτι περὶ τῆς κοιμήσεως τοῦ ὕπνου λέγει.

text_en: Then therefore Jesus said to them plainly: Lazarus is dead.
text_la: Tunc ergo Jesus dixit eis manifeste : Lazarus mortuus est:
text_pt: Então Jesus disse-lhes claramente: Lázaro está morto;
text_el: τότε οὖν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς παρρησίᾳ: Λάζαρος ἀπέθανεν,

text_en: And I am glad, for your sakes; that I was not there, that you may believe . But, let us go to him.
text_la: et gaudeo propter vos, ut credatis, quoniam non eram ibi, sed eamus ad eum.
text_pt: E folgo, por amor de vós, de que eu lá não estivesse, para que acrediteis; mas vamos ter com ele.
text_el: καὶ χαίρω δι' ὑμᾶς, ἵνα πιστεύσητε, ὅτι οὐκ ἤμην ἐκεῖ: ἀλλὰ ἄγωμεν πρὸς αὐτόν.

text_en: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples : Let us also go, that we may die with him.
text_la: Dixit ergo Thomas, qui dicitur Didymus, ad condiscipulos : Eamus et nos, ut moriamur cum eo.
text_pt: Disse, pois, Tomé, chamado Dídimo, aos condiscípulos: Vamos nós também, para morrermos com ele.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν Θωμᾶς ὁ λεγόμενος Δίδυμος τοῖς συμμαθηταῖς: ἄγωμεν καὶ ἡμεῖς ἵνα ἀποθάνωμεν μετ' αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Jesus therefore came: and found that he had been four days already in the grave.
text_la: Venit itaque Jesus : et invenit eum quatuor dies jam in monumento habentem.
text_pt: Chegando, pois, Jesus, achou que já havia quatro dias que estava na sepultura.
text_el: Ἐλθὼν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εὗρεν αὐτὸν τέσσαρας ἤδη ἡμέρας ἔχοντα ἐν τῷ μνημείῳ.

text_en: (Now Bethania was near Jerusalem , about fifteen furlongs off.)
text_la: (Erat autem Bethania juxta Jerosolymam quasi stadiis quindecim.)
text_pt: (Ora Betânia distava de Jerusalém quase quinze estádios. )
text_el: ἦν δὲ Βηθανία ἐγγὺς τῶν Ἱεροσολύμων ὡς ἀπὸ σταδίων δεκαπέντε.

text_en: And many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
text_la: Multi autem ex Judæis venerant ad Martham et Mariam, ut consolarentur eas de fratre suo.
text_pt: E muitos dos judeus tinham ido consolar a Marta e a Maria, acerca de seu irmão.
text_el: πολλοὶ δὲ ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἐληλύθεισαν πρὸς τὴν Μάρθαν καὶ Μαριὰμ, ἵνα παραμυθήσωνται αὐτὰς περὶ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ.

text_en: Martha therefore, as soon as she heard that Jesus had come, went to meet him: but Mary sat at home.
text_la: Martha ergo ut audivit quia Jesus venit, occurrit illi : Maria autem domi sedebat.
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, Marta que Jesus vinha, saiu-lhe ao encontro; Maria, porém, ficou assentada em casa.
text_el: ἡ οὖν Μάρθα ὡς ἤκουσεν ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἔρχεται, ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ: Μαριὰμ δὲ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ ἐκαθέζετο.

text_en: Martha therefore said to Jesus : Lord, if you had been here, my brother had not died.
text_la: Dixit ergo Martha ad Jesum : Domine, si fuisses hic, frater meus non fuisset mortuus:
text_pt: Disse, pois, Marta a Jesus: Senhor, se tu estivesses aqui, meu irmão não teria morrido.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν ἡ Μάρθα πρὸς Ἰησοῦν: κύριε, εἰ ἦς ὧδε, οὐκ ἂν ἀπέθανεν ὁ ἀδελφός μου:

text_en: But now also I know that whatsoever you will ask of God , God will give it you.
text_la: sed et nunc scio quia quæcumque poposceris a Deo, dabit tibi Deus.
text_pt: Mas também agora sei que tudo quanto pedires a Deus, Deus to concederá.
text_el: καὶ νῦν οἶδα ὅτι ὅσα ἂν αἰτήσῃ τὸν θεὸν, δώσει σοι ὁ θεός.

text_en: Jesus says to her: Your brother shall rise again.
text_la: Dicit illi Jesus : Resurget frater tuus.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Teu irmão há de ressuscitar.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἀναστήσεται ὁ ἀδελφός σου.

text_en: Martha said to him: I know that he shall rise again, in the resurrection at the last day .
text_la: Dicit ei Martha: Scio quia resurget in resurrectione in novissimo die.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Marta: Eu sei que há de ressuscitar na ressurreição do último dia.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ Μάρθα: οἶδα ὅτι ἀναστήσεται ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ.

text_en: Jesus said to her: I am the resurrection and the life: he that believes in me, although he be dead, shall live:
text_la: Dixit ei Jesus : Ego sum resurrectio et vita : qui credit in me, etiam si mortuus fuerit, vivet:
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Eu sou a ressurreição e a vida; quem crê em mim, ainda que esteja morto, viverá;
text_el: εἶπεν αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἀνάστασις καὶ ἡ ζωή: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ κἂν ἀποθάνῃ ζήσεται,

text_en: And every one that lives and believes in me shall not die for ever. Do you believe this?
text_la: et omnis qui vivit et credit in me, non morietur in æternum. Credis hoc?
text_pt: E todo aquele que vive, e crê em mim, nunca morrerá. Crês tu isto?
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ζῶν καὶ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνῃ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα: πιστεύεις τοῦτο;

text_en: She said to him: Yea, Lord, I have believed that you are Christ , the Son of the living God , who has come into this world.
text_la: Ait illi : Utique Domine, ego credidi quia tu es Christus, Filius Dei vivi, qui in hunc mundum venisti.
text_pt: Disse-lhe ela: Sim, Senhor, creio que tu és o Cristo, o Filho de Deus, que havia de vir ao mundo.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ: ναί, κύριε: ἐγὼ πεπίστευκα ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ὁ εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἐρχόμενος.

text_en: And when she had said these things, she went and called her sister Mary secretly, saying: The master has come and calls for you.
text_la: Et cum hæc dixisset, abiit, et vocavit Mariam sororem suam silentio, dicens : Magister adest, et vocat te.
text_pt: E, dito isto, partiu, e chamou em segredo a Maria, sua irmã, dizendo: O Mestre está cá, e chama-te.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτο εἰποῦσα ἀπῆλθεν καὶ ἐφώνησεν Μαριὰμ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῆς λάθρᾳ εἰποῦσα: ὁ διδάσκαλος πάρεστιν καὶ φωνεῖ σε.

text_en: She, as soon as she heard this, rises quickly and comes to him.
text_la: Illa ut audivit, surgit cito, et venit ad eum;
text_pt: Ela, ouvindo isto, levantou-se logo, e foi ter com ele.
text_el: ἐκείνη δὲ ὡς ἤκουσεν, ἠγέρθη ταχὺ καὶ ἤρχετο πρὸς αὐτόν:

text_en: For Jesus was not yet come into the town: but he was still in that place where Martha had met him.
text_la: nondum enim venerat Jesus in castellum : sed erat adhuc in illo loco, ubi occurrerat ei Martha.
text_pt: (Pois, Jesus ainda não tinha chegado à aldeia, mas estava no lugar onde Marta o encontrara.)
text_el: οὔπω δὲ ἐληλύθει ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν κώμην, ἀλλ' ἦν ἔτι ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ὅπου ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ ἡ Μάρθα.

text_en: The Jews therefore, who were with her in the house and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up speedily and went out, followed her, saying: She goes to the grave to weep there.
text_la: Judæi ergo, qui erant cum ea in domo, et consolabantur eam, cum vidissent Mariam quia cito surrexit, et exiit, secuti sunt eam dicentes : Quia vadit ad monumentum, ut ploret ibi.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, os judeus, que estavam com ela em casa e a consolavam, que Maria apressadamente se levantara e saíra, seguiram-na, dizendo: Vai ao sepulcro para chorar ali.
text_el: οἱ οὖν Ἰουδαῖοι οἱ ὄντες μετ' αὐτῆς ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ καὶ παραμυθούμενοι αὐτήν, ἰδόντες τὴν Μαριὰμ ὅτι ταχέως ἀνέστη καὶ ἐξῆλθεν, ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῇ, δόξαντες ὅτι ὑπάγει εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον ἵνα κλαύσῃ ἐκεῖ.

text_en: When Mary therefore had come where Jesus was, seeing him, she fell down at his feet and says to him. Lord, if you had been here, my brother had not died.
text_la: Maria ergo, cum venisset ubi erat Jesus, videns eum, cecidit ad pedes ejus, et dicit ei : Domine, si fuisses hic, non esset mortuus frater meus.
text_pt: Tendo, pois, Maria chegado aonde Jesus estava, e vendo-o, lançou-se aos seus pés, dizendo-lhe: Senhor, se tu estivesses aqui, meu irmão não teria morrido.
text_el: ἡ οὖν Μαριὰμ ὡς ἦλθεν ὅπου ἦν Ἰησοῦς, ἰδοῦσα αὐτὸν ἔπεσεν αὐτοῦ πρὸς τοὺς πόδας, λέγουσα αὐτῷ: κύριε, εἰ ἦς ὧδε, οὐκ ἄν μου ἀπέθανεν ὁ ἀδελφός.

text_en: Jesus , therefore, when he saw her weeping, and the Jews that had come with her weeping, groaned in the spirit and troubled himself,
text_la: Jesus ergo, ut vidit eam plorantem, et Judæos, qui venerant cum ea, plorantes, infremuit spiritu, et turbavit seipsum,
text_pt: Jesus pois, quando a viu chorar, e também chorando os judeus que com ela vinham, moveu-se muito em espírito, e perturbou-se.
text_el: Ἰησοῦς οὖν ὡς εἶδεν αὐτὴν κλαίουσαν καὶ τοὺς συνελθόντας αὐτῇ Ἰουδαίους κλαίοντας, ἐνεβριμήσατο τῷ πνεύματι καὶ ἐτάραξεν ἑαυτόν,

text_en: and said: Where have you laid him? They say to him: Lord, come and see.
text_la: et dixit : Ubi posuistis eum? Dicunt ei : Domine, veni, et vide.
text_pt: E disse: Onde o pusestes? Disseram-lhe: Senhor, vem, e vê.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν: ποῦ τεθείκατε αὐτόν; λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: κύριε, ἔρχου καὶ ἴδε.

text_en: And Jesus wept.
text_la: Et lacrimatus est Jesus.
text_pt: Jesus chorou.
text_el: ἐδάκρυσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς.

text_en: The Jews therefore said: Behold how he loved him.
text_la: Dixerunt ergo Judæi : Ecce quomodo amabat eum.
text_pt: Disseram, pois, os judeus: Vede como o amava.
text_el: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι: ἴδε πῶς ἐφίλει αὐτόν.

text_en: But some of them said: Could not he that opened the eyes of the man born blind have caused that this man should not die?
text_la: Quidam autem ex ipsis dixerunt : Non poterat hic, qui aperuit oculos cæci nati, facere ut hic non moreretur?
text_pt: E alguns deles disseram: Não podia ele, que abriu os olhos ao cego, fazer também com que este não morresse?
text_el: τινὲς δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶπαν: οὐκ ἐδύνατο οὗτος ὁ ἀνοίξας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τοῦ τυφλοῦ ποιῆσαι ἵνα καὶ οὗτος μὴ ἀποθάνῃ;

text_en: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself, comes to the sepulchre. Now it was a cave; and a stone was laid over it.
text_la: Jesus ergo rursum fremens in semetipso, venit ad monumentum. Erat autem spelunca, et lapis superpositus erat ei.
text_pt: Jesus, pois, movendo-se outra vez muito em si mesmo, veio ao sepulcro; e era uma caverna, e tinha uma pedra posta sobre ela.
text_el: Ἰησοῦς οὖν πάλιν ἐμβριμώμενος ἐν ἑαυτῷ ἔρχεται εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον: ἦν δὲ σπήλαιον, καὶ λίθος ἐπέκειτο ἐπ' αὐτῷ.

text_en: Jesus says: Take away the stone. Martha , the sister of him that was dead, said to him: Lord, by this time he stinks, for he is now of four days.
text_la: Ait Jesus : Tollite lapidem. Dicit ei Martha, soror ejus qui mortuus fuerat : Domine, jam fœtet, quatriduanus est enim.
text_pt: Disse Jesus: Tirai a pedra. Marta, irmã do defunto, disse-lhe: Senhor, já cheira mal, porque é já de quatro dias.
text_el: λέγει ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἄρατε τὸν λίθον. λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ ἀδελφὴ τοῦ τετελευτηκότος Μάρθα: κύριε, ἤδη ὄζει: τεταρταῖος γάρ ἐστιν.

text_en: Jesus says to her: Did not I say to you that if you believe , you shall see the glory of God ?
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Nonne dixi tibi quoniam si credideris, videbis gloriam Dei?
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Não te hei dito que, se creres, verás a glória de Deus?
text_el: λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: οὐκ εἶπόν σοι ὅτι ἐὰν πιστεύσῃς ὄψῃ τὴν δόξαν τοῦ θεοῦ;

text_en: They took therefore the stone away. And Jesus lifting up his eyes, said: Father , I give you thanks that you have heard me.
text_la: Tulerunt ergo lapidem : Jesus autem, elevatis sursum oculis, dixit : Pater, gratias ago tibi quoniam audisti me.
text_pt: Tiraram, pois, a pedra de onde o defunto jazia. E Jesus, levantando os olhos para cima, disse: Pai, graças te dou, por me haveres ouvido.
text_el: ἦραν οὖν τὸν λίθον: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἦρεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἄνω καὶ εἶπεν: πάτερ, εὐχαριστῶ σοι ὅτι ἤκουσάς μου.

text_en: And I knew that you hear me always: but because of the people who stand about have I said it, that they may believe that you have sent me.
text_la: Ego autem sciebam quia semper me audis, sed propter populum qui circumstat, dixi : ut credant quia tu me misisti.
text_pt: Eu bem sei que sempre me ouves, mas eu disse isto por causa da multidão que está em redor, para que creiam que tu me enviaste.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ᾔδειν ὅτι πάντοτέ μου ἀκούεις: ἀλλὰ διὰ τὸν ὄχλον τὸν περιεστῶτα εἶπον, ἵνα πιστεύσωσιν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.

text_en: When he had said these things, he cried with a loud voice: Lazarus , come forth.
text_la: Hæc cum dixisset, voce magna clamavit : Lazare, veni foras.
text_pt: E, tendo dito isto, clamou com grande voz: Lázaro, sai para fora.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα εἰπὼν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἐκραύγασεν: Λάζαρε, δεῦρο ἔξω.

text_en: And presently he that had been dead came forth, bound feet and hands with winding bands. And his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus said to them: Loose him and let him go.
text_la: Et statim prodiit qui fuerat mortuus, ligatus pedes, et manus institis, et facies illius sudario erat ligata. Dixit eis Jesus : Solvite eum et sinite abire.
text_pt: E o defunto saiu, tendo as mãos e os pés ligados com faixas, e o seu rosto envolto num lenço. Disse-lhes Jesus: Desligai-o, e deixai-o ir.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν ὁ τεθνηκὼς δεδεμένος τοὺς πόδας καὶ τὰς χεῖρας κειρίαις, καὶ ἡ ὄψις αὐτοῦ σουδαρίῳ περιεδέδετο. λέγει [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς αὐτοῖς: λύσατε αὐτὸν καὶ ἄφετε αὐτὸν ὑπάγειν.

text_en: Many therefore of the Jews , who had come to Mary and Martha and had seen the things that Jesus did, believed in him.
text_la: Multi ergo ex Judæis, qui venerant ad Mariam, et Martham, et viderant quæ fecit Jesus, crediderunt in eum.
text_pt: Muitos, pois, dentre os judeus que tinham vindo a Maria, e que tinham visto o que Jesus fizera, creram nele.
text_el: Πολλοὶ οὖν ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων, οἱ ἐλθόντες πρὸς τὴν Μαριὰμ καὶ θεασάμενοι ὃ ἐποίησεν, ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν:

text_en: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them the things that Jesus had done.
text_la: Quidam autem ex ipsis abierunt ad pharisæos, et dixerunt eis quæ fecit Jesus.
text_pt: Mas alguns deles foram ter com os fariseus, e disseram-lhes o que Jesus tinha feito.
text_el: τινὲς δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπῆλθον πρὸς τοὺς Φαρισαίους καὶ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς ἃ ἐποίησεν Ἰησοῦς.

text_en: The chief priests , therefore, and the Pharisees gathered a council and said: What do we, for this man does many miracles ?
text_la: Collegerunt ergo pontifices et pharisæi concilium, et dicebant : Quid facimus, quia hic homo multa signa facit?
text_pt: Depois os principais dos sacerdotes e os fariseus formaram conselho, e diziam: Que faremos? porquanto este homem faz muitos sinais.
text_el: Συνήγαγον οὖν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι συνέδριον, καὶ ἔλεγον: τί ποιοῦμεν, ὅτι οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος πολλὰ ποιεῖ σημεῖα;

text_en: If we let him alone so, all will believe in him; and the Romans will come, and take away our place and nation.
text_la: Si dimittimus eum sic, omnes credent in eum, et venient Romani, et tollent nostrum locum, et gentem.
text_pt: Se o deixamos assim, todos crerão nele, e virão os romanos, e tirar-nos-ão o nosso lugar e a nação.
text_el: ἐὰν ἀφῶμεν αὐτὸν οὕτως, πάντες πιστεύσουσιν εἰς αὐτόν, καὶ ἐλεύσονται οἱ Ῥωμαῖοι καὶ ἀροῦσιν ἡμῶν καὶ τὸν τόπον καὶ τὸ ἔθνος.

text_en: But one of them, named Caiphas , being the high priest that year, said to them: You know nothing.
text_la: Unus autem ex ipsis, Caiphas nomine, cum esset pontifex anni illius, dixit eis : Vos nescitis quidquam,
text_pt: E Caifás, um deles que era sumo sacerdote naquele ano, lhes disse: Vós nada sabeis,
text_el: εἷς δέ τις ἐξ αὐτῶν Καϊάφας, ἀρχιερεὺς ὢν τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐκείνου, εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε οὐδέν,

text_en: Neither do you consider that it is expedient for you that one man should die for the people and that the whole nation perish not.
text_la: nec cogitatis quia expedit vobis ut unus moriatur homo pro populo, et non tota gens pereat.
text_pt: Nem considerais que nos convém que um homem morra pelo povo, e que não pereça toda a nação.
text_el: οὐδὲ λογίζεσθε ὅτι συμφέρει ὑμῖν ἵνα εἷς ἄνθρωπος ἀποθάνῃ ὑπὲρ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ μὴ ὅλον τὸ ἔθνος ἀπόληται.

text_en: And this he spoke not of himself: but being the high priest of that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for the nation.
text_la: Hoc autem a semetipso non dixit : sed cum esset pontifex anni illius, prophetavit, quod Jesus moriturus erat pro gente,
text_pt: Ora ele não disse isto de si mesmo, mas, sendo o sumo sacerdote naquele ano, profetizou que Jesus devia morrer pela nação.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ ἀφ' ἑαυτοῦ οὐκ εἶπεν, ἀλλὰ ἀρχιερεὺς ὢν τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐκείνου ἐπροφήτευσεν ὅτι ἔμελλεν Ἰησοῦς ἀποθνῄσκειν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ἔθνους,

text_en: And not only for the nation, but to gather together in one the children of God that were dispersed .
text_la: et non tantum pro gente, sed ut filios Dei, qui erant dispersi, congregaret in unum.
text_pt: E não somente pela nação, mas também para reunir em um corpo os filhos de Deus que andavam dispersos.
text_el: καὶ οὐχ ὑπὲρ τοῦ ἔθνους μόνον, ἀλλ' ἵνα καὶ τὰ τέκνα τοῦ θεοῦ τὰ διεσκορπισμένα συναγάγῃ εἰς ἕν.

text_en: From that day therefore they devised to put him to death.
text_la: Ab illo ergo die cogitaverunt ut interficerent eum.
text_pt: Desde aquele dia, pois, consultavam-se para o matarem.
text_el: ἀπ' ἐκείνης οὖν τῆς ἡμέρας ἐβουλεύσαντο ἵνα ἀποκτείνωσιν αὐτόν.

text_en: Wherefore Jesus walked no more openly among the Jews : but he went into a country near the desert , unto a city that is called Ephrem. And there he abode with his disciples .
text_la: Jesus ergo jam non in palam ambulabat apud Judæos, sed abiit in regionem juxta desertum, in civitatem quæ dicitur Ephrem, et ibi morabatur cum discipulis suis.
text_pt: Jesus, pois, já não andava manifestamente entre os judeus, mas retirou-se dali para a terra junto do deserto, para uma cidade chamada Efraim; e ali ficou com os seus discípulos.
text_el: ὁ οὖν Ἰησοῦς οὐκέτι παρρησίᾳ περιεπάτει ἐν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις, ἀλλὰ ἀπῆλθεν ἐκεῖθεν εἰς τὴν χώραν ἐγγὺς τῆς ἐρήμου, εἰς Ἐφραὶμ λεγομένην πόλιν, κἀκεῖ ἔμεινεν μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν.

text_en: And the pasch of the Jews was at hand: and many from the country went up to Jerusalem , before the pasch , to purify themselves.
text_la: Proximum autem erat Pascha Judæorum, et ascenderunt multi Jerosolymam de regione ante Pascha, ut sanctificarent seipsos.
text_pt: E estava próxima a páscoa dos judeus, e muitos daquela região subiram a Jerusalém antes da páscoa para se purificarem.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ἐγγὺς τὸ πάσχα τῶν Ἰουδαίων, καὶ ἀνέβησαν πολλοὶ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἐκ τῆς χώρας πρὸ τοῦ πάσχα, ἵνα ἁγνίσωσιν ἑαυτούς.

text_en: They sought therefore for Jesus ; and they discoursed one with another, standing in the temple : What think you that he is not come to the festival day?
text_la: Quærebant ergo Jesum, et colloquebantur ad invicem, in templo stantes : Quid putatis, quia non venit ad diem festum?
text_pt: Buscavam, pois, a Jesus, e diziam uns aos outros, estando no templo: Que vos parece? Não virá à festa?
text_el: ἐζήτουν οὖν τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἔλεγον μετ' ἀλλήλων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἑστηκότες: τί δοκεῖ ὑμῖν, ὅτι οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν;

text_en: And the chief priests and Pharisees had given a commandment that, if any man knew where he was, he should tell, that they might apprehend him.
text_la: Dederant autem pontifices et pharisæi mandatum ut si quis cognoverit ubi sit, indicet, ut apprehendant eum.
text_pt: Ora, os principais dos sacerdotes e os fariseus tinham dado ordem para que, se alguém soubesse onde ele estava, o denunciasse, para o prenderem.
text_el: δεδώκεισαν δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ἐντολὰς ἵνα ἐάν τις γνῷ ποῦ ἐστιν μηνύσῃ, ὅπως πιάσωσιν αὐτόν.

text_en: Jesus therefore, six days before the pasch , came to Bethania , where Lazarus had been dead, whom Jesus raised to life.
text_la: Jesus ergo ante sex dies Paschæ venit Bethaniam, ubi Lazarus fuerat mortuus, quem suscitavit Jesus.
text_pt: Foi, pois, Jesus seis dias antes da páscoa a betânia, onde estava Lázaro, o que falecera, e a quem ressuscitara dentre os mortos.
text_el: Ὁ οὖν Ἰησοῦς πρὸ ἓξ ἡμερῶν τοῦ πάσχα ἦλθεν εἰς Βηθανίαν, ὅπου ἦν Λάζαρος, ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν Ἰησοῦς.

text_en: And they made him a supper there: and Martha served. But Lazarus was one of them that were at table with him.
text_la: Fecerunt autem ei cœnam ibi, et Martha ministrabat, Lazarus vero unus erat ex discumbentibus cum eo.
text_pt: Fizeram-lhe, pois, ali uma ceia, e Marta servia, e Lázaro era um dos que estavam à mesa com ele.
text_el: ἐποίησαν οὖν αὐτῷ δεῖπνον ἐκεῖ, καὶ ἡ Μάρθα διηκόνει, ὁ δὲ Λάζαρος εἷς ἦν ἐκ τῶν ἀνακειμένων σὺν αὐτῷ.

text_en: Mary therefore took a pound of ointment of right spikenard, of great price, and anointed the feet of Jesus and wiped his feet with her hair . And the house was filled with the odour of the ointment .
text_la: Maria ergo accepit libram unguenti nardi pistici pretiosi, et unxit pedes Jesu, et extersit pedes ejus capillis suis : et domus impleta est ex odore unguenti.
text_pt: Então Maria, tomando um arrátel de ungüento de nardo puro, de muito preço, ungiu os pés de Jesus, e enxugou-lhe os pés com os seus cabelos; e encheu-se a casa do cheiro do ungüento.
text_el: ἡ οὖν Μαριὰμ λαβοῦσα λίτραν μύρου νάρδου πιστικῆς πολυτίμου ἤλειψεν τοὺς πόδας [τοῦ] Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἐξέμαξεν ταῖς θριξὶν αὐτῆς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ: ἡ δὲ οἰκία ἐπληρώθη ἐκ τῆς ὀσμῆς τοῦ μύρου.

text_en: Then one of his disciples , Judas Iscariot , he that was about to betray him, said:
text_la: Dixit ergo unus ex discipulis ejus, Judas Iscariotes, qui erat eum traditurus:
text_pt: Então, um dos seus discípulos, Judas Iscariotes, filho de Simão, o que havia de traí-lo, disse:
text_el: λέγει [δὲ] Ἰούδας ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης, εἷς τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ, ὁ μέλλων αὐτὸν παραδιδόναι,

text_en: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence and given to the poor?
text_la: Quare hoc unguentum non veniit trecentis denariis, et datum est egenis?
text_pt: Por que não se vendeu este ungüento por trezentos dinheiros e não se deu aos pobres?
text_el: διὰ τί τοῦτο τὸ μύρον οὐκ ἐπράθη τριακοσίων δηναρίων καὶ ἐδόθη πτωχοῖς;

text_en: Now he said this not because he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief and, having the purse, carried the things that were put therein.
text_la: Dixit autem hoc, non quia de egenis pertinebat ad eum, sed quia fur erat, et loculos habens, ea quæ mittebantur, portabat.
text_pt: Ora, ele disse isto, não pelo cuidado que tivesse dos pobres, mas porque era ladrão e tinha a bolsa, e tirava o que ali se lançava.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ τοῦτο οὐχ ὅτι περὶ τῶν πτωχῶν ἔμελεν αὐτῷ ἀλλ' ὅτι κλέπτης ἦν καὶ τὸ γλωσσόκομον ἔχων τὰ βαλλόμενα ἐβάσταζεν.

text_en: Jesus therefore said: Let her alone, that she may keep it against the day of my burial.
text_la: Dixit ergo Jesus: Sinite illam ut in diem sepulturæ meæ servet illud.
text_pt: Disse, pois, Jesus: Deixai-a; para o dia da minha sepultura guardou isto;
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἄφες αὐτήν, ἵνα εἰς τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ ἐνταφιασμοῦ μου τηρήσῃ αὐτό:

text_en: For the poor you have always with you: but me you have not always.
text_la: Pauperes enim semper habetis vobiscum : me autem non semper habetis.
text_pt: Porque os pobres sempre os tendes convosco, mas a mim nem sempre me tendes.
text_el: τοὺς πτωχοὺς γὰρ πάντοτε ἔχετε μεθ' ἑαυτῶν, ἐμὲ δὲ οὐ πάντοτε ἔχετε.

text_en: A great multitude therefore of the Jews knew that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus , whom he had raised from the dead.
text_la: Cognovit ergo turba multa ex Judæis quia illic est, et venerunt, non propter Jesum tantum, sed ut Lazarum viderent, quem suscitavit a mortuis.
text_pt: E muita gente dos judeus soube que ele estava ali; e foram, não só por causa de Jesus, mas também para ver a Lázaro, a quem ressuscitara dentre os mortos.
text_el: Ἔγνω οὖν ὁ ὄχλος πολὺς ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐστιν, καὶ ἦλθον οὐ διὰ τὸν Ἰησοῦν μόνον, ἀλλ' ἵνα καὶ τὸν Λάζαρον ἴδωσιν, ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν.

text_en: But the chief priests thought to kill Lazarus also:
text_la: Cogitaverunt autem principes sacerdotum ut et Lazarum interficerent:
text_pt: E os principais dos sacerdotes tomaram deliberação para matar também a Lázaro;
text_el: ἐβουλεύσαντο δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἵνα καὶ τὸν Λάζαρον ἀποκτείνωσιν,

text_en: Because many of the Jews , by reason of him, went away and believed in Jesus .
text_la: quia multi propter illum abibant ex Judæis, et credebant in Jesum.
text_pt: Porque muitos dos judeus, por causa dele, iam e criam em Jesus.
text_el: ὅτι πολλοὶ δι' αὐτὸν ὑπῆγον τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ ἐπίστευον εἰς τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: And on the next day, a great multitude that had come to the festival day, when they had heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem ,
text_la: In crastinum autem, turba multa quæ venerat ad diem festum, cum audissent quia venit Jesus Jerosolymam,
text_pt: No dia seguinte, ouvindo uma grande multidão, que viera à festa, que Jesus vinha a Jerusalém,
text_el: τῇ ἐπαύριον ὁ ὄχλος πολὺς ὁ ἐλθὼν εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν, ἀκούσαντες ὅτι ἔρχεται Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα,

text_en: took branches of palm trees and went forth to meet him and cried Hosanna . Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord , the king of Israel .
text_la: acceperunt ramos palmarum, et processerunt obviam ei, et clamabant : Hosanna, benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini, rex Israël.
text_pt: Tomaram ramos de palmeiras, e saíram-lhe ao encontro, e clamavam: Hosana! Bendito o Rei de Israel que vem em nome do Senhor.
text_el: ἔλαβον τὰ βαΐα τῶν φοινίκων καὶ ἐξῆλθον εἰς ὑπάντησιν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἐκραύγαζον: ὡσαννά: εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου, καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: And Jesus found a young ass and sat upon it, as it is written:
text_la: Et invenit Jesus asellum, et sedit super eum, sicut scriptum est:
text_pt: E achou Jesus um jumentinho, e assentou-se sobre ele, como está escrito:
text_el: εὑρὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὀνάριον ἐκάθισεν ἐπ' αὐτό, καθώς ἐστιν γεγραμμένον:

text_en: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold your king comes, sitting on an ass' colt.
text_la: Noli timere, filia Sion : ecce rex tuus venit sedens super pullum asinæ.
text_pt: Não temas, ó filha de Sião; eis que o teu Rei vem assentado sobre o filho de uma jumenta.
text_el: μὴ φοβοῦ, θυγάτηρ Σιών: ἰδοὺ ὁ βασιλεύς σου ἔρχεται, καθήμενος ἐπὶ πῶλον ὄνου.

text_en: These things his disciples did not know at the first: but when Jesus was glorified , then they remembered that these things were written of him and that they had done these things to him.
text_la: Hæc non cognoverunt discipuli ejus primum : sed quando glorificatus est Jesus, tunc recordati sunt quia hæc erant scripta de eo, et hæc fecerunt ei.
text_pt: Os seus discípulos, porém, não entenderam isto no princípio; mas, quando Jesus foi glorificado, então se lembraram de que isto estava escrito dele, e que isto lhe fizeram.
text_el: ταῦτα οὐκ ἔγνωσαν αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ τὸ πρῶτον, ἀλλ' ὅτε ἐδοξάσθη Ἰησοῦς τότε ἐμνήσθησαν ὅτι ταῦτα ἦν ἐπ' αὐτῷ γεγραμμένα καὶ ταῦτα ἐποίησαν αὐτῷ.
