text_en: The multitude therefore gave testimony, which was with him, when he called Lazarus out of the grave and raised him from the dead.
text_la: Testimonium ergo perhibebat turba, quæ erat cum eo quando Lazarum vocavit de monumento, et suscitavit eum a mortuis.
text_pt: A multidão, pois, que estava com ele quando Lázaro foi chamado da sepultura, testificava que ele o ressuscitara dentre os mortos.
text_el: ἐμαρτύρει οὖν ὁ ὄχλος ὁ ὢν μετ' αὐτοῦ ὅτε τὸν Λάζαρον ἐφώνησεν ἐκ τοῦ μνημείου καὶ ἤγειρεν αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν.

text_en: For which reason also the people came to meet him, because they heard that he had done this miracle .
text_la: Propterea et obviam venit ei turba : quia audierunt fecisse hoc signum.
text_pt: Por isso a multidão lhe saiu ao encontro, porque tinham ouvido que ele fizera este sinal.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ ὁ ὄχλος, ὅτι ἤκουσαν τοῦτο αὐτὸν πεποιηκέναι τὸ σημεῖον.

text_en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves: Do you see that we prevail nothing? Behold, the whole world has gone after him.
text_la: Pharisæi ergo dixerunt ad semetipsos : Videtis quia nihil proficimus? ecce mundus totus post eum abiit.
text_pt: Disseram, pois, os fariseus entre si: Vedes que nada aproveitais? Eis que toda a gente vai após ele.
text_el: οἱ οὖν Φαρισαῖοι εἶπαν πρὸς ἑαυτούς: θεωρεῖτε ὅτι οὐκ ὠφελεῖτε οὐδέν: ἴδε ὁ κόσμος ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθεν.

text_en: Now there were certain Gentiles among them, who came up to adore on the festival day.
text_la: Erant autem quidam gentiles, ex his qui ascenderant ut adorarent in die festo.
text_pt: Ora, havia alguns gregos, entre os que tinham subido a adorar no dia da festa.
text_el: Ἦσαν δὲ Ἕλληνές τινες ἐκ τῶν ἀναβαινόντων ἵνα προσκυνήσωσιν ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ:

text_en: These therefore came to Philip , who was of Bethsaida of Galilee , and desired him, saying: Sir, we would see Jesus .
text_la: Hi ergo accesserunt ad Philippum, qui erat a Bethsaida Galilææ, et rogabant eum, dicentes : Domine, volumus Jesum videre.
text_pt: Estes, pois, dirigiram-se a Filipe, que era de Betsaida da Galiléia, e rogaram-lhe, dizendo: Senhor, queríamos ver a Jesus.
text_el: οὗτοι οὖν προσῆλθον Φιλίππῳ τῷ ἀπὸ Βηθσαϊδὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, καὶ ἠρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες: κύριε, θέλομεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἰδεῖν.

text_en: Philip comes and tells Andrew . Again Andrew and Philip told Jesus .
text_la: Venit Philippus, et dicit Andreæ; Andreas rursum et Philippus dixerunt Jesu.
text_pt: Filipe foi dizê-lo a André, e então André e Filipe o disseram a Jesus.
text_el: ἔρχεται ὁ Φίλιππος καὶ λέγει τῷ Ἀνδρέᾳ, ἔρχεται Ἀνδρέας καὶ Φίλιππος καὶ λέγουσιν τῷ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: But Jesus answered them, saying: The hour has come that the Son of man should be glorified .
text_la: Jesus autem respondit eis, dicens : Venit hora, ut clarificetur Filius hominis.
text_pt: E Jesus lhes respondeu, dizendo: É chegada a hora em que o Filho do homem há de ser glorificado.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀποκρίνεται αὐτοῖς λέγων: ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

text_en: Amen , amen , I say to you, unless the grain of wheat falling into the ground die,
text_la: Amen, amen dico vobis, nisi granum frumenti cadens in terram, mortuum fuerit,
text_pt: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que, se o grão de trigo, caindo na terra, não morrer, fica ele só; mas se morrer, dá muito fruto.
text_el: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν μὴ ὁ κόκκος τοῦ σίτου πεσὼν εἰς τὴν γῆν ἀποθάνῃ, αὐτὸς μόνος μένει: ἐὰν δὲ ἀποθάνῃ, πολὺν καρπὸν φέρει.

text_en: itself remains alone. But if it die it brings forth much fruit. He that loves his life shall lose it and he that hates his life in this world keeps it unto life eternal .
text_la: ipsum solum manet : si autem mortuum fuerit, multum fructum affert. Qui amat animam suam, perdet eam; et qui odit animam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam æternam custodit eam.
text_pt: Quem ama a sua vida perdê-la-á, e quem neste mundo odeia a sua vida, guardá-la-á para a vida eterna.
text_el: ὁ φιλῶν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἀπολλύει αὐτήν, καὶ ὁ μισῶν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ τούτῳ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον φυλάξει αὐτήν.

text_en: If any man minister to me, let him follow me: and where I am, there also shall my minister be. If any man minister to me, him will my Father honour .
text_la: Si quis mihi ministrat, me sequatur, et ubi sum ego, illic et minister meus erit. Si quis mihi ministraverit, honorificabit eum Pater meus.
text_pt: Se alguém me serve, siga-me, e onde eu estiver, ali estará também o meu servo. E, se alguém me servir, meu Pai o honrará.
text_el: ἐὰν ἐμοί τις διακονῇ, ἐμοὶ ἀκολουθείτω, καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ, ἐκεῖ καὶ ὁ διάκονος ὁ ἐμὸς ἔσται: ἐάν τις ἐμοὶ διακονῇ, τιμήσει αὐτὸν ὁ πατήρ.

text_en: Now is my soul troubled. And what shall I say? Father , save me from this hour. But for this cause I came unto this hour.
text_la: Nunc anima mea turbata est. Et quid dicam? Pater, salvifica me ex hac hora. Sed propterea veni in horam hanc:
text_pt: Agora a minha alma está perturbada; e que direi eu? Pai, salva-me desta hora; mas para isto vim a esta hora.
text_el: νῦν ἡ ψυχή μου τετάρακται, καὶ τί εἴπω; πάτερ, σῶσόν με ἐκ τῆς ὥρας ταύτης; ἀλλὰ διὰ τοῦτο ἦλθον εἰς τὴν ὥραν ταύτην:

text_en: Father , glorify your name . A voice therefore came from heaven : I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.
text_la: Pater, clarifica nomen tuum. Venit ergo vox de cælo : Et clarificavi, et iterum clarificabo.
text_pt: Pai, glorifica o teu nome. Então veio uma voz do céu que dizia: Já o tenho glorificado, e outra vez o glorificarei.
text_el: πάτερ, δόξασόν σου τὸ ὄνομα. ἦλθεν οὖν φωνὴ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ: καὶ ἐδόξασα καὶ πάλιν δοξάσω.

text_en: The multitude therefore that stood and heard said that it thundered. Others said: An angel spoke to him.
text_la: Turba ergo, quæ stabat, et audierat, dicebat tonitruum esse factum. Alii dicebant : Angelus ei locutus est.
text_pt: Ora, a multidão que ali estava, e que a ouvira, dizia que havia sido um trovão. Outros diziam: Um anjo lhe falou.
text_el: ὁ [οὖν] ὄχλος ὁ ἑστὼς καὶ ἀκούσας ἔλεγεν βροντὴν γεγονέναι: ἄλλοι ἔλεγον: ἄγγελος αὐτῷ λελάληκεν.

text_en: Jesus answered and said: This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
text_la: Respondit Jesus, et dixit : Non propter me hæc vox venit, sed propter vos.
text_pt: Respondeu Jesus, e disse: Não veio esta voz por amor de mim, mas por amor de vós.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς: οὐ δι' ἐμὲ ἡ φωνὴ αὕτη γέγονεν ἀλλὰ δι' ὑμᾶς.

text_en: Now is the judgment of the world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
text_la: Nunc judicium est mundi : nunc princeps hujus mundi ejicietur foras.
text_pt: Agora é o juízo deste mundo; agora será expulso o príncipe deste mundo.
text_el: νῦν κρίσις ἐστὶν τοῦ κόσμου τούτου: νῦν ὁ ἄρχων τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἐκβληθήσεται ἔξω,

text_en: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all things to myself.
text_la: Et ego, si exaltatus fuero a terra, omnia traham ad meipsum.
text_pt: E eu, quando for levantado da terra, todos atrairei a mim.
text_el: κἀγὼ ἐὰν ὑψωθῶ ἐκ τῆς γῆς, πάντας ἑλκύσω πρὸς ἐμαυτόν.

text_en: (Now this he said, signifying what death he should die.)
text_la: (Hoc autem dicebat, significans qua morte esset moriturus.)
text_pt: E dizia isto, significando de que morte havia de morrer.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγεν σημαίνων ποίῳ θανάτῳ ἤμελλεν ἀποθνῄσκειν.

text_en: The multitude answered him: We have heard out of the law that Christ abides for ever. And how do you say: The Son of man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of man ?
text_la: Respondit ei turba : Nos audivimus ex lege, quia Christus manet in æternum : et quomodo tu dicis : Oportet exaltari Filium hominis? quis est iste Filius hominis?
text_pt: Respondeu-lhe a multidão: Nós temos ouvido da lei, que o Cristo permanece para sempre; e como dizes tu que convém que o Filho do homem seja levantado? Quem é esse Filho do homem?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ ὄχλος, ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν ἐκ τοῦ νόμου ὅτι ὁ Χριστὸς μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ πῶς λέγεις σὺ ὅτι δεῖ ὑψωθῆναι τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου; τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου;

text_en: Jesus therefore said to them: Yet a little while, the light is among you. Walk whilst you have the light, and the darkness overtake you not. And he that walks in darkness knows not whither be goes.
text_la: Dixit ergo eis Jesus : Adhuc modicum, lumen in vobis est. Ambulate dum lucem habetis, ut non vos tenebræ comprehendant; et qui ambulat in tenebris, nescit quo vadat.
text_pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus: A luz ainda está convosco por um pouco de tempo. Andai enquanto tendes luz, para que as trevas não vos apanhem; pois quem anda nas trevas não sabe para onde vai.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἔτι μικρὸν χρόνον τὸ φῶς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐστιν. περιπατεῖτε ὡς τὸ φῶς ἔχετε, ἵνα μὴ σκοτία ὑμᾶς καταλάβῃ: καὶ ὁ περιπατῶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει.

text_en: Whilst you have the light, believe in the light, that you may be the children of light. These things Jesus spoke: and he went away and hid himself from them.
text_la: Dum lucem habetis, credite in lucem, ut filii lucis sitis. Hæc locutus est Jesus, et abiit et abscondit se ab eis.
text_pt: Enquanto tendes luz, crede na luz, para que sejais filhos da luz. Estas coisas disse Jesus e, retirando-se, escondeu-se deles.
text_el: ὡς τὸ φῶς ἔχετε, πιστεύετε εἰς τὸ φῶς, ἵνα υἱοὶ φωτὸς γένησθε. Ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἀπελθὼν ἐκρύβη ἀπ' αὐτῶν.

text_en: And whereas he had done so many miracles before them, they believed not in him:
text_la: Cum autem tanta signa fecisset coram eis, non credebant in eum;
text_pt: E, ainda que tinha feito tantos sinais diante deles, não criam nele;
text_el: τοσαῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ σημεῖα πεποιηκότος ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπίστευον εἰς αὐτόν,

text_en: That the saying of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he said: Lord, who has believed our hearing? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?
text_la: ut sermo Isaiæ prophetæ impleretur, quem dixit : Domine, quis credidit auditui nostro? et brachium Domini cui revelatum est?
text_pt: Para que se cumprisse a palavra do profeta Isaías, que diz: Senhor, quem creu na nossa pregação? E a quem foi revelado o braço do Senhor?
text_el: ἵνα ὁ λόγος Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου πληρωθῇ, ὃν εἶπεν: κύριε, τίς ἐπίστευσεν τῇ ἀκοῇ ἡμῶν; καὶ ὁ βραχίων κυρίου τίνι ἀπεκαλύφθη;

text_en: Therefore they could not believe , because Isaiah said again:
text_la: Propterea non poterant credere, quia iterum dixit Isaias:
text_pt: Por isso não podiam crer, entào Isaías disse outra vez:
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἠδύναντο πιστεύειν, ὅτι πάλιν εἶπεν Ἠσαΐας:

text_en: He has blinded their eyes and hardened their heart, that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart and be converted : and I should heal them.
text_la: Excæcavit oculos eorum, et induravit cor eorum ut non videant oculis, et non intelligant corde, et convertantur, et sanem eos.
text_pt: Cegou-lhes os olhos, e endureceu-lhes o coração, A fim de que não vejam com os olhos, e compreendam no coração, E se convertam, E eu os cure.
text_el: τετύφλωκεν αὐτῶν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς καὶ ἐπώρωσεν αὐτῶν τὴν καρδίαν, ἵνα μὴ ἴδωσιν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς καὶ νοήσωσιν τῇ καρδίᾳ καὶ στραφῶσιν, καὶ ἰάσομαι αὐτούς.

text_en: These things said Isaiah , when he saw his glory , and spoke of him.
text_la: Hæc dixit Isaias, quando vidit gloriam ejus, et locutus est de eo.
text_pt: Isaías disse isto quando viu a sua glória e falou dele.
text_el: ταῦτα εἶπεν Ἠσαΐας, ὅτι εἶδεν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐλάλησεν περὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: However, many of the chief men also believed in him: but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, that they might not be cast out of the synagogue .
text_la: Verumtamen et ex principibus multi crediderunt in eum : sed propter pharisæos non confitebantur, ut e synagoga non ejicerentur.
text_pt: Apesar de tudo, até muitos dos principais creram nele; mas não o confessavam por causa dos fariseus, para não serem expulsos da sinagoga.
text_el: ὅμως μέντοι καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀρχόντων πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν, ἀλλὰ διὰ τοὺς Φαρισαίους οὐχ ὡμολόγουν, ἵνα μὴ ἀποσυνάγωγοι γένωνται:

text_en: For they loved the glory of men more than the glory of God .
text_la: Dilexerunt enim gloriam hominum magis quam gloriam Dei.
text_pt: Porque amavam mais a glória dos homens do que a glória de Deus.
text_el: ἠγάπησαν γὰρ τὴν δόξαν τῶν ἀνθρώπων μᾶλλον ἤπερ τὴν δόξαν τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: But Jesus cried and said: He that believes in me does not believe in me, but in him that sent me.
text_la: Jesus autem clamavit, et dixit : Qui credit in me, non credit in me, sed in eum qui misit me.
text_pt: E Jesus clamou, e disse: Quem crê em mim, crê, não em mim, mas naquele que me enviou.
text_el: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἔκραξεν καὶ εἶπεν: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ πιστεύει εἰς ἐμὲ ἀλλὰ εἰς τὸν πέμψαντά με,

text_en: And he that sees me, sees him that sent me.
text_la: Et qui videt me, videt eum qui misit me.
text_pt: E quem me vê a mim, vê aquele que me enviou.
text_el: καὶ ὁ θεωρῶν ἐμὲ θεωρεῖ τὸν πέμψαντά με.

text_en: I have come, a light into the world, that whosoever believes in me may not remain in darkness.
text_la: Ego lux in mundum veni, ut omnis qui credit in me, in tenebris non maneat.
text_pt: Eu sou a luz que vim ao mundo, para que todo aquele que crê em mim não permaneça nas trevas.
text_el: ἐγὼ φῶς εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἐλήλυθα, ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ μὴ μείνῃ.

text_en: And if any man hear my words and keep them not, I do not judge him for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
text_la: Et si quis audierit verba mea, et non custodierit, ego non judico eum; non enim veni ut judicem mundum, sed ut salvificem mundum.
text_pt: E se alguém ouvir as minhas palavras, e não crer, eu não o julgo; porque eu vim, não para julgar o mundo, mas para salvar o mundo.
text_el: καὶ ἐάν τίς μου ἀκούσῃ τῶν ῥημάτων καὶ μὴ φυλάξῃ, ἐγὼ οὐ κρίνω αὐτόν: οὐ γὰρ ἦλθον ἵνα κρίνω τὸν κόσμον, ἀλλ' ἵνα σώσω τὸν κόσμον.

text_en: He that despises me and receives not my words has one that judges him. The word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
text_la: Qui spernit me et non accipit verba mea, habet qui judicet eum. Sermo quem locutus sum, ille judicabit eum in novissimo die.
text_pt: Quem me rejeitar a mim, e não receber as minhas palavras, já tem quem o julgue; a palavra que tenho pregado, essa o há de julgar no último dia.
text_el: ὁ ἀθετῶν ἐμὲ καὶ μὴ λαμβάνων τὰ ῥήματά μου ἔχει τὸν κρίνοντα αὐτόν: ὁ λόγος ὃν ἐλάλησα, ἐκεῖνος κρινεῖ αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ:

text_en: For I have not spoken of myself: but the Father who sent me, he gave me commandment what I should say and what I should speak.
text_la: Quia ego ex meipso non sum locutus, sed qui misit me, Pater, ipse mihi mandatum dedit quid dicam et quid loquar.
text_pt: Porque eu não tenho falado de mim mesmo; mas o Pai, que me enviou, ele me deu mandamento sobre o que hei de dizer e sobre o que hei de falar.
text_el: ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐξ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐκ ἐλάλησα, ἀλλ' ὁ πέμψας με πατὴρ αὐτός μοι ἐντολὴν δέδωκεν τί εἴπω καὶ τί λαλήσω.

text_en: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting. The things therefore that I speak, even as the Father said unto me, so do I speak.
text_la: Et scio quia mandatum ejus vita æterna est : quæ ergo ego loquor, sicut dixit mihi Pater, sic loquor.
text_pt: E sei que o seu mandamento é a vida eterna. Portanto, o que eu falo, falo-o como o Pai mo tem dito.
text_el: καὶ οἶδα ὅτι ἡ ἐντολὴ αὐτοῦ ζωὴ αἰώνιός ἐστιν. ἃ οὖν ἐγὼ λαλῶ, καθὼς εἴρηκέν μοι ὁ πατήρ, οὕτως λαλῶ.

text_en: Before the festival day of the pasch , Jesus knowing that his hour had come, that he should pass out of this world to the Father : having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
text_la: Ante diem festum Paschæ, sciens Jesus quia venit hora ejus ut transeat ex hoc mundo ad Patrem : cum dilexisset suos, qui erant in mundo, in finem dilexit eos.
text_pt: Ora, antes da festa da páscoa, sabendo Jesus que já era chegada a sua hora de passar deste mundo para o Pai, como havia amado os seus, que estavam no mundo, amou-os até o fim.
text_el: Πρὸ δὲ τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ πάσχα εἰδὼς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἦλθεν αὐτοῦ ἡ ὥρα ἵνα μεταβῇ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου πρὸς τὸν πατέρα, ἀγαπήσας τοὺς ἰδίους τοὺς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, εἰς τέλος ἠγάπησεν αὐτούς.

text_en: And when supper was done (the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon , to betray him),
text_la: Et cœna facta, cum diabolus jam misisset in cor ut traderet eum Judas Simonis Iscariotæ:
text_pt: E, acabada a ceia, tendo já o diabo posto no coração de Judas Iscariotes, filho de Simão, que o traísse,
text_el: καὶ δείπνου γινομένου, τοῦ διαβόλου ἤδη βεβληκότος εἰς τὴν καρδίαν ἵνα παραδοῖ αὐτὸν Ἰούδας Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτης,

text_en: knowing that the Father had given him all things into his hands and that he came from God and goes to God ,
text_la: sciens quia omnia dedit ei Pater in manus, et quia a Deo exivit, et ad Deum vadit:
text_pt: Jesus, sabendo que o Pai tinha depositado nas suas mãos todas as coisas, e que havia saído de Deus e ia para Deus,
text_el: εἰδὼς ὅτι πάντα ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ πατὴρ εἰς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ ὅτι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθεν καὶ πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ὑπάγει,

text_en: he rose from supper and laid aside his garments and, having taken a towel, girded himself.
text_la: surgit a cœna, et ponit vestimenta sua, et cum accepisset linteum, præcinxit se.
text_pt: Levantou-se da ceia, tirou as vestes, e, tomando uma toalha, cingiu-se.
text_el: ἐγείρεται ἐκ τοῦ δείπνου καὶ τίθησιν τὰ ἱμάτια, καὶ λαβὼν λέντιον διέζωσεν ἑαυτόν:

text_en: After that, he put water into a basin and began to wash the feet of the disciples and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
text_la: Deinde mittit aquam in pelvim, et cœpit lavare pedes discipulorum, et extergere linteo, quo erat præcinctus.
text_pt: Depois deitou água numa bacia, e começou a lavar os pés aos discípulos, e a enxugar-lhos com a toalha com que estava cingido.
text_el: εἶτα βάλλει ὕδωρ εἰς τὸν νιπτῆρα, καὶ ἤρξατο νίπτειν τοὺς πόδας τῶν μαθητῶν καὶ ἐκμάσσειν τῷ λεντίῳ ᾧ ἦν διεζωσμένος.

text_en: He came therefore to Simon Peter . And Peter said to him: Lord, do you wash my feet ?
text_la: Venit ergo ad Simonem Petrum. Et dicit ei Petrus : Domine, tu mihi lavas pedes?
text_pt: Aproximou-se, pois, de Simão Pedro, que lhe disse: Senhor, tu lavas-me os pés a mim?
text_el: ἔρχεται οὖν πρὸς Σίμωνα Πέτρον: λέγει αὐτῷ: κύριε, σύ μου νίπτεις τοὺς πόδας;

text_en: Jesus answered and said to him: What I do, you know not now; but you shall know hereafter.
text_la: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei : Quod ego facio, tu nescis modo : scies autem postea.
text_pt: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhe: O que eu faço não o sabes tu agora, mas tu o saberás depois.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ὃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ σὺ οὐκ οἶδας ἄρτι, γνώσῃ δὲ μετὰ ταῦτα.

text_en: Peter said to him: You shall never wash my feet , Jesus answered him: If I wash you not, you shall have no part with me.
text_la: Dicit ei Petrus : Non lavabis mihi pedes in æternum. Respondit ei Jesus : Si non lavero te, non habebis partem mecum.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Pedro: Nunca me lavarás os pés. Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Se eu te não lavar, não tens parte comigo.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ Πέτρος: οὐ μὴ νίψῃς μου τοὺς πόδας εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς αὐτῷ: ἐὰν μὴ νίψω σε, οὐκ ἔχεις μέρος μετ' ἐμοῦ.

text_en: Simon Peter said to him: Lord, not only my feet, but also my hands and my head.
text_la: Dicit ei Simon Petrus : Domine, non tantum pedes meos, sed et manus, et caput.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Simão Pedro: Senhor, não só os meus pés, mas também as mãos e a cabeça.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος: κύριε, μὴ τοὺς πόδας μου μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τὴν κεφαλήν.

text_en: Jesus said to him: He that is washed needs not but to wash his feet , but is clean wholly. And you are clean, but not all.
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Qui lotus est, non indiget nisi ut pedes lavet, sed est mundus totus. Et vos mundi estis, sed non omnes.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Aquele que está lavado não necessita de lavar senão os pés, pois no mais todo está limpo. Ora vós estais limpos, mas não todos.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς: ὁ λελουμένος οὐκ ἔχει χρείαν [εἰ μὴ τοὺς πόδας] νίψασθαι, ἀλλ' ἔστιν καθαρὸς ὅλος: καὶ ὑμεῖς καθαροί ἐστε, ἀλλ' οὐχὶ πάντες.

text_en: For he knew who he was that would betray him; therefore he said: You are not all clean.
text_la: Sciebat enim quisnam esset qui traderet eum; propterea dixit : Non estis mundi omnes.
text_pt: Porque bem sabia ele quem o havia de trair; por isso disse: Nem todos estais limpos.
text_el: ᾔδει γὰρ τὸν παραδιδόντα αὐτόν: διὰ τοῦτο εἶπεν ὅτι οὐχὶ πάντες καθαροί ἐστε.

text_en: Then after he had washed their feet and taken his garments, being set down again, he said to them: Do you know what I have done to you?
text_la: Postquam ergo lavit pedes eorum, et accepit vestimenta sua, cum recubuisset iterum, dixit eis : Scitis quid fecerim vobis?
text_pt: Depois que lhes lavou os pés, e tomou as suas vestes, e se assentou outra vez à mesa, disse-lhes: Entendeis o que vos tenho feito?
text_el: Ὅτε οὖν ἔνιψεν τοὺς πόδας αὐτῶν καὶ ἔλαβεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνέπεσεν πάλιν, εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: γινώσκετε τί πεποίηκα ὑμῖν;

text_en: You call me Master and Lord. And you say well: for so I am.
text_la: Vos vocatis me Magister et Domine, et bene dicitis : sum etenim.
text_pt: Vós me chamais Mestre e Senhor, e dizeis bem, porque eu o sou.
text_el: ὑμεῖς φωνεῖτέ με: ὁ διδάσκαλος καὶ ὁ κύριος, καὶ καλῶς λέγετε: εἰμὶ γάρ.

text_en: If then I being your Lord and Master, have washed your feet ; you also ought to wash one another's feet.
text_la: Si ergo ego lavi pedes vestros, Dominus et Magister, et vos debetis alter alterius lavare pedes.
text_pt: Ora, se eu, Senhor e Mestre, vos lavei os pés, vós deveis também lavar os pés uns aos outros.
text_el: εἰ οὖν ἐγὼ ἔνιψα ὑμῶν τοὺς πόδας ὁ κύριος καὶ ὁ διδάσκαλος, καὶ ὑμεῖς ὀφείλετε ἀλλήλων νίπτειν τοὺς πόδας:

text_en: For I have given you an example, that as I have done to you, so you do also.
text_la: Exemplum enim dedi vobis, ut quemadmodum ego feci vobis, ita et vos faciatis.
text_pt: Porque eu vos dei o exemplo, para que, como eu vos fiz, façais vós também.
text_el: ὑπόδειγμα γὰρ ἔδωκα ὑμῖν, ἵνα καθὼς ἐγὼ ἐποίησα ὑμῖν καὶ ὑμεῖς ποιῆτε.

text_en: Amen , amen , I say to you: The servant is not greater than his lord: neither is the apostle greater than he that sent him.
text_la: Amen, amen dico vobis : non est servus major domino suo : neque apostolus major est eo qui misit illum.
text_pt: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que não é o servo maior do que o seu senhor, nem o enviado maior do que aquele que o enviou.
text_el: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐκ ἔστιν δοῦλος μείζων τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἀπόστολος μείζων τοῦ πέμψαντος αὐτόν.

text_en: If you know these things, you shall be blessed if you do them.
text_la: Si hæc scitis, beati eritis si feceritis ea.
text_pt: Se sabeis estas coisas, bem-aventurados sois se as fizerdes.
text_el: εἰ ταῦτα οἴδατε, μακάριοί ἐστε ἐὰν ποιῆτε αὐτά.

text_en: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen. But that the scripture may be fulfilled: He that eats bread with me shall lift up his heel against me,
text_la: Non de omnibus vobis dico : ego scio quos elegerim; sed ut adimpleatur Scriptura : Qui manducat mecum panem, levabit contra me calcaneum suum.
text_pt: Não falo de todos vós; eu bem sei os que tenho escolhido; mas para que se cumpra a Escritura: O que come o pão comigo, levantou contra mim o seu calcanhar.
text_el: οὐ περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν λέγω: ἐγὼ οἶδα τίνας ἐξελεξάμην: ἀλλ' ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ: Ὁ τρώγων μου τὸν ἄρτον ἐπῆρεν ἐπ' ἐμὲ τὴν πτέρναν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: at present I tell you, before it come to pass: that when it shall come to pass, you may believe that I am he.
text_la: Amodo dico vobis, priusquam fiat : ut cum factum fuerit, credatis quia ego sum.
text_pt: Desde agora vo-lo digo, antes que aconteça, para que, quando acontecer, acrediteis que eu sou.
text_el: ἀπ' ἄρτι λέγω ὑμῖν πρὸ τοῦ γενέσθαι, ἵνα πιστεύητε ὅταν γένηται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι.

text_en: Amen , amen , I say to you, he that receives whomsoever I send receives me: and he that receives me receives him that sent me.
text_la: Amen, amen dico vobis : qui accipit si quem misero, me accipit; qui autem me accipit, accipit eum qui me misit.
text_pt: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo: Se alguém receber o que eu enviar, me recebe a mim, e quem me recebe a mim, recebe aquele que me enviou.
text_el: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ λαμβάνων ἄν τινα πέμψω ἐμὲ λαμβάνει, ὁ δὲ ἐμὲ λαμβάνων λαμβάνει τὸν πέμψαντά με.

text_en: When Jesus had said these things, he was troubled in spirit; and he testified, and said: Amen , amen , I say to you, one of you shall betray me.
text_la: Cum hæc dixisset Jesus, turbatus est spiritu : et protestatus est, et dixit : Amen, amen dico vobis, quia unus ex vobis tradet me.
text_pt: Tendo Jesus dito isto, turbou-se em espírito, e afirmou, dizendo: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que um de vós me há de trair.
text_el: Ταῦτα εἰπὼν Ἰησοῦς ἐταράχθη τῷ πνεύματι καὶ ἐμαρτύρησεν καὶ εἶπεν: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με.

text_en: The disciples therefore looked one upon another, doubting of whom he spoke.
text_la: Aspiciebant ergo ad invicem discipuli, hæsitantes de quo diceret.
text_pt: Então os discípulos olhavam uns para os outros, duvidando de quem ele falava.
text_el: ἔβλεπον εἰς ἀλλήλους οἱ μαθηταὶ, ἀπορούμενοι περὶ τίνος λέγει.

text_en: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples , whom Jesus loved .
text_la: Erat ergo recumbens unus ex discipulis ejus in sinu Jesu, quem diligebat Jesus.
text_pt: Ora, um de seus discípulos, aquele a quem Jesus amava, estava reclinado no seio de Jesus.
text_el: ἦν ἀνακείμενος εἷς ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ὃν ἠγάπα [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς:

text_en: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him and said to him: Who is it of whom he speaks?
text_la: Innuit ergo huic Simon Petrus, et dixit ei : Quis est, de quo dicit?
text_pt: Então Simão Pedro fez sinal a este, para que perguntasse quem era aquele de quem ele falava.
text_el: νεύει οὖν τούτῳ Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ εἰπὲ τίς ἐστιν περὶ οὗ λέγει.

text_en: He therefore, leaning on the breast of Jesus , said to him: Lord, who is it?
text_la: Itaque cum recubuisset ille supra pectus Jesu, dicit ei : Domine, quis est?
text_pt: E, inclinando-se ele sobre o peito de Jesus, disse-lhe: Senhor, quem é?
text_el: ἀναπεσὼν ἐκεῖνος οὕτως ἐπὶ τὸ στῆθος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ λέγει αὐτῷ: κύριε, τίς ἐστιν;

text_en: Jesus answered: He it is to whom I shall reach bread dipped. And when he had dipped the bread, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon .
text_la: Respondit Jesus : Ille est cui ego intinctum panem porrexero. Et cum intinxisset panem, dedit Judæ Simonis Iscariotæ.
text_pt: Jesus respondeu: É aquele a quem eu der o bocado molhado. E, molhando o bocado, o deu a Judas Iscariotes, filho de Simão.
text_el: ἀποκρίνεται οὖν [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς, ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ᾧ ἐγὼ βάψω τὸ ψωμίον καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ. βάψας οὖν [τὸ] ψωμίον λαμβάνει καὶ δίδωσιν Ἰούδᾳ Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτου.

text_en: And after the morsel, Satan entered into him . And Jesus said to him: That which you do, do quickly.
text_la: Et post buccellam, introivit in eum Satanas. Et dixit ei Jesus : Quod facis, fac citius.
text_pt: E, após o bocado, entrou nele Satanás. Disse, pois, Jesus: O que fazes, faze-o depressa.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τὸ ψωμίον, τότε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς ἐκεῖνον ὁ Σατανᾶς. λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς: ὃ ποιεῖς ποίησον τάχιον.

text_en: Now no man at the table knew to what purpose he said this unto him.
text_la: Hoc autem nemo scivit discumbentium ad quid dixerit ei.
text_pt: E nenhum dos que estavam assentados à mesa compreendeu a que propósito lhe dissera isto.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ οὐδεὶς ἔγνω τῶν ἀνακειμένων πρὸς τί εἶπεν αὐτῷ:

text_en: For some thought, because Judas had the purse, that Jesus had said to him: Buy those things which we have need of for the festival day : or that he should give something to the poor.
text_la: Quidam enim putabant, quia loculos habebat Judas, quod dixisset ei Jesus : Eme ea quæ opus sunt nobis ad diem festum : aut egenis ut aliquid daret.
text_pt: Porque, como Judas tinha a bolsa, pensavam alguns que Jesus lhe tinha dito: Compra o que nos é necessário para a festa; ou que desse alguma coisa aos pobres.
text_el: τινὲς γὰρ ἐδόκουν, ἐπεὶ τὸ γλωσσόκομον εἶχεν Ἰούδας, ὅτι λέγει αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς, ἀγόρασον ὧν χρείαν ἔχομεν εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν, ἢ τοῖς πτωχοῖς ἵνα τι δῷ.

text_en: He therefore, having received the morsel, went out immediately. And it was night.
text_la: Cum ergo accepisset ille buccellam, exivit continuo. Erat autem nox.
text_pt: E, tendo Judas tomado o bocado, saiu logo. E era já noite.
text_el: λαβὼν οὖν τὸ ψωμίον ἐκεῖνος ἐξῆλθεν εὐθύς: ἦν δὲ νύξ.

text_en: When he therefore had gone out, Jesus said: Now is the Son of man glorified ; and God is glorified in him.
text_la: Cum ergo exisset, dixit Jesus : Nunc clarificatus est Filius hominis, et Deus clarificatus est in eo.
text_pt: Tendo ele, pois, saído, disse Jesus: Agora é glorificado o Filho do homem, e Deus é glorificado nele.
text_el: Ὅτε οὖν ἐξῆλθεν λέγει Ἰησοῦς: νῦν ἐδοξάσθη ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐδοξάσθη ἐν αὐτῷ.

text_en: If God be glorified in him, God also will glorify him in himself: and immediately will he glorify him.
text_la: Si Deus clarificatus est in eo, et Deus clarificabit eum in semetipso : et continuo clarificabit eum.
text_pt: Se Deus é glorificado nele, também Deus o glorificará em si mesmo, e logo o há de glorificar.
text_el: Καὶ ὁ θεὸς δοξάσει αὐτὸν ἐν αὐτῷ, καὶ εὐθὺς δοξάσει αὐτόν.

text_en: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. You shall seek me. And as I said to the Jews : Where I go you cannot come; so I say to you now.
text_la: Filioli, adhuc modicum vobiscum sum. Quæretis me; et sicut dixi Judæis, quo ego vado, vos non potestis venire : et vobis dico modo.
text_pt: Filhinhos, ainda por um pouco estou convosco. Vós me buscareis, mas, como tenho dito aos judeus: Para onde eu vou não podeis vós ir; eu vo-lo digo também agora.
text_el: τεκνία, ἔτι μικρὸν μεθ' ὑμῶν εἰμι: ζητήσετέ με, καὶ καθὼς εἶπον τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν, καὶ ὑμῖν λέγω ἄρτι.

text_en: A new commandment I give unto you: That you love one another, as I have loved you, that you also love one another.
text_la: Mandatum novum do vobis : ut diligatis invicem : sicut dilexi vos, ut et vos diligatis invicem.
text_pt: Um novo mandamento vos dou: Que vos ameis uns aos outros; como eu vos amei a vós, que também vós uns aos outros vos ameis.
text_el: ἐντολὴν καινὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν, ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους: καθὼς ἠγάπησα ὑμᾶς ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους.

text_en: By this shall all men know that you are my disciples , if you have love one for another.
text_la: In hoc cognoscent omnes quia discipuli mei estis, si dilectionem habueritis ad invicem.
text_pt: Nisto todos conhecerão que sois meus discípulos, se vos amardes uns aos outros.
text_el: ἐν τούτῳ γνώσονται πάντες ὅτι ἐμοὶ μαθηταί ἐστε, ἐὰν ἀγάπην ἔχητε ἐν ἀλλήλοις.

text_en: Simon Peter said to him: Lord, where are you going? Jesus answered: Where I go, you can not follow me now: but you shall follow hereafter.
text_la: Dicit ei Simon Petrus : Domine, quo vadis? Respondit Jesus : Quo ego vado non potes me modo sequi : sequeris autem postea.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Simão Pedro: Senhor, para onde vais? Jesus lhe respondeu: Para onde eu vou não podes agora seguir-me, mas depois me seguirás.
text_el: Λέγει αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος: κύριε, ποῦ ὑπάγεις; ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς ὅπου ὑπάγω οὐ δύνασαί μοι νῦν ἀκολουθῆσαι, ἀκολουθήσεις δὲ ὕστερον.

text_en: Peter said to him: Why cannot I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.
text_la: Dicit ei Petrus : Quare non possum te sequi modo? animam meam pro te ponam.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Pedro: Por que não posso seguir-te agora? Por ti darei a minha vida.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ [ὁ] Πέτρος: κύριε, διὰ τί οὐ δύναμαί σοι ἀκολουθεῖν ἄρτι; τὴν ψυχήν μου ὑπὲρ σοῦ θήσω.

text_en: Jesus answered him: Will you lay down your life for me? Amen , amen , I say to you, the cock shall not crow, till you deny me thrice.
text_la: Respondit ei Jesus : Animam tuam pro me pones? amen, amen dico tibi : non cantabit gallus, donec ter me neges.
text_pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Tu darás a tua vida por mim? Na verdade, na verdade te digo que não cantará o galo enquanto não me tiveres negado três vezes.
text_el: ἀποκρίνεται Ἰησοῦς: τὴν ψυχήν σου ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ θήσεις; ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, οὐ μὴ ἀλέκτωρ φωνήσῃ ἕως οὗ ἀρνήσῃ με τρίς.

text_en: Let not your heart be troubled. You believe in God : believe also in me.
text_la: Non turbetur cor vestrum. Creditis in Deum, et in me credite.
text_pt: Não se turbe o vosso coração; credes em Deus, crede também em mim.
text_el: Μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία: πιστεύετε εἰς τὸν θεόν, καὶ εἰς ἐμὲ πιστεύετε.

text_en: In my Father's house there are many mansions. If not, I would have told you: because I go to prepare a place for you.
text_la: In domo Patris mei mansiones multæ sunt; si quominus dixissem vobis : quia vado parare vobis locum.
text_pt: Na casa de meu Pai há muitas moradas; se não fosse assim, eu vo-lo teria dito. Vou preparar-vos lugar.
text_el: ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ τοῦ πατρός μου μοναὶ πολλαί εἰσιν: εἰ δὲ μή, εἶπον ἂν ὑμῖν: ὅτι πορεύομαι ἑτοιμάσαι τόπον ὑμῖν:

text_en: And if I shall go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will take you to myself: that where I am, you also may be.
text_la: Et si abiero, et præparavero vobis locum, iterum venio, et accipiam vos ad meipsum : ut ubi sum ego, et vos sitis.
text_pt: E quando eu for, e vos preparar lugar, virei outra vez, e vos levarei para mim mesmo, para que onde eu estiver estejais vós também.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν πορευθῶ καὶ ἑτοιμάσω τόπον ὑμῖν, πάλιν ἔρχομαι καὶ παραλήμψομαι ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἐμαυτόν, ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἦτε.

text_en: And whither I go you know : and the way you know .
text_la: Et quo ego vado scitis, et viam scitis.
text_pt: Mesmo vós sabeis para onde vou, e conheceis o caminho.
text_el: καὶ ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω οἴδατε τὴν ὁδόν.

text_en: Thomas said to him: Lord, we know not whither you go. And how can we know the way?
text_la: Dicit ei Thomas : Domine, nescimus quo vadis : et quomodo possumus viam scire?
text_pt: Disse-lhe Tomé: Senhor, nós não sabemos para onde vais; e como podemos saber o caminho?
text_el: Λέγει αὐτῷ Θωμᾶς: κύριε, οὐκ οἴδαμεν ποῦ ὑπάγεις, πῶς οἴδαμεν τὴν ὁδὸν;

text_en: Jesus said to him: I am the way, and the truth , and the life. No man comes to the Father , but by me.
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Ego sum via, et veritas, et vita. Nemo venit ad Patrem, nisi per me.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Eu sou o caminho, e a verdade e a vida; ninguém vem ao Pai, senão por mim.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς: ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ὁδὸς καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια καὶ ἡ ζωή: οὐδεὶς ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸν πατέρα εἰ μὴ δι' ἐμοῦ.

text_en: If you had known me, you would without doubt have known my Father also: and from henceforth you shall know him. And you have seen him.
text_la: Si cognovissetis me, et Patrem meum utique cognovissetis : et amodo cognoscetis eum, et vidistis eum.
text_pt: Se vós me conhecêsseis a mim, também conheceríeis a meu Pai; e já desde agora o conheceis, e o tendes visto.
text_el: εἰ ἐγνώκειτέ με, καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου ἂν ᾔδειτε{punk:} ἀπ' ἄρτι γινώσκετε αὐτὸν καὶ ἑωράκατε.

text_en: Philip said to him: Lord, show us the Father ; and it is enough for us.
text_la: Dicit ei Philippus : Domine, ostende nobis Patrem, et sufficit nobis.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Filipe: Senhor, mostra-nos o Pai, o que nos basta.
text_el: Λέγει αὐτῷ Φίλιππος: κύριε, δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν πατέρα, καὶ ἀρκεῖ ἡμῖν.

text_en: Jesus said to him: Have I been so long a time with you and have you not known me? Philip , he that sees me sees the Father also. How do you say: Show us the Father ?
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Tanto tempore vobiscum sum, et non cognovistis me? Philippe, qui videt me, videt et Patrem. Quomodo tu dicis : Ostende nobis Patrem?
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Estou há tanto tempo convosco, e não me tendes conhecido, Filipe? Quem me vê a mim vê o Pai; e como dizes tu: Mostra-nos o Pai?
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: τοσοῦτον χρόνον μεθ' ὑμῶν εἰμι, καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωκάς με, Φίλιππε; ὁ ἑωρακὼς ἐμὲ ἑώρακεν τὸν πατέρα: πῶς σὺ λέγεις: δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν πατέρα;

text_en: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father in me? The words that I speak to you, I speak not of myself. But the Father who abides in me, he does the works.
text_la: Non creditis quia ego in Patre, et Pater in me est? Verba quæ ego loquor vobis, a meipso non loquor. Pater autem in me manens, ipse fecit opera.
text_pt: Não crês tu que eu estou no Pai, e que o Pai está em mim? As palavras que eu vos digo não as digo de mim mesmo, mas o Pai, que está em mim, é quem faz as obras.
text_el: οὐ πιστεύεις ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρὶ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί ἐστιν; τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπ' ἐμαυτοῦ οὐ λαλῶ: ὁ δὲ πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοὶ μένων ποιεῖ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Believe you not that I am in the Father and the Father in me?
text_la: Non creditis quia ego in Patre, et Pater in me est?
text_pt: Crede-me que estou no Pai, e o Pai em mim; crede-me, ao menos, por causa das mesmas obras.
text_el: πιστεύετέ μοι ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρὶ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί: εἰ δὲ μή, διὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτὰ πιστεύετε.

text_en: Otherwise believe for the very works' sake. Amen , amen , I say to you, he that believes in me, the works that I do, he also shall do: and greater than these shall he do.
text_la: alioquin propter opera ipsa credite. Amen, amen dico vobis, qui credit in me, opera quæ ego facio, et ipse faciet, et majora horum faciet : quia ego ad Patrem vado.
text_pt: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que aquele que crê em mim também fará as obras que eu faço, e as fará maiores do que estas, porque eu vou para meu Pai.
text_el: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ, τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ κἀκεῖνος ποιήσει, καὶ μείζονα τούτων ποιήσει: ὅτι ἐγὼ πρὸς τὸν πατέρα πορεύομαι:

text_en: Because I go to the Father : and whatsoever you shall ask the Father in my name , that will I do: that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
text_la: Et quodcumque petieritis Patrem in nomine meo, hoc faciam : ut glorificetur Pater in Filio.
text_pt: E tudo quanto pedirdes em meu nome eu o farei, para que o Pai seja glorificado no Filho.
text_el: καὶ ὅ τι ἂν αἰτήσητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου τοῦτο ποιήσω, ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ πατὴρ ἐν τῷ υἱῷ:

text_en: If you shall ask me anything in my name , that I will do.
text_la: Si quid petieritis me in nomine meo, hoc faciam.
text_pt: Se pedirdes alguma coisa em meu nome, eu o farei.
text_el: ἐάν τι αἰτήσητέ [με] ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου τοῦτο ποιήσω.

text_en: If you love me, keep my commandments.
text_la: Si diligitis me, mandata mea servate:
text_pt: Se me amais, guardai os meus mandamentos.
text_el: Ἐὰν ἀγαπᾶτέ με, τὰς ἐντολὰς τὰς ἐμὰς τηρήσετε:

text_en: And I will ask the Father : and he shall give you another Paraclete , that he may abide with you for ever:
text_la: et ego rogabo Patrem, et alium Paraclitum dabit vobis, ut maneat vobiscum in æternum,
text_pt: E eu rogarei ao Pai, e ele vos dará outro Consolador, para que fique convosco para sempre;
text_el: κἀγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν πατέρα καὶ ἄλλον παράκλητον δώσει ὑμῖν, ἵνα ᾖμεθ' ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα,

text_en: The spirit of truth , whom the world cannot receive, because it sees him not, nor knows him. But you shall know him; because he shall abide with you and shall be in you.
text_la: Spiritum veritatis, quem mundus non potest accipere, quia non videt eum, nec scit eum : vos autem cognoscetis eum, quia apud vos manebit, et in vobis erit.
text_pt: O Espírito de verdade, que o mundo não pode receber, porque não o vê nem o conhece; mas vós o conheceis, porque habita convosco, e estará em vós.
text_el: τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας, ὃ ὁ κόσμος οὐ δύναται λαβεῖν, ὅτι οὐ θεωρεῖ αὐτὸ οὐδὲ γινώσκει: ὑμεῖς γινώσκετε αὐτό, ὅτι παρ' ὑμῖν μένει καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ἐστίν.

text_en: I will not leave you orphans: I will come to you.
text_la: Non relinquam vos orphanos : veniam ad vos.
text_pt: Não vos deixarei órfãos; voltarei para vós.
text_el: οὐκ ἀφήσω ὑμᾶς ὀρφανούς, ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς.

text_en: Yet a little while and the world sees me no more. But you see me: because I live, and you shall live.
text_la: Adhuc modicum, et mundus me jam non videt. Vos autem videtis me : quia ego vivo, et vos vivetis.
text_pt: Ainda um pouco, e o mundo não me verá mais, mas vós me vereis; porque eu vivo, e vós vivereis.
text_el: ἔτι μικρὸν καὶ ὁ κόσμος με οὐκέτι θεωρεῖ: ὑμεῖς δὲ θεωρεῖτέ με, ὅτι ἐγὼ ζῶ καὶ ὑμεῖς ζήσετε.

text_en: In that day you shall know that I am in my Father : and you in me, and I in you.
text_la: In illo die vos cognoscetis quia ego sum in Patre meo, et vos in me, et ego in vobis.
text_pt: Naquele dia conhecereis que estou em meu Pai, e vós em mim, e eu em vós.
text_el: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὑμεῖς γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρί μου καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν.

text_en: He that has my commandments and keeps them; he it is that loves me. And he that loves me shall be loved of my Father : and I will love him and will manifest myself to him.
text_la: Qui habet mandata mea, et servat ea : ille est qui diligit me. Qui autem diligit me, diligetur a Patre meo : et ego diligam eum, et manifestabo ei meipsum.
text_pt: Aquele que tem os meus mandamentos e os guarda esse é o que me ama; e aquele que me ama será amado de meu Pai, e eu o amarei, e me manifestarei a ele.
text_el: ὁ ἔχων τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τηρῶν αὐτὰς, ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαπῶν με: ὁ δὲ ἀγαπῶν με ἀγαπηθήσεται ὑπὸ τοῦ πατρός μου, κἀγὼ ἀγαπήσω αὐτὸν καὶ ἐμφανίσω αὐτῷ ἐμαυτόν.

text_en: Judas says to him, not the Iscariot : Lord, how is it that you will manifest yourself to us, and not to the world?
text_la: Dicit ei Judas, non ille Iscariotes : Domine, quid factum est, quia manifestaturus es nobis teipsum, et non mundo?
text_pt: Disse-lhe Judas (não o Iscariotes): Senhor, de onde vem que te hás de manifestar a nós, e não ao mundo?
text_el: Λέγει αὐτῷ Ἰούδας, οὐχ ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης: κύριε, τί γέγονεν ὅτι ἡμῖν μέλλεις ἐμφανίζειν σεαυτὸν καὶ οὐχὶ τῷ κόσμῳ;

text_en: Jesus answered and said to him: If any one love me, he will keep my word. And my Father will love him and we will come to him and will make our abode with him.
text_la: Respondit Jesus, et dixit ei : Si quis diligit me, sermonem meum servabit, et Pater meus diliget eum, et ad eum veniemus, et mansionem apud eum faciemus;
text_pt: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Se alguém me ama, guardará a minha palavra, e meu Pai o amará, e viremos para ele, e faremos nele morada.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ με, τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσει, καὶ ὁ πατήρ μου ἀγαπήσει αὐτόν, καὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐλευσόμεθα καὶ μονὴν παρ' αὐτῷ ποιησόμεθα.

text_en: He that loves me not keeps not my words. And the word which you have heard is not mine; but the Father's who sent me.
text_la: qui non diligit me, sermones meos non servat. Et sermonem, quem audistis, non est meus : sed ejus qui misit me, Patris.
text_pt: Quem não me ama não guarda as minhas palavras; ora, a palavra que ouvistes não é minha, mas do Pai que me enviou.
text_el: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν με τοὺς λόγους μου οὐ τηρεῖ: καὶ ὁ λόγος ὃν ἀκούετε οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὸς ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με πατρός.

text_en: These things have I spoken to you, abiding with you.
text_la: Hæc locutus sum vobis apud vos manens.
text_pt: Tenho-vos dito isto, estando convosco.
text_el: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν παρ' ὑμῖν μένων:

text_en: But the Paraclete , the Holy Ghost , whom the Father will send in my name , he will teach you all things and bring all things to your mind, whatsoever I shall have said to you.
text_la: Paraclitus autem Spiritus Sanctus, quem mittet Pater in nomine meo, ille vos docebit omnia, et suggeret vobis omnia quæcumque dixero vobis.
text_pt: Mas aquele Consolador, o Espírito Santo, que o Pai enviará em meu nome, esse vos ensinará todas as coisas, e vos fará lembrar de tudo quanto vos tenho dito.
text_el: ὁ δὲ παράκλητος, τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ὃ πέμψει ὁ πατὴρ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐκεῖνος ὑμᾶς διδάξει πάντα καὶ ὑπομνήσει ὑμᾶς πάντα ἃ εἶπον ὑμῖν. ἐγώ

text_en: Peace I leave with you: my peace I give unto you: not as the world gives, do I give unto you. Let not your heart be troubled: nor let it be afraid.
text_la: Pacem relinquo vobis, pacem meam do vobis : non quomodo mundus dat, ego do vobis. Non turbetur cor vestrum, neque formidet.
text_pt: Deixo-vos a paz, a minha paz vos dou; não vo-la dou como o mundo a dá. Não se turbe o vosso coração, nem se atemorize.
text_el: εἰρήνην ἀφίημι ὑμῖν, εἰρήνην τὴν ἐμὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν: οὐ καθὼς ὁ κόσμος δίδωσιν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν. μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία μηδὲ δειλιάτω.

text_en: You have heard that I said to you: I go away, and I come unto you. If you loved me you would indeed be glad, because I go to the Father : for the Father is greater than I.
text_la: Audistis quia ego dixi vobis : Vado, et venio ad vos. Si diligeretis me, gauderetis utique, quia vado ad Patrem : quia Pater major me est.
text_pt: Ouvistes que eu vos disse: Vou, e venho para vós. Se me amásseis, certamente exultaríeis porque eu disse: Vou para o Pai; porque meu Pai é maior do que eu.
text_el: ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν: ὑπάγω καὶ ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς. εἰ ἠγαπᾶτέ με ἐχάρητε ἄν, ὅτι πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα, ὅτι ὁ πατὴρ μείζων μού ἐστιν.

text_en: And now I have told you before it come to pass: that when it shall come to pass, you may believe .
text_la: Et nunc dixi vobis priusquam fiat : ut cum factum fuerit, credatis.
text_pt: Eu vo-lo disse agora antes que aconteça, para que, quando acontecer, vós acrediteis.
text_el: καὶ νῦν εἴρηκα ὑμῖν πρὶν γενέσθαι, ἵνα ὅταν γένηται πιστεύσητε.

text_en: I will not now speak many things with you. For the prince of this world comes: and in me he has not anything.
text_la: Jam non multa loquar vobiscum : venit enim princeps mundi hujus, et in me non habet quidquam.
text_pt: Já não falarei muito convosco, porque se aproxima o príncipe deste mundo, e nada tem em mim;
text_el: οὐκέτι πολλὰ λαλήσω μεθ' ὑμῶν: ἔρχεται γὰρ ὁ τοῦ κόσμου ἄρχων, καὶ ἐν ἐμοὶ οὐκ ἔχει οὐδέν,

text_en: But that the world may know that I love the Father : and as the Father has given me commandments, so do I. Arise, let us go hence.
text_la: Sed ut cognoscat mundus quia diligo Patrem, et sicut mandatum dedit mihi Pater, sic facio. Surgite, eamus hinc.
text_pt: Mas é para que o mundo saiba que eu amo o Pai, e que faço como o Pai me mandou. Levantai-vos, vamo-nos daqui.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἵνα γνῷ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι ἀγαπῶ τὸν πατέρα, καὶ καθὼς ἐντολὴν ἔδωκέν μοι ὁ πατήρ, οὕτως ποιῶ. ἐγείρεσθε, ἄγωμεν ἐντεῦθεν.

text_en: I am the true vine: and my Father is the husbandman.
text_la: Ego sum vitis vera, et Pater meus agricola est.
text_pt: Eu sou a videira verdadeira, e meu Pai é o lavrador.
text_el: Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἄμπελος ἡ ἀληθινή, καὶ ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ γεωργός ἐστιν.

text_en: Every branch in me that bears not fruit, he will take away: and every one that bears fruit, he will purge it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
text_la: Omnem palmitem in me non ferentem fructum, tollet eum, et omnem qui fert fructum, purgabit eum, ut fructum plus afferat.
text_pt: Toda a vara em mim, que não dá fruto, a tira; e limpa toda aquela que dá fruto, para que dê mais fruto.
text_el: πᾶν κλῆμα ἐν ἐμοὶ μὴ φέρον καρπόν, αἴρει αὐτό, καὶ πᾶν τὸ καρπὸν φέρον, καθαίρει αὐτὸ ἵνα καρπὸν πλείονα φέρῃ.

text_en: Now you are clean, by reason of the word which I have spoken to you.
text_la: Jam vos mundi estis propter sermonem quem locutus sum vobis.
text_pt: Vós já estais limpos, pela palavra que vos tenho falado.
text_el: ἤδη ὑμεῖς καθαροί ἐστε διὰ τὸν λόγον ὃν λελάληκα ὑμῖν:

text_en: Abide in me: and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, unless it abide in the vine, so neither can you, unless you abide in me.
text_la: Manete in me, et ego in vobis. Sicut palmes non potest ferre fructum a semetipso, nisi manserit in vite, sic nec vos, nisi in me manseritis.
text_pt: Estai em mim, e eu em vós; como a vara de si mesma não pode dar fruto, se não estiver na videira, assim também vós, se não estiverdes em mim.
text_el: μείνατε ἐν ἐμοί, κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν. καθὼς τὸ κλῆμα οὐ δύναται καρπὸν φέρειν ἀφ' ἑαυτοῦ ἐὰν μὴ μένῃ ἐν τῇ ἀμπέλῳ, οὕτως οὐδὲ ὑμεῖς ἐὰν μὴ ἐν ἐμοὶ μένητε.

text_en: I am the vine: you the branches. He that abides in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit: for without me you can do nothing.
text_la: Ego sum vitis, vos palmites : qui manet in me, et ego in eo, hic fert fructum multum, quia sine me nihil potestis facere.
text_pt: Eu sou a videira, vós as varas; quem está em mim, e eu nele, esse dá muito fruto; porque sem mim nada podeis fazer.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἄμπελος, ὑμεῖς τὰ κλήματα. ὁ μένων ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ, οὗτος φέρει καρπὸν πολύν, ὅτι χωρὶς ἐμοῦ οὐ δύνασθε ποιεῖν οὐδέν.

text_en: If any one abide not in me, he shall be cast forth as a branch and shall wither: and they shall gather him up and cast him into the fire: and he burns.
text_la: Si quis in me non manserit, mittetur foras sicut palmes, et arescet, et colligent eum, et in ignem mittent, et ardet.
text_pt: Se alguém não estiver em mim, será lançado fora, como a vara, e secará; e os colhem e lançam no fogo, e ardem.
text_el: ἐὰν μή τις μένῃ ἐν ἐμοί, ἐβλήθη ἔξω ὡς τὸ κλῆμα καὶ ἐξηράνθη, καὶ συνάγουσιν αὐτὰ καὶ εἰς τὸ πῦρ βάλλουσιν, καὶ καίεται.

text_en: If you abide in me and my words abide in you, you shall ask whatever you will: and it shall be done unto you.
text_la: Si manseritis in me, et verba mea in vobis manserint, quodcumque volueritis petetis, et fiet vobis.
text_pt: Se vós estiverdes em mim, e as minhas palavras estiverem em vós, pedireis tudo o que quiserdes, e vos será feito.
text_el: ἐὰν μείνητε ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ τὰ ῥήματά μου ἐν ὑμῖν μείνῃ, ὃ ἐὰν θέλητε αἰτήσασθε, καὶ γενήσεται ὑμῖν.

text_en: In this is my Father glorified : that you bring forth very much fruit and become my disciples .
text_la: In hoc clarificatus est Pater meus, ut fructum plurimum afferatis, et efficiamini mei discipuli.
text_pt: Nisto é glorificado meu Pai, que deis muito fruto; e assim sereis meus discípulos.
text_el: ἐν τούτῳ ἐδοξάσθη ὁ πατήρ μου, ἵνα καρπὸν πολὺν φέρητε καὶ γένησθε ἐμοὶ μαθηταί.

text_en: As the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Abide in my love .
text_la: Sicut dilexit me Pater, et ego dilexi vos. Manete in dilectione mea.
text_pt: Como o Pai me amou, também eu vos amei a vós; permanecei no meu amor.
text_el: καθὼς ἠγάπησέν με ὁ πατήρ, κἀγὼ ὑμᾶς ἠγάπησα: μείνατε ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ἐμῇ.

text_en: If you keep my commandments, you shall abide in my love : as I also have kept my Father's commandments and do abide in his love .
text_la: Si præcepta mea servaveritis, manebitis in dilectione mea, sicut et ego Patris mei præcepta servavi, et maneo in ejus dilectione.
text_pt: Se guardardes os meus mandamentos, permanecereis no meu amor; do mesmo modo que eu tenho guardado os mandamentos de meu Pai, e permaneço no seu amor.
text_el: ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολάς μου τηρήσητε, μενεῖτε ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ μου, καθὼς ἐγὼ τοῦ πατρός τὰς ἐντολὰς μου τετήρηκα καὶ μένω αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ.

text_en: These things I have spoken to you, that my joy may be in you, and your joy may be filled.
text_la: Hæc locutus sum vobis : ut gaudium meum in vobis sit, et gaudium vestrum impleatur.
text_pt: Tenho-vos dito isto, para que o meu gozo permaneça em vós, e o vosso gozo seja completo.
text_el: ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ἡ ἐμὴ ἐν ὑμῖν ᾖ καὶ ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν πληρωθῇ.

text_en: This is my commandment, that you love one another, as I have loved you.
text_la: Hoc est præceptum meum, ut diligatis invicem, sicut dilexi vos.
text_pt: O meu mandamento é este: Que vos ameis uns aos outros, assim como eu vos amei.
text_el: αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐντολὴ ἡ ἐμή, ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους καθὼς ἠγάπησα ὑμᾶς:

text_en: Greater love than this no man has, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
text_la: Majorem hac dilectionem nemo habet, ut animam suam ponat qui pro amicis suis.
text_pt: Ninguém tem maior amor do que este, de dar alguém a sua vida pelos seus amigos.
text_el: μείζονα ταύτης ἀγάπην οὐδεὶς ἔχει ἵνα τις τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ θῇ ὑπὲρ τῶν φίλων αὐτοῦ.

text_en: You are my friends, if you do the things that I command you.
text_la: Vos amici mei estis, si feceritis quæ ego præcipio vobis.
text_pt: Vós sereis meus amigos, se fizerdes o que eu vos mando.
text_el: ὑμεῖς φίλοι μού ἐστε, ἐὰν ποιῆτε ὃ ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν.

text_en: I will not now call you servants: for the servant knows not what his lord does. But I have called you friends because all things, whatsoever I have heard of my Father , I have made known to you.
text_la: Jam non dicam vos servos : quia servus nescit quid faciat dominus ejus. Vos autem dixi amicos : quia omnia quæcumque audivi a Patre meo, nota feci vobis.
text_pt: Já vos não chamarei servos, porque o servo não sabe o que faz o seu senhor; mas tenho-vos chamado amigos, porque tudo quanto ouvi de meu Pai vos tenho feito conhecer.
text_el: οὐκέτι λέγω ὑμᾶς δούλους, ὅτι ὁ δοῦλος οὐκ οἶδεν τί ποιεῖ αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος: ὑμᾶς δὲ εἴρηκα φίλους, ὅτι πάντα ἃ ἤκουσα παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου ἐγνώρισα ὑμῖν.

text_en: You have not chosen me: but I have chosen you; and have appointed you, that you should go and should bring forth fruit; and your fruit should remain: that whatsoever you shall ask of the Father in my name , he may give it you.
text_la: Non vos me elegistis, sed ego elegi vos, et posui vos ut eatis, et fructum afferatis, et fructus vester maneat : ut quodcumque petieritis Patrem in nomine meo, det vobis.
text_pt: Não me escolhestes vós a mim, mas eu vos escolhi a vós, e vos nomeei, para que vades e deis fruto, e o vosso fruto permaneça; a fim de que tudo quanto em meu nome pedirdes ao Pai ele vo-lo conceda.
text_el: οὐχ ὑμεῖς με ἐξελέξασθε, ἀλλ' ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην ὑμᾶς καὶ ἔθηκα ὑμᾶς ἵνα ὑμεῖς ὑπάγητε καὶ καρπὸν φέρητε καὶ ὁ καρπὸς ὑμῶν μένῃ, ἵνα ὅ τι ἂν αἰτήσητε τὸν πατέρα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου δῷ ὑμῖν.

text_en: These things I command you, that you love one another.
text_la: Hæc mando vobis : ut diligatis invicem.
text_pt: Isto vos mando: Que vos ameis uns aos outros.
text_el: ταῦτα ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν, ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους.

text_en: If the world hate you, know that it has hated me before you.
text_la: Si mundus vos odit, scitote quia me priorem vobis odio habuit.
text_pt: Se o mundo vos odeia, sabei que, primeiro do que a vós, me odiou a mim.
text_el: εἰ ὁ κόσμος ὑμᾶς μισεῖ, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐμὲ πρῶτον ὑμῶν μεμίσηκεν.

text_en: If you had been of the world, the world would love its own: but because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
text_la: Si de mundo fuissetis, mundus quod suum erat diligeret : quia vero de mundo non estis, sed ego elegi vos de mundo, propterea odit vos mundus.
text_pt: Se vós fôsseis do mundo, o mundo amaria o que era seu, mas porque não sois do mundo, antes eu vos escolhi do mundo, por isso é que o mundo vos odeia.
text_el: εἰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἦτε, ὁ κόσμος ἂν τὸ ἴδιον ἐφίλει: ὅτι δὲ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου οὐκ ἐστέ, ἀλλ' ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην ὑμᾶς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου, διὰ τοῦτο μισεῖ ὑμᾶς ὁ κόσμος.

text_en: Remember my word that I said to you: The servant is not greater than his master. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they have kept my word, they will keep yours also.
text_la: Mementote sermonis mei, quem ego dixi vobis : non est servus major domino suo. Si me persecuti sunt, et vos persequentur; si sermonem meum servaverunt, et vestrum servabunt.
text_pt: Lembrai-vos da palavra que vos disse: Não é o servo maior do que o seu senhor. Se a mim me perseguiram, também vos perseguirão a vós; se guardaram a minha palavra, também guardarão a vossa.
text_el: μνημονεύετε τοῦ λόγου οὗ ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν: οὐκ ἔστιν δοῦλος μείζων τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ. εἰ ἐμὲ ἐδίωξαν, καὶ ὑμᾶς διώξουσιν: εἰ τὸν λόγον μου ἐτήρησαν, καὶ τὸν ὑμέτερον τηρήσουσιν.

text_en: But all these things they will do to you for my name's sake: because they know not him that sent me.
text_la: Sed hæc omnia facient vobis propter nomen meum : quia nesciunt eum qui misit me.
text_pt: Mas tudo isto vos farão por causa do meu nome, porque não conhecem aquele que me enviou.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ταῦτα πάντα ποιήσουσιν εἰς ὑμᾶς διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου, ὅτι οὐκ οἴδασιν τὸν πέμψαντά με.

text_en: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have sin : but now they have no excuse for their sin .
text_la: Si non venissem, et locutus fuissem eis, peccatum non haberent : nunc autem excusationem non habent de peccato suo.
text_pt: Se eu não viera, nem lhes houvera falado, não teriam pecado, mas agora não têm desculpa do seu pecado.
text_el: εἰ μὴ ἦλθον καὶ ἐλάλησα αὐτοῖς, ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ εἴχοσαν: νῦν δὲ πρόφασιν οὐκ ἔχουσιν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.

text_en: He that hates me hates my Father also.
text_la: Qui me odit, et Patrem meum odit.
text_pt: Aquele que me odeia, odeia também a meu Pai.
text_el: ὁ ἐμὲ μισῶν καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου μισεῖ.

text_en: If I had not done among them the works that no other man has done, they would not have sin : but now they have both seen and hated both me and my Father .
text_la: Si opera non fecissem in eis quæ nemo alius fecit, peccatum non haberent : nunc autem et viderunt, et oderunt et me, et Patrem meum.
text_pt: Se eu entre eles não fizesse tais obras, quais nenhum outro tem feito, não teriam pecado; mas agora, viram-nas e me odiaram a mim e a meu Pai.
text_el: εἰ τὰ ἔργα μὴ ἐποίησα ἐν αὐτοῖς ἃ οὐδεὶς ἄλλος ἐποίησεν, ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ εἴχοσαν: νῦν δὲ καὶ ἑωράκασιν καὶ μεμισήκασιν καὶ ἐμὲ καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου.

text_en: But that the word may be fulfilled which is written in their law: they hated me without cause.
text_la: Sed ut adimpleatur sermo, qui in lege eorum scriptus est : Quia odio habuerunt me gratis.
text_pt: Mas é para que se cumpra a palavra que está escrita na sua lei: Odiaram-me sem causa.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἵνα πληρωθῇ ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ αὐτῶν γεγραμμένος ὅτι ἐμίσησάν με δωρεάν.

text_en: But when the Paraclete comes, whom I will send you from the Father , the Spirit of truth , who proceeds from the Father , he shall give testimony of me.
text_la: Cum autem venerit Paraclitus, quem ego mittam vobis a Patre, Spiritum veritatis, qui a Patre procedit, ille testimonium perhibebit de me;
text_pt: Mas, quando vier o Consolador, que eu da parte do Pai vos hei de enviar, aquele Espírito de verdade, que procede do Pai, ele testificará de mim.
text_el: ὅταν ἔλθῃ ὁ παράκλητος ὃν ἐγὼ πέμψω ὑμῖν παρὰ τοῦ πατρός, τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας ὃ παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ἐκπορεύεται, ἐκεῖνος μαρτυρήσει περὶ ἐμοῦ:

text_en: And you shall give testimony, because you are with me from the beginning.
text_la: et vos testimonium perhibebitis, quia ab initio mecum estis.
text_pt: E vós também testificareis, pois estivestes comigo desde o princípio.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς δὲ μαρτυρεῖτε, ὅτι ἀπ' ἀρχῆς μετ' ἐμοῦ ἐστε.

text_en: These things have I spoken to you things have I spoken to you that you may not be scandalized .
text_la: Hæc locutus sum vobis, ut non scandalizemini.
text_pt: Tenho-vos dito estas coisas para que vos não escandalizeis.
text_el: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ σκανδαλισθῆτε.

text_en: They will put you out of the synagogues : yea, the hour comes, that whosoever kills you will think that he does a service to God .
text_la: Absque synagogis facient vos : sed venit hora, ut omnis qui interficit vos arbitretur obsequium se præstare Deo.
text_pt: Expulsar-vos-ão das sinagogas; vem mesmo a hora em que qualquer que vos matar cuidará fazer um serviço a Deus.
text_el: ἀποσυναγώγους ποιήσουσιν ὑμᾶς: ἀλλ' ἔρχεται ὥρα ἵνα πᾶς ὁ ἀποκτείνας [ὑμᾶς] δόξῃ λατρείαν προσφέρειν τῷ θεῷ.

text_en: And these things will they do to you; because they have not known the Father nor me.
text_la: Et hæc facient vobis, quia non noverunt Patrem, neque me.
text_pt: E isto vos farão, porque não conheceram ao Pai nem a mim.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα ποιήσουσιν ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὸν πατέρα οὐδὲ ἐμέ.

text_en: But these things I have told you, that when the hour shall come, you may remember that I told you of them.
text_la: Sed hæc locutus sum vobis, ut cum venerit hora eorum, reminiscamini quia ego dixi vobis.
text_pt: Mas tenho-vos dito isto, a fim de que, quando chegar aquela hora, vos lembreis de que já vo-lo tinha dito. E eu não vos disse isto desde o princípio, porque estava convosco.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἡ ὥρα αὐτῶν μνημονεύητε αὐτῶν, ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν. ταῦτα δὲ ὑμῖν ἐξ ἀρχῆς οὐκ εἶπον, ὅτι μεθ' ὑμῶν ἤμην.

text_en: But I told you not these things from the beginning, because I was with you. And now I go to him that sent me, and none of you asks me: Where are you going?
text_la: Hæc autem vobis ab initio non dixi, quia vobiscum eram. Et nunc vado ad eum qui misit me; et nemo ex vobis interrogat me : Quo vadis?
text_pt: E agora vou para aquele que me enviou; e nenhum de vós me pergunta: Para onde vais?
text_el: νῦν δὲ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐρωτᾷ με: ποῦ ὑπάγεις;

text_en: But because I have spoken these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.
text_la: sed quia hæc locutus sum vobis, tristitia implevit cor vestrum.
text_pt: Antes, porque isto vos tenho dito, o vosso coração se encheu de tristeza.
text_el: ἀλλ' ὅτι ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἡ λύπη πεπλήρωκεν ὑμῶν τὴν καρδίαν.

text_en: But I tell you the truth : it is expedient to you that I go. For if I go not, the Paraclete will not come to you: but if I go, I will send him to you.
text_la: Sed ego veritatem dico vobis : expedit vobis ut ego vadam : si enim non abiero, Paraclitus non veniet ad vos; si autem abiero, mittam eum ad vos.
text_pt: Todavia digo-vos a verdade, que vos convém que eu vá; porque, se eu não for, o Consolador não virá a vós; mas, quando eu for, vo-lo enviarei.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἐγὼ τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω ὑμῖν, συμφέρει ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐγὼ ἀπέλθω. ἐὰν γὰρ μὴ ἀπέλθω, ὁ παράκλητος οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς: ἐὰν δὲ πορευθῶ, πέμψω αὐτὸν πρὸς ὑμᾶς.

text_en: And when he has come, he will convince the world of sin and of justice and of judgment.
text_la: Et cum venerit ille, arguet mundum de peccato, et de justitia, et de judicio.
text_pt: E, quando ele vier, convencerá o mundo do pecado, e da justiça e do juízo.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐκεῖνος ἐλέγξει τὸν κόσμον περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ περὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ περὶ κρίσεως:

text_en: Of sin : because they believed not in me.
text_la: De peccato quidem, quia non crediderunt in me.
text_pt: Do pecado, porque não crêem em mim;
text_el: περὶ ἁμαρτίας μέν, ὅτι οὐ πιστεύουσιν εἰς ἐμέ:

text_en: And of justice : because I go to the Father : and you shall see me no longer.
text_la: De justitia vero, quia ad Patrem vado, et jam non videbitis me.
text_pt: Da justiça, porque vou para meu Pai, e não me vereis mais;
text_el: περὶ δικαιοσύνης δέ, ὅτι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα ὑπάγω καὶ οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με:

text_en: And of judgment: because the prince of this world is already judged.
text_la: De judicio autem, quia princeps hujus mundi jam judicatus est.
text_pt: E do juízo, porque já o príncipe deste mundo está julgado.
text_el: περὶ δὲ κρίσεως, ὅτι ὁ ἄρχων τοῦ κόσμου τούτου κέκριται.

text_en: I have yet many things to say to you: but you cannot bear them now.
text_la: Adhuc multa habeo vobis dicere, sed non potestis portare modo.
text_pt: Ainda tenho muito que vos dizer, mas vós não o podeis suportar agora.
text_el: ἔτι πολλὰ ἔχω ὑμῖν λέγειν, ἀλλ' οὐ δύνασθε βαστάζειν ἄρτι:

text_en: But when he, the Spirit of truth , has come, he will teach you all truth . For he shall not speak of himself: but what things soever he shall hear, he shall speak. And the things that are to come, he shall show you.
text_la: Cum autem venerit ille Spiritus veritatis, docebit vos omnem veritatem : non enim loquetur a semetipso, sed quæcumque audiet loquetur, et quæ ventura sunt annuntiabit vobis.
text_pt: Mas, quando vier aquele Espírito de verdade, ele vos guiará em toda a verdade; porque não falará de si mesmo, mas dirá tudo o que tiver ouvido, e vos anunciará o que há de vir.
text_el: ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖνος, τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας, ὁδηγήσει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν ἀλήθειαν πᾶσαν: οὐ γὰρ λαλήσει ἀφ' ἑαυτοῦ, ἀλλ' ὅσα ἀκούει λαλήσει, καὶ τὰ ἐρχόμενα ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.

text_en: He shall glorify me: because he shall receive of mine and shall show it to you.
text_la: Ille me clarificabit, quia de meo accipiet, et annuntiabit vobis.
text_pt: Ele me glorificará, porque há de receber do que é meu, e vo-lo há de anunciar.
text_el: ἐκεῖνος ἐμὲ δοξάσει, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λήμψεται καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.

text_en: All things whatsoever the Father has are mine. Therefore I said that he shall receive of me and show it to you.
text_la: Omnia quæcumque habet Pater, mea sunt. Propterea dixi : quia de meo accipiet, et annuntiabit vobis.
text_pt: Tudo quanto o Pai tem é meu; por isso vos disse que há de receber do que é meu e vo-lo há de anunciar.
text_el: πάντα ὅσα ἔχει ὁ πατὴρ ἐμά ἐστιν: διὰ τοῦτο εἶπον ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λαμβάνει καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.

text_en: A little while, and now you shall not see me: and again a little while, and you shall see me: because I go to the Father .
text_la: Modicum, et jam non videbitis me; et iterum modicum, et videbitis me : quia vado ad Patrem.
text_pt: Um pouco, e não me vereis; e outra vez um pouco, e ver-me-eis; porquanto vou para o Pai.
text_el: μικρὸν καὶ οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με.

text_en: Then some of his disciples said one to another: What is this that he says to us: A little while, and you shall not see me: and again a little while, and you shall see me, and, Because I go to the Father ?
text_la: Dixerunt ergo ex discipulis ejus ad invicem : Quid est hoc quod dicit nobis : Modicum, et non videbitis me; et iterum modicum, et videbitis me, et quia vado ad Patrem?
text_pt: Então alguns dos seus discípulos disseram uns aos outros: Que é isto que nos diz? Um pouco, e não me vereis; e outra vez um pouco, e ver-me-eis; e: Porquanto vou para o Pai?
text_el: εἶπαν οὖν ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ πρὸς ἀλλήλους: τί ἐστιν τοῦτο ὃ λέγει ἡμῖν: μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με; καί ὅτι ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πατέρα;

text_en: They said therefore: What is this that he says, A little while? We know not what he speaks.
text_la: Dicebant ergo : Quid est hoc quod dicit : Modicum? nescimus quid loquitur.
text_pt: Diziam, pois: Que quer dizer isto: Um pouco? Não sabemos o que diz.
text_el: ἔλεγον οὖν: τί ἐστιν τοῦτο ὃ λέγει, τὸ μικρόν; οὐκ οἴδαμεν [τί λαλεῖ].

text_en: And Jesus knew that they had a mind to ask him. And he said to them: Of this do you inquire among yourselves, because I said: A little while, and you shall not see me; and again a little while, and you shall see me?
text_la: Cognovit autem Jesus, quia volebant eum interrogare, et dixit eis : De hoc quæritis inter vos quia dixi : Modicum, et non videbitis me; et iterum modicum, et videbitis me.
text_pt: Conheceu, pois, Jesus que o queriam interrogar, e disse-lhes: Indagais entre vós acerca disto que disse: Um pouco, e não me vereis, e outra vez um pouco, e ver-me-eis?
text_el: ἔγνω Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤθελον αὐτὸν ἐρωτᾶν, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: περὶ τούτου ζητεῖτε μετ' ἀλλήλων ὅτι εἶπον, μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με;

text_en: Amen , amen , I say to you, that you shall lament and weep, but the world shall rejoice: and you shall be made sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy .
text_la: Amen, amen dico vobis : quia plorabitis, et flebitis vos, mundus autem gaudebit; vos autem contristabimini, sed tristitia vestra vertetur in gaudium.
text_pt: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que vós chorareis e vos lamentareis, e o mundo se alegrará, e vós estareis tristes, mas a vossa tristeza se converterá em alegria.
text_el: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι κλαύσετε καὶ θρηνήσετε ὑμεῖς, ὁ δὲ κόσμος χαρήσεται: ὑμεῖς λυπηθήσεσθε, ἀλλ' ἡ λύπη ὑμῶν εἰς χαρὰν γενήσεται.

text_en: A woman , when she is in labour, has sorrow, because her hour has come; but when she has brought forth the child, she remembers no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
text_la: Mulier cum parit, tristitiam habet, quia venit hora ejus; cum autem pepererit puerum, jam non meminit pressuræ propter gaudium, quia natus est homo in mundum.
text_pt: A mulher, quando está para dar à luz, sente tristeza, porque é chegada a sua hora; mas, depois de ter dado à luz a criança, já não se lembra da aflição, pelo prazer de haver nascido um homem no mundo.
text_el: ἡ γυνὴ ὅταν τίκτῃ λύπην ἔχει, ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα αὐτῆς: ὅταν δὲ γεννήσῃ τὸ παιδίον, οὐκέτι μνημονεύει τῆς θλίψεως διὰ τὴν χαρὰν ὅτι ἐγεννήθη ἄνθρωπος εἰς τὸν κόσμον.

text_en: So also you now indeed have sorrow: but I will see you again and your heart shall rejoice. And your joy no man shall take from you.
text_la: Et vos igitur nunc quidem tristitiam habetis, iterum autem videbo vos, et gaudebit cor vestrum : et gaudium vestrum nemo tollet a vobis.
text_pt: Assim também vós agora, na verdade, tendes tristeza; mas outra vez vos verei, e o vosso coração se alegrará, e a vossa alegria ninguém vo-la tirará.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν νῦν μὲν λύπην ἔχετε: πάλιν δὲ ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς, καὶ χαρήσεται ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία, καὶ τὴν χαρὰν ὑμῶν οὐδεὶς ἀρεῖ ἀφ' ὑμῶν.

text_en: And in that day you shall not ask me anything. Amen , amen , I say to you: if you ask the Father anything in my name , he will give it you.
text_la: Et in illo die me non rogabitis quidquam. Amen, amen dico vobis : si quid petieritis Patrem in nomine meo, dabit vobis.
text_pt: E naquele dia nada me perguntareis. Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que tudo quanto pedirdes a meu Pai, em meu nome, ele vo-lo há de dar.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἐρωτήσετε οὐδέν. ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἄν τι αἰτήσητε τὸν πατέρα, δώσει ὑμῖνἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου.

text_en: Hitherto, you have not asked anything in my name . Ask, and you shall receive; that your joy may be full.
text_la: Usque modo non petistis quidquam in nomine meo : petite, et accipietis, ut gaudium vestrum sit plenum.
text_pt: Até agora nada pedistes em meu nome; pedi, e recebereis, para que o vosso gozo se cumpra.
text_el: ἕως ἄρτι οὐκ ᾐτήσατε οὐδὲν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου: αἰτεῖτε καὶ λήμψεσθε, ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν ᾖ πεπληρωμένη.

text_en: These things I have spoken to you in proverbs. The hour comes when I will no longer speak to you in proverbs, but will show you plainly of the Father .
text_la: Hæc in proverbiis locutus sum vobis. Venit hora cum jam non in proverbiis loquar vobis, sed palam de Patre annuntiabo vobis:
text_pt: Disse-vos isto por parábolas; chega, porém, a hora em que não vos falarei mais por parábolas, mas abertamente vos falarei acerca do Pai.
text_el: Ταῦτα ἐν παροιμίαις λελάληκα ὑμῖν: ἔρχεται ὥρα ὅτε οὐκέτι ἐν παροιμίαις λαλήσω ὑμῖν, ἀλλὰ παρρησίᾳ περὶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἀπαγγελῶ ὑμῖν.

text_en: In that day, you shall ask in my name : and I say not to you that I will ask the Father for you.
text_la: in illo die in nomine meo petetis: et non dico vobis quia ego rogabo Patrem de vobis:
text_pt: Naquele dia pedireis em meu nome, e não vos digo que eu rogarei por vós ao Pai;
text_el: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου αἰτήσεσθε, καὶ οὐ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν πατέρα περὶ ὑμῶν:

text_en: For the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me and have believed that I came out from God .
text_la: ipse enim Pater amat vos, quia vos me amastis, et credidistis, quia ego a Deo exivi.
text_pt: Pois o mesmo Pai vos ama, visto como vós me amastes, e crestes que saí de Deus.
text_el: αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ φιλεῖ ὑμᾶς, ὅτι ὑμεῖς ἐμὲ πεφιλήκατε καὶ πεπιστεύκατε ὅτι ἐγὼ παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ἐξῆλθον.

text_en: I came forth from the Father and have come into the world: again I leave the world and I go to the Father .
text_la: Exivi a Patre, et veni in mundum : iterum relinquo mundum, et vado ad Patrem.
text_pt: Saí do Pai, e vim ao mundo; outra vez deixo o mundo, e vou para o Pai.
text_el: ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ ἐλήλυθα εἰς τὸν κόσμον: πάλιν ἀφίημι τὸν κόσμον καὶ πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα.

text_en: His disciples say to him: Behold, now you speak plainly and speak no proverb.
text_la: Dicunt ei discipuli ejus : Ecce nunc palam loqueris, et proverbium nullum dicis:
text_pt: Disseram-lhe os seus discípulos: Eis que agora falas abertamente, e não dizes parábola alguma.
text_el: Λέγουσιν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ: ἴδε νῦν ἐν παρρησίᾳ λαλεῖς, καὶ παροιμίαν οὐδεμίαν λέγεις.

text_en: Now we know that you know all things and you need not that any man should ask you. By this we believe that you came forth from God .
text_la: nunc scimus quia scis omnia, et non opus est tibi ut quis te interroget : in hoc credimus quia a Deo existi.
text_pt: Agora conhecemos que sabes tudo, e não precisas de que alguém te interrogue. Por isso cremos que saíste de Deus.
text_el: νῦν οἴδαμεν ὅτι οἶδας πάντα καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχεις ἵνα τίς σε ἐρωτᾷ: ἐν τούτῳ πιστεύομεν ὅτι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθες.

text_en: Jesus answered them: Do you now believe ?
text_la: Respondit eis Jesus : Modo creditis?
text_pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Credes agora?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς: ἄρτι πιστεύετε;

text_en: Behold, the hour comes, and it is now come, that you shall be scattered every man to his own and shall leave me alone. And yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
text_la: ecce venit hora, et jam venit, ut dispergamini unusquisque in propria, et me solum relinquatis : et non sum solus, quia Pater mecum est.
text_pt: Eis que chega a hora, e já se aproxima, em que vós sereis dispersos cada um para sua parte, e me deixareis só; mas não estou só, porque o Pai está comigo.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ ἐλήλυθεν ἵνα σκορπισθῆτε ἕκαστος εἰς τὰ ἴδια κἀμὲ μόνον ἀφῆτε: καὶ οὐκ εἰμὶ μόνος, ὅτι ὁ πατὴρ μετ' ἐμοῦ ἐστιν.

text_en: These things I have spoken to you, that in me you may have peace. In the world you shall have distress. But have confidence. I have overcome the world.
text_la: Hæc locutus sum vobis, ut in me pacem habeatis. In mundo pressuram habebitis : sed confidite, ego vici mundum.
text_pt: Tenho-vos dito isto, para que em mim tenhais paz; no mundo tereis aflições, mas tende bom ânimo, eu venci o mundo.
text_el: ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐν ἐμοὶ εἰρήνην ἔχητε. ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ θλῖψιν ἔχετε: ἀλλὰ θαρσεῖτε, ἐγὼ νενίκηκα τὸν κόσμον.

text_en: These things Jesus spoke: and lifting up his eyes to heaven , he said: the hour has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may glorify you.
text_la: Hæc locutus est Jesus : et sublevatis oculis in cælum, dixit : Pater, venit hora : clarifica Filium tuum, ut Filius tuus clarificet te:
text_pt: Jesus falou assim e, levantando seus olhos ao céu, e disse: Pai, é chegada a hora; glorifica a teu Filho, para que também o teu Filho te glorifique a ti;
text_el: Ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐπάρας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶπεν: πάτερ, ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα: δόξασόν σου τὸν υἱόν, ἵνα ὁ υἱὸς δοξάσῃ σέ,

text_en: As you have given him power over all flesh, that he may give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
text_la: sicut dedisti ei potestatem omnis carnis, ut omne, quod dedisti ei, det eis vitam æternam.
text_pt: Assim como lhe deste poder sobre toda a carne, para que dê a vida eterna a todos quantos lhe deste.
text_el: καθὼς ἔδωκας αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν πάσης σαρκός, ἵνα πᾶν ὃ δέδωκας αὐτῷ δώσει αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

text_en: Now this is eternal life: That they may know you, the only true God , and Jesus Christ , whom you have sent.
text_la: Hæc est autem vita æterna : ut cognoscant te, solum Deum verum, et quem misisti Jesum Christum.
text_pt: E a vida eterna é esta: que te conheçam, a ti só, por único Deus verdadeiro, e a Jesus Cristo, a quem enviaste.
text_el: αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ αἰώνιος ζωή, ἵνα γινώσκωσιν σὲ τὸν μόνον ἀληθινὸν θεὸν καὶ ὃν ἀπέστειλας Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν.

text_en: I have glorified you on the earth; I have finished the work which you gave me to do.
text_la: Ego te clarificavi super terram : opus consummavi, quod dedisti mihi ut faciam:
text_pt: Eu glorifiquei-te na terra, tendo consumado a obra que me deste a fazer.
text_el: ἐγώ σε ἐδόξασα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τὸ ἔργον τελειώσας ὃ δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ποιήσω:

text_en: And now glorify me, O Father , with yourself, with the glory which I had, before the world was, with you.
text_la: et nunc clarifica me tu, Pater, apud temetipsum, claritate quam habui, priusquam mundus esset, apud te.
text_pt: E agora glorifica-me tu, ó Pai, junto de ti mesmo, com aquela glória que tinha contigo antes que o mundo existisse.
text_el: καὶ νῦν δόξασόν με σύ, πάτερ, παρὰ σεαυτῷ τῇ δόξῃ ᾗ εἶχον πρὸ τοῦ τὸν κόσμον εἶναι παρὰ σοί.

text_en: I have manifested your name to the men whom you have given me out of the world. Yours they were: and to me you gave them. And they have kept your word.
text_la: Manifestavi nomen tuum hominibus, quos dedisti mihi de mundo : tui erant, et mihi eos dedisti : et sermonem tuum servaverunt.
text_pt: Manifestei o teu nome aos homens que do mundo me deste; eram teus, e tu mos deste, e guardaram a tua palavra.
text_el: Ἐφανέρωσά σου τὸ ὄνομα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις οὓς ἔδωκάς μοι ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου. σοὶ ἦσαν κἀμοὶ αὐτοὺς ἔδωκας, καὶ τὸν λόγον σου τετήρηκαν:

text_en: Now they have known that all things which you have given me are from you:
text_la: Nunc cognoverunt quia omnia quæ dedisti mihi, abs te sunt:
text_pt: Agora já têm conhecido que tudo quanto me deste provém de ti;
text_el: νῦν ἔγνωκαν ὅτι πάντα ὅσα ἔδωκάς μοι παρὰ σοῦ εἰσιν:

text_en: Because the words which you gave me, I have given to them. And they have received them and have known in very deed that I came out from you: and they have believed that you sent me.
text_la: quia verba quæ dedisti mihi, dedi eis : et ipsi acceperunt, et cognoverunt vere quia a te exivi, et crediderunt quia tu me misisti.
text_pt: Porque lhes dei as palavras que tu me deste; e eles as receberam, e têm verdadeiramente conhecido que saí de ti, e creram que me enviaste.
text_el: ὅτι τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἔδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔλαβον, καὶ ἔγνωσαν ἀληθῶς ὅτι παρὰ σοῦ ἐξῆλθον, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.

text_en: I pray for them. I pray not for the world, but for them whom you have given me: because they are yours.
text_la: Ego pro eis rogo; non pro mundo rogo, sed pro his quos dedisti mihi : quia tui sunt:
text_pt: Eu rogo por eles; não rogo pelo mundo, mas por aqueles que me deste, porque são teus.
text_el: ἐγὼ περὶ αὐτῶν ἐρωτῶ: οὐ περὶ τοῦ κόσμου ἐρωτῶ, ἀλλὰ περὶ ὧν δέδωκάς μοι, ὅτι σοί εἰσιν,

text_en: And all my things are yours, and yours are mine: and I am glorified in them.
text_la: et mea omnia tua sunt, et tua mea sunt : et clarificatus sum in eis.
text_pt: E todas as minhas coisas são tuas, e as tuas coisas são minhas; e neles sou glorificado.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ἐμὰ πάντα σά ἐστιν καὶ τὰ σὰ ἐμά, καὶ δεδόξασμαι ἐν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And now I am not in the world, and these are in the world, and I come to you. Holy Father , keep them in your name whom you have given me: that they may be one, as we also are.
text_la: Et jam non sum in mundo, et hi in mundo sunt, et ego ad te venio. Pater sancte, serva eos in nomine tuo, quos dedisti mihi : ut sint unum, sicut et nos.
text_pt: E eu já não estou mais no mundo, mas eles estão no mundo, e eu vou para ti. Pai santo, guarda em teu nome aqueles que me deste, para que sejam um, assim como nós.
text_el: καὶ οὐκέτι εἰμὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ εἰσίν, κἀγὼ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι. πάτερ ἅγιε, τήρησον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι, ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς.

text_en: While I was with them, I kept them in your name . Those whom you gave me have I kept: and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition: that the scripture may be fulfilled.
text_la: Cum essem cum eis, ego servabam eos in nomine tuo. Quos dedisti mihi, custodivi : et nemo ex eis periit, nisi filius perditionis, ut Scriptura impleatur.
text_pt: Estando eu com eles no mundo, guardava-os em teu nome. Tenho guardado aqueles que tu me deste, e nenhum deles se perdeu, senão o filho da perdição, para que a Escritura se cumprisse.
