text_el: ὅτε ἤμην μετ' αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἐτήρουν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι, καὶ ἐφύλαξα, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπώλετο εἰ μὴ ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας, ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ.

text_en: And now I come to you: and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy filled in themselves.
text_la: Nunc autem ad te venio : et hæc loquor in mundo, ut habeant gaudium meum impletum in semetipsis.
text_pt: Mas agora vou para ti, e digo isto no mundo, para que tenham a minha alegria completa em si mesmos.
text_el: νῦν δὲ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι, καὶ ταῦτα λαλῶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἵνα ἔχωσιν τὴν χαρὰν τὴν ἐμὴν πεπληρωμένην ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.

text_en: I have given them your word, and the world has hated them: because they are not of the world, as I also am not of the world.
text_la: Ego dedi eis sermonem tuum, et mundus eos odio habuit, quia non sunt de mundo, sicut et ego non sum de mundo.
text_pt: Dei-lhes a tua palavra, e o mundo os odiou, porque não são do mundo, assim como eu não sou do mundo.
text_el: ἐγὼ δέδωκα αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον σου, καὶ ὁ κόσμος ἐμίσησεν αὐτούς, ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου.

text_en: I pray not that you should take them out of the world, but that you should keep them from evil .
text_la: Non rogo ut tollas eos de mundo, sed ut serves eos a malo.
text_pt: Não peço que os tires do mundo, mas que os livres do mal.
text_el: οὐκ ἐρωτῶ ἵνα ἄρῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἀλλ' ἵνα τηρήσῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ.

text_en: They are not of the world, as I also am not of the world.
text_la: De mundo non sunt, sicut et ego non sum de mundo.
text_pt: Não são do mundo, como eu do mundo não sou.
text_el: ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου οὐκ εἰσὶν καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου.

text_en: Sanctify them in truth . Your word is truth .
text_la: Sanctifica eos in veritate. Sermo tuus veritas est.
text_pt: Santifica-os na tua verdade; a tua palavra é a verdade.
text_el: ἁγίασον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ: ὁ λόγος ὁ σὸς ἀλήθειά ἐστιν.

text_en: As you have sent me into the world, I also have sent them into the world.
text_la: Sicut tu me misisti in mundum, et ego misi eos in mundum:
text_pt: Assim como tu me enviaste ao mundo, também eu os enviei ao mundo.
text_el: καθὼς ἐμὲ ἀπέστειλας εἰς τὸν κόσμον, κἀγὼ ἀπέστειλα αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν κόσμον:

text_en: And for them do I sanctify myself, that they also may be sanctified in truth .
text_la: et pro eis ego sanctifico meipsum : ut sint et ipsi sanctificati in veritate.
text_pt: E por eles me santifico a mim mesmo, para que também eles sejam santificados na verdade.
text_el: καὶ ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν [ἐγὼ] ἁγιάζω ἐμαυτόν, ἵνα ὦσιν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἡγιασμένοι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ.

text_en: And not for them only do I pray , but for them also who through their word shall believe in me.
text_la: Non pro eis autem rogo tantum, sed et pro eis qui credituri sunt per verbum eorum in me:
text_pt: E não rogo somente por estes, mas também por aqueles que pela tua palavra hão de crer em mim;
text_el: Οὐ περὶ τούτων δὲ ἐρωτῶ μόνον, ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ τῶν πιστευόντων διὰ τοῦ λόγου αὐτῶν εἰς ἐμέ,

text_en: That they all may be one, as you, Father , in me, and I in you; that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that you have sent me.
text_la: ut omnes unum sint, sicut tu Pater in me, et ego in te, ut et ipsi in nobis unum sint : ut credat mundus, quia tu me misisti.
text_pt: Para que todos sejam um, como tu, ó Pai, o és em mim, e eu em ti; que também eles sejam um em nós, para que o mundo creia que tu me enviaste.
text_el: ἵνα πάντες ἓν ὦσιν, καθὼς σύ πατήρ ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν σοί, ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἡμῖν ὦσιν, ἵνα ὁ κόσμος πιστεύῃ ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας.

text_en: And the glory which you have given me, I have given to them: that, they may be one, as we also are one.
text_la: Et ego claritatem, quam dedisti mihi, dedi eis : ut sint unum, sicut et nos unum sumus.
text_pt: E eu dei-lhes a glória que a mim me deste, para que sejam um, como nós somos um.
text_el: κἀγὼ τὴν δόξαν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς, ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς ἕν:

text_en: I in them, and you in me: that they may be made perfect in one: and the world may know that you have sent me and have loved them, as you have also loved me.
text_la: Ego in eis, et tu in me : ut sint consummati in unum : et cognoscat mundus quia tu me misisti, et dilexisti eos, sicut et me dilexisti.
text_pt: Eu neles, e tu em mim, para que eles sejam perfeitos em unidade, e para que o mundo conheça que tu me enviaste a mim, e que os tens amado a eles como me tens amado a mim.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ σὺ ἐν ἐμοί, ἵνα ὦσιν τετελειωμένοι εἰς ἕν, ἵνα γινώσκῃ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας καὶ ἠγάπησας αὐτοὺς καθὼς ἐμὲ ἠγάπησας.

text_en: Father , I will that where I am, they also whom you have given me may be with me: that they may see my glory which you have given me, because you have loved me before the creation of the world.
text_la: Pater, quos dedisti mihi, volo ut ubi sum ego, et illi sint mecum : ut videant claritatem meam, quam dedisti mihi : quia dilexisti me ante constitutionem mundi.
text_pt: Pai, aqueles que me deste quero que, onde eu estiver, também eles estejam comigo, para que vejam a minha glória que me deste; porque tu me amaste antes da fundação do mundo.
text_el: Πατήρ, ὃ δέδωκάς μοι, θέλω ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ κἀκεῖνοι ὦσιν μετ' ἐμοῦ, ἵνα θεωρῶσιν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἐμὴν, ἣν δέδωκάς μοι, ὅτι ἠγάπησάς με πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου.

text_en: Just Father , the world has not known you: but I have known you. And these have known that you have sent me.
text_la: Pater juste, mundus te non cognovit, ego autem te cognovi : et hi cognoverunt, quia tu me misisti.
text_pt: Pai justo, o mundo não te conheceu; mas eu te conheci, e estes conheceram que tu me enviaste a mim.
text_el: Πατήρ δίκαιε, καὶ ὁ κόσμος σε οὐκ ἔγνω, ἐγὼ δέ σε ἔγνων, καὶ οὗτοι ἔγνωσαν ὅτι σύ με ἀπέστειλας:

text_en: And I have made known your name to them and will make it known : that the love wherewith you have loved me may be in them, and I in them.
text_la: Et notum feci eis nomen tuum, et notum faciam : ut dilectio, qua dilexisti me, in ipsis sit, et ego in ipsis.
text_pt: E eu lhes fiz conhecer o teu nome, e lho farei conhecer mais, para que o amor com que me tens amado esteja neles, e eu neles esteja.
text_el: καὶ ἐγνώρισα αὐτοῖς τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ γνωρίσω, ἵνα ἡ ἀγάπη ἣν ἠγάπησάς με ἐν αὐτοῖς ᾖ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς.

text_en: When Jesus had said these things, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron , where there was a garden, into which he entered with his disciples .
text_la: Hæc cum dixisset Jesus, egressus est cum discipulis suis trans torrentem Cedron, ubi erat hortus, in quem introivit ipse, et discipuli ejus.
text_pt: Tendo Jesus dito isto, saiu com os seus discípulos para além do ribeiro de Cedrom, onde havia um horto, no qual ele entrou e seus discípulos.
text_el: Ταῦτα εἰπὼν Ἰησοῦς ἐξῆλθεν σὺν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ πέραν τοῦ χειμάρρου τῶν Κεδρὼν, ὅπου ἦν κῆπος, εἰς ὃν εἰσῆλθεν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And Judas also, who betrayed him, knew the place: because Jesus had often resorted thither together with his disciples .
text_la: Sciebat autem et Judas, qui tradebat eum, locum : quia frequenter Jesus convenerat illuc cum discipulis suis.
text_pt: E Judas, que o traía, também conhecia aquele lugar, porque Jesus muitas vezes se ajuntava ali com os seus discípulos.
text_el: ᾔδει δὲ καὶ Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν τὸν τόπον, ὅτι πολλάκις συνήχθη Ἰησοῦς ἐκεῖ μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Judas therefore having received a band of soldiers and servants from the chief priests and the Pharisees , comes thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
text_la: Judas ergo cum accepisset cohortem, et a pontificibus et pharisæis ministros, venit illuc cum laternis, et facibus, et armis.
text_pt: Tendo, pois, Judas recebido a coorte e oficiais dos principais sacerdotes e fariseus, veio para ali com lanternas, e archotes e armas.
text_el: ὁ οὖν Ἰούδας λαβὼν τὴν σπεῖραν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ [ἐκ] τῶν Φαρισαίων ὑπηρέτας ἔρχεται ἐκεῖ μετὰ φανῶν καὶ λαμπάδων καὶ ὅπλων.

text_en: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth and said to them: Whom do you seek?
text_la: Jesus itaque sciens omnia quæ ventura erant super eum, processit, et dixit eis : Quem quæritis?
text_pt: Sabendo, pois, Jesus todas as coisas que sobre ele haviam de vir, adiantou-se, e disse-lhes: A quem buscais?
text_el: Ἰησοῦς οὖν εἰδὼς πάντα τὰ ἐρχόμενα ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἐξῆλθεν καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: τίνα ζητεῖτε;

text_en: They answered him: Jesus of Nazareth . Jesus says to them: I am he. And Judas also, who betrayed him, stood with them.
text_la: Responderunt ei : Jesum Nazarenum. Dicit eis Jesus : Ego sum. Stabat autem et Judas, qui tradebat eum, cum ipsis.
text_pt: Responderam-lhe: A Jesus Nazareno. Disse-lhes Jesus: Sou eu. E Judas, que o traía, estava com eles.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ, Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον. λέγει αὐτοῖς: Ἐγώ εἰμι. εἱστήκει δὲ καὶ Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν μετ' αὐτῶν.

text_en: As soon therefore as he had said to them: I am he; they went backward and fell to the ground.
text_la: Ut ergo dixit eis : Ego sum : abierunt retrorsum, et ceciderunt in terram.
text_pt: Quando, pois, lhes disse: Sou eu, recuaram, e caíram por terra.
text_el: ὡς οὖν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἐγώ εἰμι, ἀπῆλθον εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ ἔπεσαν χαμαί.

text_en: Again therefore he asked them: Whom do you seek? And they said: Jesus of Nazareth .
text_la: Iterum ergo interrogavit eos : Quem quæritis? Illi autem dixerunt : Jesum Nazarenum.
text_pt: Tornou-lhes, pois, a perguntar: A quem buscais? E eles disseram: A Jesus Nazareno.
text_el: πάλιν οὖν ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτούς: τίνα ζητεῖτε; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν: Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον.

text_en: Jesus answered: I have told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,
text_la: Respondit Jesus : Dixi vobis, quia ego sum : si ergo me quæritis, sinite hos abire.
text_pt: Jesus respondeu: Já vos disse que sou eu; se, pois, me buscais a mim, deixai ir estes;
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς: εἶπον ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι: εἰ οὖν ἐμὲ ζητεῖτε, ἄφετε τούτους ὑπάγειν.

text_en: that the word might be fulfilled which he said: Of them whom you have given me, I have not lost any one.
text_la: Ut impleretur sermo, quem dixit : Quia quos dedisti mihi, non perdidi ex eis quemquam.
text_pt: Para que se cumprisse a palavra que tinha dito: Dos que me deste nenhum deles perdi.
text_el: ἵνα πληρωθῇ ὁ λόγος ὃν εἶπεν, ὅτι οὓς δέδωκάς μοι, οὐκ ἀπώλεσα ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐδένα.

text_en: Then Simon Peter , having a sword, drew it and struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear. And the name of you servant was Malchus.
text_la: Simon ergo Petrus habens gladium eduxit eum : et percussit pontificis servum, et abscidit auriculam ejus dexteram. Erat autem nomen servo Malchus.
text_pt: Então Simão Pedro, que tinha espada, desembainhou-a, e feriu o servo do sumo sacerdote, cortando-lhe a orelha direita. E o nome do servo era Malco.
text_el: Σίμων οὖν Πέτρος ἔχων μάχαιραν εἵλκυσεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἔπαισεν τὸν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως δοῦλον καὶ ἀπέκοψεν αὐτοῦ τὸ ὠτάριον τὸ δεξιόν: ἦν δὲ ὄνομα τῷ δούλῳ Μάλχος.

text_en: Jesus therefore said to Peter : Put up your sword into the scabbard. The chalice which my father has given me, shall I not drink it?
text_la: Dixit ergo Jesus Petro : Mitte gladium tuum in vaginam. Calicem, quem dedit mihi Pater, non bibam illum?
text_pt: Mas Jesus disse a Pedro: Põe a tua espada na bainha; não beberei eu o cálice que o Pai me deu?
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ Πέτρῳ: βάλε τὴν μάχαιραν εἰς τὴν θήκην: τὸ ποτήριον ὃ δέδωκέν μοι ὁ πατὴρ, οὐ μὴ πίω αὐτό;

text_en: Then the band and the tribune and the servants of the Jews took Jesus and bound him.
text_la: Cohors ergo, et tribunus, et ministri Judæorum comprehenderunt Jesum, et ligaverunt eum.
text_pt: Então a coorte, e o tribuno, e os servos dos judeus prenderam a Jesus e o maniataram.
text_el: Ἡ οὖν σπεῖρα καὶ ὁ χιλίαρχος καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται τῶν Ἰουδαίων συνέλαβον τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἔδησαν αὐτὸν,

text_en: And they led him away to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiphas , who was the high priest of that year.
text_la: Et adduxerunt eum ad Annam primum : erat enim socer Caiphæ, qui erat pontifex anni illius.
text_pt: E conduziram-no primeiramente a Anás, por ser sogro de Caifás, que era o sumo sacerdote daquele ano.
text_el: καὶ ἤγαγον πρὸς Ἅνναν πρῶτον: ἦν γὰρ πενθερὸς τοῦ Καϊάφα, ὃς ἦν ἀρχιερεὺς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐκείνου:

text_en: Now Caiphas was he who had given the counsel to the Jews : That it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
text_la: Erat autem Caiphas, qui consilium dederat Judæis : Quia expedit unum hominem mori pro populo.
text_pt: Ora, Caifás era quem tinha aconselhado aos judeus que convinha que um homem morresse pelo povo.
text_el: ἦν δὲ Καϊάφας ὁ συμβουλεύσας τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι συμφέρει ἕνα ἄνθρωπον ἀποθανεῖν ὑπὲρ τοῦ λαοῦ.

text_en: And Simon Peter followed Jesus : and so did another disciple . And that disciple was known to the high priest and went in with Jesus into the court of the high priest .
text_la: Sequebatur autem Jesum Simon Petrus, et alius discipulus. Discipulus autem ille erat notus pontifici, et introivit cum Jesu in atrium pontificis.
text_pt: E Simão Pedro e outro discípulo seguiam a Jesus. E este discípulo era conhecido do sumo sacerdote, e entrou com Jesus na sala do sumo sacerdote.
text_el: Ἠκολούθει δὲ τῷ Ἰησοῦ Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ ἄλλος μαθητής. ὁ δὲ μαθητὴς ἐκεῖνος ἦν γνωστὸς τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ, καὶ συνεισῆλθεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως,

text_en: But Peter stood at the door without. The other disciple therefore, who was known to the high priest , went out and spoke to the portress and brought in Peter .
text_la: Petrus autem stabat ad ostium foris. Exivit ergo discipulus alius, qui erat notus pontifici, et dixit ostiariæ : et introduxit Petrum.
text_pt: E Pedro estava da parte de fora, à porta. Saiu então o outro discípulo que era conhecido do sumo sacerdote, e falou à porteira, levando Pedro para dentro.
text_el: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος εἱστήκει πρὸς τῇ θύρᾳ ἔξω. ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ μαθητὴς ὁ ἄλλος ὁ γνωστὸς τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ εἶπεν τῇ θυρωρῷ, καὶ εἰσήγαγεν τὸν Πέτρον.

text_en: The maid therefore that was portress says to Peter : Are you not also one of this man's disciple ? He says I am not .
text_la: Dicit ergo Petro ancilla ostiaria : Numquid et tu ex discipulis es hominis istius? Dicit ille : Non sum.
text_pt: Então a porteira disse a Pedro: Não és tu também dos discípulos deste homem? Disse ele: Não sou.
text_el: λέγει οὖν τῷ Πέτρῳ ἡ παιδίσκη ἡ θυρωρός, μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν εἶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου; λέγει ἐκεῖνος: οὐκ εἰμί.

text_en: Now the servants and ministers stood at a fire of coals, because it was cold, and warmed themselves. And with them was Peter also, standing and warming himself.
text_la: Stabant autem servi et ministri ad prunas, quia frigus erat, et calefaciebant se : erat autem cum eis et Petrus stans, et calefaciens se.
text_pt: Ora, estavam ali os servos e os servidores, que tinham feito brasas, e se aquentavam, porque fazia frio; e com eles estava Pedro, aquentando-se também.
text_el: εἱστήκεισαν δὲ οἱ δοῦλοι καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται ἀνθρακιὰν πεποιηκότες, ὅτι ψῦχος ἦν, καὶ ἐθερμαίνοντο: ἦν δὲ καὶ ὁ Πέτρος μετ' αὐτῶν ἑστὼς καὶ θερμαινόμενος.

text_en: The high priest therefore asked Jesus of his disciples and of his doctrine.
text_la: Pontifex ergo interrogavit Jesum de discipulis suis, et de doctrina ejus.
text_pt: E o sumo sacerdote interrogou Jesus acerca dos seus discípulos e da sua doutrina.
text_el: Ὁ οὖν ἀρχιερεὺς ἠρώτησεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν περὶ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ τῆς διδαχῆς αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Jesus answered him: I have spoken openly to the world. I have always taught in the synagogue and in the temple , whither all the Jews resort: and in secret I have spoken nothing.
text_la: Respondit ei Jesus : Ego palam locutus sum mundo : ego semper docui in synagoga, et in templo, quo omnes Judæi conveniunt, et in occulto locutus sum nihil.
text_pt: Jesus lhe respondeu: Eu falei abertamente ao mundo; eu sempre ensinei na sinagoga e no templo, onde os judeus sempre se ajuntam, e nada disse em oculto.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς: ἐγὼ παρρησίᾳ λελάληκα τῷ κόσμῳ: ἐγὼ πάντοτε ἐδίδαξα ἐν συναγωγῇ καὶ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ, ὅπου πάντες οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι συνέρχονται, καὶ ἐν κρυπτῷ ἐλάλησα οὐδέν.

text_en: Why do you ask me? Ask them who have heard what I have spoken unto them. Behold they know what things I have said.
text_la: Quid me interrogas? interroga eos qui audierunt quid locutus sim ipsis : ecce hi sciunt quæ dixerim ego.
text_pt: Para que me perguntas a mim? Pergunta aos que ouviram o que é que lhes ensinei; eis que eles sabem o que eu lhes tenho dito.
text_el: τί με ἐρωτᾷς; ἐρώτησον τοὺς ἀκηκοότας τί ἐλάλησα αὐτοῖς: ἴδε οὗτοι οἴδασιν ἃ εἶπον ἐγώ.

text_en: And when he had said these things, one of the servants standing by gave Jesus a blow, saying: Do you answer the high priest so?
text_la: Hæc autem cum dixisset, unus assistens ministrorum dedit alapam Jesu, dicens : Sic respondes pontifici?
text_pt: E, tendo dito isto, um dos servidores que ali estavam, deu uma bofetada em Jesus, dizendo: Assim respondes ao sumo sacerdote?
text_el: ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ εἰπόντος εἷς παρεστηκὼς τῶν ὑπηρετῶν ἔδωκεν ῥάπισμα τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰπών: οὕτως ἀποκρίνῃ τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ;

text_en: Jesus answered him: If I have spoken evil , give testimony of the evil ; but if well, why do you strike me?
text_la: Respondit ei Jesus : Si male locutus sum, testimonium perhibe de malo : si autem bene, quid me cædis?
text_pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Se falei mal, dá testemunho do mal; e, se bem, por que me feres?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς: εἰ κακῶς ἐλάλησα, μαρτύρησον περὶ τοῦ κακοῦ: εἰ δὲ καλῶς, τί με δέρεις;

text_en: And Annas sent him bound to Caiphas the high priest .
text_la: Et misit eum Annas ligatum ad Caipham pontificem.
text_pt: E Anás mandou-o, maniatado, ao sumo sacerdote Caifás.
text_el: ἀπέστειλεν οὖν αὐτὸν ὁ Ἅννας δεδεμένον πρὸς Καϊάφαν τὸν ἀρχιερέα.

text_en: And Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him: Are you not also one of his disciples ? He denied it and said: I am not.
text_la: Erat autem Simon Petrus stans, et calefaciens se. Dixerunt ergo ei : Numquid et tu ex discipulis ejus es? Negavit ille, et dixit : Non sum.
text_pt: E Simão Pedro estava ali, e aquentava-se. Disseram-lhe, pois: Não és também tu um dos seus discípulos? Ele negou, e disse: Não sou.
text_el: Ἦν δὲ Σίμων Πέτρος ἑστὼς καὶ θερμαινόμενος. εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ: μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ εἶ; ἠρνήσατο ἐκεῖνος καὶ εἶπεν: οὐκ εἰμί.

text_en: One of the servants of the high priest (a kinsman to him whose ear Peter cut off ) said to him: Did not I see you in the garden with him?
text_la: Dicit ei unus ex servis pontificis, cognatus ejus, cujus abscidit Petrus auriculam : Nonne ego te vidi in horto cum illo?
text_pt: E um dos servos do sumo sacerdote, parente daquele a quem Pedro cortara a orelha, disse: Não te vi eu no horto com ele?
text_el: λέγει εἷς ἐκ τῶν δούλων τοῦ ἀρχιερέως, συγγενὴς ὢν οὗ ἀπέκοψεν Πέτρος τὸ ὠτίον: οὐκ ἐγώ σε εἶδον ἐν τῷ κήπῳ μετ' αὐτοῦ;

text_en: Again therefore Peter denied: and immediately the cock crew.
text_la: Iterum ergo negavit Petrus : et statim gallus cantavit.
text_pt: E Pedro negou outra vez, e logo o galo cantou.
text_el: πάλιν οὖν ἠρνήσατο Πέτρος: καὶ εὐθέως ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν.

text_en: Then they led Jesus from Caiphas to the governor's hall. And it was morning: and they went not into the hall , that they might not be defiled, but that they might eat the pasch .
text_la: Adducunt ergo Jesum a Caipha in prætorium. Erat autem mane : et ipsi non introierunt in prætorium, ut non contaminarentur, sed ut manducarent Pascha.
text_pt: Depois levaram Jesus da casa de Caifás para a audiência. E era pela manhã cedo. E não entraram na audiência, para não se contaminarem, mas poderem comer a páscoa.
text_el: Ἄγουσιν οὖν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ Καϊάφα εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον: ἦν δὲ πρωΐ: καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐκ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον, ἵνα μὴ μιανθῶσιν ἀλλὰ φάγωσιν τὸ πάσχα.

text_en: Pilate therefore went out to them, and said: What accusation bring you against this man ?
text_la: Exivit ergo Pilatus ad eos foras, et dixit : Quam accusationem affertis adversus hominem hunc?
text_pt: Então Pilatos saiu fora e disse-lhes: Que acusação trazeis contra este homem?
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἔξω πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ φησίν: τίνα κατηγορίαν φέρετε τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου;

text_en: They answered and said to him: If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up to you.
text_la: Responderunt, et dixerunt ei : Si non esset hic malefactor, non tibi tradidissemus eum.
text_pt: Responderam, e disseram-lhe: Se este não fosse malfeitor, não to entregaríamos.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ: εἰ μὴ ἦν οὗτος κακὸν ποιῶν, οὐκ ἄν σοι παρεδώκαμεν αὐτόν.

text_en: Pilate therefore said to them: Take him you, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said to him: It is not lawful for us to put any man to death.
text_la: Dixit ergo eis Pilatus : Accipite eum vos, et secundum legem vestram judicate eum. Dixerunt ergo ei Judæi : Nobis non licet interficere quemquam.
text_pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Pilatos: Levai-o vós, e julgai-o segundo a vossa lei. Disseram-lhe então os judeus: A nós não nos é lícito matar pessoa alguma.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς Πιλᾶτος: λάβετε αὐτὸν ὑμεῖς καὶ κατὰ τὸν νόμον ὑμῶν κρίνατε. αὐτόν εἶπον αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι: ἡμῖν οὐκ ἔξεστιν ἀποκτεῖναι οὐδένα.

text_en: That the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he said, signifying what death he should die.
text_la: Ut sermo Jesu impleretur, quem dixit, significans qua morte esset moriturus.
text_pt: (Para que se cumprisse a palavra que Jesus tinha dito, significando de que morte havia de morrer).
text_el: ἵνα ὁ λόγος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ πληρωθῇ, ὃν εἶπεν σημαίνων ποίῳ θανάτῳ ἤμελλεν ἀποθνῄσκειν.

text_en: Pilate therefore went into the hall again and called Jesus and said to him: Are you the king of the Jews ?
text_la: Introivit ergo iterum in prætorium Pilatus : et vocavit Jesum, et dixit ei : Tu es rex Judæorum?
text_pt: Tornou, pois, a entrar Pilatos na audiência, e chamou a Jesus, e disse-lhe: Tu és o Rei dos Judeus?
text_el: Εἰσῆλθεν οὖν πάλιν εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον ὁ Πιλᾶτος καὶ ἐφώνησεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: σὺ εἶ ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων;

text_en: Jesus answered: Do you say this thing of yourself, or have others told it you of me?
text_la: Respondit Jesus : A temetipso hoc dicis, an alii dixerunt tibi de me?
text_pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Tu dizes isso de ti mesmo, ou disseram-to outros de mim?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς: ἀπὸ' σεαυτοῦ σὺ τοῦτο λέγεις, ἢ ἄλλοι εἶπόν σοι περὶ ἐμοῦ;

text_en: Pilate answered: Am I a Jew ? Your own nation and the chief priests have delivered you up to me. What have you done?
text_la: Respondit Pilatus : Numquid ego Judæus sum? gens tua et pontifices tradiderunt te mihi : quid fecisti?
text_pt: Pilatos respondeu: Porventura sou eu judeu? A tua nação e os principais dos sacerdotes entregaram-te a mim. Que fizeste?
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Πιλᾶτος: μήτι ἐγὼ Ἰουδαῖός εἰμι; τὸ ἔθνος τὸ σὸν καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς παρέδωκάν σε ἐμοί: τί ἐποίησας;

text_en: Jesus answered: My kingdom is not of this world. If my kingdom were of this world, my servants would certainly strive that I should not be delivered to the Jews : but now my kingdom is not from hence.
text_la: Respondit Jesus : Regnum meum non est de hoc mundo. Si ex hoc mundo esset regnum meum, ministri mei utique decertarent ut non traderer Judæis : nunc autem regnum meum non est hinc.
text_pt: Respondeu Jesus: O meu reino não é deste mundo; se o meu reino fosse deste mundo, pelejariam os meus servos, para que eu não fosse entregue aos judeus; mas agora o meu reino não é daqui.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς: ἡ βασιλεία ἡ ἐμὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου: εἰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἦν ἡ βασιλεία ἡ ἐμή, οἱ ὑπηρέται οἱ ἐμοὶ ἠγωνίζοντο ἄν, ἵνα μὴ παραδοθῶ τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις: νῦν δὲ ἡ βασιλεία ἡ ἐμὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐντεῦθεν.

text_en: Pilate therefore said to him: Are you a king then? Jesus answered: You say that I am a king. For this was I born, and for this came I into the world; that I should give testimony to the truth . Every one that is of the truth hears my voice.
text_la: Dixit itaque ei Pilatus : Ergo rex es tu? Respondit Jesus : Tu dicis quia rex sum ego. Ego in hoc natus sum, et ad hoc veni in mundum, ut testimonium perhibeam veritati : omnis qui est ex veritate, audit vocem meam.
text_pt: Disse-lhe, pois, Pilatos: Logo tu és rei? Jesus respondeu: Tu dizes que eu sou rei. Eu para isso nasci, e para isso vim ao mundo, a fim de dar testemunho da verdade. Todo aquele que é da verdade ouve a minha voz.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ Πιλᾶτος: οὐκοῦν βασιλεὺς εἶ σύ; ἀπεκρίθη [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: σὺ λέγεις, ὅτι βασιλεύς εἰμι. ἐγὼ εἰς τοῦτο γεγέννημαι καὶ εἰς τοῦτο ἐλήλυθα εἰς τὸν κόσμον, ἵνα μαρτυρήσω τῇ ἀληθείᾳ: πᾶς ὁ ὢν ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας ἀκούει μου τῆς φωνῆς.

text_en: Pilate said to him: What is truth ? And when he said this, he went out again to the Jews and says to them: I find no cause in him.
text_la: Dicit ei Pilatus : Quid est veritas? Et cum hoc dixisset, iterum exivit ad Judæos, et dicit eis : Ego nullam invenio in eo causam.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Pilatos: Que é a verdade? E, dizendo isto, tornou a ir ter com os judeus, e disse-lhes: Não acho nele crime algum.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πιλᾶτος: τί ἐστιν ἀλήθεια; καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν πάλιν ἐξῆλθεν πρὸς τοὺς Ἰουδαίους, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: ἐγὼ οὐδεμίαν εὑρίσκω ἐν αὐτῷ αἰτίαν.

text_en: But you have a custom that I should release one unto you at the Pasch . Will you, therefore, that I release unto you the king of the Jews ?
text_la: Est autem consuetudo vobis ut unum dimittam vobis in Pascha: vultis ergo dimittam vobis regem Judæorum?
text_pt: Mas vós tendes por costume que eu vos solte alguém pela páscoa. Quereis, pois, que vos solte o Rei dos Judeus?
text_el: ἔστιν δὲ συνήθεια ὑμῖν ἵνα ἕνα ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν [ἐν] τῷ πάσχα: βούλεσθε οὖν ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν τὸν βασιλέα τῶν Ἰουδαίων;

text_en: Then cried they all again, saying: Not this man , but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
text_la: Clamaverunt ergo rursum omnes, dicentes : Non hunc, sed Barabbam. Erat autem Barabbas latro.
text_pt: Então todos tornaram a clamar, dizendo: Este não, mas Barrabás. E Barrabás era um salteador.
text_el: ἐκραύγασαν οὖν πάλιν λέγοντες: μὴ τοῦτον, ἀλλὰ τὸν Βαραββᾶν. ἦν δὲ ὁ Βαραββᾶς λῃστής.

text_en: Then therefore Pilate took Jesus and scourged him.
text_la: Tunc ergo apprehendit Pilatus Jesum, et flagellavit.
text_pt: Pilatos, pois, tomou então a Jesus, e o açoitou.
text_el: Τότε οὖν ἔλαβεν ὁ Πιλᾶτος τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἐμαστίγωσεν.

text_en: And the soldiers platting a crown of thorns , put it upon his head: and they put on him a purple garment.
text_la: Et milites plectentes coronam de spinis, imposuerunt capiti ejus : et veste purpurea circumdederunt eum.
text_pt: E os soldados, tecendo uma coroa de espinhos, lha puseram sobre a cabeça, e lhe vestiram roupa de púrpura.
text_el: καὶ οἱ στρατιῶται πλέξαντες στέφανον ἐξ ἀκανθῶν ἐπέθηκαν αὐτοῦ τῇ κεφαλῇ, καὶ ἱμάτιον πορφυροῦν περιέβαλον αὐτόν,

text_en: And they came to him and said: Hail, king of the Jews . And they gave him blows.
text_la: Et veniebant ad eum, et dicebant : Ave, rex Judæorum : et dabant ei alapas.
text_pt: E diziam: Salve, Rei dos Judeus. E davam-lhe bofetadas.
text_el: καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἔλεγον: χαῖρε, ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων: καὶ ἐδίδοσαν αὐτῷ ῥαπίσματα.

text_en: Pilate therefore went forth again and says to them: Behold, I bring him forth unto you, that you may know that I find no cause in him.
text_la: Exivit ergo iterum Pilatus foras, et dicit eis : Ecce adduco vobis eum foras, ut cognoscatis quia nullam invenio in eo causam.
text_pt: Então Pilatos saiu outra vez fora, e disse-lhes: Eis aqui vo-lo trago fora, para que saibais que não acho nele crime algum.
text_el: καὶ Ἐξῆλθεν πάλιν ἔξω ὁ Πιλᾶτος καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: ἴδε ἄγω ὑμῖν αὐτὸν ἔξω, ἵνα γνῶτε ὅτι οὐδεμίαν αἰτίαν εὑρίσκω ἐν αὐτῷ.

text_en: ( Jesus therefore came forth, bearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment.) And he says to them: Behold the Man.
text_la: (Exivit ergo Jesus portans coronam spineam, et purpureum vestimentum.) Et dicit eis : Ecce homo.
text_pt: Saiu, pois, Jesus fora, levando a coroa de espinhos e roupa de púrpura. E disse-lhes Pilatos: Eis aqui o homem.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν οὖν [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς ἔξω, φορῶν τὸν ἀκάνθινον στέφανον καὶ τὸ πορφυροῦν ἱμάτιον. καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: ἰδοὺ ὁ ἄνθρωπος.

text_en: When the chief priests , therefore, and the servants had seen him, they cried out, saying: Crucify him, Crucify him. Pilate says to them: Take him you, and crucify him: for I find no cause in him.
text_la: Cum ergo vidissent eum pontifices et ministri, clamabant, dicentes : Crucifige, crucifige eum. Dicit eis Pilatus : Accipite eum vos, et crucifigite : ego enim non invenio in eo causam.
text_pt: Vendo-o, pois, os principais dos sacerdotes e os servos, clamaram, dizendo: Crucifica-o, crucifica-o. Disse-lhes Pilatos: Tomai-o vós, e crucificai-o; porque eu nenhum crime acho nele.
text_el: ὅτε οὖν εἶδον αὐτὸν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται, ἐκραύγασαν: λέγοντες σταύρωσον σταύρωσον. λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος: λάβετε αὐτὸν ὑμεῖς καὶ σταυρώσατε, ἐγὼ γὰρ οὐχ εὑρίσκω ἐν αὐτῷ αἰτίαν.

text_en: The Jews answered him: We have a law ; and according to the law he ought to die , because he made himself the Son of God .
text_la: Responderunt ei Judæi : Nos legem habemus, et secundum legem debet mori, quia Filium Dei se fecit.
text_pt: Responderam-lhe os judeus: Nós temos uma lei e, segundo a nossa lei, deve morrer, porque se fez Filho de Deus.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι: ἡμεῖς νόμον ἔχομεν, καὶ κατὰ τὸν νόμον ὀφείλει ἀποθανεῖν, ὅτι υἱὸν θεοῦ ἑαυτὸν ἐποίησεν.

text_en: When Pilate therefore had heard this saying, he feared the more.
text_la: Cum ergo audisset Pilatus hunc sermonem, magis timuit.
text_pt: E Pilatos, quando ouviu esta palavra, mais atemorizado ficou.
text_el: Ὅτε οὖν ἤκουσεν ὁ Πιλᾶτος τοῦτον τὸν λόγον, μᾶλλον ἐφοβήθη,

text_en: And he entered into the hall again; and he said to Jesus : Whence are you? But Jesus gave him no answer.
text_la: Et ingressus est prætorium iterum : et dixit ad Jesum : Unde es tu? Jesus autem responsum non dedit ei.
text_pt: E entrou outra vez na audiência, e disse a Jesus: De onde és tu? Mas Jesus não lhe deu resposta.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον πάλιν καὶ λέγει τῷ Ἰησοῦ: πόθεν εἶ σύ; ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀπόκρισιν οὐκ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ.

text_en: Pilate therefore said to him: Do you not speak to me? Do you not know that I have power to crucify you, and I have power to release you?
text_la: Dicit ergo ei Pilatus : Mihi non loqueris? nescis quia potestatem habeo crucifigere te, et potestatem habeo dimittere te?
text_pt: Disse-lhe, pois, Pilatos: Não me falas a mim? Não sabes tu que tenho poder para te crucificar e tenho poder para te soltar?
text_el: λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ Πιλᾶτος: ἐμοὶ οὐ λαλεῖς; οὐκ οἶδας ὅτι ἐξουσίαν ἔχω ἀπολῦσαί σε καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔχω σταυρῶσαί σε;

text_en: Jesus answered: You should not have any power against me, unless it were given you from above. Therefore, he that has delivered me to you has the greater sin .
text_la: Respondit Jesus : Non haberes potestatem adversum me ullam, nisi tibi datum esset desuper. Propterea qui me tradidit tibi, majus peccatum habet.
text_pt: Respondeu Jesus: Nenhum poder terias contra mim, se de cima não te fosse dado; mas aquele que me entregou a ti maior pecado tem.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς: οὐκ εἶχες ἐξουσίαν κατ' ἐμοῦ οὐδεμίαν εἰ μὴ ἦν δεδομένον σοι ἄνωθεν: διὰ τοῦτο ὁ παραδούς μέ σοι μείζονα ἁμαρτίαν ἔχει.

text_en: And from henceforth Pilate sought to release him. But the Jews cried out, saying: If you release this man , you are not Caesar's friend. For whosoever makes himself a king speaks against Caesar .
text_la: Et exinde quærebat Pilatus dimittere eum. Judæi autem clamabant dicentes : Si hunc dimittis, non es amicus Cæsaris. Omnis enim qui se regem facit, contradicit Cæsari.
text_pt: Desde então Pilatos procurava soltá-lo; mas os judeus clamavam, dizendo: Se soltas este, não és amigo de César; qualquer que se faz rei é contra César.
text_el: ἐκ τούτου ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἐζήτει ἀπολῦσαι αὐτόν: οἱ δὲ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐκραύγασαν λέγοντες: ἐὰν τοῦτον ἀπολύσῃς, οὐκ εἶ φίλος τοῦ Καίσαρος: πᾶς ὁ βασιλέα ἑαυτὸν ποιῶν ἀντιλέγει τῷ Καίσαρι.

text_en: Now when Pilate had heard these words, he brought Jesus forth and sat down in the judgment seat, in the place that is called Lithostrotos , and in Hebrew Gabbatha .
text_la: Pilatus autem cum audisset hos sermones, adduxit foras Jesum : et sedit pro tribunali, in loco qui dicitur Lithostrotos, hebraice autem Gabbatha.
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, Pilatos este dito, levou Jesus para fora, e assentou-se no tribunal, no lugar chamado Litóstrotos, e em hebraico Gabatá.
text_el: ὁ οὖν Πιλᾶτος ἀκούσας τῶν λόγων τούτων ἤγαγεν ἔξω τὸν Ἰησοῦν, καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐπὶ βήματος εἰς τόπον λεγόμενον λιθόστρωτον, Ἑβραϊστὶ δὲ Γαββαθα.

text_en: And it was the parasceve of the pasch , about the sixth hour : and he says to the Jews : Behold your king.
text_la: Erat autem parasceve Paschæ, hora quasi sexta, et dicit Judæis : Ecce rex vester.
text_pt: E era a preparação da páscoa, e quase à hora sexta; e disse aos judeus: Eis aqui o vosso Rei.
text_el: ἦν δὲ παρασκευὴ τοῦ πάσχα, ὥρα ἦν ὡς ἕκτη. καὶ λέγει τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις: ἴδε ὁ βασιλεὺς ὑμῶν.

text_en: But they cried out: Away with him: Away with him: Crucify him. Pilate says to them: shall I crucify your king? The chief priests answered: We have no king but Caesar .
text_la: Illi autem clamabant : Tolle, tolle, crucifige eum. Dicit eis Pilatus : Regem vestrum crucifigam? Responderunt pontifices : Non habemus regem, nisi Cæsarem.
text_pt: Mas eles bradaram: Tira, tira, crucifica-o. Disse-lhes Pilatos: Hei de crucificar o vosso Rei? Responderam os principais dos sacerdotes: Não temos rei, senão César.
text_el: ἐκραύγασαν οὖν ἐκεῖνοι: ἆρον ἆρον, σταύρωσον αὐτόν. λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος: τὸν βασιλέα ὑμῶν σταυρώσω; ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς: οὐκ ἔχομεν βασιλέα εἰ μὴ Καίσαρα.

text_en: Then therefore he delivered him to them to be crucified. And they took Jesus and led him forth.
text_la: Tunc ergo tradidit eis illum ut crucifigeretur. Susceperunt autem Jesum, et eduxerunt.
text_pt: Então, consequentemente entregou-lho, para que fosse crucificado. E tomaram a Jesus, e o levaram.
text_el: τότε οὖν παρέδωκεν αὐτὸν αὐτοῖς ἵνα σταυρωθῇ. Παρέλαβον οὖν τὸν Ἰησοῦν,

text_en: And bearing his own cross , he went forth to the place which is called Calvary , but in Hebrew Golgotha .
text_la: Et bajulans sibi crucem exivit in eum, qui dicitur Calvariæ locum, hebraice autem Golgotha:
text_pt: E, levando ele às costas a sua cruz, saiu para o lugar chamado Caveira, que em hebraico se chama Gólgota,
text_el: καὶ βαστάζων ἑαυτῷ τὸν σταυρὸν ἐξῆλθεν εἰς τὸν λεγόμενον Κρανίου τόπον, ὃ λέγεται Ἑβραϊστὶ Γολγοθᾶ,

text_en: Where they crucified him, and with him two others, one on each side, and Jesus in the midst.
text_la: ubi crucifixerunt eum, et cum eo alios duos hinc et hinc, medium autem Jesum.
text_pt: Onde o crucificaram, e com ele outros dois, um de cada lado, e Jesus no meio.
text_el: ὅπου αὐτὸν ἐσταύρωσαν, καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἄλλους δύο ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ἐντεῦθεν, μέσον δὲ τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: And Pilate wrote a title also: and he put it upon the cross . And the writing was: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
text_la: Scripsit autem et titulum Pilatus, et posuit super crucem. Erat autem scriptum : Jesus Nazarenus, Rex Judæorum.
text_pt: E Pilatos escreveu também um título, e pô-lo em cima da cruz; e nele estava escrito: JESUS NAZARENO, O REI DOS JUDEUS.
text_el: ἔγραψεν δὲ καὶ τίτλον ὁ Πιλᾶτος καὶ ἔθηκεν ἐπὶ τοῦ σταυροῦ: ἦν δὲ γεγραμμένον, Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζωραῖος ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων.

text_en: This title therefore many of the Jews did read: because the place where Jesus was crucified was near to the city. And it was written in Hebrew , in Greek, and in Latin .
text_la: Hunc ergo titulum multi Judæorum legerunt : quia prope civitatem erat locus, ubi crucifixus est Jesus, et erat scriptum hebraice, græce, et latine.
text_pt: E muitos dos judeus leram este título; porque o lugar onde Jesus estava crucificado era próximo da cidade; e estava escrito em hebraico, grego e latim.
text_el: τοῦτον οὖν τὸν τίτλον πολλοὶ ἀνέγνωσαν τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ὅτι ἐγγὺς ἦν ὁ τόπος τῆς πόλεως ὅπου ἐσταυρώθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς: καὶ ἦν γεγραμμένον Ἑβραϊστί, Ῥωμαϊστί, Ἑλληνιστί.

text_en: Then the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate : Write not: The King of the Jews . But that he said: I am the King of the Jews .
text_la: Dicebant ergo Pilato pontifices Judæorum : Noli scribere : Rex Judæorum : sed quia ipse dixit : Rex sum Judæorum.
text_pt: Diziam, pois, os principais sacerdotes dos judeus a Pilatos: Não escrevas, O Rei dos Judeus, mas que ele disse: Sou o Rei dos Judeus.
text_el: ἔλεγον οὖν τῷ Πιλάτῳ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς τῶν Ἰουδαίων: μὴ γράφε: ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ἀλλ' ὅτι ἐκεῖνος εἶπεν: βασιλεύς τῶν Ἰουδαίων εἰμι.

text_en: Pilate answered: What I have written, I have written.
text_la: Respondit Pilatus : Quod scripsi, scripsi.
text_pt: Respondeu Pilatos: O que escrevi, escrevi.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Πιλᾶτος: ὃ γέγραφα, γέγραφα.

text_en: The soldiers therefore, when they had crucified him, took his garments, (and they made four parts, to every soldier a part) and also his coat . Now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
text_la: Milites ergo cum crucifixissent eum, acceperunt vestimenta ejus (et fecerunt quatuor partes, unicuique militi partem) et tunicam. Erat autem tunica inconsutilis, desuper contexta per totum.
text_pt: Tendo, pois, os soldados crucificado a Jesus, tomaram as suas vestes, e fizeram quatro partes, para cada soldado uma parte; e também a túnica. A túnica, porém, tecida toda de alto a baixo, não tinha costura.
text_el: Οἱ οὖν στρατιῶται, ὅτε ἐσταύρωσαν τὸν Ἰησοῦν, ἔλαβον τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐποίησαν τέσσαρα μέρη, ἑκάστῳ στρατιώτῃ μέρος, καὶ τὸν χιτῶνα. ἦν δὲ ὁ χιτὼν ἄραφος, ἐκ τῶν ἄνωθεν ὑφαντὸς δι' ὅλου.

text_en: They said then one to another: Let us not cut it but let us cast lots for it, whose it shall be; that the scripture might be fulfilled, saying: They have parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture they have cast lots . And the soldiers indeed did these things.
text_la: Dixerunt ergo ad invicem : Non scindamus eam, sed sortiamur de illa cujus sit. Ut Scriptura impleretur, dicens : Partiti sunt vestimenta mea sibi : et in vestem meam miserunt sortem. Et milites quidem hæc fecerunt.
text_pt: Disseram, pois, uns aos outros: Não a rasguemos, mas lancemos sortes sobre ela, para ver de quem será. Para que se cumprisse a Escritura que diz: Repartiram entre si as minhas vestes, E sobre a minha vestidura lançaram sortes. Os soldados, pois, fizeram estas coisas.
text_el: εἶπαν οὖν πρὸς ἀλλήλους: μὴ σχίσωμεν αὐτόν, ἀλλὰ λάχωμεν περὶ αὐτοῦ, τίνος ἔσται. ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ: διεμερίσαντο τὰ ἱμάτιά μου ἑαυτοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν ἱματισμόν μου ἔβαλον κλῆρον. Οἱ μὲν οὖν στρατιῶται ταῦτα ἐποίησαν.

text_en: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus , his mother and his mother's sister, Mary of Cleophas , and Mary Magdalen .
text_la: Stabant autem juxta crucem Jesu mater ejus, et soror matris ejus, Maria Cleophæ, et Maria Magdalene.
text_pt: E junto à cruz de Jesus estava sua mãe, e a irmã de sua mãe, Maria mulher de Clopas, e Maria Madalena.
text_el: εἱστήκεισαν δὲ παρὰ τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ ἀδελφὴ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ, Μαρία ἡ τοῦ Κλωπᾶ καὶ Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνή.

text_en: When Jesus therefore had seen his mother and the disciple standing whom he loved , he says to his mother : Woman , behold your son.
text_la: Cum vidisset ergo Jesus matrem, et discipulum stantem, quem diligebat, dicit matri suæ : Mulier, ecce filius tuus.
text_pt: Ora Jesus, vendo ali sua mãe, e que o discípulo a quem ele amava estava presente, disse a sua mãe: Mulher, eis aí o teu filho.
text_el: Ἰησοῦς οὖν ἰδὼν τὴν μητέρα καὶ τὸν μαθητὴν παρεστῶτα ὃν ἠγάπα, λέγει τῇ μητρί: γύναι, ἴδε ὁ υἱός σου.

text_en: After that, he says to the disciple : Behold your mother. And from that hour, the disciple took her to his own.
text_la: Deinde dicit discipulo : Ecce mater tua. Et ex illa hora accepit eam discipulus in sua.
text_pt: Depois disse ao discípulo: Eis aí tua mãe. E desde aquela hora o discípulo a recebeu em sua casa.
text_el: εἶτα λέγει τῷ μαθητῇ: ἴδε ἡ μήτηρ σου. καὶ ἀπ' ἐκείνης τῆς ὥρας ἔλαβεν ὁ μαθητὴς αὐτὴν εἰς τὰ ἴδια.

text_en: Afterwards, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, said: I thirst.
text_la: Postea sciens Jesus quia omnia consummata sunt, ut consummaretur Scriptura, dixit : Sitio.
text_pt: Depois, sabendo Jesus que já todas as coisas estavam terminadas, para que a Escritura se cumprisse, disse: Tenho sede.
text_el: Μετὰ τοῦτο εἰδὼς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤδη πάντα τετέλεσται, ἵνα τελειωθῇ ἡ γραφή, λέγει: διψῶ.

text_en: Now there was a vessel set there, full of vinegar. And they, putting a sponge full of vinegar about hyssop , put it to his mouth.
text_la: Vas ergo erat positum aceto plenum. Illi autem spongiam plenam aceto, hyssopo circumponentes, obtulerunt ori ejus.
text_pt: Estava, pois, ali um vaso cheio de vinagre. E encheram de vinagre uma esponja, e, pondo-a num hissopo, lha chegaram à boca.
text_el: σκεῦος ἔκειτο ὄξους μεστόν: σπόγγον οὖν μεστὸν τοῦ ὄξους ὑσσώπῳ περιθέντες προσήνεγκαν αὐτοῦ τῷ στόματι.

text_en: Jesus therefore, when he had taken the vinegar, said: It is consummated. And bowing his head, he gave up the ghost .
text_la: Cum ergo accepisset Jesus acetum, dixit : Consummatum est. Et inclinato capite tradidit spiritum.
text_pt: E, quando Jesus tomou o vinagre, disse: Está consumado. E, inclinando a cabeça, entregou o espírito.
text_el: ὅτε οὖν ἔλαβεν τὸ ὄξος ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν: τετέλεσται, καὶ κλίνας τὴν κεφαλὴν παρέδωκεν τὸ πνεῦμα.

text_en: Then the Jews (because it was the parasceve ), that the bodies might not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day (for that was a great sabbath day ), besought Pilate that their legs might be broken: and that they might be taken away.
text_la: Judæi ergo (quoniam parasceve erat) ut non remanerent in cruce corpora sabbato (erat enim magnus dies ille sabbati), rogaverunt Pilatum ut frangerentur eorum crura, et tollerentur.
text_pt: Os judeus, pois, para que no sábado não ficassem os corpos na cruz, visto como era a preparação (pois era grande o dia de sábado), rogaram a Pilatos que se lhes quebrassem as pernas, e fossem tirados.
text_el: Οἱ οὖν Ἰουδαῖοι, ἐπεὶ παρασκευὴ ἦν, ἵνα μὴ μείνῃ ἐπὶ τοῦ σταυροῦ τὰ σώματα ἐν τῷ σαββάτῳ, ἦν γὰρ μεγάλη ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνου τοῦ σαββάτου, ἠρώτησαν τὸν Πιλᾶτον ἵνα κατεαγῶσιν αὐτῶν τὰ σκέλη καὶ ἀρθῶσιν.

text_en: The soldiers therefore came: and they broke the legs of the first, and of the other that was crucified with him.
text_la: Venerunt ergo milites : et primi quidem fregerunt crura, et alterius, qui crucifixus est cum eo.
text_pt: Foram, pois, os soldados, e, na verdade, quebraram as pernas ao primeiro, e ao outro que como ele fora crucificado;
text_el: ἦλθον οὖν οἱ στρατιῶται, καὶ τοῦ μὲν πρώτου κατέαξαν τὰ σκέλη καὶ τοῦ ἄλλου τοῦ συσταυρωθέντος αὐτῷ:

text_en: But after they had come to Jesus , when they saw that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.
text_la: Ad Jesum autem cum venissent, ut viderunt eum jam mortuum, non fregerunt ejus crura,
text_pt: Mas, vindo a Jesus, e vendo-o já morto, não lhe quebraram as pernas.
text_el: ἐπὶ δὲ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐλθόντες, ὡς εἶδον ἤδη αὐτὸν τεθνηκότα, οὐ κατέαξαν αὐτοῦ τὰ σκέλη,

text_en: But one of the soldiers with a spear opened his side: and immediately there came out blood and water.
text_la: sed unus militum lancea latus ejus aperuit, et continuo exivit sanguis et aqua.
text_pt: Contudo um dos soldados lhe furou o lado com uma lança, e logo saiu sangue e água.
text_el: ἀλλ' εἷς τῶν στρατιωτῶν λόγχῃ αὐτοῦ τὴν πλευρὰν ἔνυξεν, καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εὐθὺς αἷμα καὶ ὕδωρ.

text_en: And he that saw it has given testimony: and his testimony is true . And he knows that he says true : that you also may believe .
text_la: Et qui vidit, testimonium perhibuit : et verum est testimonium ejus. Et ille scit quia vera dicit : ut et vos credatis.
text_pt: E aquele que o viu testificou, e o seu testemunho é verdadeiro; e sabe que é verdade o que diz, para que também vós o creiais.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἑωρακὼς μεμαρτύρηκεν, καὶ ἀληθινὴ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία, καὶ ἐκεῖνος οἶδεν ὅτι ἀληθῆ λέγει, ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς πιστεύητε.

text_en: For these things were done that the scripture might be fulfilled: You shall not break a bone of him.
text_la: Facta sunt enim hæc ut Scriptura impleretur : Os non comminuetis ex eo.
text_pt: Porque isto aconteceu para que se cumprisse a Escritura, que diz: Nenhum dos seus ossos será quebrado.
text_el: ἐγένετο γὰρ ταῦτα ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ: ὀστοῦν οὐ συντριβήσεται αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And again another scripture says: They shall look on him whom they pierced.
text_la: Et iterum alia Scriptura dicit : Videbunt in quem transfixerunt.
text_pt: E outra vez diz a Escritura: Verão aquele que traspassaram.
text_el: καὶ πάλιν ἑτέρα γραφὴ λέγει: ὄψονται εἰς ὃν ἐξεκέντησαν.

text_en: And after these things, Joseph of Arimathea (because he was a disciple of Jesus , but secretly for fear of the Jews ), besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus . And Pilate gave leave. He came therefore and took away the body of Jesus .
text_la: Post hæc autem rogavit Pilatum Joseph ab Arimathæa (eo quod esset discipulus Jesu, occultus autem propter metum Judæorum), ut tolleret corpus Jesu. Et permisit Pilatus. Venit ergo, et tulit corpus Jesu.
text_pt: Depois disto, José de Arimatéia (o que era discípulo de Jesus, mas oculto, por medo dos judeus) rogou a Pilatos que lhe permitisse tirar o corpo de Jesus. E Pilatos lho permitiu. Então foi e tirou o corpo de Jesus.
text_el: Μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα ἠρώτησεν τὸν Πιλᾶτον Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ Ἁριμαθαίας, ὢν μαθητὴς [τοῦ] Ἰησοῦ κεκρυμμένος δὲ διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ἵνα ἄρῃ τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ: καὶ ἐπέτρεψεν ὁ Πιλᾶτος. ἦλθεν οὖν καὶ ἦρεν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And Nicodemus also came (he who at the first came to Jesus by night), bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
text_la: Venit autem et Nicodemus, qui venerat ad Jesum nocte primum, ferens mixturam myrrhæ et aloës, quasi libras centum.
text_pt: E foi também Nicodemos (aquele que anteriormente se dirigira de noite a Jesus), levando quase cem arráteis de um composto de mirra e aloés.
text_el: ἦλθεν δὲ καὶ Νικόδημος, ὁ ἐλθὼν πρὸς αὐτὸν νυκτὸς τὸ πρῶτον, φέρων ἕλιγμα σμύρνης καὶ ἀλόης ὡς λίτρας ἑκατόν.

text_en: They took therefore the body of Jesus and bound it in linen cloths , with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
text_la: Acceperunt ergo corpus Jesu, et ligaverunt illud linteis cum aromatibus, sicut mos est Judæis sepelire.
text_pt: Tomaram, pois, o corpo de Jesus e o envolveram em lençóis com as especiarias, como os judeus costumam fazer, na preparação para o sepulcro.
text_el: ἔλαβον οὖν τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἔδησαν αὐτὸ ὀθονίοις μετὰ τῶν ἀρωμάτων, καθὼς ἔθος ἐστὶν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ἐνταφιάζειν.

text_en: Now there was in the place where he was crucified a garden: and in the garden a new sepulchre , wherein no man yet had been laid.
text_la: Erat autem in loco, ubi crucifixus est, hortus : et in horto monumentum novum, in quo nondum quisquam positus erat.
text_pt: E havia um horto naquele lugar onde fora crucificado, e no horto um sepulcro novo, em que ainda ninguém havia sido posto.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ὅπου ἐσταυρώθη κῆπος, καὶ ἐν τῷ κήπῳ μνημεῖον καινὸν, ἐν ᾧ οὐδέπω οὐδεὶς ἦν τεθειμένος:

text_en: There, therefore, because of the parasceve of the Jews , they laid Jesus : because the sepulchre was near at hand.
text_la: Ibi ergo propter parasceven Judæorum, quia juxta erat monumentum, posuerunt Jesum.
text_pt: Ali, pois (por causa da preparação dos judeus, e por estar perto aquele sepulcro), puseram a Jesus.
text_el: ἐκεῖ οὖν διὰ τὴν παρασκευὴν τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ὅτι ἐγγὺς ἦν τὸ μνημεῖον, ἔθηκαν τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

text_en: And on the first day of the week , Mary Magdalen comes early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre : and she saw the stone taken away from the sepulchre .
text_la: Una autem sabbati, Maria Magdalene venit mane, cum adhuc tenebræ essent, ad monumentum : et vidit lapidem sublatum a monumento.
text_pt: E no primeiro dia da semana, Maria Madalena foi ao sepulcro de madrugada, sendo ainda escuro, e viu a pedra tirada do sepulcro.
text_el: Τῇ δὲ μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ ἔρχεται πρωῒ σκοτίας ἔτι οὔσης εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον, καὶ βλέπει τὸν λίθον ἠρμένον ἐκ τοῦ μνημείου.

text_en: She ran therefore and comes to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved and says to them: They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre : and we know not where they have laid him.
text_la: Cucurrit ergo, et venit ad Simonem Petrum, et ad alium discipulum, quem amabat Jesus, et dicit illis : Tulerunt Dominum de monumento, et nescimus ubi posuerunt eum.
text_pt: Correu, pois, e foi a Simão Pedro, e ao outro discípulo, a quem Jesus amava, e disse-lhes: Levaram o Senhor do sepulcro, e não sabemos onde o puseram.
text_el: τρέχει οὖν καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς Σίμωνα Πέτρον καὶ πρὸς τὸν ἄλλον μαθητὴν ὃν ἐφίλει ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: ἦραν τὸν κύριον ἐκ τοῦ μνημείου, καὶ οὐκ οἴδαμεν ποῦ ἔθηκαν αὐτόν.

text_en: Peter therefore went out, and the other disciple : and they came to the sepulchre .
text_la: Exiit ergo Petrus, et ille alius discipulus, et venerunt ad monumentum.
text_pt: Então Pedro saiu com o outro discípulo, e foram ao sepulcro.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ Πέτρος καὶ ὁ ἄλλος μαθητής, καὶ ἤρχοντο εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον.

text_en: And they both ran together: and that other disciple did outrun Peter and came first to the sepulchre .
text_la: Currebant autem duo simul, et ille alius discipulus præcucurrit citius Petro, et venit primus ad monumentum.
text_pt: E os dois corriam juntos, mas o outro discípulo correu mais apressadamente do que Pedro, e chegou primeiro ao sepulcro.
text_el: ἔτρεχον δὲ οἱ δύο ὁμοῦ: καὶ ὁ ἄλλος μαθητὴς προέδραμεν τάχιον τοῦ Πέτρου καὶ ἦλθεν πρῶτος εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον,

text_en: And when he stooped down, he saw the linen cloths lying: but yet he went not in.
text_la: Et cum se inclinasset, vidit posita linteamina : non tamen introivit.
text_pt: E, abaixando-se, viu no chão os lençóis; todavia não entrou.
text_el: καὶ παρακύψας βλέπει κείμενα τὰ ὀθόνια, οὐ μέντοι εἰσῆλθεν.

text_en: Then comes Simon Peter , following him, and went into the sepulchre : and saw the linen cloths lying,
text_la: Venit ergo Simon Petrus sequens eum, et introivit in monumentum, et vidit linteamina posita,
text_pt: Chegou, pois, Simão Pedro, que o seguia, e entrou no sepulcro, e viu no chão os lençóis,
text_el: ἔρχεται οὖν καὶ Σίμων Πέτρος ἀκολουθῶν αὐτῷ, καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον, καὶ θεωρεῖ τὰ ὀθόνια κείμενα,

text_en: and the napkin that had been about his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but apart, wrapped up into one place.
text_la: et sudarium, quod fuerat super caput ejus, non cum linteaminibus positum, sed separatim involutum in unum locum.
text_pt: E que o lenço, que tinha estado sobre a sua cabeça, não estava com os lençóis, mas enrolado num lugar à parte.
text_el: καὶ τὸ σουδάριον, ὃ ἦν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ, οὐ μετὰ τῶν ὀθονίων κείμενον ἀλλὰ χωρὶς ἐντετυλιγμένον εἰς ἕνα τόπον.

text_en: Then that other disciple also went in, who came first to the sepulchre : and he saw and believed .
text_la: Tunc ergo introivit et ille discipulus qui venerat primus ad monumentum : et vidit, et credidit:
text_pt: Então entrou também o outro discípulo, que chegara primeiro ao sepulcro, e viu, e creu.
text_el: τότε οὖν εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ὁ ἄλλος μαθητὴς ὁ ἐλθὼν πρῶτος εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον, καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἐπίστευσεν:

text_en: For as yet they knew not the scripture , that he must rise again from the dead .
text_la: nondum enim sciebant Scripturam, quia oportebat eum a mortuis resurgere.
text_pt: Porque ainda não sabiam a Escritura, que era necessário que ressuscitasse dentre os mortos.
text_el: οὐδέπω γὰρ ᾔδεισαν τὴν γραφὴν ὅτι δεῖ αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῆναι.

text_en: The disciples therefore departed again to their home.
text_la: Abierunt ergo iterum discipuli ad semetipsos.
text_pt: Tornaram, pois, os discípulos para casa.
text_el: ἀπῆλθον οὖν πάλιν πρὸς αὐτοὺς οἱ μαθηταί.

text_en: But Mary stood at the sepulchre without, weeping. Now as she was weeping, she stooped down and looked into the sepulchre ,
text_la: Maria autem stabat ad monumentum foris, plorans. Dum ergo fleret, inclinavit se, et prospexit in monumentum:
text_pt: E Maria estava chorando fora, junto ao sepulcro. Estando ela, pois, chorando, abaixou-se para o sepulcro.
text_el: Μαρία δὲ εἱστήκει πρὸς τῷ μνημείῳ ἔξω κλαίουσα. ὡς οὖν ἔκλαιεν παρέκυψεν εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον,

text_en: and she saw two angels in white, sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had been laid.
text_la: et vidit duos angelos in albis sedentes, unum ad caput, et unum ad pedes, ubi positum fuerat corpus Jesu.
text_pt: E viu dois anjos vestidos de branco, assentados onde jazera o corpo de Jesus, um à cabeceira e outro aos pés.
text_el: καὶ θεωρεῖ δύο ἀγγέλους ἐν λευκοῖς καθεζομένους, ἕνα πρὸς τῇ κεφαλῇ καὶ ἕνα πρὸς τοῖς ποσίν, ὅπου ἔκειτο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: They say to her: Woman , why do you weep? She says to them: Because they have taken away my Lord: and I know not where they have laid him.
text_la: Dicunt ei illi : Mulier, quid ploras? Dicit eis : Quia tulerunt Dominum meum : et nescio ubi posuerunt eum.
text_pt: E disseram-lhe eles: Mulher, por que choras? Ela lhes disse: Porque levaram o meu Senhor, e não sei onde o puseram.
text_el: καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῇ ἐκεῖνοι: γύναι, τί κλαίεις; λέγει αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἦραν τὸν κύριόν μου, καὶ οὐκ οἶδα ποῦ ἔθηκαν αὐτόν.

text_en: When she had thus said, she turned herself back and saw Jesus standing: and she knew not that it was Jesus .
text_la: Hæc cum dixisset, conversa est retrorsum, et vidit Jesum stantem : et non sciebat quia Jesus est.
text_pt: E, tendo dito isto, voltou-se para trás, e viu Jesus em pé, mas não sabia que era Jesus.
text_el: ταῦτα εἰποῦσα ἐστράφη εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω, καὶ θεωρεῖ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἑστῶτα, καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν.

text_en: Jesus says to her: Woman , why do you weep? Whom do you seek? She, thinking that it was the gardener, said to him: Sir, if you have taken him hence, tell me where you have laid him: and I will take him away.
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Mulier, quid ploras? quem quæris? Illa existimans quia hortulanus esset, dicit ei : Domine, si tu sustulisti eum, dicito mihi ubi posuisti eum, et ego eum tollam.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Mulher, por que choras? Quem buscas? Ela, cuidando que era o hortelão, disse-lhe: Senhor, se tu o levaste, dize-me onde o puseste, e eu o levarei.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῇ Ἰησοῦς: γύναι, τί κλαίεις; τίνα ζητεῖς; ἐκείνη δοκοῦσα ὅτι ὁ κηπουρός ἐστιν, λέγει αὐτῷ: κύριε, εἰ σὺ ἐβάστασας αὐτόν, εἰπέ μοι ποῦ ἔθηκας αὐτόν, κἀγὼ αὐτὸν ἀρῶ.

text_en: Jesus says to her: Mary. She turning, said to him: Rabboni (which is to say, Master).
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Maria. Conversa illa, dicit ei : Rabboni (quod dicitur Magister).
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Maria! Ela, voltando-se, disse-lhe: Raboni, que quer dizer: Mestre.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῇ Ἰησοῦς: Μαριάμ. στραφεῖσα ἐκείνη λέγει αὐτῷ Ἑβραϊστί: Ραββουνι, ὃ λέγεται διδάσκαλε.

text_en: Jesus says to her: Do not touch me: for I am not yet ascended to my Father . But go to my brethren and say to them: I ascend to my Father and to your Father , to my God and to your God .
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Noli me tangere, nondum enim ascendi ad Patrem meum : vade autem ad fratres meos, et dic eis : Ascendo ad Patrem meum, et Patrem vestrum, Deum meum, et Deum vestrum.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Não me detenhas, porque ainda não subi para meu Pai, mas vai para meus irmãos, e dize-lhes que eu subo para meu Pai e vosso Pai, meu Deus e vosso Deus.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῇ Ἰησοῦς: μή μου ἅπτου: οὔπω γὰρ ἀναβέβηκα πρὸς τὸν πατέρα: πορεύου δὲ πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφούς μου καὶ εἰπὲ αὐτοῖς: ἀναβαίνω πρὸς τὸν πατέρα μου καὶ πατέρα ὑμῶν καὶ θεόν μου καὶ θεὸν ὑμῶν.

text_en: Mary Magdalen comes and tells the disciples : I have seen the Lord; and these things he said to me.
text_la: Venit Maria Magdalene annuntians discipulis : Quia vidi Dominum, et hæc dixit mihi.
text_pt: Maria Madalena foi e anunciou aos discípulos que vira o Senhor, e que ele lhe dissera isto.
text_el: ἔρχεται Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ ἀγγέλλουσα τοῖς μαθηταῖς ὅτι ἑώρακα τὸν κύριον, καὶ ταῦτα εἶπεν αὐτῇ.

text_en: Now when it was late the same day, the first of the week, and the doors were shut, where the disciples were gathered together, for fear of the Jews , Jesus came and stood in the midst and said to them: Peace be to you.
text_la: Cum ergo sero esset die illo, una sabbatorum, et fores essent clausæ, ubi erant discipuli congregati propter metum Judæorum : venit Jesus, et stetit in medio, et dixit eis : Pax vobis.
text_pt: Chegada, pois, a tarde daquele dia, o primeiro da semana, e cerradas as portas onde os discípulos, com medo dos judeus, se tinham ajuntado, chegou Jesus, e pôs-se no meio, e disse-lhes: Paz seja convosco.
text_el: Οὔσης οὖν ὀψίας τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ τῇ μιᾷ σαββάτων, καὶ τῶν θυρῶν κεκλεισμένων ὅπου ἦσαν οἱ μαθηταὶ διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἔστη εἰς τὸ μέσον, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: εἰρήνη ὑμῖν.

text_en: And when he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad, when they saw the Lord .
text_la: Et cum hoc dixisset, ostendit eis manus et latus. Gavisi sunt ergo discipuli, viso Domino.
text_pt: E, dizendo isto, mostrou-lhes as suas mãos e o lado. De sorte que os discípulos se alegraram, vendo o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἔδειξεν καὶ τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τὴν πλευρὰν αὐτοῖς. ἐχάρησαν οὖν οἱ μαθηταὶ ἰδόντες τὸν κύριον.

text_en: He said therefore to them again: Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, I also send you.
text_la: Dixit ergo eis iterum : Pax vobis. Sicut misit me Pater, et ego mitto vos.
text_pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus outra vez: Paz seja convosco; assim como o Pai me enviou, também eu vos envio a vós.
text_el: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς [ὁ Ἰησοῦς] πάλιν: εἰρήνη ὑμῖν: καθὼς ἀπέσταλκέν με ὁ πατήρ, κἀγὼ πέμπω ὑμᾶς.

text_en: When he had said this, he breathed on them; and he said to them: Receive the Holy Ghost .
text_la: Hæc cum dixisset, insufflavit, et dixit eis : Accipite Spiritum Sanctum:
text_pt: E, havendo dito isto, assoprou sobre eles e disse-lhes: Recebei o Espírito Santo.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἐνεφύσησεν καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς: λάβετε πνεῦμα ἅγιον.

text_en: Whose sins you shall forgive, they are forgiven them: and whose sins you shall retain, they are retained.
text_la: quorum remiseritis peccata, remittuntur eis : et quorum retinueritis, retenta sunt.
text_pt: «queles a quem perdoardes os pecados lhes são perdoados; e àqueles a quem os retiverdes lhes são retidos.
text_el: ἄν τινων ἀφῆτε τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἀφέωνται αὐτοῖς: ἄν τινων κρατῆτε, κεκράτηνται.

text_en: Now Thomas , one of the twelve, who is called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
text_la: Thomas autem unus ex duodecim, qui dicitur Didymus, non erat cum eis quando venit Jesus.
text_pt: Ora, Tomé, um dos doze, chamado Dídimo, não estava com eles quando veio Jesus.
text_el: Θωμᾶς δὲ εἷς ἐκ τῶν δώδεκα, ὁ λεγόμενος Δίδυμος, οὐκ ἦν μετ' αὐτῶν ὅτε ἦλθεν Ἰησοῦς.

text_en: The other disciples therefore said to him: We have seen the Lord. But he said to them: Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails and put my finger into the place of the nails and put my hand into his side, I will not believe .
text_la: Dixerunt ergo ei alii discipuli : Vidimus Dominum. Ille autem dixit eis : Nisi videro in manibus ejus fixuram clavorum, et mittam digitum meum in locum clavorum, et mittam manum meam in latus ejus, non credam.
text_pt: Disseram-lhe, pois, os outros discípulos: Vimos o Senhor. Mas ele disse-lhes: Se eu não vir o sinal dos cravos em suas mãos, e não puser o meu dedo no lugar dos cravos, e não puser a minha mão no seu lado, de maneira nenhuma o crerei.
text_el: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ οἱ ἄλλοι μαθηταί: ἑωράκαμεν τὸν κύριον. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: ἐὰν μὴ ἴδω ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ τὸν τύπον τῶν ἥλων καὶ βάλω τὸν δάκτυλόν μου εἰς τὸν τύπον τῶν ἥλων καὶ βάλω μου τὴν χεῖρα εἰς τὴν πλευρὰν αὐτοῦ, οὐ μὴ πιστεύσω.

text_en: And after eight days, again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them. Jesus comes, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst and said: Peace be to you.
text_la: Et post dies octo, iterum erant discipuli ejus intus, et Thomas cum eis. Venit Jesus januis clausis, et stetit in medio, et dixit : Pax vobis.
text_pt: E oito dias depois estavam outra vez os seus discípulos dentro, e com eles Tomé. Chegou Jesus, estando as portas fechadas, e apresentou-se no meio, e disse: Paz seja convosco.
text_el: καὶ μεθ' ἡμέρας ὀκτὼ πάλιν ἦσαν ἔσω οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ Θωμᾶς μετ' αὐτῶν. ἔρχεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῶν θυρῶν κεκλεισμένων, καὶ ἔστη εἰς τὸ μέσον καὶ εἶπεν: εἰρήνη ὑμῖν.

text_en: Then he said to Thomas : Put in your finger hither and see my hands. And bring hither the hand and put it into my side. And be not faithless, but believing .
text_la: Deinde dicit Thomæ : Infer digitum tuum huc, et vide manus meas, et affer manum tuam, et mitte in latus meum : et noli esse incredulus, sed fidelis.
text_pt: Depois disse a Tomé: Põe aqui o teu dedo, e vê as minhas mãos; e chega a tua mão, e põe-na no meu lado; e não sejas incrédulo, mas crente.
text_el: εἶτα λέγει τῷ Θωμᾷ: φέρε τὸν δάκτυλόν σου ὧδε καὶ ἴδε τὰς χεῖράς μου, καὶ φέρε τὴν χεῖρά σου καὶ βάλε εἰς τὴν πλευράν μου, καὶ μὴ γίνου ἄπιστος ἀλλὰ πιστός.

text_en: Thomas answered and said to him: My Lord and my God .
text_la: Respondit Thomas, et dixit ei : Dominus meus et Deus meus.
text_pt: E Tomé respondeu, e disse-lhe: Senhor meu, e Deus meu!
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη Θωμᾶς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: ὁ κύριός μου καὶ ὁ θεός μου.

text_en: Jesus said to him: Because you have seen me, Thomas , you have believed : blessed are they that have not seen and have believed .
text_la: Dixit ei Jesus : Quia vidisti me, Thoma, credidisti : beati qui non viderunt, et crediderunt.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Porque me viste, Tomé, creste; bem-aventurados os que não viram e creram.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: ὅτι ἑώρακάς με, πεπίστευκας; μακάριοι οἱ μὴ ἰδόντες καὶ πιστεύσαντες.

text_en: Many other signs also did Jesus in the sight of his disciples , which are not written in this book.
text_la: Multa quidem et alia signa fecit Jesus in conspectu discipulorum suorum, quæ non sunt scripta in libro hoc.
text_pt: Jesus, pois, operou também em presença de seus discípulos muitos outros sinais, que não estão escritos neste livro.
text_el: Πολλὰ μὲν οὖν καὶ ἄλλα σημεῖα ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐνώπιον τῶν μαθητῶν, ἃ οὐκ ἔστιν γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ:

text_en: But these are written, that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ , the Son of God : and that believing , you may have life in his name .
text_la: Hæc autem scripta sunt ut credatis, quia Jesus est Christus Filius Dei : et ut credentes, vitam habeatis in nomine ejus.
text_pt: Estes, porém, foram escritos para que creiais que Jesus é o Cristo, o Filho de Deus, e para que, crendo, tenhais vida em seu nome.
text_el: ταῦτα δὲ γέγραπται ἵνα πιστεύητε ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ ἵνα πιστεύοντες ζωὴν ἔχητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ.

text_en: After this, Jesus showed himself to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias . And he showed himself after this manner.
text_la: Postea manifestavit se iterum Jesus discipulis ad mare Tiberiadis. Manifestavit autem sic:
text_pt: Depois disto manifestou-se Jesus outra vez aos discípulos junto do mar de Tiberíades; e manifestou-se assim:
text_el: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἐφανέρωσεν ἑαυτὸν πάλιν Ἰησοῦς τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς Τιβεριάδος: ἐφανέρωσεν δὲ οὕτως.

text_en: There were together: Simon Peter and Thomas, who is called Didymus , and Nathanael , who was of Cana of Galilee , and the sons of Zebedee and two others of his disciples .
text_la: erant simul Simon Petrus, et Thomas, qui dicitur Didymus, et Nathanaël, qui erat a Cana Galilææ, et filii Zebedæi, et alii ex discipulis ejus duo.
text_pt: Estavam juntos Simão Pedro, e Tomé, chamado Dídimo, e Natanael, que era de Caná da Galiléia, os filhos de Zebedeu, e outros dois dos seus discípulos.
text_el: ἦσαν ὁμοῦ Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ Θωμᾶς ὁ λεγόμενος Δίδυμος καὶ Ναθαναὴλ ὁ ἀπὸ Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ οἱ τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ ἄλλοι ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ δύο.

text_en: Simon Peter says to them: I go a fishing. They say to him: We also come with you. And they went forth and entered into the ship: and that night they caught nothing.
text_la: Dicit eis Simon Petrus : Vado piscari. Dicunt ei : Venimus et nos tecum. Et exierunt, et ascenderunt in navim : et illa nocte nihil prendiderunt.
text_pt: Disse-lhes Simão Pedro: Vou pescar. Dizem-lhe eles: Também nós vamos contigo. Foram, e subiram logo para o barco, e naquela noite nada apanharam.
text_el: λέγει αὐτοῖς Σίμων Πέτρος: ὑπάγω ἁλιεύειν. λέγουσιν αὐτῷ: ἐρχόμεθα καὶ ἡμεῖς σὺν σοί. ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἐνέβησαν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ νυκτὶ ἐπίασαν οὐδέν.

text_en: But when the morning had come, Jesus stood on the shore: yet the disciples knew not that it was Jesus .
text_la: Mane autem facto stetit Jesus in littore: non tamen cognoverunt discipuli quia Jesus est.
text_pt: E, sendo já manhã, Jesus se apresentou na praia, mas os discípulos não conheceram que era Jesus.
text_el: πρωΐας δὲ ἤδη γινομένης ἔστη Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸν αἰγιαλόν: οὐ μέντοι ᾔδεισαν οἱ μαθηταὶ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν.

text_en: Jesus therefore said to them: Children, have you any meat? They answered him: No.
text_la: Dixit ergo eis Jesus : Pueri, numquid pulmentarium habetis? Responderunt ei : Non.
text_pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus: Filhos, tendes alguma coisa de comer? Responderam-lhe: Não.
text_el: λέγει οὖν αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς: παιδία, μή τι προσφάγιον ἔχετε; ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ: οὔ.

text_en: He says to them: Cast the net on the right side of the ship; and you shall find. They cast therefore: and now they were not able to draw it, for the multitude of fishes.
text_la: Dicit eis : Mittite in dexteram navigii rete, et invenietis. Miserunt ergo : et jam non valebant illud trahere præ multitudine piscium.
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Lançai a rede para o lado direito do barco, e achareis. Lançaram-na, pois, e já não a podiam tirar, pela multidão dos peixes.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς: βάλετε εἰς τὰ δεξιὰ μέρη τοῦ πλοίου τὸ δίκτυον, καὶ εὑρήσετε. ἔβαλον οὖν, καὶ οὐκέτι αὐτὸ ἑλκύσαι ἴσχυον ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους τῶν ἰχθύων.

text_en: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter : It is the Lord. Simon Peter , when he heard that it was the Lord, girt his coat about him (for he was naked) and cast himself into the sea.
text_la: Dixit ergo discipulus ille, quem diligebat Jesus, Petro : Dominus est. Simon Petrus cum audisset quia Dominus est, tunica succinxit se (erat enim nudus) et misit se in mare.
text_pt: Então aquele discípulo, a quem Jesus amava, disse a Pedro: É o Senhor. E, quando Simão Pedro ouviu que era o Senhor, cingiu-se com a túnica (porque estava nu) e lançou-se ao mar.
text_el: λέγει οὖν ὁ μαθητὴς ἐκεῖνος ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ Πέτρῳ: ὁ κύριός ἐστιν. Σίμων οὖν Πέτρος, ἀκούσας ὅτι ὁ κύριός ἐστιν, τὸν ἐπενδύτην διεζώσατο, ἦν γὰρ γυμνός, καὶ ἔβαλεν ἑαυτὸν εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν:

text_en: But the other disciples came in the ship (for they were not far from the land, but as it were two hundred cubits) dragging the net with fishes.
text_la: Alii autem discipuli navigio venerunt (non enim longe erant a terra, sed quasi cubitis ducentis), trahentes rete piscium.
text_pt: E os outros discípulos foram com o barco (porque não estavam distantes da terra senão quase duzentos côvados), levando a rede cheia de peixes.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἄλλοι μαθηταὶ τῷ πλοιαρίῳ ἦλθον, οὐ γὰρ ἦσαν μακρὰν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἀλλὰ ὡς ἀπὸ πηχῶν διακοσίων, σύροντες τὸ δίκτυον τῶν ἰχθύων.

text_en: As soon then as they came to land they saw hot coals lying, and a fish laid thereon, and bread.
text_la: Ut ergo descenderunt in terram, viderunt prunas positas, et piscem superpositum, et panem.
text_pt: Logo que desceram para terra, viram ali brasas, e um peixe posto em cima, e pão.
text_el: ὡς οὖν ἀπέβησαν εἰς τὴν γῆν, βλέπουσιν ἀνθρακιὰν κειμένην καὶ ὀψάριον ἐπικείμενον καὶ ἄρτον.

text_en: Jesus says to them: Bring hither of the fishes which you have now caught.
text_la: Dicit eis Jesus : Afferte de piscibus, quos prendidistis nunc.
text_pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Trazei dos peixes que agora apanhastes.
text_el: λέγει αὐτοῖς [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: ἐνέγκατε ἀπὸ τῶν ὀψαρίων ὧν ἐπιάσατε νῦν.

text_en: Simon Peter went up and drew the net to land, full of great fishes, one hundred and fifty-three. And although there were so many, the net was not broken.
text_la: Ascendit Simon Petrus et traxit rete in terram, plenum magnis piscibus centum quinquaginta tribus. Et cum tanti essent, non est scissum rete.
text_pt: Simão Pedro subiu e puxou a rede para terra, cheia de cento e cinqüenta e três grandes peixes e, sendo tantos, não se rompeu a rede.
text_el: ἀνέβη οὖν Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ εἵλκυσεν τὸ δίκτυον εἰς τὴν γῆν μεστὸν ἰχθύων μεγάλων ἑκατὸν πεντήκοντα τριῶν: καὶ τοσούτων ὄντων οὐκ ἐσχίσθη τὸ δίκτυον.

text_en: Jesus says to them: Come and dine. And none of them who were at meat, dared ask him: Who are you? Knowing that it was the Lord.
text_la: Dicit eis Jesus : Venite, prandete. Et nemo audebat discumbentium interrogare eum : Tu quis es? scientes, quia Dominus est.
text_pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Vinde, comei. E nenhum dos discípulos ousava perguntar-lhe: Quem és tu? sabendo que era o Senhor.
text_el: λέγει αὐτοῖς [ὁ] Ἰησοῦς: δεῦτε ἀριστήσατε. οὐδεὶς ἐτόλμα τῶν μαθητῶν ἐξετάσαι αὐτόν: σὺ τίς εἶ; εἰδότες ὅτι ὁ κύριός ἐστιν.

text_en: And Jesus comes and takes bread and gives them: and fish in like manner.
text_la: Et venit Jesus, et accipit panem, et dat eis, et piscem similiter.
text_pt: Chegou, pois, Jesus, e tomou o pão, e deu-lhes e, semelhantemente o peixe.
text_el: ἔρχεται Ἰησοῦς καὶ λαμβάνει τὸν ἄρτον καὶ δίδωσιν αὐτοῖς, καὶ τὸ ὀψάριον ὁμοίως.

text_en: This is now the third time that Jesus was manifested to his disciples , after he was risen from the dead.
text_la: Hoc jam tertio manifestatus est Jesus discipulis suis cum resurrexisset a mortuis.
text_pt: E já era a terceira vez que Jesus se manifestava aos seus discípulos, depois de ter ressuscitado dentre os mortos.
text_el: τοῦτο ἤδη τρίτον ἐφανερώθη Ἰησοῦς τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἐγερθεὶς ἐκ νεκρῶν.

text_en: When therefore they had dined, Jesus says to Simon Peter : Simon, son of John , do you love me more than these? He said to him: Yea, Lord, you know that I love you. He said to him: Feed my lambs.
text_la: Cum ergo prandissent, dicit Simoni Petro Jesus : Simon Joannis, diligis me plus his? Dicit ei : Etiam Domine, tu scis quia amo te. Dicit ei : Pasce agnos meos.
text_pt: E, depois de terem jantado, disse Jesus a Simão Pedro: Simão, filho de Jonas, amas-me mais do que estes? E ele respondeu: Sim, Senhor, tu sabes que te amo. Disse-lhe: Apascenta os meus cordeiros.
text_el: Ὅτε οὖν ἠρίστησαν, λέγει τῷ Σίμωνι Πέτρῳ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, Σίμων Ἰωάννου, ἀγαπᾷς με πλέον τούτων; λέγει αὐτῷ: ναί κύριε, σὺ οἶδας ὅτι φιλῶ σε. λέγει αὐτῷ: βόσκε τὰ ἀρνία μου.

text_en: He says to him again: Simon, son of John , do you love me? He said to him: yea, Lord, you know that I love you. He said to him: Feed my lambs.
text_la: Dicit ei iterum : Simon Joannis, diligis me? Ait illi : Etiam Domine, tu scis quia amo te. Dicit ei : Pasce agnos meos.
text_pt: Tornou a dizer-lhe segunda vez: Simão, filho de Jonas, amas-me? Disse-lhe: Sim, Senhor, tu sabes que te amo. Disse-lhe: Apascenta as minhas ovelhas.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ πάλιν δεύτερον: Σίμων Ἰωάννου, ἀγαπᾷς με; λέγει αὐτῷ: ναί κύριε, σὺ οἶδας ὅτι φιλῶ σε. λέγει αὐτῷ: ποίμαινε τὰ προβάτιά μου.

text_en: He said to him the third time: Simon, son of John , do you love me? Peter was grieved because he had said to him the third time: Do you love me? And he said to him: Lord, you know all things: you know that I love you. He said to him: Feed my sheep.
text_la: Dicit ei tertio : Simon Joannis, amas me? Contristatus est Petrus, quia dixit ei tertio : Amas me? et dixit ei : Domine, tu omnia nosti, tu scis quia amo te. Dixit ei : Pasce oves meas.
text_pt: Disse-lhe terceira vez: Simão, filho de Jonas, amas-me? Simão entristeceu-se por lhe ter dito terceira vez: Amas-me? E disse-lhe: Senhor, tu sabes tudo; tu sabes que eu te amo. Jesus disse-lhe: Apascenta as minhas ovelhas.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ τὸ τρίτον: Σίμων Ἰωάννου, φιλεῖς με; ἐλυπήθη ὁ Πέτρος ὅτι εἶπεν αὐτῷ τὸ τρίτον: φιλεῖς με; καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ: κύριε, πάντα σὺ οἶδας, σὺ γινώσκεις ὅτι φιλῶ σε. λέγει αὐτῷ: Ἰησοῦς βόσκε τὰ προβάτιά μου.

text_en: Amen , amen , I say to you, When you were younger, you girded yourself and walked where you would. But when you shall be old, you shall stretch forth your hands, and another shall gird you and lead you whither you would not.
text_la: Amen, amen dico tibi : cum esses junior, cingebas te, et ambulabas ubi volebas : cum autem senueris, extendes manus tuas, et alius te cinget, et ducet quo tu non vis.
text_pt: Na verdade, na verdade te digo que, quando eras mais moço, te cingias a ti mesmo, e andavas por onde querias; mas, quando já fores velho, estenderás as tuas mãos, e outro te cingirá, e te levará para onde tu não queiras.
text_el: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, ὅτε ἦς νεώτερος, ἐζώννυες σεαυτὸν καὶ περιεπάτεις ὅπου ἤθελες: ὅταν δὲ γηράσῃς, ἐκτενεῖς τὰς χεῖράς σου, καὶ ἄλλος ζώσει σε καὶ οἴσει ὅπου οὐ θέλεις.

text_en: And this he said, signifying by what death he should glorify God . And when he had said this, he said to him: Follow me.
text_la: Hoc autem dixit significans qua morte clarificaturus esset Deum. Et cum hoc dixisset, dicit ei : Sequere me.
text_pt: E disse isto, significando com que morte havia ele de glorificar a Deus. E, dito isto, disse-lhe: Segue-me.
text_el: τοῦτο δὲ εἶπεν σημαίνων ποίῳ θανάτῳ δοξάσει τὸν θεόν. καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν λέγει αὐτῷ: ἀκολούθει μοι.

text_en: Peter turning about, saw that disciple whom Jesus loved following, who also leaned on his breast at supper and said: Lord, who is he that shall betray you?
text_la: Conversus Petrus vidit illum discipulum, quem diligebat Jesus, sequentem, qui et recubuit in cœna super pectus ejus, et dixit : Domine, quis est qui tradet te?
text_pt: E Pedro, voltando-se, viu que o seguia aquele discípulo a quem Jesus amava, e que na ceia se recostara também sobre o seu peito, e que dissera: Senhor, quem é que te há de trair?
text_el: ἐπιστραφεὶς ὁ Πέτρος βλέπει τὸν μαθητὴν ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀκολουθοῦντα, ὃς καὶ ἀνέπεσεν ἐν τῷ δείπνῳ ἐπὶ τὸ στῆθος αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν: κύριε, τίς ἐστιν ὁ παραδιδούς σε;

text_en: Him therefore when Peter had seen, he says to Jesus : Lord, and what shall this man do?
text_la: Hunc ergo cum vidisset Petrus, dixit Jesu : Domine, hic autem quid?
text_pt: Vendo Pedro a este, disse a Jesus: Senhor, e deste que será?
text_el: τοῦτον οὖν ἰδὼν ὁ Πέτρος λέγει τῷ Ἰησοῦ: κύριε οὗτος δὲ τί;

text_en: Jesus said to him: So I will have him to remain till I come, what is it to you? Follow me.
text_la: Dicit ei Jesus : Sic eum volo manere donec veniam, quid ad te? tu me sequere.
text_pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Se eu quero que ele fique até que eu venha, que te importa a ti? Segue-me tu.
text_el: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς: ἐὰν αὐτὸν θέλω μένειν ἕως ἔρχομαι, τί πρὸς σέ; σύ μοι ἀκολούθει.

text_en: This saying therefore went abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die. And Jesus did not say to him: He should not die; but: So I will have him to remain till I come, what is it to you?
text_la: Exiit ergo sermo iste inter fratres quia discipulus ille non moritur. Et non dixit ei Jesus : Non moritur, sed : Sic eum volo manere donec veniam, quid ad te?
text_pt: Divulgou-se, pois, entre os irmãos este dito, que aquele discípulo não havia de morrer. Jesus, porém, não lhe disse que não morreria, mas: Se eu quero que ele fique até que eu venha, que te importa a ti?
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν οὖν οὗτος ὁ λόγος εἰς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὅτι ὁ μαθητὴς ἐκεῖνος οὐκ ἀποθνῄσκει: οὐκ εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι οὐκ ἀποθνῄσκει, ἀλλ': Ἐὰν αὐτὸν θέλω μένειν ἕως ἔρχομαι. τί πρὸς σέ

text_en: This is that disciple who gives testimony of these things and has written these things: and we know that his testimony is true .
text_la: Hic est discipulus ille qui testimonium perhibet de his, et scripsit hæc : et scimus quia verum est testimonium ejus.
text_pt: Este é o discípulo que testifica destas coisas e as escreveu; e sabemos que o seu testemunho é verdadeiro.
text_el: Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μαθητὴς ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ τούτων καὶ ὁ γράψας ταῦτα, καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀληθὴς αὐτοῦ ἡ μαρτυρία ἐστίν.

text_en: But there are also many other things which Jesus did which, if they were written every one, the world itself, I think, would not be able to contain the books that should be written.
text_la: Sunt autem et alia multa quæ fecit Jesus : quæ si scribantur per singula, nec ipsum arbitror mundum capere posse eos, qui scribendi sunt, libros.
text_pt: Há, porém, ainda muitas outras coisas que Jesus fez; e se cada uma das quais fosse escrita, cuido que nem ainda o mundo todo poderia conter os livros que se escrevessem. Amém.
text_el: ἔστιν δὲ καὶ ἄλλα πολλὰ ἃ ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἅτινα ἐὰν γράφηται καθ' ἕν οὐδ' αὐτὸν οἶμαι τὸν κόσμον χωρήσειν τὰ γραφόμενα βιβλία
